title: VOA 核心词汇
subtitle: 源自 VOA Learning English 官方 Word Book（美国国际媒体署），约 1500 核心词

defsEn: one
any
each
zh: 第一个字母 A; 一个; 第一的

defsEn: having the power to do something
zh: a. 能干的, 能够的
examples: You will not be able to catch the train.
He will not be able to do the work.
exampleZh: 你将无法赶上火车。
他没能力做这个工作。

defsEn: almost (“about half”)
of or having a relation to (“We talk about the weather.”)
zh: prep. 在...周围, 大约, 有关, 关于
adv. 大约, 四处, 在附近, 周围
examples: I think you need to think about the future.
Why do you go about being cross at people?
exampleZh: 我觉得你应该考虑到未来。
你为什么要骂人家？

defsEn: at a higher place
zh: prep. 在上方, 超出
adv. 在上面
a. 上述的, 上面的
examples: A clock must be above all correct.
Above all, you must take good care of yourself.
exampleZh: 一个时钟最重要的是准确。
最重要的是你要好好照顾自己。

defsEn: bad treatment causing harm or injury
zh: n. 滥用, 虐待, 恶习, 辱骂
vt. 滥用, 辱骂, 虐待
examples: How long, O Catiline, will you abuse our patience?
We can only abuse of things that are good.
exampleZh: 喀提林，你还会滥用我们的耐心多久呀？
我们只能滥用善良的。

defsEn: to agree to receive
zh: vt. 接受, 承认, 同意, 相信, 赞成, 承担, 承兑, 采纳, 接纳, 容忍
vi. 同意
examples: We must learn to accept the people around us.
People can accept praise more easily than criticism.
exampleZh: 嫁鸡随鸡嫁狗随狗。
赞扬比批评更容易让人接受。

defsEn: something that happens by chance or mistake
an unplanned event
zh: n. 意外事件, 机遇, 事故, 次要方面
examples: The accident almost cost him his life.
I found the book by accident.
exampleZh: 事故差点让他丢了性命。
我偶然发现了那本书。

defsEn: to say a person is responsible for an act or crime
to make a statement against someone
zh: vt. 指责, 控告, 归咎于
vi. 指责, 控告
examples: Why do you accuse my son?
She accused me of being a liar.
exampleZh: 你为什么指责我儿子？
她骂我是个骗子。

defsEn: from side to side
to the other side
zh: prep. 越过, 穿过, 与...相交叉, 在...的对面
adv. 交叉, 到另一边, 在对面, 成十字
examples: I saw him swim across the river.
We saw him walking across the street.
exampleZh: 我看见他游过了河。
我们看见他正在过马路。。

defsEn: to do something
zh: n. 行动, 行为, 幕, 法案
vi. 行动, 表演, 假装, 见效, 表现, 担当
vt. 扮演, 装作
examples: We should always act in obedience to the law.
Now is the time to act.
exampleZh: 我们无论如何也应该遵守法律。
现在是行动的时候了。

defsEn: one who seeks change through action
zh: n. 激进主义分子
examples: Cyber activists want to meet with the Supreme Leader.
Tom is an activist in his community.
exampleZh: 网络积极分子想跟最高领袖见面。
汤姆是社群中的积极分子。

defsEn: someone acting in a play or show
zh: n. 男演员, 行动者
examples: Do you want to be an actor in a movie?
To tell the truth, that actor is married.
exampleZh: 你想成为一名电影演员吗？
其实那个演员已经结婚了。

defsEn: to put (something) with another to make it larger
to say more
zh: vt. 增加, 添加, 附带说明, 计算...总和
vi. 做加法, 积累而成, 增添
examples: Your presence adds a special touch to any gathering.
Wax adds a look of depth to any finish.

defsEn: the executive part of a government, usually headed by a president or prime minister
zh: n. 行政, 管理, 政府机关
examples: I have to call the administration department.
The heat is on the administration to come up with a new policy.

defsEn: to accept (“admitted to the United Nations”)
to express one’s guilt or responsibility (“He admitted that what he did was wrong.”)
zh: vt. 承认, 接受, 允许进入, 容许
vi. 开向, 容许, 承认
examples: I admit that this may not be the best way of doing it.
I admit this may not be the best way of doing it.
exampleZh: 我承认这可能不是最好的方法。
我承认这可能不是最好的方法。

defsEn: a grown person
zh: n. 成人, 成虫
a. 成年的, 成熟的
examples: This person is new to being an adult.
And yet, in the "real adult world" there are a lot of competitions.
exampleZh: 此人涉世不深。
但是，在「真实的大人世界」里是有很多竞争的。

defsEn: to show or present the qualities of a product to increase sales
zh: vt. 做广告, 通知, 公布
vi. 做广告
examples: I advertised my house in the newspaper.
I advertised my car for sale.
exampleZh: 我在报纸上刊登了我的房子的广告。
我登广告卖我的车。

defsEn: to help with information, knowledge or ideas in making a decision
zh: vt. 劝告, 给...出主意, 通知, 建议
vi. 提意见, 商量
examples: I advise you never to live beyond your income.
I advise you to give up drinking.
exampleZh: 我建议你永远不要入不敷出。
我劝你戒酒。

defsEn: to produce an effect on
to influence (“A lack of sleep affected the singer’s performance.”)
zh: vt. 影响, 感动, 假装, 模仿, 爱好, 倾向于
n. 自觉感情
examples: The bad weather affected his health.
Imagination affects every part of our lives.
exampleZh: 恶劣的天气对他的健康带来了影响。
想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。

defsEn: feeling fear
zh: a. 害怕的, 恐怕的, 遗憾的
examples: I'm afraid that I differ with you on this point.
He said that he was afraid it would be rainy.
exampleZh: 恐怕就这点上，我和你持不同意见。
他说他怕天会下雨。

defsEn: later
behind
zh: prep. 在...之后, 由于
conj. 在...之后
adv. 后来
examples: You must be tired after such a long trip.
You should look after the children from time to time.
exampleZh: 在这么长程的旅途后你一定很累了。
你应该偶尔照顾孩子。

defsEn: another time
as before
zh: adv. 再一次, 又, 到原处

defsEn: opposed to
not agreeing with something
zh: prep. 反对, 对着, 倚靠
examples: He hit his head against a rock.
You may be right, but I am against your opinion.
exampleZh: 他的头撞到了一块岩石。
你可能是对的，但我和你意见相反。

defsEn: how old a person or thing is
zh: n. 年龄, 老年, 成年, 寿命, 时代, 时期
v. 变老, 成熟
examples: By what age would you like to get married?
At what age do you want to get married?
exampleZh: 你想到几岁才结婚呢？
你想到几岁才结婚呢？

defsEn: an organization that is part of a larger group (“an agency of the United Nations”)
zh: n. 代理机构, 经销商, 中介
examples: I work in a travel agency.
I work at a travel agency.
exampleZh: 我在旅行社工作.
我在旅行社工作.

defsEn: an attack against a person or country
the violation of a country’s borders
zh: n. 侵犯, 侵略
examples: As North Korea displays aggression, South Korea concentrates its forces near the border.
People who are prone to aggression can be dangerous.
exampleZh: 韩国随着朝鲜的外患而在边界附近集结军队。

defsEn: of time past
before now
zh: adv. 以前
examples: A long time ago, there lived an old king on a small island.
Long, long ago, there lived an old man in a village.
exampleZh: 很久很久以前，在一座小岛上，住着一个老国王。
很久、很久以前，有一个村子，里面住了一个老人。

defsEn: to have the same belief as someone
to be willing to do something
zh: vi. 同意, 赞成, 应允, 适合
vt. 承认, 认定, 同意
examples: I agree with what you say to some extent.
I do not agree with you at all.
exampleZh: 在某种程度上，我认同你所说的。
我完全不赞成你的意见。

defsEn: farming
zh: n. 农业
examples: Agriculture consumes a great amount of water.
Knowledge of agriculture can enable people to become self-sufficient.
exampleZh: 农业需要消耗大量的水。

defsEn: to help
to support
n. help, assistance
zh: n. 帮助, 外援, 助手
vt. 援助, 帮助, 有助于
vi. 帮助
examples: He put a Band-Aid on his hand.
She aided her daughter in dressing.
exampleZh: 他在手上贴了一块胶布。
她帮她女儿穿好衣服。

defsEn: to point a gun at
n. a goal or purpose
zh: n. 目标, 瞄准, 击中目标的能力
vi. 对准目标, 致力, 打算
vt. 瞄准
应用接口模块, 医学人工智能, 相联索引法, 异步接口模块
自动化信息管理, 自动化综合制造, 自动化库存管理
examples: I aim to be a doctor when I grow up.
Wish big, aim high, be gentle, be careful.
exampleZh: 我长大了想当医生。
愿要大、志要坚、气要柔、心要细。

defsEn: the mixture of gases around the earth, mostly nitrogen and oxygen, that we breathe
zh: n. 空气, 旋律, 态度
vt. 晾, 使通风, 夸耀
examples: A change of air will do you a lot of good.
Without air there can be no wind or sound on the moon.
exampleZh: 改变环境将对你有很多好处。
月球表面没有空气，所以没有风，也没有声音。

defsEn: a vehicle with wings that flies airplane
zh: n. 飞机
examples: He is afraid to fly in an airplane.
The airplane took off on time.
exampleZh: 他怕坐飞机。
这班飞机准时起飞。

defsEn: a place where airplanes take off and land
zh: n. 飞机场
examples: Where do I get an airport bus?
I have to go to the airport to meet my family.
exampleZh: 我能在哪里乘上机场巴士？
我要去机场迎接我的家人。

defsEn: a collection of recorded music
zh: n. 粘贴簿, 唱片套
examples: There is an album on the shelf.
Will you show me your photo album?
exampleZh: 架上放着一本相簿。
你能让我看看你的相簿吗？

defsEn: a strong, colorless liquid, usually made from grain, used in drinks or in industrial products
zh: n. 酒精, 酒
examples: What kind of alcohol do you like to drink?
I could smell the alcohol on his breath.
exampleZh: 你为什么不喜欢喝酒？
我能闻到他呼吸中的酒精味。

defsEn: having life
not dead
zh: a. 活着的, 活泼的, 敏感的, 热闹的
examples: If she was still alive, she would be able to help me.
I owe it you that I am still alive.
exampleZh: 如果她还活着的话，现在能帮我。
多亏了你，我还活着。

defsEn: everything
everyone
the complete amount
zh: a. 所有的, 全部的, 一切的
adv. 全部, 全然
pron. 全部
n. 全部
examples: You have to put up with all this noise.
Would you all like to drink fruit juice or water?
exampleZh: 你必须忍受这一切的噪音了。
各位想喝果汁还是水？

defsEn: a nation or person joined with another for a special purpose
zh: n. 同盟者, 同盟国, 助手
vt. 使联盟, 使联合, 使有关系
vi. 结盟
examples: Germany was once an ally of Italy.
Ally loves playing with her twin sister Anne.
exampleZh: 德国曾是意大利的同盟国。
Ally喜欢和她的双胞胎妹妹Anne一起玩。

defsEn: a little less than completely
zh: adv. 几乎, 差不多
examples: The child almost hurt the small dog.
I take a bath almost every day.
exampleZh: 小孩差点伤到了小狗。
我几乎每天洗澡。

defsEn: separated from others
zh: a. 孤独的, 单独的, 独自的
adv. 独自地
examples: She left her son alone in the car.
I want to talk to you alone.
exampleZh: 她把她儿子忘在车里。
我想单独和你聊聊。

defsEn: near or on (“along the road”)
zh: adv. 平行地, 向前
prep. 沿着
examples: Go along this street and turn right at the bank.
I always get along well with him.
exampleZh: 请沿着这条路走，在银行那里向右转。
我跟他总是相处得很好。

defsEn: before now
even now
zh: adv. 已经, 早已
examples: I already want to read them.
I already know what you want!
exampleZh: 我已经想要读一读了。
我已经知道你想要什么！

defsEn: added to
too
zh: adv. 也, 并且, 同样地
examples: She can also speak a little bit of French.
I also know how to cook.
exampleZh: 她也会讲一点法语。
我也会做饭。

defsEn: even if it is true that
zh: conj. 虽然, 尽管
examples: Although he may be clever, he is not wise.
Although old, he is still very much alive.
exampleZh: 他只不过是有点小聪明。
虽然上了年纪，他依旧充满活力。

defsEn: at all times
every time
zh: adv. 总是, 始终
examples: When in a bus, I always sit at the front.
I always have a look at the newspaper before breakfast.
exampleZh: 在巴士里，我总是坐在前面。
我经常在早饭前看一眼报纸。

defsEn: a nation’s highest diplomatic representative (to another government)
zh: n. 大使
examples: I have spoken with the Polish ambassador.
I talked with the Polish ambassador.
exampleZh: 我和波兰大使说了话。
我和波兰大使说了话。

defsEn: to add to or to change. (a proposal or law)
zh: vt. 修改, 改善, 改良
vi. 改过自新
examples: I want to make amends for my behavior.
He will make amends for the damage.

defsEn: the bullets or shells fired from guns
zh: n. 军火, 弹药
examples: How much more ammunition do you need?
How did live ammunition get on set, anyway?

defsEn: in or part of (a group)
zh: prep. 在...之中
examples: She's not among the regular employees of this company.
He believes that there is a spy among us.
exampleZh: 她不是这间公司正式的职员。
他认为我们当中有一个奸细。

defsEn: the number, size or weight of anything
zh: n. 总数, 总额
vi. 总计, 等同
examples: I have a certain amount of money on me.
The amount of time spent asleep can vary from person to person.
exampleZh: 我有些钱。
睡眠时间的长短可因人而异。

defsEn: a lack of order
lawlessness
zh: n. 无政府状态, 政治混乱
examples: The country was in a state of anarchy at that time.
Anarchy is the mother of order.

defsEn: a family member from the past
zh: n. 祖先, 祖宗
examples: You carry the strength of your ancestors within you.
We rise with the courage of our ancestors.

defsEn: very old
long ago
zh: a. 古代的, 古老的, 年老的, 旧的
examples: I wish I could see the ancient world.
What is this word's ancient pronunciation?
exampleZh: 我真想看看古代的世界是怎样的。
这个字的古音是什么？

defsEn: also
in addition to
with
zh: conj. 和, 与

defsEn: a strong emotion against someone or something
zh: n. 忿怒
vt. 激怒, 使发怒
vi. 发怒
examples: Anger me again, I might just peel your skin off.
Bob could not control his anger.
exampleZh: 再惹我生气，小心我扒了你的皮！
鲍勃无法控制他的愤怒。

defsEn: a living creature that moves, such as a dog or cat
zh: n. 动物
examples: What do you call this animal in Japanese?
I know the name of this animal.
exampleZh: 这种动物日语叫什么名字？
我知道这种动物的名字。

defsEn: a yearly celebration or observance of an event that happened in the past
zh: n. 周年纪念
examples: We celebrated our anniversary with my brother-in-law and his family.
It's the anniversary of the end of the war.

defsEn: to make known publicly
to declare officially
zh: vt. 宣布, 声称, 显示, 预告
vi. 当报幕员, 宣布参加竞选
examples: He announced that he would come at once and investigate the matter.
Tom ran as fast as he could to announce the good news to Mary.
exampleZh: 他宣布他将立刻来调查此事。
汤姆以最快的速度跑着，好向玛丽宣布好消息。

defsEn: one more
a different one
zh: a. 另外的, 再一的, 不同的
pron. 又一个, 另一个, 类似的另一个
examples: I would like to have another cup of coffee.
Would you care for another cup of coffee?
exampleZh: 我想再要一杯咖啡。
再来一杯咖啡怎么样？

defsEn: a statement produced by a question
v. to make a statement after being asked a question
zh: n. 答案, 回答, 回报, 答辩
vt. 回答, 反驳, 适应, 响应, 符合
vi. 回答, 答应, 负责, 符合, 成功
examples: I wonder if I should answer his letter.
You have only to answer the first question.
exampleZh: 我应该回信给他吗？
你只需要回答头一个问题。

defsEn: special proteins produced in the blood that kill harmful bacteria
zh: n. 抗体（antibody的复数）
examples: Antibodies give a new lease of life.
Antibodies are a key part of the immune system.

defsEn: one or more of no special kind
zh: a. 任何的
pron. 任何
examples: Do you have any idea who would do this?
Do you know of any good restaurant near here?
exampleZh: 你觉得这事是谁干的？
你知道这儿附近有什么好餐馆吗?

defsEn: to express regret for a mistake or accident for which one accepts responsibility
zh: vi. 道歉, 辩解
examples: I think that you ought to apologize to her.
You should apologize to her for being rude.
exampleZh: 我认为你应该跟她道歉。
你应该为你的粗鲁向她道歉。

defsEn: to take to a higher court, person or group for a decision
to call on somebody for help
zh: n. 恳求, 诉请, 上诉, 吸引力
vi. 呼吁, 诉请, 要求, 上诉, 有吸引力
vt. 将...上诉
examples: His music and words appeal to young people.
We made an appeal for support.
exampleZh: 他的曲和词都很受年轻人欢迎。
我们提出了请求支持的呼吁。

defsEn: to show oneself
to come into sight
to seem
zh: vi. 出现, 显得, 来到
examples: The king will appear in person tomorrow evening.
What you think of in the day, appears in your dream at night.
exampleZh: 国王明晚会亲自出现。
日有所思，夜有所梦。

defsEn: to name
to choose. (“appoint a judge”)
zh: vt. 任命, 指定, 下令
examples: They appointed him as a director.
The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
exampleZh: 他们任命他为经理。
董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。

defsEn: to agree with
to agree to support
zh: vt. 赞同, 核准, 为...提供证据
vi. 赞许
examples: I cannot approve of your going out with him.
Do you approve of what he is doing?
exampleZh: 我不能让你和他出去。
他做的事情你赞成的吧？

defsEn: the scientific study of past human life and activities
zh: 考古学
examples: I study at the Faculty of Archeology in Tbilisi State University.
Archeology is the science that studies the remnants of human civilization.

defsEn: any place or part of it
zh: n. 区域, 面积, 范围, 空地
examples: Please find the area of the triangle.
I know this area pretty well.
exampleZh: 求三角形的面积
我很了解这地方。

defsEn: to offer reasons for or against something
to dispute
to disagree
zh: vi. 提出理由, 争论, 辩论
vt. 主张, 辩论, 证明, 说服
examples: Tom and Mary argue with each other all the time.
After they argued, they didn't speak to each other for a week.
exampleZh: 汤姆和玛丽无时无刻不在辩论。
他们争吵后，一周都没有再说话。

defsEn: military equipment
weapons
zh: n. 武器, 军事行动
examples: He had a big box in his arms.
She held her baby in her arms.
exampleZh: 他抱着一个大箱子。
她把她的孩子抱在怀里。

defsEn: military ground forces
zh: n. 军队, 陆军
examples: He joined the Army during the war.
An army marches on its stomach.
exampleZh: 他在战时参军。
胃里如同千军万马开过。

defsEn: on every side (of)
zh: prep. 包围, 在...周围, 四处
adv. 兜着圈子, 在附近, 到处
examples: I would like to travel around the world.
Let me show you around our house.
exampleZh: 我想环游世界。
让我带你四处看看我们的房子。

defsEn: to seize a person for legal action
to take as a prisoner
zh: n. 逮捕, 监禁
vt. 拘捕, 抑制, 吸引, 阻止
examples: The police officer arrested the burglar.
Instead of him, my brother was arrested.
exampleZh: 警官逮捕了窃贼。
我的兄弟被捕了而不是他。

defsEn: to come to a place, especially at the end of a trip
zh: vi. 到达, 抵达
examples: The letter will arrive in a week or so.
The train will arrive on time without fail.
exampleZh: 这封信约一个星期左右到达。
我保证火车会准时来。

defsEn: expressions or creations by humans, such as paintings, music, writing or statues art
zh: n. 艺术, 人文科学, 技术, 巧妙, 诡计, 美术
examples: Do you think art can change the world?
I would rather go to the art museum than to the movie theater.
exampleZh: 你觉得，艺术能改变世界吗？
我想去美术馆胜过去电影院。

defsEn: big guns
zh: n. 火炮, 炮兵, 炮术
examples: The enemy entered the artillery range.
The artillery is placed in a clearing.

defsEn: equally (“as fast as”)
when
while
zh: adv. 同样地, 例如
prep. 做为, 当作
conj. 当...之时, 以...的方式, 像...一样, 因为

defsEn: the part left after something burns
zh: n. 灰, 灰烬
examples: Grandmother's ashes are in an urn at the temple.
Our school was reduced to ashes.
exampleZh: 祖母的骨灰在寺院的骨灰瓮里。
我们的学校被烧成了灰烬。

defsEn: to question
to say something is wanted (“We ask the teacher questions every day.”)
zh: vi. 问, 要求
vt. 问, 要求, 邀请, 需要
examples: May I ask you for your name and address?
May I ask, can I open a bank account?
exampleZh: 我能问一下您的姓名和住址吗？
请问，我可以开户头吗?

defsEn: to help
zh: n. 帮助, 协助
vt. 帮助, 促进
vi. 协助, 参加
examples: I would like you to assist me with my gardening.
I'll be able to assist you.
exampleZh: 我想请你帮我整理花园。
我能协助你。

defsEn: a person who travels in space
zh: n. 太空旅行者, 宇航员
examples: Spacesuits protect astronauts from being injured from impacts of small bits of space dust.
The word astronaut means "star sailor" in Latin.
exampleZh: 宇航服保护宇航员们不会因和微小宇宙尘埃碰撞而受伤。

defsEn: the scientific study of stars and the universe astronaut
zh: n. 天文学
examples: Astronomy is at the same time the most ancient and the most modern science.
He is an expert in astronomy.
exampleZh: 天文学同时是最古老也最现代的科学。
他是个天文学专家。

defsEn: political protection given by a government to a person from another country
zh: n. 庇护, 收容所
examples: They built an asylum for the blind.
The asylum seeker was finally able to speak to a lawyer.

defsEn: in or near (“at the edge”)
where (“look at”)
when (“at noon”)
zh: prep. 在, 向, 对

defsEn: the gases surrounding any star or planet
zh: n. 大气, 空气, 气氛
examples: There was a different kind of atmosphere in the headquarters.
I like the atmosphere of this restaurant.
exampleZh: 总部里有另外一种气氛。

defsEn: a very small part of all things
the smallest part of an element that can join with parts of other elements
zh: n. 原子, 核能, 微粒, 微量
examples: To see an atom, you need a special microscope.
An hydrogen atom only has one proton and one electron.

defsEn: to tie together
to connect
zh: vt. 附上, 使依附, 使附属, 使喜爱, 系, 缚
vi. 附属, 归属, 联系在一起
examples: You need to attach your photo to the application form.
I forgot to attach a stamp to the envelope.
exampleZh: 你必须把你的照片贴在申请书上。
我忘记在信封上贴邮票了。

defsEn: a violent attempt to damage, injure or kill
v. to start a fight
zh: n. 攻击, 抨击
vt. 攻击, 抨击, 动手干
vi. 攻击
examples: The enemy made a strong attack on that building.
He died of a heart attack on the stage.
exampleZh: 敌人对那栋建筑物使出了强力攻击。
他是在舞台上心脏病发死的。

defsEn: to work toward something
to try
to make an effort
zh: n. 尝试, 企图
vt. 尝试, 企图
examples: What would you attempt to do if you knew you could not fail?
They attempted to break through the enemy line.
exampleZh: 如果你有一次绝对不会失败的机会，你会选择做什么事情呢？
他们试图冲破敌军防线。

defsEn: to be present at
zh: vt. 参加, 照料, 伴随
vi. 专心于, 照顾, 服侍, 出席
examples: Like it or not, we have to attend that meeting.
Ask him if he will attend the meeting.
exampleZh: 不管喜不喜欢，我们都得参加那个会议。
问他会不会来参加会议。

defsEn: close or careful observing of, or listening to, someone or something (“The student paid attention to his teacher.”)
zh: n. 注意, 注意力
examples: You should pay attention to what he says.
You must pay attention to his advice.
exampleZh: 你得注意他说的话。
你一定要注意他的建议。

defsEn: a vehicle with wheels used to carry people
a car
zh: n. 汽车
examples: In the United States the automobile is a necessity and not a luxury.
He got killed in an automobile accident.
exampleZh: 在美国，汽车并不是奢华的象征，而是生活的必需品。
他死于一场车祸。

defsEn: the time of the year between summer and winter
zh: n. 秋天, 成熟期
examples: In autumn, some animals store food away for the winter.
On Mid-Autumn Day, families gather, eat moon cake together, and watch the moon.
exampleZh: 有些动物会在秋天为冬季储藏食物。
在中秋节，家人团聚，一起吃月饼、赏月。

defsEn: present and ready for use
willing to serve or help. (“There was a list of available candidates.”)
zh: a. 可利用的, 可获得的, 有效的
examples: This book is available at one shop only.
There is a position available for a secretary.
exampleZh: 只有一家商店卖这本书。
有一个做秘书的空缺职位。

defsEn: something (a number) representing the middle
ad. common
normal
zh: n. 平均, 平均数, 一般水平, 海损
a. 平均的, 中等的, 平常的
vt. 算出...平均数, 平均做, 均分, 使平衡
vi. 平均为, 呈中间色
examples: On average, I watch two films a month.
What is the average height of the players?
exampleZh: 我平均每月看两部电影。
选手们的平均身高是多少？

defsEn: to stay away from
zh: vt. 避免, 防止, 撤消
examples: We must avoid war at all cost.
Why do you always avoid that topic?
exampleZh: 我们应该不惜代价避免战争。
你为什么总是逃避这个话题？

defsEn: not sleeping
zh: a. 醒着的
vt. 唤醒, 唤起, 使意识到
vi. 醒来, 被唤起, 意识到
examples: Take care not to awake the sleeping baby.
You think you're awake, but you may, in fact, be dreaming.
exampleZh: 小心不要弄醒了正在睡觉的婴儿。
你以为自己醒着，但其实你可能是在做梦。

defsEn: an honor or prize for an act or service
zh: n. 奖品, 裁定, 判决
vt. 授予, 给予
examples: They awarded her first prize at the art exhibition.
He was awarded a grant to study in Germany.
exampleZh: 他们在画展上授予了她一等奖。
他获得了一份去德国留学的奖学金。

defsEn: not near
zh: adv. 离去
examples: Go away before they see you here.
I thought I told you to stay away from my computer.
exampleZh: 在他们看见你之前离开这儿。
我说过让你离我的电脑远一点的。

defsEn: a newly born creature
zh: n. 婴孩
examples: The baby fell asleep in the cradle.
He saved the baby at the cost of his life.
exampleZh: 宝宝在摇篮里入睡了。
他救了那个婴儿，但是却牺牲了自己的生命。

defsEn: the part behind the front
ad. the other way from forward
zh: a. 后面的
vt. 使后退, 支持
vi. 倒退, 背靠
adv. 向后地
n. 背部, 后面
examples: Please come back home as soon as you can.
She said she must come back before dusk.
exampleZh: 请尽快回家。
她说她黄昏之前必须回来。

defsEn: living things that are one cell and can be seen only through a microscope
some cause disease
zh: pl. 细菌
examples: Bacteria are so small that they cannot be seen with the naked eye.
You must make the bacteria inside you happy.
exampleZh: 细菌微小到无法用肉眼看到。

defsEn: wrong
acting against the law
not good
zh: a. 坏的
n. 坏
adv. 坏地
examples: I have a bit of bad news.
I have a bad headache today.
exampleZh: 我有个坏消息。
今天我头痛欲裂。

defsEn: to make two sides or forces equal
zh: n. 平衡, 差额
vi. 平衡, 相等
vt. 称, 权衡, 比较, 使平衡, 结算, 抵消
examples: The balance of public opinion remains in his favor.
Due to a lack of balance the ship turned over.
exampleZh: 公众意见的平衡仍是他的关切。
那艘船失去平衡，翻了过来。

defsEn: something round ball
zh: n. 球, 舞会, 球状物
v. 捏成球形
examples: Could you give me a ball-park figure?
He hit the ball with his racket.
exampleZh: 您能估计一下数量吗？
他用他的球拍击球。

defsEn: a device of strong, light material that rises when filled with gas lighter than air
zh: n. 气球
vt. 使成气球状
vi. 膨胀如气球, 激增
examples: The balloon was caught in the tree.
Our hot-air balloon rose into the sky.
exampleZh: 这颗气球被树绊住了。

defsEn: a piece of paper used for voting
zh: n. 投票, 投票用纸, 抽签
vi. 投票, 抽签
vt. 投票选出, 拉选票
examples: The ballot paper must be put into an envelope.
Today we went to the ballot box to vote for the European Parliament.

defsEn: to not permit
to stop
n. an official restriction
zh: n. 禁令
vt. 禁止, 取缔
examples: We need to band together to beat the enemy.
There's a band at my school.
exampleZh: 我们必须团结起来才能战胜敌人。
我的学校里有个乐队。

defsEn: an organization that keeps and lends money
zh: n. 银行, 堤, 岸
examples: I have to go to the bank.
She put the money in the bank.
exampleZh: 我必须到银行去。
她把钱存在银行里。

defsEn: to prevent or block
zh: n. 条, 棒, 酒吧, 栅, 障碍物
vt. 禁止, 阻挡, 妨碍
examples: If you did that, they'd kick you out of the bar.
I bared my soul to her.
exampleZh: 你那么干会被人踢出酒吧的。
我跟她说了心里话。

defsEn: anything that blocks or makes an action difficult
zh: n. 障碍, 栅栏
examples: Trade barriers were lifted after the war ended.
I want to maintain a barrier around my heart.
exampleZh: 战争结束之后贸易障碍被解除。

defsEn: a military center
v. to establish as a fact (“Her research was based on experiments.”)
zh: n. 底部, 垒, 基础, 基地
vt. 以...作基础
a. 卑鄙的, 低劣的
examples: What do you base your theory on?
This city lies at the base of a mountain.
exampleZh: 你的理论是以什么为基础?
这座城市位于山脚下。

defsEn: a fight between opposing armed forces
zh: n. 战役
v. 战斗
examples: They all died in the battle.
We have already won this battle.
exampleZh: 他们都战死了。
我们已经赢得了这场战斗。

defsEn: to live
to happen
to exist
zh: v. 是, 表示, 在

defsEn: to hit again and again
zh: n. 心跳(声), 打, 敲打声, 拍子
v. 打, 拍打, 打败
a. 疲乏的, 颓废的
beat的过去式
examples: The rain beats against the window pane.
My heart began to beat fast.
exampleZh: 雨滴敲打窗户玻璃。
我的心开始快速跳动。

defsEn: that which pleases the eye, ear or spirit
zh: n. 美, 美人
examples: She will be a beauty when she grows up.
There is no doubt as to her beauty.
exampleZh: 她长大后一定会是个美人。
她的美貌是毫无疑问的。

defsEn: for the reason that (“He left because he was sick.”)
zh: conj. 因为
examples: She should be there now because she left an hour ago.
It is not because I hate him, but because I love him.
exampleZh: 她是在一个小时前出发的，所以现在应该已经到了。
这并不是因为我恨他，相反我爱他。

defsEn: to come to be
zh: vi. 变成, 变得
vt. 适合
examples: Why do you want to become a nurse?
We will become happy in the long run.
exampleZh: 你为什么想成为护士呢？
我们最终都会获得幸福的。

defsEn: a sleeping place
zh: n. 床, 睡眠处, 河床, 底座, 路基, 一层
vt. 提供宿处, 栽种, 安装
vi. 睡, 形成坚实的一层
examples: I need to go to bed early tonight.
I have to stay in bed all day.
exampleZh: 我今晚需要早点睡。
我不得不一整天都待在床上。

defsEn: earlier
zh: prep. 在...之前
conj. 在...之前
adv. 在前
examples: Turn off the light before you go to bed.
Before I leave, I would like to see you.
exampleZh: 上床之前关灯。
离开之前，我想见见你。

defsEn: to do the first part of an action
to start
zh: v. 开始
examples: If we begin early, we can finish by lunch.
If you begin to look at it more closely, actually, it is not.
exampleZh: 如果我们早点开始的话，就能在午饭时间之前完成。
如果细究起来，实则不然。

defsEn: the way in which a person or animal acts (“The child’s behavior was bad because he fought with other children.”)
zh: 作，行为；性能，特性，品质；状态，工况，运行情况
examples: Such behavior can cause an accident.
This behavior shows a lack of respect for the performance.
exampleZh: 这种行为可能造成意外。
这种行为是对演出的不尊重。

defsEn: at the back of
in back of
zh: adv. 在后地
prep. 在...背后
examples: He shut the door behind him.
You can park behind the hotel.
exampleZh: 他把门闩上。
你们可以把车停到旅馆背后。

defsEn: to think
to feel sure of
to accept as true
to trust
zh: v. 相信
examples: Whether you believe it or not, I believe it.
They believe in a life after death.
exampleZh: 至于你信不信，由你，我反正信了。
他们相信来世。

defsEn: to be owned by
to be a member of
zh: vi. 属于, 合适
examples: I belong to the drama club.
Do you know who this belongs to?
exampleZh: 我参加戏剧社。
这是谁的你知道吗？

defsEn: lower than
zh: prep. 在下面
adv. 在下面
examples: Concerning the content below, I want to verify two things.
The temperature has fallen below zero this morning.
exampleZh: 关于下面的内容，我想确认两件事情。
今天早上温度降到了零下。

defsEn: the most good
zh: a. 最好的
adv. 最好地
n. 最好的人
examples: We will do our best to help you.
If you do your best, you will succeed.
exampleZh: 我们会尽力帮助你。
如果你尽力而为, 你就会成功。

defsEn: to turn against
to be false to
zh: vt. 出卖, 背叛, 辜负, 暴露
examples: A true gentleman would not betray his friends.
Afraid of losing his life, he has to betray his organization.
exampleZh: 一个真正的绅士不会出卖他的朋友。
他害怕牺牲生命，不得不出卖组织。

defsEn: more good than
zh: a. 较好的
adv. 比较好
examples: It would be better if you would eat more.
You ought to know better at your age.
exampleZh: 如果你吃的多一点，你将会比现在好一点
在你这个年纪你应该要更懂事。

defsEn: in the space or time that separates
from one to the other (“talks between two nations”)
zh: prep. 在...之间
examples: I can choose between tea and coffee.
Between you and me, he's in trouble with the boss.
exampleZh: 我有茶和咖啡这两个选择。
他和老板有矛盾，这个我们知道就好。

defsEn: of great size
not small
zh: a. 大的, 重要的
adv. 大量地
examples: People living in a big city tend to lack exercise.
A big tree fell in the storm.
exampleZh: 住在大城市的人们一般都缺乏锻炼。
一棵大树在暴风中倒下。

defsEn: a legislative proposal
zh: n. 帐单, 清单, 钞票, 鸟嘴, 广告, 法案, 票据
vt. 开帐单, (用招贴)宣布
examples: Put it on one bill, please.
The bill will never go through.
exampleZh: 请记在一张帐单上。
该法案将永远不会通过。

defsEn: the scientific study of life or living things in all their forms
zh: n. 生物学
examples: She'll write a book on biology.
He's a professor of biology at Harvard.
exampleZh: 她将写一本关于生物学的书。
他是哈佛大学的生物学教授。

defsEn: a creature that flies
zh: n. 鸟, 羽毛球
vi. 打鸟
examples: She set the bird free from the cage.
What do you call this bird?
exampleZh: 她把小鸟从笼子里释放出来。
这只鸟叫作什么?

defsEn: to cut with the teeth
zh: n. 咬, 一口
v. 咬, 刺痛, 穿透
examples: How about a bite to eat?
I could not eat another bite.
exampleZh: 吃点东西如何？
再也吃不下了。

defsEn: dark
having the color like that of the night sky
zh: n. 黑色, 黑颜料
a. 黑色的
examples: I have a black dog and a white dog.
I would prefer the black one, there.
exampleZh: 我有一只黑狗和一只白狗。
我比较喜欢黑色的。

defsEn: to accuse
to hold responsible
zh: n. 过失, 责备
vt. 责备, 归咎于
examples: You have no one but yourself to blame.
Bill took the blame for the loss.
exampleZh: 你只能怪责自己。
比尔承担了损失的过失责任。

defsEn: to lose blood
zh: vi. 流血, 悲痛, 渗出
vt. 使出血, 榨取
examples: I bleed when I make love.
We have to stop the bleeding.
exampleZh: 我性交的时候会出血。
我们必须止血。

defsEn: not able to see
zh: n. 蒙蔽物, 窗帘
a. 盲目的, 瞎的, 不加思考的
vt. 使失明, 蒙蔽, 遮暗
adv. 盲目地
examples: The old man is blind in one eye.
I am blind in the right eye.
exampleZh: 这老人瞎了一只眼。
我的右眼瞎了。

defsEn: to stop something from being done
to prevent movement
zh: n. 街区, 木块, 石块, 块
vt. 阻塞, 封锁, 使成块状
examples: Walk two blocks, and turn left.
In addition to a blocked nose, I'm also suffering from a high temperature.
exampleZh: 走过两个街区，然后左转。
除了鼻子不通以外，我还发着高烧。

defsEn: red fluid in the body
zh: n. 血, 血统, 流血, 气质, 生命
vt. 使出血, 用血涂
examples: I need to check your blood pressure.
Let me take your blood pressure.
exampleZh: 我需要检查一下你的血压。
让我量量你的血压。

defsEn: to move with force, as in air (“The wind blows.”)
zh: n. 吹, 打击, 殴打, 花开
v. 吹, 风吹, 吹响, 开花
examples: They defused the bomb before it could blow up.
Make a wish and blow out the candles.
exampleZh: 他们趁炸弹还没有爆炸的时候就把它拆掉了。
许个愿，然后吹熄蜡烛吧。

defsEn: having the color like that of a clear sky
zh: n. 蓝色
a. 蓝色的, 下流的, 忧郁的
vt. 染成蓝色
vi. 变蓝
examples: Red and blue - which one do you like?
Do you prefer the blue one or the red one?
exampleZh: 红色和蓝色，你喜欢那一个?
你喜欢蓝色的还是红色的？

defsEn: something built to travel on water that carries people or goods
zh: n. 船
vi. 乘船
vt. 以船运
examples: Now, get off the boat and swim to shore.
You can go there in a boat.
exampleZh: 现在下船，游到岸边。
你可以坐船去那。

defsEn: all of a person or animal
the remains of a person or animal
zh: n. 身体, 人, 尸体, 主要部分, 团体
vt. 赋以形体
examples: Me without you is like a body with no soul.
Tom found a dead body on the beach.
exampleZh: 没有了你，我就像没有灵魂的躯体。
汤姆在海边发现了具尸体。

defsEn: to heat a liquid until it becomes very hot
zh: n. 煮沸, 沸腾, 疖
v. 煮沸, 激动
examples: Bring the water to a boil.
Do you want a boiled egg for breakfast?
exampleZh: 把水烧开。
你早餐想吃水煮蛋吗？

defsEn: a device that explodes with great force
v. to attack or destroy with bombs
zh: n. 炸弹
vt. 轰炸, 投弹于
vi. 失败
examples: This bomb can kill a lot of people.
This bomb can kill many people.
exampleZh: 这个炸弹可以炸死很多人。
这个炸弹可以炸死很多人。

defsEn: the hard material in the body
zh: n. 骨头, 骨, 骨制品
vt. 剔骨
vi. 专心致志
examples: She is all skin and bone.
I got a fish bone stuck in my throat.
exampleZh: 她瘦得只剩皮包骨了。
我被鱼骨刺到了喉咙。

defsEn: a long written work for reading book
zh: n. 书, 书籍, 帐簿, 名册, 工作簿
v. 登记, 预订
examples: I hope that you give this book a read.
This book will be of great use to us.
exampleZh: 我希望你读读这本书。
这本书会对我们有很大用处。

defsEn: a dividing line between nations
zh: n. 边缘, 边境, 边界, 花坛
vt. 在...上镶边, 接近
vi. 接界, 近似
examples: This is a small border town.
The USA and Canada share a border.
exampleZh: 这是一座边境小城。
美国和加拿大接壤。

defsEn: to come to life
to come into existence
zh: a. 天生的
bear的过去分词
examples: They say that she was born in Germany.
He was born in this very room.
exampleZh: 他们说她是在德国出生的。
他就是在这间屋子里出生的。

defsEn: to take as a loan
zh: vt. 借, 借入, 借用
vi. 借
examples: Can I borrow your book for a minute?
How long can I borrow this book?
exampleZh: 我可以借一会你的书吗？
这本书我能借多久？

defsEn: not just one of two, but the two together
zh: a. 两者的
adv. 两者都
pron. 两者
examples: They both fell in love with the same man.
They both fell in love with the same woman.
exampleZh: 她们俩同时爱上了同一个男人。
他们俩爱上了同一个女的。

defsEn: a container, usually made of glass, to hold liquid
zh: n. 瓶子, 酒瓶
vt. 装瓶, 抑制, 围困
examples: Can I have a bottle of red wine?
I want a bottle of ice water.
exampleZh: 请来瓶红酒。
我要一瓶冰水。

defsEn: the lowest part of something
zh: n. 底部
a. 底部的
vt. 给...装底, 查明真相
vi. 到达底部, 建立基础
examples: I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
Put the book on the bottom shelf.
exampleZh: 我打心底里感激你。
把这本书放在架子的底部。

defsEn: something to put things into
a container, usually made of paper or wood
zh: n. 盒子, 箱, 方框, 一巴掌
vt. 装...入盒中, 装箱, 打耳光
vi. 拳击
examples: He put this box on the table-top.
Ask at the police box over there.
exampleZh: 他把这个盒子放到了桌子上。
问那边的警察岗哨。

defsEn: a young male person
zh: n. 男孩
examples: Do you know the boy in the picture?
I saw you with a tall boy.
exampleZh: 你认识画里面的男孩吗？
我看见你和一个高个子男孩在一起。

defsEn: to refuse to take part in or deal with
zh: n. 联合抵制
vt. 联合抵制
examples: The boycott lasted a little more than a year.
The boycott lasted little more than a year.

defsEn: the control center of thought, emotions and body activity of all creatures
zh: n. 脑
vt. 打碎脑部
examples: The brain is just a complicated machine.
His brain is still very active.
exampleZh: 大脑只是个复杂的机器。
他的大脑仍然很活跃。

defsEn: having no fear
zh: a. 勇敢的, 美好的, 华丽的
n. 勇敢者
vt. 勇敢地面对
examples: We know him to be a brave man.
I think she is very brave.
exampleZh: 我们知道他是个勇敢的人。
我觉得她很勇敢。

defsEn: a food made from grain
zh: n. 面包, 生计, 食物
vt. 裹以面包屑
examples: She spread the butter on the bread.
Would you like some bread for lunch?
exampleZh: 她把奶油涂在面包上。
你午饭想吃面包吗？

defsEn: to divide into parts by force
to destroy
zh: n. 休息, 中断, 破裂处, 绝交, 破晓, 突变
vt. 打破, 弄破, 弄坏, 破坏, 违反, 打断, 削弱, 放弃
vi. 破碎, 决裂, 破晓, 突变, 变弱, 暂停
n. 分隔符
examples: I mean to break up with her.
I want you to take a break.
exampleZh: 我想和她分手。
我想让你歇歇。

defsEn: to take air into the body and let it out again
zh: vi. 呼吸, 生存, 低语
vt. 呼吸, 使喘息, 发散, 低声说
examples: I want to breathe some fresh air.
Breathe through your nose, not your mouth.
exampleZh: 我想呼吸一下新鲜空气。
你不要用嘴呼吸，用鼻呼吸。

defsEn: a structure built over a waterway, valley or road so people and vehicles can cross from one side to the other bridge
zh: n. 桥, 舰桥, 桥梁, 桥牌
vt. 架桥于, 跨越
examples: There used to be a bridge here.
The bridge will be completed by the end of this year.
exampleZh: 以前这里有一座桥。
大桥将在年底完工。

defsEn: short
not long
zh: n. 摘要, 简报
a. 简短的, 短暂的
vt. 对...作简报, 摘要, 节录
examples: Let's take a brief look at this topic.
He gave his reasons in brief.
exampleZh: 让我们来简单地了解一下这个课题。
他简单地阐述了他的理由。

defsEn: giving much light
strong and clear in color
zh: a. 明亮的, 聪明的, 鲜明的, 欢快的
adv. 明亮地, 欢快地
examples: People show up bright on an infrared camera because of their body heat.
I remember him as a cute, bright little boy.
exampleZh: 人会因为体温而在红外线摄影机上显现。
我印象中的他是个可爱聪明的小男孩。

defsEn: to come with something
zh: vt. 带来, 产生, 促使, 提出
vi. 生产
examples: No one can bring time to a stop.
Do I have to bring my son to your office?
exampleZh: 没有人能够让时间停止。
我必须带我的儿子到你的办公室吗？

defsEn: to send information, stories or music by radio or television
n. a radio or television program
zh: n. 广播, 传播
a. 广播的
v. 广播
adv. 经广播, 四散地
examples: We broadcast news on the hour.
His death was broadcast all over the world.
exampleZh: 我们正点播报新闻。
他去世的消息在世界各地播出。

defsEn: a male with the same father or mother as another person
zh: n. 兄弟
examples: My brother will often sit up all night.
I saw your brother the other day.
exampleZh: 我弟弟会经常彻夜不睡。
前几天我看到了你哥哥。

defsEn: having the color like that of coffee
zh: n. 褐色
a. 褐色的
v. (使)变褐色
examples: Mr. Brown, a friend from Oregon, will visit us tomorrow.
The quick brown fox jumps over a lazy dog.
exampleZh: 一个从俄勒冈州来的朋友，布朗先生明天会来拜访我们。
身手矫健的棕狐狸跃过懒洋洋的狗。

defsEn: a spending plan
zh: n. 预算
vi. 编预算
vt. 编入预算, 安排
a. 廉价的
examples: We are traveling on a tight budget.
We're traveling on a tight budget.
exampleZh: 我们很节省地旅行。
我们用少的预算旅行。

defsEn: to join materials together to make something
zh: v. 建立, 建筑
n. 构造, 体格
examples: Building a new house cost a lot of money.
Look at that smoke. That building must be on fire.
exampleZh: 建新家花了很多钱。
你看，那边正在冒烟，那栋大厦一定是失火了。

defsEn: anything built for use as a house, factory, office, school, store or place of entertainment
zh: n. 建筑物, 建筑
examples: There are many tall buildings in the city center.
There are a lot of new buildings here now.
exampleZh: 城市中心有很多高高的建筑。
这里现在有了许多新建筑。

defsEn: a small piece of metal shot from a gun
zh: n. 子弹
examples: We marched under a hail of bullets.
He was killed by a single bullet.
exampleZh: 我们在枪林弹雨之下行进。
他被一颗子弹打死了。

defsEn: to be on fire
to destroy or damage by fire
zh: vt. 烧, 烧毁, 烧伤
vi. 燃烧, 发热, 烧毁
n. 烧伤, 烙印
examples: Burn this letter after you finish reading it.
Burn that bridge when one comes to it.
exampleZh: 看完这封信请把它烧掉。
过河拆桥。

defsEn: to break open suddenly
zh: n. 破裂, 突发, 爆发
v. 爆裂, 突发, 充满
examples: The moment she saw me, she burst out crying.
The young girl burst into tears.
exampleZh: 她一看到我就开始哭了。
这个年轻的女孩泪流满面。

defsEn: to put into the ground and cover with earth
zh: vt. 埋葬, 埋藏
examples: You can only bury these deeply in your heart.
They buried him in the graveyard by the church.
exampleZh: 只能把这些深深地埋在心里。
他们把他埋葬在教堂旁的墓园。

defsEn: a public vehicle to carry people
zh: n. 公共汽车
examples: We want to be on the first bus tomorrow morning.
This bus will take you to the museum.
exampleZh: 我们想乘明天早上第一班公交车。
这辆公车会载你去博物馆。

defsEn: one’s work
buying and selling to earn money
trade
zh: n. 生意, 事情, 业务, 商业, 商行, 职责
examples: It is your business to take care of them.
Because your business can play to my strengths.
exampleZh: 照顾他们是你自己的事儿。
因为你们公司的业务能够发挥我的特长。

defsEn: doing something
very active
zh: a. 忙碌的, 热闹的, 没空的
vt. 使忙
vi. 忙碌
examples: He will be very busy next month.
He will be busy next month.
exampleZh: 下个月他会很忙。
他下月会很忙。

defsEn: however
other than
yet
zh: prep. 除了
conj. 但是
adv. 仅仅

defsEn: to get by paying something, usually money
zh: vt. 买, 获得
vi. 买
n. 购买, 买得的东西
examples: I have to buy some new clothes next week.
Do you want to buy a house in Germany?
exampleZh: 下周我必须买一些新衣服。
你想在德国买房吗？

defsEn: near
at
next to (“by the road”)
from (“a play by William Shakespeare”)
not later than (“by midnight”)
zh: prep. 被, 经, 由, 在...之旁
adv. 经过, 在近处

defsEn: a group of ministers that helps lead a government
zh: n. 橱柜, 内阁
a. 内阁的, 细木工做的
examples: The tablecloth is in the cabinet.
Please look in the cabinet, the top shelf.
exampleZh: 桌布在橱柜里。

defsEn: to give a name to (“I call myself John.”)
to ask for or request (“They called for an end to the fighting.”)
zh: n. 呼叫, 访问, 打电话, 号召, 召集, 要求
vt. 呼叫, 召集, 打电话
vi. 叫喊, 访问, 叫牌
examples: May I ask you to call me back later?
Tell him to call me tomorrow at noon.
exampleZh: 你等一会然后再给我打电话，可以吗？
明天中午叫他打给我一个电话。

defsEn: quiet
peaceful
opposite tense
zh: n. 平稳, 风平浪静
a. 平静的, 冷静的
vi. 平静下来, 镇静
vt. 使平静
examples: Calm down, and listen to me speak from the beginning.
She said reading can calm a person.
exampleZh: 你们冷静下来，从头开始跟我说。
她说阅读能让人平静。

defsEn: a device for taking pictures
zh: n. 照相机, 摄影机, 密谈室, 暗箱
examples: Would you take a picture of us with this camera?
Your camera is only half the size of mine.
exampleZh: 你能用这台相机帮我们拍张照吗？
你的照相机只有我那台的一半大小。

defsEn: a place with temporary housing camera
zh: n. 露营, 帐篷
vi. 露营, 扎营
vt. 使扎营
examples: A small rock was thrown into our camp.
Did you go camping last weekend?
exampleZh: 小石头被丢到我们营地。
你上周末去露营了吗？

defsEn: a competition by opposing political candidates seeking support from voters
a connected series of military actions during a war
zh: n. 战役, 运动, 竞选运动
vi. 参加运动, 作战
examples: We started a campaign against smoking.
I have a campaign to run.
exampleZh: 我们开始了一个反对吸烟运动。

defsEn: to be able to
to have the right to
n. a container used to hold liquid or food, usually made of metal
zh: vt. 装罐
n. 罐头, 容器
aux. 能, 可以
examples: Can I get to know you for a bit?
If you can come, I will be very happy.
exampleZh: 我能认识一下你吗？
如果你能来，我会很高兴。

defsEn: to end
to stop
zh: n. 取消, 撤消, 盖销(邮票)
vt. 取消, 删去, 抵销, 盖销
vi. 相互抵销
examples: He canceled the appointment at the last moment.
I should cancel the trip to LA.
exampleZh: 他到了最后的一刻才取消了约会。
我应该取消我到洛杉矶的旅行。

defsEn: a disease in which dangerous cells grow quickly and destroy parts of the body
zh: n. 癌, 恶性肿瘤
examples: My brother died of cancer last year.
The doctor cured him of his cancer.
exampleZh: 我弟弟去年死于癌症。
医生治好了他的癌症。

defsEn: a person who seeks or is nominated for an office or an honor
zh: n. 候选人, 投考者
examples: He was the strongest candidate for the position.
He is one of the candidates running for mayor.
exampleZh: 他是那个职位最有希望的候选人。
他是市长的候选人之一。

defsEn: the official center of a government
the city where a country’s government is
zh: n. 首都, 大写字母, 资本
a. 首都的, 重要的
examples: Who will provide capital for the venture?
A capital letter is used at the beginning of a sentence.
exampleZh: 谁来为风险投资提供资金？
一个句子以一个大写字母开始。

defsEn: to make a person or animal a prisoner
to seize or take by force
to get control of
zh: 袭夺
examples: They would capture as many people as possible.
To be honest, we came to capture you.
exampleZh: 他们会尽可能地抓更多的人。
老实说，我们是来抓你的。

defsEn: a vehicle with wheels used to carry people
an automobile
a part of a train
zh: n. 汽车, 客车
examples: I like the old car more than the new.
You can use my car if you like.
exampleZh: 我喜欢旧车胜于新车。
如果你喜欢你可以用我的车。

defsEn: to like
to protect
to feel worry or interest
zh: n. 小心, 照料, 忧虑
vi. 关心, 介意
vt. 在意, 喜欢
examples: Take care when you cross a busy road.
Would you care for a cup of tea?
exampleZh: 当你穿越交通繁忙的街道时要小心注意。
你想不想喝点儿茶？

defsEn: a chosen profession
a person’s working life (“The actor’s career lasted for thirty years.”)
zh: n. 事业, 生涯, 成功
examples: His political career is done for.
She is certainly a career woman.
exampleZh: 他的政治生涯完蛋了。
她真是个女强人。

defsEn: acting safely
with much thought
zh: a. 小心的, 谨慎的
examples: You must be careful not to make him angry.
You should be more careful with what you speak about.
exampleZh: 你要小心别惹他生气。
你应该更注意你说的话。

defsEn: to take something or someone from one place to another
zh: n. 进位, 射程, 运载
vt. 携带, 运送, 支持, 传送, 包含
vi. 被携带, 能达到
examples: We must carry out the plan at once.
Can I carry this on the plane?
exampleZh: 我们必须马上实行这个计划。
我能把这个东西带到飞机上吗？

defsEn: a legal action
zh: n. 情形, 情况, 箱, 容器, 事实, 病例, 案例, 框子
vt. 装箱, 包盖
examples: In case of fire, do not use the lift.
She may be late, in which case we will wait.
exampleZh: 如有火警，切勿使用升降机。
她可能迟到，然后我们就要等。

defsEn: a small animal that often lives with humans
zh: n. 猫, 恶妇
vi. 呕吐
计算机辅助教育, 计算机辅助测试, 计算机辅助翻译, 计算机辅助排版
examples: I have a dog and a cat.
I do not have a cat.
exampleZh: 我有一只狗和一只猫。
我没有猫。

defsEn: to seize after a chase
to stop and seize with the hands
zh: 捕获量；渔获量
examples: If you hurry, you will catch up with him.
Hurry up, and you can catch the bus.
exampleZh: 如果你快一点，还能赶上他。
快一点，你就可以搭上公车。

defsEn: to make happen
n. the thing or person that produces a result
zh: n. 原因, 目标
vt. 引起, 使产生, 使遭受
examples: The cause of his death still remains a mystery.
This can also cause lung cancer.
exampleZh: 他的死因仍然是一个谜。
这也可能会导致肺癌。

defsEn: a halt in fighting, usually by agreement
zh: n. （通常指永久性的）停火, 停战; 停火命令
examples: Malians need to turn their ceasefire into a lasting peace.
We don't need a ceasefire to end the war.

defsEn: to honor a person or event with special activities
zh: v. 庆祝, 祝贺, 举行
examples: Perhaps he would not celebrate Chinese New Year again.
Where do you want to celebrate New Year?
exampleZh: 他或许不会再庆祝春节了。
你要去哪里跨年?

defsEn: a small mass of living material that is part of all plants and animals
zh: n. 单元, 细胞, 电池
examples: I need to charge my cell phone.
Can you give me your cell number?
exampleZh: 我需要给手机充电。
你能告诉我你的手机号吗？

defsEn: the middle of something
the place in the middle
a place that is the main point of an activity
zh: n. 中心, 中心点, 中锋
a. 中央的, 位在正中的
vt. 集中, 定中心
vi. 居中
examples: Our school is in the center of the town.
The library is in the center of the city.
exampleZh: 我们学校在市中心。
图书馆位于城市中心。

defsEn: one hundred years
zh: n. 世纪, 百年
examples: At the turn of the century, children still worked in factories.
Much of London was destroyed in the seventeenth century.
exampleZh: 虽然已经踏入了新世纪，但是工厂雇用童工的情况还是没有改善。
伦敦许多部份在十七世纪时被摧毁。

defsEn: an act or series of acts done in a special way established by tradition
zh: n. 典礼, 仪式, 礼节
examples: The ceremony will take place tomorrow.
At the end of the ceremony, the new couple kissed.
exampleZh: 明天举行典礼。
典礼结束时，新人接了吻。

defsEn: a person leading a meeting or an organized group
zh: n. 主席, 会长
examples: They made him the chairman of a club.
I'll recommend him as chairman, whether you are in favor of it or not.
exampleZh: 他们选他做具乐部主席。
你赞成也好，不赞成也好，我也会推荐他当主席的。

defsEn: the best
the winner
zh: n. 冠军, 拥护者, 战士
vt. 保卫, 拥护
a. 优胜的
examples: I hope you become the champion.
France is the world champion! Way to go, France!

defsEn: a possibility of winning or losing or that something will happen
zh: n. 机会, 意外, 可能性
vi. 偶然发生
vt. 冒险
examples: Give me a chance to make you proud of me.
Come on! Give me a chance.
exampleZh: 给我机会来让你为我感到自豪。
来嘛！给我个机会。

defsEn: to make different
to become different
zh: n. 变化, 找回的零钱, 找头, 更换
vt. 改变, 更换, 兑换
examples: I have to change into my work clothes.
Should you change your mind, let me know.
exampleZh: 我得换工服了。
如果你要改变主意，通知我。

defsEn: to accuse someone of something, usually a crime
n. a statement in which someone is accused of something
zh: n. 指控, 费用, 冲锋, 电荷, 炸药, 主管, 被托管人, 命令
vt. 控诉, 加罪于, 使充满, 使充电, 使承担
vi. 冲锋, 要价, 收费
examples: I need to charge my mobile.
He's in charge of the department.
exampleZh: 我需要给手机充电。
他负责这个部门。

defsEn: to run or go after someone or something
zh: n. 追求, 狩猎, 追逐
vt. 追捕, 追逐, 雕刻, 在...上镶嵌宝石
vi. 追赶, 奔跑
examples: The cat chased the mouse around the house.
The hunter chases the rabbit in the fields.
exampleZh: 猫在房子里追老鼠。
猎人在田野追兔子

defsEn: to get by a trick
to steal from
zh: n. 欺骗, 作弊, 骗子
v. 欺骗, 逃脱, 骗取
examples: The man cheated the old woman out of her money.
Never did I dream that George would cheat me.
exampleZh: 他骗了老婆婆的钱。
我连做梦也没有想过乔治会骗我。

defsEn: to shout approval or praise
zh: n. 愉快, 振奋, 欢呼
vi. 欢呼, 喝彩, 快活起来
vt. 使振奋, 欢呼
examples: He tried to cheer up his wife, but wasn't able to.
The situation is improving, so cheer up!
exampleZh: 他试着哄他老婆开心，但他没做到。
情况正在改善，所以振作起来！

defsEn: elements found in nature or made by people
substances used in the science of chemistry
zh: n. 化学品, 化学制品；化学药品；化工产品（chemical的复数）
examples: We need to dispose of these chemicals properly.
Exposure to these chemicals can increase your risk of developing cancer.

defsEn: the scientific study of substances, what they are made of, how they act under different conditions, and how they form other substances
zh: n. 化学, 化学过程
examples: I found him a genius at chemistry.
I majored in chemistry at the university.
exampleZh: 我发现了他在化学方面的天赋。
我在大学主修化学。

defsEn: the head or leader of a group
ad. leading
most important
zh: n. 领袖, 酋长, 长官, 主要部分
a. 主要的, 首位的
examples: He is the chief of my department.
I got acquainted with the chief executive.
exampleZh: 他是我部门的主管。
我认识了这位行政长官。

defsEn: a baby
a boy or girl
zh: n. 孩子, 产物, 追随者
examples: They send their child to a part-time nursery.
We saw the child get on the bus.
exampleZh: 他们送孩子去了幼儿园的半托班。
我们看见孩子上了车。

defsEn: more than one child
zh: pl. 孩子, 孩子们
examples: Tell the children to stay out of the kitchen.
One of the children left the door open.
exampleZh: 告诉孩子别进厨房。
其中一个孩子让门开着。

defsEn: to decide between two or more
zh: vt. 选择, 宁愿, 欲
vi. 作出选择, 愿意
examples: Choose the color you like the best.
You may choose whichever book you like.
exampleZh: 选你最喜欢的颜色。
你可以选择任何你喜欢的书。

defsEn: a line of genes
most human cells contain 46 chromosomes
zh: n. 染色体
examples: If you have a male chromosome pair, you're a man.
Your chromosome can undoubtedly show what kind of human you are!

defsEn: a closed shape that has all its points equally distant from the center, like an “O”
zh: n. 圆周, 社交圈, 循环, 范围
vt. 围着, 环绕
vi. 盘旋, 循环
examples: She drew a circle on a piece of paper with a pencil.
I really like him, but not his circle of friends.
exampleZh: 她用铅笔在纸上画了一个圈。
我真的很喜欢他, 可是我不喜欢他周围的朋友。

defsEn: a person who is a member of a country by birth or by law city
zh: n. 市民, 公民
examples: I'm a citizen of the world.
She is a British citizen, but she was born in France.
exampleZh: 我是世界公民。
她是一个英国公民，但她是在法国出生的。

defsEn: any important large town
zh: n. 城市, 市
examples: I hope to leave that city, and never come back.
We can see the city from here.
exampleZh: 我希望离开那个城市，并且不再回来。
我们从这里看到城市。

defsEn: not military
zh: n. 平民, 民法专家
a. 平民的, 百姓的, 民用的
examples: You should change into civilian clothes.
We should defend the civilian population.

defsEn: to say something as a fact
zh: n. 要求, 要求权, 断言, 权利
vt. 要求, 认领, 主张
vi. 提出要求, 主张, 断言
examples: This product claims to help you lose weight.
His claim is that there is a close relation between birth order and personality.
exampleZh: 这个产品称它能帮助你减肥。
他主张的是出生的先后次序和个性有很密切的关系。

defsEn: a battle
v. to fight or oppose
zh: n. 冲突, 撞击声, 抵触
vi. 冲突, 抵触
vt. 使发出撞击声
examples: Every now and then they clash over their differences.
The color of the wall clashes with that of the floor.
exampleZh: 他们有时候有矛盾冲突

defsEn: a group of students who meet to study the same subject
also a social or economic group. (“They were members of the middle class.”)
zh: n. 班级, 阶级, 种类, 课
vt. 分类
examples: You never have class or what?!
When do you go to class?
exampleZh: 你从来没课还是怎样？
你什么时候去上课？

defsEn: to make pure
ad. free from dirt or harmful substances (“clean water”)
zh: a. 干净的, 清白的, 简洁的
adv. 清洁地, 完全地
vt. 清理, 使干净, 出空
vi. 被搞干净
n. 打扫
examples: My mother told me to clean the room.
I have to clean the toilet.
exampleZh: 我妈要求我把我的房间收拾好。
我要清理厕所了。

defsEn: easy to see or see through
easily understood
zh: a. 清楚的, 明确的, 澄清的
adv. 清晰地
vt. 澄清, 清除障碍
vi. 放晴, 变清澈
n. 空隙
examples: We want to clear up this problem.
I just want a clear answer.
exampleZh: 我们像澄清这个问题
我只想要一个明确的答案。

defsEn: a body of officials within a religious organization
zh: n. 牧师, 僧侣, 神职人员
examples: All the clergy are against the new law.
Tensions grew when the laity questioned the primacy of the clergy in moral decision-making.

defsEn: the normal weather conditions of a place
zh: n. 气候, 社会趋势, 气候区
examples: Do you think our climate has an influence on our character?
What is the climate on the island like?
exampleZh: 你觉得气候会不会影响人的性格呢？
岛上气候怎么样？

defsEn: to go up or down something by using the feet and sometimes the hands
zh: v. 攀登, 上升, 爬
n. 攀登, 爬升
examples: We plan to climb that mountain.
It's dangerous to climb a mountain in bad weather.
exampleZh: 我们计划去爬那座山。
天气差的时候去爬山是很危险的。

defsEn: a device that measures and shows time
zh: n. 时钟, 计时器, (袜子上的)绣花边花
vt. 绣花样, 记时, 记录
vi. 记录时间
examples: They guarantee this clock for a year.
There is no clock in my room.
exampleZh: 他们保证这个时钟可用一年。
我的房间里没有时钟。

defsEn: to make something not open
ad. near to
zh: n. 结束, 完结
a. 靠近的, 亲近的, 亲密的, 严密的, 关闭的, 狭窄的, 秘密的
vt. 关, 结束, 使靠近, 封闭, 使接近
vi. 关闭, 结束, 靠近
adv. 接近地, 紧密地
examples: We have to make a close analysis of the accident.
May I ask you to close the window?
exampleZh: 我们要详细的分析一下意外发生的前因后果。
帮我关下窗可以吗？

defsEn: a material made from plants, chemicals, animal hair and other substances
zh: n. 布料, 织品, 布
examples: We need food, clothes and a home in order to live.
We provided food and clothes for them.
exampleZh: 食物、衣服和住所都是生活的必需品。
我们为他们提供了食物和衣服。

defsEn: what people wear clothes
zh: n. 衣服
examples: We have many clothes to put in the suitcase.
Do you have any clothes that you never wear?

defsEn: a mass of fog high in the sky
zh: n. 云, 阴暗, 烟雾, 疑团
vt. 以云遮敝, 笼罩, 使黯然
vi. 乌云密布, 阴沉
examples: Not a single cloud could be seen in the sky.
I saw a white cloud drifting across the sky.
exampleZh: 天上万里无云。
我见到一片白云在空中飘过。

defsEn: a solid black substance used as fuel
zh: n. 煤, 木炭
v. 加煤
examples: Coal and natural gas are natural fuels.
Australia is the world's fifth-largest coal producer.
exampleZh: 煤和天然气是天然燃料。
澳大利亚是世界第五大煤炭产地。

defsEn: forces, groups or nations joined together
zh: n. 结合体, 结合, 联合
examples: They form a coalition for change.
A strong international coalition should enforce peace in the genocidal war zone.

defsEn: land on the edge of the ocean
zh: n. 海岸, 滑坡
v. 沿海岸而行
examples: His cottage is on the coast.
Come with me to the southern coast of France!
exampleZh: 他的村屋在海岸上。

defsEn: a drink made from the plant of the same name coffee
zh: n. 咖啡, 咖啡色
examples: I have coffee, tea, water, and fresh fruit juice.
How do you like your coffee? Strong and black?
exampleZh: 我有咖啡、茶、水跟新鲜果汁。
你喜欢什么口味的咖啡？浓的黑咖啡？

defsEn: not warm
having or feeling great coolness or a low temperature
zh: n. 感冒, 寒冷
a. 寒冷的, 冷淡的, 冷静的
adv. 完全地
examples: I want a cup of cold black tea.
If you have a cold, you should get plenty of rest.
exampleZh: 我要一杯冰红茶。
你患了感冒的话，一定要好好休息。

defsEn: to fall down or inward suddenly
to break down or fail suddenly in strength, health or power. (“The building collapsed in the earthquake.” “The government collapsed after a vote in parliament.”)
zh: n. 崩溃, 倒塌, 虚脱
vi. 倒塌, 崩溃, 瓦解
vt. 使倒塌, 折叠
examples: The house collapsed under the weight of the snow.
The house collapsed under the weight of snow.
exampleZh: 那房子在积雪的重量下坍塌了。
那房子在积雪的重量下坍塌了。

defsEn: to bring or gather together in one place
to demand and receive (“collect taxes”)
zh: v. 收集, 聚集, 集中, 搜集
a. 由收到者付款的
adv. 由收到者付款地
examples: When can I collect my luggage?
Collect your thoughts before you begin your work.
exampleZh: 我什么时候能拿我的行李？
工作之前先收好思绪。

defsEn: a small university
zh: n. 学院, 大学, 学会
examples: He's saving up to go to college.
He's a student at this college.
exampleZh: 他在攒钱上大学。
他是这所大学的学生。

defsEn: land controlled by another country or government
zh: 蜂群
examples: Kenya used to be a British colony.
Taiwan was once a colony of Japan.
exampleZh: 肯尼亚曾经是英国的殖民地。
台湾曾经是日本的殖民地。

defsEn: the different effects of light on the eye, making blue, red, brown, black, yellow and others
zh: 颜色，色料，色素
examples: I like the color of this table.
I like this color as well.
exampleZh: 我喜欢这张桌子的颜色。
我也喜欢这颜色。

defsEn: to mix or bring together
zh: v. (使)联合, (使)结合
n. (企业的)联合, 联合收割机
examples: We may combine your personal information with other information.
I like how WHAT THE CAR? combines racing with fun puzzle gameplay and exploration.
exampleZh: 我们可能会将你的私人信息和其他信息结合在一起。
我喜欢《WHAT THE CAR?》将赛车与有趣的益智游戏和探索相结合。

defsEn: to move toward
to arrive
zh: vi. 过来, 来, 到达, 出现, 开始
interj. 喂
examples: The day will come when you will realize it.
We would like you to come to our party.
exampleZh: 有一天你会意识到它。
我们希望你来我们的聚会。

defsEn: to order
to have power over something
zh: n. 命令, 指挥, 控制, 部队, 司令部
v. 命令, 指挥, 控制
examples: I learned to use a command block today.
Take control of the command post.
exampleZh: 我今天学会用命令方块了。
掌管指挥所。

defsEn: to say something about
to express an opinion about something I think.. comment
zh: n. 注解, 批评, 评论, 备注
vi. 评论, 注解
examples: His comments about the book were favorable.
The speaker's comments were highly offensive.
exampleZh: 他给这本书正面的评价。
发言人的评论极有攻击性。

defsEn: a group of people given special work
zh: n. 委员会
examples: He's the chairman of the committee.
They made John chairman of the committee.
exampleZh: 他是委员会主席。
他们让约翰做了委员会的主席。

defsEn: usual
same for all. (“a common purpose”)
zh: a. 通常的, 共同的, 通俗的, 公共的
examples: I have a lot in common with her.
She and I have nothing in common.
exampleZh: 我跟她有很多共同点。
我和她没有共同之处。

defsEn: to tell
to give or exchange information
zh: vt. 显露, 传达, 感染
vi. 通讯
examples: We have to try to communicate with them.
They communicate with each other by gesture.
exampleZh: 我们要设法跟他们交流。
她们用手势沟通。

defsEn: a group of people living together in one place or area
zh: n. 社区, 公众, 共有, 共同体
examples: The new community center was inaugurated yesterday with pomp and circumstance.
Is this community safe? Are there lighting installations for the night?
exampleZh: 新的社区中心在昨天隆重落成。
小区安全吗？夜晚有照明设施吗？

defsEn: a business organized for trade, industrial or other purposes
zh: n. 公司, 友伴, 交往, 连队, 朋友, 一群
vt. 陪伴
vi. 交往
examples: Every month at our company, they run a community activity.
The phone company cut me off last month.
exampleZh: 在我们公司每月都会举办社团活动。
电话公司上个月切了我的线。

defsEn: to examine what is different or similar
zh: vt. 比较, 比喻, 对照
vi. 相比
n. 比较
examples: Compare the two carefully, and you will see the difference.
Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.
exampleZh: 仔细的比较一下，就会发现两者之间的分别了。
比较一下你写的句子和黑板上的句子。

defsEn: to try to do as well as, or better than, another or others
zh: vi. 竞争, 对抗
examples: Only four horses competed in the race.
Ten teams competed for the prize.
exampleZh: 只有四匹马参加了比赛。
十支队伍竞逐奖项。

defsEn: having all parts
ended or finished
zh: a. 完全的, 十足的, 完成的
vt. 完成, 完工, 使圆满
examples: I need to complete it as soon as possible.
Please tell me in complete detail what occurred, when and where.
exampleZh: 我需要尽快完成。
请给我统统说清楚什么时候在哪里发生了什么事。

defsEn: of or having many parts that are difficult to understand
not simple
zh: n. 综合体, 情结, 络合物
a. 复杂的, 组合的
examples: Grammar is a very complex thing.
The brain has a complex structure.
exampleZh: 语法是很复杂的。
头脑的结构很复杂。

defsEn: a substance containing two or more elements
zh: n. 混合物, 复合词, 化合物, 院子
a. 复合的, 混合的, 化合的
vi. 化合, 和解, 妥协
vt. 使复合, 使化合
examples: Do you know what compound words are?
Compound interest is the most powerful force in the universe.
exampleZh: 你知道什么是复合词吗？

defsEn: the settlement of an argument where each side agrees to accept less than first demanded
zh: n. 妥协, 折中, 折中方案, 和解
vi. 妥协处理
vt. 危害
examples: We tried to come to a compromise with them.
In the end, we reached a compromise.
exampleZh: 我们试着和他们妥协。
最后我们达成了协议。

defsEn: an electronic machine for storing and organizing information, and for communicating with others
zh: n. 电脑, 电子计算机
examples: You can use this computer any time.
I want to play on the computer.
exampleZh: 你可以随时使用这台电脑。
我想玩电脑。

defsEn: interest, worry (“express concern about”)
v. to fear (“to be concerned”)
zh: n. 关心, 忧虑
vt. 与...有关, 使担心, 使挂念
examples: Concerning this issue, I feel that the trash media only report biased information.
He is very much concerned about the future of his son.
exampleZh: 关于这个问题，我觉得垃圾媒体只报道了很片面的信息。
他非常关心他儿子的将来。

defsEn: to say a person or action is wrong or bad
zh: vt. 判刑, 责备, 谴责
examples: It is important to condemn racism, but that alone is not enough.
Your soul has been condemned to hell.
exampleZh: 谴责种族主义很重要，但光是谴责种族主义是不够的。
你的灵魂已坠进了地狱。

defsEn: something declared necessary to complete an agreement
a person’s health
zh: n. 情况, 条件
vt. 使健康, 以...为条件, 决定, 使适应
examples: What conditions must a child meet to be able to learn the piano?
I would like an air-conditioned room.
exampleZh: 孩子学钢琴要具备哪些条件？
我想要个有空调的房间。

defsEn: a meeting
zh: n. 会议
examples: The conference will take place in Tokyo.
Everyone chose him to speak at the conference.
exampleZh: 会议将在东京举行。
大家推举他到大会发言。

defsEn: to approve
to say that something is true
zh: vt. 证实, 确定, 批准, 使巩固
examples: I want to quickly confirm my flight again.
We will confirm your order as follows.
exampleZh: 我想要再确认一下我的航班。
您的订单确认如下。

defsEn: a fight
a battle, especially a long one
zh: n. 战斗, 冲突, 矛盾, 争执
vi. 争执, 战斗, 冲突, 抵触
examples: He seems not to be aware of the conflict between my father and me.
The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.
exampleZh: 他似乎不知道我父亲和我之间的纠葛。
在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。

defsEn: to praise a person or to express pleasure for success or good luck
zh: vt. 祝贺, 庆贺
examples: I congratulate you on your engagement.
He congratulated me on my success.
exampleZh: 我为你的订婚祝贺。
他为我的成功恭贺我。

defsEn: the organization of people elected to make the laws of the United States (the House of Representatives and the Senate)
a similar organization in other countries
zh: n. 国会, 会议, 讨论会
examples: The next congress may take place in Africa.
The ambassador greeted congress on behalf of his government.

defsEn: to join one thing to another
to unite
to link
zh: v. 连接, 联合, 联系
examples: I often use SSH to remotely connect to my computer.
I am not connected to this crime in any way.
exampleZh: 我经常使用SSH来远程连接到我的电脑。
我与这起犯罪没有任何关系。

defsEn: one who usually supports tradition and opposes great change
zh: a. 保守的, 守旧的, 有保存力的
examples: On the whole, the Japanese are conservative.
A conservative is not always a reactionary.
exampleZh: 总体上说，日本人很保守。
保守分子不一定是反动分子。

defsEn: to give thought to
to think about carefully
zh: v. 考虑, 思考, 认为
examples: They consider him the best doctor in town.
Some consider language as a form of knowledge.
exampleZh: 他们把他视为城里最好的医生。
有些人认为语言是一种知识的形式。

defsEn: the written general laws and ideas that form a nation’s system of government
zh: n. 构成, 宪法, 体格
examples: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.
The U.S. Constitution was poorly written.
exampleZh: 平等是由宪法保障的。
美国宪法写得很烂。

defsEn: the act of touching or being close to a person or thing (“He was in contact with animals that had the disease.”) v. to meet or communicate with (“He wanted to contact his local official.”)
zh: n. 联系, 交际, 熟人, 接触
vi. 接触, 联系
vt. 使接触
examples: You can contact me in case of emergency.
They will contact us before noon today.
exampleZh: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。
他们会在今天中午之前联系我们。

defsEn: to hold
to include
zh: vt. 包含, 容纳, 控制
vi. 自制
examples: He could no longer contain his anger.
This bottle is able to contain two liters of hot water.
exampleZh: 他再也忍不住气了。
这个瓶子可以装两升热水。

defsEn: a box, bottle or can used to hold something
zh: n. 容器, 集装箱
examples: Could you hand me that glass container there?
This container can hold two litres of hot water.

defsEn: any of the seven great land areas of the world
zh: n. 大陆, 洲
a. 自制的
examples: Africa is a continent of migration.
Africa is a continent, but Greenland is not.
exampleZh: 非洲是转移的大洲。
非洲是一个大陆, 而格陵兰不是。

defsEn: to go on doing or being
zh: vi. 继续, 延续, 延长
vt. 使继续, 使延长
examples: She asked me to continue writing to your father.
Her mother will continue to work.
exampleZh: 她叫我继续写信给你的父亲。
她母亲将继续工作。

defsEn: to direct
to have power over
zh: n. 控制, 管理, 克制, 控制器, 操纵装置
vt. 控制, 操纵, 抑制
examples: I could not control my anger.
You should learn how to control that mood of yours.
exampleZh: 我气坏了。
您应该学会控制自己的情绪。

defsEn: a large meeting for a special purpose
zh: n. 大会, 协定, 惯例, 约定
examples: Not complying with the naming conventions will result in parse errors.
The convention will draw many of the top physicists in the globe.
exampleZh: 不遵守命名规则会导致解析错误。

defsEn: to heat food before eating it cook
zh: n. 厨子, 厨师
vt. 烹调, 煮饭, 加热
vi. 在煮着
examples: She asked us if we would like to cook.
Do you know how to cook meat?
exampleZh: 她问我们想不想下厨。
你知道怎么煮肉吗?

defsEn: almost cold
zh: n. 凉爽, 凉爽的空气
a. 凉爽的, 冷淡的, 冷静的
vi. 冷却, 平息
vt. 使冷却, 使平静
examples: Do you think of me as a cool guy?
Keep it in a cool place.
exampleZh: 你觉得我是个酷哥吗？
保存在阴凉的地方。

defsEn: to act or work together
zh: vi. 合作, 协力, 配合
examples: We are working hard to cooperate more.
I need you to cooperate with me on this.
exampleZh: 我们正在努力扩展合作。

defsEn: to make something exactly like another
n. something made to look exactly like another
zh: n. 副本, 摹仿, 一册
v. 复印, 抄袭, 复制
将几个文件合并成一个文件, 以及将文件传至外设或在设备之间传送
examples: I keep the master copy under lock and key.
Can you copy this for me?
exampleZh: 我妥善保管原版拷贝。
你能替我拷贝这个吗？

defsEn: a food grain
zh: n. 玉蜀黍, 谷类, 谷粒, 鸡眼
vt. 使成颗粒, 腌
examples: Our breakfast has oats and corn in it.
I bought a bag of frozen corn.
exampleZh: 我们早餐有燕麦和玉米。
我买了一包冰冻玉米。

defsEn: true
free from mistakes
v. to change to what is right
zh: a. 正确的, 合适的
vt. 改正, 订正
examples: Correct the mistake and return the file to Mr Luxemburg.
In this case, I think he is correct.
exampleZh: 请把错误改正过来，然后把文件夹还给 Luxemburg 先生。
这样的话，我想他是对的。

defsEn: actions corn taken to gain money or power that are legally or morally wrong
zh: n. 腐败, 堕落, 贪污
examples: Corruption and red tape continue to permeate the business environment.
The more power, the more corruption.

defsEn: the price or value of something (“The cost of the book is five dollars.”)
v. to be valued at
zh: n. 代价, 价值, 费用
vi. 花费
vt. 使失去, 值, 使花费
examples: It will cost you more to go by plane.
How much will it cost you to go by air?
exampleZh: 搭飞机将花你比较多的钱。
坐飞机将花你多少钱？

defsEn: a material made from a plant of the same name
zh: n. 棉花
vi. 和谐, 有好感, 理解
examples: Someday I will buy a cotton candy machine.
Someday I'll buy a cotton candy machine.
exampleZh: 有一天我买了一台棉花糖机。
有一天我买了一台棉花糖机。

defsEn: to speak or add numbers
zh: vt. 计算, 视为
vi. 计数
n. 计算, 合计, 计数, 伯爵
examples: My son can count up to a hundred now.
Can you count to ten in Chinese?
exampleZh: 我儿子现在可以数到100。
你能用中文数到十吗？

defsEn: a nation
the territory of a nation
land away from cities
zh: n. 国家, 乡村, 地区, 故乡
a. 乡下的, 农村的
examples: I love my country with every fiber of my being.
Do the people of your country eat rice?
exampleZh: 我深爱我的祖国。
你国家的人吃米吗?

defsEn: where trials take place
where judges make decisions about law
zh: n. 法院, 庭院, 奉承
vt. 献殷勤, 追求, 招致
vi. 求爱
examples: The court declared him innocent on the charge of murder.
Have you met the new court jester?
exampleZh: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。
你见过新来的那货了吗？

defsEn: to put something over a person or thing
n. anything that is put over a person or thing
zh: n. 盖子, 封面, 藉口
vt. 覆盖, 掩饰, 保护, 掩护, 包括
vi. 覆盖
examples: Cover your head when you are in the sun.
We saw the ground covered with snow.
exampleZh: 当你在阳光下的时候，遮住你的头。
我们看见地面被雪覆盖了。

defsEn: a farm animal used for its milk
zh: n. 母牛, 母兽
vt. 威胁
examples: There is a cow in the village.
Cows provide us with good milk.
exampleZh: 村里有一头母牛。
牛供给我们好奶。

defsEn: to fall violently
to hit with great force
zh: n. 哗啦声, 猛撞, 崩溃, 粗布
v. 撞碎, 破碎, (使)...坠毁
a. 速成的
examples: The plane crash was only last week.
The crash was and remains to date the deadliest airplane accident on Canadian soil.
exampleZh: 上个星期这架飞机坠毁了。
这起空难是迄今为止加拿大境内最严重的空难。

defsEn: to make
to give life or form to
zh: vt. 创造, 建造, 引起, 任命
examples: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
You need to create two new categories.
exampleZh: 起初，神创造了天地。
需新建两个分类。

defsEn: any living being
any animal or human
zh: n. 人, 动物, 创造物, 生物
examples: Without water, no creature could live.
How can there exist a creature as adorable as a cat?
exampleZh: 没有水，没有生物能够存活。
怎么会有猫咪这么可爱的生物？

defsEn: an agreement that payments will be made at a later time
zh: n. 信用, 信任, 荣誉, 贷款, 学分
vt. 归功于, 赞颂, 信任, 相信
examples: I would like to pay with a credit card.
I want to pay with a credit card.
exampleZh: 我想用信用卡支付。
我想用信用卡付款。

defsEn: a group of people working together
zh: n. 全体人员, 一群人, 全体队员
crow的过去式
examples: Some of the crew were drowned.
Every member of our crew can speak French.
exampleZh: 有几个船员溺水而亡。

defsEn: an act that violates a law
zh: n. 犯罪, 罪行, 罪恶
examples: It's no crime to skip breakfast once in a while.
I viewed my action as a crime.
exampleZh: 偶尔不吃早餐也不会如何不好呀。
我把我的行为看成是犯罪。

defsEn: a person who is responsible for a crime
zh: n. 罪犯, 犯人, 刑事
a. 犯了罪的, 刑事的, 有罪的
examples: A dangerous criminal escaped from prison.
The criminal is still at large.
exampleZh: 有一个危险的罪犯从监狱里逃了出来。
那个犯人还没被抓到。

defsEn: an extremely important time when something may become much better or worse
a dangerous situation
zh: n. 危机, 危险期, 紧要关头
examples: In a crisis, you must get in touch with your teacher.
His company didn't survive the crisis.
exampleZh: 在危险的时候你必须跟你的老师联系。
他的公司没有从危机中幸存。

defsEn: to say what is wrong with something or someone
to condemn
to judge
zh: v. 批评, 吹毛求疵, 非难
examples: I don't mind being criticized when I am wrong.
Tom criticized Mary in front of everyone.
exampleZh: 要是我说错话被人议论，我是不管的。
汤姆在所有人面前批评了玛丽。

defsEn: plants that are grown and gathered for food, such as grains, fruits and vegetables
zh: 分批出现(疹)
examples: In the fall we harvest our summer crops.
We need to learn how to grow crops on Mars.

defsEn: to go from one side to another
to go across
zh: n. 十字架, 十字架形物件, 交叉, 十字标, 交叉路, 磨难, 杂交
a. 生气的, 交叉的, 相反的
v. 交叉, 横过, 越过
examples: Well, I can cross that off my bucket list.
Take care when you cross the street.
exampleZh: 太好了，死前心愿又完成了一样。
过马路时小心.

defsEn: a large number of people gathered in one place
zh: n. 群众, 一伙人
vt. 拥挤, 挤满, 挤进
examples: The train was so crowded that I had to keep standing all the way.
The train was so crowded that none of us could get a seat.
exampleZh: 火车拥挤极了，我整趟车程都没有位子坐。
火车挤得要命，我们都找不到位子坐。

defsEn: to damage or destroy by great weight
to defeat completely
zh: n. 压碎, 粉碎, 群众, 迷恋
vt. 压破, 征服, 塞, 弄皱, 榨出
vi. 被压碎, 起皱, 挤
examples: She has a crush on the boy next door.
It's normal to experience workplace crushes, but remember to stay professional.
exampleZh: 她看上了隔壁的那个男孩。
在职场中对某人产生好感是很正常的，但记得要保持专业形象。

defsEn: to express or show sorrow or pain
zh: n. 叫声, 哭声, 大叫
vi. 哭, 叫, 喊
vt. 叫喊, 大声说, 哭出
examples: I cry every time I watch this movie.
I always cry when I see this picture.
exampleZh: 我每次看这部电影都会哭。
当我看到这张图片的时候总是哭。

defsEn: all the beliefs, traditions and arts of a group or population
zh: n. 文化, 修养, 耕种
vt. 耕种, 培养
examples: We should pass on our culture to the next generation.
They had a culture of their own.
exampleZh: 我们应当把文化传承到下一代。
他们有他们自己的文化。

defsEn: to improve health
to make well (“The doctor can cure the disease.”)
n. something that makes a sick person well (“Antibiotics are a cure for infection.”)
zh: n. 治疗, 治愈, 治疗法
vt. 治疗, 治愈, 改正, 腌制, 加工处理, 使硫化
vi. 受治疗, 被加工处理, 被硫化
examples: This medicine will cure you of your skin disease.
No medicine can cure this disease.
exampleZh: 这药可以治疗你的皮肤病。
没有药物能够治疗这种疾病。

defsEn: an order to people to stay off the streets or to close their businesses
zh: n. 晚钟, 打晚钟时刻, 宵禁
examples: There is a curfew in effect from dusk to dawn.
I had a strict curfew at my house.

defsEn: movement of air, water or electricity
ad. belonging to the present time (“She found the report in a current publication.”)
zh: n. 涌流, 趋势, 流
a. 流通的, 现在的, 当前的, 流行的
examples: An electric current can generate magnetism.
The current era is the atomic era.
exampleZh: 电流可以产生磁性。
现在的时代是原子时代。

defsEn: a long-established belief or activity of a people
zh: n. 习惯, 风俗, 海关, 自定义
a. 定制的
examples: It's my custom to go for a walk before breakfast.
These customs differ from those in our country.
exampleZh: 我习惯早餐之前出去散步。
这些习俗和我们国家不同。

defsEn: taxes on imports
zh: n. 海关, 关卡, 关税
examples: We should do away with out-of-date customs.
A customs official asked me to open my suitcase.

defsEn: to divide or injure with a sharp tool
to make less
to reduce
zh: n. 切口, 割伤, 降低, 切, 割, 砍, 削, 伤口, 削减, 缩短, 删节, 通路
a. 经切割的, 缩减的
vt. 切, 割, 减少, 刺痛, 开辟, 雕刻, 删节, 缩短, 停止, 排斥, 切断, 关, 显出
vi. 切, 割, 砍, 刺痛, 相交, 抄近路, 剪辑
examples: He cut down a tree in his garden.
Can you cut it down a bit?
exampleZh: 他在花园里砍了一棵树。
可以便宜一点吗？

defsEn: a wall built across a river to hold back flowing water dam
zh: n. 水坝, 障碍
v. 控制, 筑坝
examples: This dam supplies us with water and electricity.
The dam burst owing to the heavy rain.
exampleZh: 这个水坝给我们提供水和电。

defsEn: to cause injury or destruction
n. harm
hurt or injury, usually to things
zh: n. 损害, 伤害
v. 损害
examples: The damage will cost us a lot of money.
My car was badly damaged in the accident.
exampleZh: 这破坏会花费我们很多钱。
我的车在事故中受到严重损坏

defsEn: to move the body and feet to music
n. a series of steps, usually to music
zh: n. 跳舞, 舞蹈, 舞会
v. 跳舞
examples: I would like to learn how to dance.
Would you like to dance with me?
exampleZh: 我想学跳舞。
你愿意和我跳舞吗？

defsEn: a strong chance of suffering injury, damage or loss
zh: n. 危险, 威胁
examples: That will put you in danger.
The old bridge is in danger of collapse.
exampleZh: 那将会使你处于危险。
那座老桥正面临坍塌的危险。

defsEn: having little or no light (“The room was dark.”)
zh: n. 黑暗, 夜, 黄昏, 模糊
a. 黑暗的, 暗的, 深色的, 隐密的, 模糊的, 无知的
examples: It will be dark by the time the police come here.
As soon as it gets dark, the fireworks will start.
exampleZh: 等到警察来的时候，天大概也黑了吧。
天一黑，就会开始放焰火了。

defsEn: an expression of time
a day, month and year
zh: n. 日期, 约会, 枣椰树
vt. 约会, 定日期
vi. 注明日期, 过时
examples: May I know the date of you departure?
I asked her out on a date.
exampleZh: 我可能知道你离开的日期吗？
我请她出去约会。

defsEn: a person’s female child
zh: n. 女儿
a. 女儿的
examples: She may be proud of her daughter.
He left his daughter a great fortune.
exampleZh: 她可以为她的女儿感到骄傲。
他留给他女儿一大笔财产。

defsEn: twenty–four hours
the hours of sunlight
zh: n. 天, 日子, 白天, 工作日
examples: Every day I take the tram to the office.
If one day you leave, I will be very sad.
exampleZh: 我每天乘电车去办公室。
如果有一天你走了，我会很难过的。

defsEn: not living
zh: a. 死的, 不活泼的, 麻木的, 熄灭的
n. 死者
adv. 完全地, 直接地
examples: We found some dead fish in the river.
He found his wife dead in the bathtub.
exampleZh: 我们在河里发现了一些死鱼。
他发现妻子死在浴缸里。

defsEn: not able to hear
zh: a. 聋的
examples: There's no one more deaf than he who does not want to listen.
He turned a deaf ear to their request.
exampleZh: 不愿意聆听的人，才是真正的聋子。
他对他们的请求置若罔闻。

defsEn: to have to do with (“The talks will deal with the problem of pollution.”)
to buy or sell (“Her company deals in plastic.”) n. an agreement
zh: n. 交易, 协定, 数量, 买卖, 松木板
vi. 处理, 应付, 做生意
vt. 分配, 发牌, 给予
examples: I have a great deal to do today.
How should we deal with this matter?
exampleZh: 我今天有很多事要做。
我们应该怎么处理这个问题呢？

defsEn: to argue for or against something
n. a public discussion or argument
zh: n. 辩论, 讨论
v. 争论, 辩论
examples: I believe that the debate should be carried on.
We debated on the question of world population.
exampleZh: 我认为辩论该继续进行。
我们在世界人口问题上争辩了一番。

defsEn: something that is owed
the condition of owing
zh: n. 债务, 罪过
examples: You are liable for the debt.
He is up to his ears in debt.
exampleZh: 你有义务还债。
他浑身是债。

defsEn: to choose
to settle
to judge
zh: v. 决定, 判决
examples: We find it difficult to decide which one to buy.
You need to decide what kind of person you want to be.
exampleZh: 我们觉得很难决定买哪一个。
你必须得决定你想要成为一个什么样的人。

defsEn: to say
to make a statement
zh: v. 宣布, 声明, 申报, 断言
examples: The country declared war against its neighbor.
Do you have anything to declare?
exampleZh: 该国对其邻国宣战了。
你有任何要申报的东西吗？

defsEn: to make less in size or amount
zh: n. 减少, 减少量
v. 减少
examples: This medicine will decrease your pain.
My income has decreased ten percent.
exampleZh: 这种药会减轻你的疼痛。
我的收入减少了百分之十。

defsEn: going far down
a long way from top to bottom
zh: a. 深的
adv. 深入地
n. 深渊, 深处
examples: That day left a deep impression on me.
The water there was so deep that I could not touch bottom.
exampleZh: 我对那天的印象很深刻。
那儿的水深到我碰不到底。

defsEn: to cause to lose in a battle or struggle
n. a loss
the condition of having lost
zh: n. 败北, 失败
vt. 击败, 使落空
examples: Our soccer team defeated all the other teams in the city.
Our football team defeated all the other teams in the city.
exampleZh: 我们的足球队打败了市里所有其他队。
我们的足球队打败了市里所有其他队。

defsEn: to guard or fight against attack
to protect
zh: vt. 防护, 辩护, 防卫
examples: That was the only way we could defend ourselves against all this terrible shooting.
To defend ourselves, we had to tell a lie.
exampleZh: 那是我们在枪林弹雨中自保的唯一方法。
为了保护自己，我们只好说谎。

defsEn: a shortage that results when spending is greater than earnings, or imports are greater than exports
zh: n. 赤字, 不足额
examples: A budget deficit will occur because of a revenue shortfall.
How huge a deficit can the nation stand?

defsEn: to give the meaning of
to explain
zh: vt. 定义, 规定, 使明确
examples: In a word, how would you define technology?
How would you define a successful marriage?

defsEn: a measure of temperature
zh: n. 程度, 度数, 学位, 度
examples: To what degree can we trust him?
He got a master's degree in law.
exampleZh: 我们可以有多相信他？
他得到了法律硕士学位。

defsEn: to decide to do something at a later time
to postpone
to cause to be late
zh: n. 耽搁, 迟滞
v. 耽搁, 延迟
examples: The weather will delay the start of the race.
An accident delayed us for half an hour.
exampleZh: 因为天气的关系，赛跑比赛将会延迟。
事故耽误了我们半小时。

defsEn: one sent to act for another
one who represents another
zh: n. 代表
vt. 委派...为代表
examples: Delegates from many countries participated in the conference.
He delegated his authority to his competent assistant.
exampleZh: 许多国家的代表出席了会议。

defsEn: to ask by ordering
to ask with force
zh: n. 要求, 需求, 需要
v. 要求, 查询
examples: I demand an explanation for this mistake.
He demanded that I should pay the money at once.
exampleZh: 我要求说明这个错误。
他要求我马上付钱。

defsEn: the system of government in which citizens vote to choose leaders or to make other important decisions
zh: n. 民主政治, 民主主义
examples: In a democracy, it's important for the press to be independent.
In a democracy, it is important that the press be independent.
exampleZh: 在民主国家，报刊的独立是很重要的。
在民主国家，报刊的独立是很重要的。

defsEn: to make a public show of opinions or feelings (“The crowd demonstrated in support of human rights.”)
to explain by using examples (“The teacher demonstrated the idea with an experiment.”)
zh: vt. 示范, 证明
vi. 示威
examples: The teacher demonstrated the idea with an experiment.
Would you demonstrate the next problem at the board?
exampleZh: 这位老师用试验论证了这个想法。

defsEn: close together
thick
zh: a. 密集的, 浓厚的
examples: There is a dense population of young people around here.
The fog was very dense during the early morning.

defsEn: to accuse of being wrong or evil
to criticize severely
zh: vt. 告发, 抨击, 谴责
examples: Who would have the courage to denounce them?
Most of them disavow and denounce that sort of behavior.

defsEn: to declare that something is not true
to refuse a request
zh: v. 否认, 拒绝
examples: No one can deny the fact.
Do you deny that you went there?
exampleZh: 谁也不能否定其事实。
你否认你去了那里吗?

defsEn: to need help and support
zh: vi. 靠, 视...而定, 信赖
examples: You may depend on him to help you.
My wife and children depend on me.
exampleZh: 你或许可以依靠他来帮助你。
我的老婆孩子都依靠我。

defsEn: to regret strongly
to express sadness
zh: vt. 悲悼, 哀叹, 对...深感遗憾
examples: One must deplore such bad behavior.
We deplore your cruelty to animals.

defsEn: to move forces or weapons into positions for action
zh: v. 展开, 配置
examples: You can still deploy that strategy.
The US deployed its own troops to Iraq.

defsEn: severe unhappiness
a period of reduced business and economic activity during which many people lose their jobs
zh: 俯角
examples: I suffer from depression during the winter.
I fell into a deep depression.

defsEn: to give a word picture of something
to give details of something
zh: vt. 描述, 描绘, 画
examples: Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?
Can you describe the situation you were in?
exampleZh: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？
你可以描述一下当时的处境吗？

defsEn: a dry area of land desert
zh: n. 沙漠, 应得的赏罚, 功劳
a. 沙漠的, 不毛的
vt. 放弃, 遗弃, 擅离
vi. 逃掉
examples: A camel is to the desert what a ship is to the sea.
It is an arid region, almost a desert.
exampleZh: 骆驼是沙漠之舟。
这是片干燥地区，几乎是一片荒漠。

defsEn: to plan or create plans for
zh: n. 设计, 图样, 方案, 企图
v. 设计, 计划
examples: My friend is currently designing a user interface for the new operating system.
This desk is designed for children.
exampleZh: 我的朋友正在为新的操作系统设计一个用户界面。
这张书桌是专门为儿童设计的。

defsEn: to want very much
to wish for
zh: n. 欲望, 要求
vt. 想要, 请求
vi. 渴望
examples: The more we have, the greater our desire will be.
Desire for food and sex is part of human nature.
exampleZh: 人拥有得愈多，贪念就愈大。
食色性也（孔子）。

defsEn: to break into pieces
to end the existence of
zh: vt. 破坏, 毁坏, 消灭
examples: If you want to be free, destroy your television set.
This city was destroyed in the war.
exampleZh: 你想成为自由就摧毁你的电视。
这座城市在战争中被摧毁。

defsEn: a small part of something
a small piece of information
zh: n. 细节, 详情
vt. 详述, 选派
vi. 画详图
examples: I'll explain it in detail next week.
We'll talk about this in detail later.
exampleZh: 我下周会详细说明的。
我们会后详谈。

defsEn: to keep or hold (“The police detained several suspects for questioning.”)
zh: vt. 扣留, 扣押, 耽搁
examples: He was detained at the border for a passport check.
Gabor saw Vladimir and his girlfriend being detained by the police.

defsEn: to grow
to create
to experience progress
zh: vt. 发展, 使发达, 进步, 洗印, 显影
vi. 发展, 生长
examples: History develops through the replacement of the old by the new.
The town developed into the center of the economy.
exampleZh: 新事物取代旧事物推动历史发展。
这座城镇发展成为了一个经济中心。

defsEn: a piece of equipment made for a special purpose
zh: n. 装置, 设计, 策略, 发明物, 设备
examples: This device made it possible to turn sea-water into fresh water easily.
You should have shown him the device.
exampleZh: 有了这个装置，把海水净化成淡水就不是难事了。
你应该给他看看这装置。

defsEn: a ruler with complete power
zh: n. 命令者, 独裁者
examples: You would make a perfect dictator.
I refuse to be a dictator.

defsEn: to become dead
to stop living
to end
zh: vi. 死亡, 消逝, 平息, 熄灭, 漠然, 渴望
vt. 死
n. 骰子, 冲模
examples: I love her so much I could die.
If you should die, what would become of your family?
exampleZh: 我爱她爱得要命。
如果你死了，你的家人会怎样呢？

defsEn: usual daily food and drink
zh: n. 日常饮食, 议会
vt. 照规定饮食
vi. 忌食
examples: She is on a diet for fear that she will put on weight.
The Diet will meet on Tuesday.
exampleZh: 她因为担心发胖而节食。
国会将在周二开会。

defsEn: not the same
zh: a. 不同的
examples: I want it to be different this time.
I suppose it's different when you think about it over the long term.
exampleZh: 我想让这次变得不一样。
我认为你考虑久了就会不一样了。

defsEn: not easy
hard to do, make or carry out
zh: a. 困难的
examples: I found it difficult to get along with him.
I want to leave this difficult job to her.
exampleZh: 我觉得很难和他相处。
我想让她干这项艰难的工作。

defsEn: to make a hole in the ground
zh: vt. 挖, 翻土, 发掘
vi. 挖掘
n. 挖掘
examples: You can dig dirt from the ground.
