You are always digging at me about my clothes.
exampleZh: 你可以在地上挖土。
你总是挖苦我的着装。

defsEn: the main amount of food eaten at a usual time (“The family had its dinner at noon.”)
a special event that includes food (“The official dinner took place at the White House.”)
zh: n. 晚餐, 正餐, 宴会
examples: I have to cook dinner today.
Dinner is ready, so we can eat whenever we want.
exampleZh: 我今天要准备晚饭。
晚餐已经准备好了，我们可以随时开始吃。

defsEn: a person who represents his or her government in dealing with another government
zh: n. 外交官, 有外交手腕的人
examples: He is about to become a diplomat at the Chinese Embassy in France.
I want to become a diplomat.
exampleZh: 他将要成为中国驻法国大使馆的外交官。

defsEn: to lead
to aim or show the way (“He directed me to the theater.”)
ad. straight to something
not through some other person or thing (“The path is direct.”)
zh: a. 直接的, 坦白的
vt. 指示, 指挥, 命令, 导演
vi. 指导, 指挥
adv. 直接地
examples: Excuse me. Can you direct me to the nearest subway station?
Is this the direct way to the Prado?
exampleZh: 打扰一下。请问你能告诉我最近的地铁站在哪吗？
这条路是不是直接通往普拉多博物馆？

defsEn: the way (east, west, north, south)
where someone or something came dirt from or went to
zh: n. 方向, 指导, 趋势
examples: You have no sense of direction.
We hurried in the direction of the fire.
exampleZh: 你一点方向感都没有。
我们急忙跑向火。

defsEn: earth or soil
zh: n. 污垢, 泥土
examples: Clean the dirt off the mirror.
The children were playing in the dirt.
exampleZh: 清理镜子上的灰尘。
孩子们在尘土里游戏。

defsEn: to become unseen
to no longer exist
zh: vi. 消失, 不见
examples: I could disappear at any time.
He put up his hoodie and tried to disappear into the crowd.
exampleZh: 我随时可以消失。
他拉起帽兜，试图隐没在人群中。

defsEn: to take away weapons
to no longer keep weapons
to make a bomb harmless by removing its exploding device
zh: vt. 解除武装, 裁军, 缓和
vi. 放下武器
examples: The police managed to disarm the perp.
Ziri forgot to disarm his alarm.

defsEn: an event causing widespread destruction or loss of life, such as an earthquake or plane crash
zh: n. 灾祸, 不幸, 彻底失败
examples: The victims of the earthquake disaster are numerous.
A string of disasters struck the region.
exampleZh: 地震灾难的受害者非常多。
一连串的灾难袭击这个地区。

defsEn: to find or learn something
zh: vt. 发现, 找到, 暴露
vi. 发现
examples: How foolish I was not to discover that simple lie!
Call me if you discover anything.
exampleZh: 我竟然蠢得被这么简单的谎话骗倒了！
如果你发现什么，请打给我。

defsEn: unfair treatment or consideration based on opinions about a whole group instead of on the qualities of an individual. (“He was accused of discrimination against people from other countries.”)
zh: n. 差别, 岐视, 辨别力
examples: Discrimination made it difficult for me to rent an apartment.
Discrimination made it difficult for me to find a job.

defsEn: to talk about
to exchange ideas
zh: vt. 讨论, 论述
examples: I would like to discuss about the price with you.
I am not in a situation to discuss this problem.
exampleZh: 我想和你谈谈价钱。
我不在讨论这个问题的状态。

defsEn: a sickness in living things, often caused by viruses, germs or bacteria
zh: n. 疾病, 弊病
examples: The doctor cured her of her disease.
I got a disease from listening to that band.
exampleZh: 医生治好了她的病。
光是听那个乐团的歌就会染病。

defsEn: to send away
to refuse to consider
zh: vt. 解散, 开除, 解职
vi. 解散
examples: He was dismissed by the boss of the factory.
Your Honor, I shall have to dismiss the entire panel.
exampleZh: 他被工厂的老板解雇。

defsEn: to oppose strongly by argument
n. an angry debate
zh: n. 争论
v. 争论
examples: We disputed for hours about what to write.
International disputes must be settled peacefully.
exampleZh: 我们为该写些什么而争论了好几个小时。
国际间的纷争一定要用和平的方法来解决。

defsEn: a person who strongly disagrees with his or her government
zh: a. 意见不同的, 持不同政见的
n. 意见不同的人, 持不同政见者
examples: The political dissident has spent nearly a decade under house arrest.
All political dissidents were purged under the former regime.

defsEn: the amount of space between two places or objects (“The distance from my house to your house is two kilometers.”)
zh: n. 距离, 远方, 遥远
examples: I saw a light in the distance.
Seen from a distance, the stone looks like a human face.
exampleZh: 我看见远处有灯光。
从远看得话，这个石头看起来像人的脸。

defsEn: to jump into water head first
zh: n. 潜水, 跳水
vi. 跳水, 俯冲, 猛冲
vt. 把...突然伸入
examples: He dived into the water and came up for air.
She dived into the swimming pool.
exampleZh: 他潜进水里，然后又浮上水来换气。
她跳入了游泳池。

defsEn: to separate into two or more parts
zh: vi. 分开, 分配, 分裂
vt. 分, 分开, 分裂, 除
n. 分配, 分水岭
examples: Let's divide this money between you and me.
We divided the money between us.
exampleZh: 这钱你和我分了吧。
我们平分这笔钱。

defsEn: to act
to make an effort
zh: v. 做, 进行, 完成
examples: What kind of person do you want to be?
Do you want to go to a movie tonight?
exampleZh: 你想成为一个怎样的人？
你今晚想去看电影吗？

defsEn: a person trained in medicine to treat sick people
zh: n. 医生, 博士
vt. 授以博士学位, 诊断, 修改
vi. 行医
examples: The doctor told her that she should take a rest.
He said, "I want to be a doctor."
exampleZh: 医生告诉她要静养。
他说：「我想成为医生。」

defsEn: an official piece of paper with facts written on it, used as proof or support of something
zh: n. 文件, 公文, 文档
vt. 证明, 为...引证
examples: This is the pen that he signed the document with.
I hadn't recognized the importance of this document until you told me about it.
exampleZh: 这就是他用来签署那份文件的笔了。
你告诉了我以后，我才知道这份文件有多重要。

defsEn: a small animal that often lives with humans
zh: n. 狗, 坏蛋
vt. 跟踪, 尾随
examples: I walk my dog in the park every morning.
I saw a dog swim across the river.
exampleZh: 我每天早上到公园里遛狗。
我见过狗游泳渡河。

defsEn: United States money, one hundred cents dollar
zh: n. 美元, 元(加、澳等国货币单位)
examples: The value of the dollar declines as the rate of inflation rises.
Suppose you had a thousand dollars, what would you do with it?
exampleZh: 随着通货膨胀的发展美元贬值了。
假如你有1000美元，你会用它做什么呢？

defsEn: to present something as a gift to an organization, country or cause. (“She donated money to the Red Cross to help survivors of the earthquake.”)
zh: v. 捐赠
examples: He anonymously donated a large sum of money to the Red Cross.
Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.
exampleZh: 他匿名向红十字捐了大笔钱。
汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。

defsEn: an opening for entering or leaving a building or room
zh: n. 门
examples: Open the door and let me in, please.
Would you please not leave the door open?
exampleZh: 拜托你开门让我进来吧。
你可以不把门开着吗？

defsEn: to increase two times as much in size, strength or number.
zh: n. 两倍
a. 两倍的, 双重的
vt. 使加倍
vi. 加倍, 代替, 快步走
examples: Do you have a double room?
The price is double what it was last year.
exampleZh: 您有双人房吗？
这个价格是去年的两倍。

defsEn: from higher to lower
in a low place
zh: a. 向下的
adv. 下, 下去, 降下
prep. 往下, 沿着
n. 丘陵, 软毛, 开阔的高地

defsEn: to have a picture or story in the mind during sleep
n. a picture or story in the mind during sleep
a happy idea about the future
zh: n. 梦, 空想, 愿望
v. 做梦, 想象, 梦想
examples: You can make your dream come true by working hard.
I hope my dream will come true.
exampleZh: 你努力工作的话，就可以实现你的梦想。
我希望我的梦想实现。

defsEn: to take liquid into the body through the mouth
zh: n. 饮料, 酒
v. 喝, 喝酒
examples: Would you like to have a drink before dinner?
I always drink a cup of coffee in the morning.
exampleZh: 晚饭前您想喝一杯吗？
在早晨，我总是喝一杯咖啡。

defsEn: to control a moving vehicle
zh: n. 驾车, 快车道, 推进力, 驱动, 动力, 击球, 驱动器
vt. 开车, 驱使, 推动, 驾驶
vi. 开车, 猛击, 飞跑
examples: Do you know how to drive a car?
Do you know how to drive this thing?
exampleZh: 你会驾车吗？
你知道怎么驾驶这玩意儿吗？

defsEn: to fall or let fall
to go lower
zh: n. 滴, 微量, 落下, 空投
vi. 放下, 掉下, 下降
vt. 使滴下, 放下, 丢失, 遗漏
examples: Drop me off at the front door, please.
That boy used to drop in on me.
exampleZh: 请把我送到家门口。
那男孩儿来访过我家。

defsEn: to die under water
zh: vi. 淹死
vt. 把...淹死, 淹没
examples: I want to watch you drown.
He saved the drowning boy at the risk of his own life.
exampleZh: 我想看你淹死。
他奋不顾身地把遇溺的男孩救了起来。

defsEn: anything used as a medicine or in making medicine
a chemical substance used to ease pain or to affect the mind
zh: n. 药, 麻药, 麻醉药
vi. 吸毒
vt. 使服麻醉药, 使麻木
examples: Do you have a drug problem?
When it comes to drugs, there's a very fine line between use and abuse.
exampleZh: 你是不是吸毒吸傻了？
用药和滥药只差一线。

defsEn: not wet
without rain
zh: a. 干的, 无酒的, 枯燥无味的, 干燥的
vt. 把...弄干
vi. 变干
n. 干, 干涸
examples: Hang your clothes out to dry!
Do you want dry cleaning or regular wash?
exampleZh: 你把衣服晾出来！
你要干洗还是湿洗？

defsEn: through the whole time
while (something is happening)
zh: prep. 在...的时候
examples: I used a map during my trip.
Do not read during the meal.
exampleZh: 我在旅行中用了地图。
别在吃饭时读书。

defsEn: pieces of matter so small that they can float in the air
zh: n. 灰尘, 尘埃, 粉末, 花粉, 土, 骚乱
vt. 拂去灰尘, 撒, 弄成粉末
vi. 拂去灰尘, 化为粉末
examples: Clean the dust off the shelf.
Jack brushed the dust off his coat.
exampleZh: 把架子上的灰尘擦一下。
杰克刷去了他外套上的灰尘。

defsEn: one’s job or responsibility
what one must do because it is right and just
zh: n. 责任, 关税, 职务, 尊敬
examples: I believe that it's my duty to protect these children.
I believe it's my duty to protect these children.
exampleZh: 我认为我有义务保护这些孩子。
我认为我有义务保护这些孩子。

defsEn: every one by itself
zh: a. 每个, 每一
adv. 每个
pron. 每个, 个人, 各自
examples: You must not talk to each other in class.
We do not understand each other.
exampleZh: 上课不能交头接耳。
我们互相不了解。

defsEn: at or near the beginning, especially the beginning of the day
opposite late
zh: a. 早的, 早熟的
adv. 很早, 初
examples: I left home early to get a good seat.
I have to catch the early train tomorrow.
exampleZh: 为了弄到一个好位子，我很早就出门了。
我明天要赶大清早的火车。

defsEn: to be paid in return for work done
zh: vt. 赚得, 获得, 博得
examples: The more you earn, the more you spend.
I want to earn a lot of money.
exampleZh: 挣的越多钱，就花得越多钱。
我想赚很多钱。

defsEn: the planet we all live on
the ground or soil earth
zh: n. 地球, 泥土, 世界, 尘世
vt. 埋入土中, 赶入洞内
vi. 躲入洞内
examples: What place on Earth could be better than the place your people came from?
If the Earth went into an Ice Age next month, how would you prepare?
exampleZh: 世界上有什么地方能比得上你的故乡好啊？
如果地球下个月将进入冰河期，你将如何准备？

defsEn: a sudden, violent shaking of the earth’s surface
zh: n. 地震
examples: An earthquake can take place at any time.
An earthquake can happen at any time.
exampleZh: 地震随时都可能发生。
地震随时都可能发生。

defsEn: to reduce
to make less difficult
zh: n. 安乐, 安逸, 悠闲
vt. 使安乐, 使安心, 减轻, 放松
vi. 减轻, 放松, 灵活地移动
examples: I feel at ease around him.
I feel quite at ease when I sit in this chair.
exampleZh: 有他在身边我感觉很自在。
这张椅子坐得很舒服。

defsEn: the direction from which the sun rises
zh: n. 东方, 东
a. 东方的, 向东的
adv. 向东方, 朝东方
examples: Cultures of the East and the West meet together in this country.
The sun comes up in the east and goes down in the west.
exampleZh: 东西方文化在这个国家融合。
太阳在东方升起，西方落下。

defsEn: not difficult
not hard to do
zh: a. 容易的, 缓缓的, 舒适的, 从容的, 宽容的, 流畅的, 随便的, 自在的, 疲软的
adv. 容易地, 慢慢地
examples: It is not always easy to distinguish the Japanese from the Chinese.
It was not easy to put out the fire at once.
exampleZh: 日本人和中国人有时很难分辨。
要即时扑灭那火灾并不容易。

defsEn: to take food into the body through the mouth
zh: v. 吃, 腐蚀
examples: I want to go eat an ice cream.
I think you should eat a ham sandwich.
exampleZh: 我想去吃个冰淇淋。
我认为你该吃火腿三明治。

defsEn: the scientific study of the environment and links among living and material things
zh: n. 生态学, 社会生态学
examples: Ecology is very important to keep our world safe.
Desert ecology is a new field of study.

defsEn: the system by which money, industry and trade are organized
zh: n. 经济, 理财, 节约
examples: I hope the economy picks up soon.
What do you think of Japan's economy?
exampleZh: 我希望经济很快复苏起来。
您怎样看日本的经济呢？

defsEn: the line where something ends or begins
zh: n. 边缘, 尖锐, 刀刃, 优势
vt. 使锐利, 挤进, 镶边
vi. 缓缓移动
examples: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.
The sidebar is displayed on the edge of the page below the site logo.
exampleZh: 如果系统工程师继续离开，公司的竞争优势将会被削弱。
侧边栏显示在网站标志下方的页面边缘。

defsEn: the act of teaching
zh: n. 教育, 训练, 教育学
examples: I believe that a fine education can change one's social status.
It's important to me that you receive an education.
exampleZh: 我相信良好的教育能改变人的社会地位。
你能受到教育，对我来说很重要。

defsEn: the result or change caused by something (“The storm had a serious effect on the economy.”)
zh: n. 结果, 影响, 效果, 印象
vt. 实行, 引起, 完成
examples: The effects of the atmosphere and ocean on the environment are very important.
The law is still in effect.
exampleZh: 大气与海洋对于地球环境的影响十分重大。
这条法律依然有效。

defsEn: an attempt
the work necessary to do something
zh: n. 努力, 成就
examples: Give your best effort in all that you do.
One more effort, you will get on in life.
exampleZh: 你做任何事都要尽全力。
再努力一下，你的人生会成功的。

defsEn: the rounded object containing unborn young produced by female birds, fish or reptiles
a single cell in a female person or animal that can develop into a baby
zh: n. 蛋, 卵
vt. 挑唆, 煽动, 调蛋黄
examples: The shell of an egg is easily broken.
It's about the size of an egg.
exampleZh: 蛋壳容易破碎。
它的大小就像鸡蛋。

defsEn: one of two, but not the other
zh: a. (两者之中)任一的, (两者之中)各一的
pron. (两者之中)任一
conj. 或, 要么
examples: You can take either road to get to the park.
Either you or I must attend the meeting.
exampleZh: 哪条路都可以去公园哦。
你和我其中一个要出席这次的会议。

defsEn: to choose by voting
zh: n. 当选人, 被选的人
a. 被选的, 选出的
vt. 选举, 选择
vi. 作选择
examples: We elected her captain of our team.
They have elected a new government.
exampleZh: 我们选她为我们队的队长。
他们选出了新政府。

defsEn: a small part of an atom that has an electrical force
zh: n. 电子
examples: Electrons orbit around the nucleus of the atom.
There is one electron in a hydrogen atom.

defsEn: a form of energy that flows through wires to provide heat and light, and power to machines
zh: n. 电, 电流, 电学, 热情, 电力供应
examples: There is no life without electricity and water.
The electricity failed during the storm.
exampleZh: 我们没有电力和水就不能生活。
暴风雨中，停电了。

defsEn: one of more than 100 substances known to science that cannot be separated into other substances
zh: n. 元件, 元素, 要素
examples: This element can be found in nature extremely rarely.
I feel out of my element.

defsEn: the offices of an ambassador and his or her assistants
zh: n. 大使馆, 大使馆全体人员
examples: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.
He has access to the American Embassy.
exampleZh: 他是美国大使馆的外交官。
他有权出入美国大使馆。

defsEn: a human or animal in the earliest stages of its development
zh: n. 胚胎, 胎儿, 胚芽
examples: A developing embryo connects to the placenta via the umbilical cord.
The embryo's cells respond differently depending on how many morphogens reach them.

defsEn: an unexpected and dangerous situation demanding quick action
zh: n. 紧急状况, 紧急事件, 紧急需要
examples: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
In case of emergency, call the police.
exampleZh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
在紧急情况下，打电话报警。

defsEn: a strong feeling such as love, hate, fear or sadness
zh: n. 情绪, 激动, 强烈的情感
examples: He hid his emotions and pretended to be enthusiastic.
Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
exampleZh: 他把情感藏进了心底，装出热心的样子。
任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。

defsEn: to give work in return for wages
zh: n. 雇用
vt. 雇用, 使用, 使从事于
examples: She employed a private detective to keep a watch on her husband.
She employed him as a programmer.
exampleZh: 她雇了一个私人侦探看守她的丈夫。
她雇用他作程式设计师。

defsEn: having nothing inside
v. to remove everything
zh: a. 空的, 空虚的, 空腹的, 空洞的
n. 空的东西, 空车
vt. 倒空, 使变空, 使排出
vi. 流空
examples: My life would be completely empty without you.
You can't fight on an empty stomach.
exampleZh: 如果没有你，我的人生就会变得空白一片。
饿着肚子是没法打仗的。

defsEn: to stop
to finish
n. the part which comes last
zh: n. 结束, 终点, 目标, 末端, 梢, 死亡, 残余
v. 结束, 终结, 终止
examples: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
In the end, what must I really believe in?
exampleZh: 你该结束这种愚蠢的行为了。
毕竟，我应认真相信些什么？

defsEn: a person opposing or hating another
a person or people of the other side in a war
zh: n. 敌人, 仇敌, 敌军
a. 敌人的
examples: The enemy of my enemy is my friend.
An enemy of an enemy is a friend.
exampleZh: 敌人的敌人是朋友。
敌人的敌人就是同伴。

defsEn: power used to do work, usually with machines
the ability and willingness to be active
zh: n. 精力, 精神, 活力, 能量
examples: I've put all of my energy into this plan.
It still costs energy to chop it off.
exampleZh: 我在这项计划上投入了所有精力。
还要花能量砍掉。

defsEn: to make something be done
zh: vt. 强迫, 执行, 坚持
examples: Should we enforce unity at the cost of justice and freedom?
The government must enforce the law immediately.

defsEn: a machine that uses energy to cause movement or to do work
zh: n. 引擎, 发动机, 机车
vt. 安装发动机于
examples: He knows how to cut the engine.
Keep the engine running. I'll be right back.
exampleZh: 他知道怎么关掉引擎。
让引擎持续运转，我去去就来。

defsEn: a person who designs engines, machines, roads, bridges or railroads
zh: n. 工程师, 工兵
vt. 设计, 监造, 精明地处理, 策划
examples: The engineer told us how to use the machine.
I want to become an engineer.
exampleZh: 工程师告诉我们如何使用机器。
我想成为一位工程师。

defsEn: to be pleased or satisfied by something
zh: vt. 享受, 喜欢, 欣赏
examples: Do they all enjoy such high speed development?
We hope you will enjoy the show.
exampleZh: 他们都享受那么快的发展吗？
我们希望你喜欢这个表演。

defsEn: as much as necessary
zh: n. 充足, 够, 很多
a. 充足的, 足够
adv. 足够
interj. 够了
examples: We just have enough time to eat breakfast.
We have enough time to catch the train.
exampleZh: 我们刚好有时间吃早饭。
我们有足够的时间赶上那班火车。

defsEn: to come or go into
zh: vt. 进入, 参加, 开始, 输入, 回车
vi. 进去, 参加
examples: Take off your hat when you enter a classroom.
We saw the children enter the room.
exampleZh: 进教室时请脱下帽子。
我们看到了孩子们进入这个房间。

defsEn: all surrounding things, conditions and influences that affect life
the natural world of land, sea, air, plants and animals
zh: n. 环境, 外界, 围绕
examples: They have no impact on the environment.
They live in a good environment.
exampleZh: 它们对环境一点都没有影响。
他们的生活环境很好。

defsEn: a special kind of protein
it produces changes in other substances without being changed itself
zh: n. 酶
examples: An enzyme is a protein that functions as a catalyst for a chemical reaction.
This enzyme is produced in the stomach.

defsEn: the same in amount, size, weight or value
having the same rights
zh: n. 对手, 匹敌, 同辈
a. 相等的, 平等的, 胜任的, 合适的, 平静的, 不相上下的
vt. 等于, 比得上
examples: Do you think that he is equal to the task?
Is she equal to a long journey?
exampleZh: 你认为他能够胜任这个任务吗?
她受得了长途旅行吗？

defsEn: things, tools or machines needed for a purpose or activity
zh: n. 装备, 设备, 才能
examples: If you use this modern equipment, it will save a lot of manpower.
This heating equipment uses diesel as fuel.
exampleZh: 如果人们使用这些现代化的机器, 那将节省很多人力。
这个取暖装置用柴油作为燃料。

defsEn: to get free
to get away from
to get out of
zh: n. 逃亡, 避难设备, 逃跑
vi. 逃脱, 避开, 溜走
vt. 逃避, 避免, 被...忘掉
examples: I barely escaped being hit by the truck.
A man can't escape his past.
exampleZh: 我差点被卡车撞上。
人无法逃避过去。

defsEn: more than others (“We liked the food, especially the fish.”)
zh: adv. 尤其, 特别, 格外
examples: You should especially not drink on an empty stomach.
I like music, especially classical music.
exampleZh: 你尤其不该空腹喝酒。
我很喜欢音乐，尤其是古典音乐。

defsEn: to bring into existence
to create
zh: vt. 建立, 确立, 制定
vi. 移植生长
examples: The security level, as established by the Department of Homeland Security, is orange.
People established churches and schools there.
exampleZh: 根据国土安全部的规定，目前的安全水准是橙色等级。
人们在那里建立了教堂和学校。

defsEn: to form an opinion about a value, size or amount using less than complete information
zh: n. 估计, 判断
vt. 估计, 评价, 判断
vi. 估计
examples: At a rough estimate, I would say the job will take two weeks.
Try to estimate how much you spent on books.
exampleZh: 我想这工作粗略估计得花上两个星期的时间。
算一算你花了多少钱买书。

defsEn: of or concerning people belonging to a large group because of their race, religion, language, tribe or where their ancestors lived
zh: a. 人种的, 种族的
examples: Do you know an ethnic dance?
If you are an ethnic writer, you have a burden of representation.

defsEn: to change from a liquid into a gas
zh: 蒸
examples: Boiling water evaporates and turns into a gas.
Water evaporates when it is heated.
exampleZh: 沸水蒸发成气体。
当水被加热时，水汽蒸发。

defsEn: in a way not thought possible (“They survived, even though the building was destroyed.”)
zh: a. 平坦的, 相等的, 连贯的, 均等的, 公平的, 偶数的, 平均的, 平衡的, 恰好的
vt. 使平坦, 使相等
vi. 变平, 成为相等
adv. 甚至, 实际上, 完全, 十分
n. 偶数, 偶校验
examples: Why do you even care about this?
I want to get even more.
exampleZh: 你怎么还关心这个？
我还要获得更多。

defsEn: that which happens, especially something of importance
zh: n. 事件, 结果, 事情的进程, 竞赛项目
examples: In any event, I will do my best.
The event is still fresh in our memory.
exampleZh: 不管怎样，我尽力。
那件事在我们的脑海中还记忆犹新。

defsEn: at any time
zh: adv. 曾经, 究竟, 永远
examples: Have you ever read a book in Chinese?
Do you ever eat rice with a spoon?
exampleZh: 你有没有看过中文书？
你用汤匙吃过米饭吗？

defsEn: each one
all
zh: a. 每一, 所有的
examples: Every day I come to university by bus.
Every time I see you, I think of your mother.
exampleZh: 我每天坐公车来大学。
我每次见到你就会想起你的母亲。

defsEn: material or facts that prove something
a reason for believing
zh: n. 根据, 证据, 迹象
examples: Unless there is reliable evidence for it, we should not believe anything.
The evidence was in his favor.
exampleZh: 除非有可靠的证据，不然我们不应该相信任何事。
证据对他有利。

defsEn: not good
extremely bad
zh: n. 邪恶, 不幸, 罪恶
a. 邪恶的, 不幸的, 有害的, 讨厌的
examples: See no evil, Hear no evil, Speak no evil.
The world's evil almost always comes from ignorance.
exampleZh: 不见、不闻、不言。
世上的罪恶差不多总是由愚昧无知造成的。

defsEn: having no mistakes
correct in every detail
zh: a. 精确的, 准确的, 精密的
vt. 强求, 急需
examples: Please give me the exact address.
I do not understand the exact meaning of this sentence.
exampleZh: 请你告诉我详细地址。
我不是很清楚这个句子的意思。

defsEn: to study closely
zh: v. 检查, 调查, 考试
examples: People must examine the front and back of a coin.
He picked up a mirror and examined his tongue.
exampleZh: 人们必须查看硬币的正反面。
他拿了面镜子细看自己的舌头。

defsEn: a part that shows what the rest of a thing or group is like
zh: n. 例子, 样本, 实例
examples: Can you give an example to explain what you mean?
Follow the example of your sister.
exampleZh: 你能举例说明你的想法吗?
学学你姐姐。

defsEn: extremely good
zh: a. 优良的, 杰出的, 出色的
examples: The weather is excellent today. Go for a walk.
The service is excellent in this hotel.
exampleZh: 今天天气不错，出去走走吧。
这家酒店服务很好。

defsEn: but for
zh: vt. 除, 除外
vi. 反对
prep. 除了...之外, 若不是, 除非
conj. 只是
examples: The room was empty except for a shabby bed.
I have no choice except going by air.
exampleZh: 房间除了一张破旧的床以外，就什么也没有了。
我除了坐飞机外别无选择。

defsEn: to trade
to give or receive one thing for another
zh: n. 交换, (电话)交换局, 交换机, 汇兑, 交易所
v. 交换, 交易, 兑换
examples: Could you please exchange some small change with me?
I would like to exchange this watch for a cheaper one.
exampleZh: 请你帮我换一点零钱行吗？
我想用这块手表换一块便宜一点的。

defsEn: to take away blame
to pardon
to forgive
n. a reason (sometimes false) for an action
zh: vt. 原谅, 申辩, 做为...的托辞
n. 致歉, 理由, 饶恕, 借口
examples: Excuse me, could you pass me the sugar?
Excuse me, but may I open the window?
exampleZh: 打扰一下，你能把糖递给我吗？
不好意思，请问我可以开窗吗？

defsEn: to kill
zh: vt. 执行, 实行, 完成, 处死, 制成
examples: I want to execute the plan by all means.
He asked his brother to execute his will.

defsEn: an activity or effort for the purpose of improving the body or to stay in good health
zh: n. 行使, 执行, 运动, 练习, 作业
vt. 运用, 练习, 运动
vi. 练习, 锻炼
examples: I exercise for one hour every day.
I need to exercise more often.
exampleZh: 我每天运动一小时。
我需要更经常地锻炼。

defsEn: to force a person to leave his or her country
to expel
n. a person who is forced to leave his or her country
zh: n. 放逐, 流放, 被放逐者
vt. 放逐, 流放, 使背井离乡
examples: I refuse to go into exile.
We refuse to go into exile.

defsEn: to be
to live
zh: vi. 存在, 生存, 发生
examples: You will exist but you will never know what it is to live.
Men can not exist without air.
exampleZh: 你活着，但是却不知道为什么活着。
没有空气，人无法存在。

defsEn: to make larger
to grow larger
zh: vt. 使膨胀, 详述, 扩张
vi. 张开, 发展
vt. 展开
vi. 展开
examples: He really needs to expand his Berber vocabulary.
That market has been rapidly expanding.
exampleZh: 他真的很需要扩大自己的柏柏语词汇量。
那个市场一直在急速扩展。

defsEn: to think or believe that something will happen
to wait for an event
zh: vt. 预期, 盼望, 期待
examples: We expect him to come back soon.
I expect that he will help us.
exampleZh: 我们觉得他一会儿就回来了。
我期望他会帮助我们。

defsEn: to force out
to remove from
to send away
zh: vt. 驱逐, 逐出, 排出, 开除
examples: His son was expelled from school.
Many Jews were expelled by the Germans.
exampleZh: 他的儿子被学校开除了。
许多犹太人被德国人驱逐。

defsEn: to live through an event, situation or condition (“She experienced great pain.”)
n. something that one has done or lived through (“The experience caused her great pain.”)
zh: n. 经历, 经验, 体验
vt. 经历, 经验, 体验
examples: What job experience do you have?
He has a lot of teaching experience.
exampleZh: 你有从事什么工作的经验?
他在教学上拥有丰富的经验。

defsEn: to test
n. a test or trial carried out to prove if an idea is true or false, or to discover something
zh: n. 实验, 试验, 实验仪器
vi. 实验, 尝试
examples: Every step in the experiment was deliberate.
I got hurt during an experiment, and the injury was pretty serious.
exampleZh: 该实验的每一步都是经过深思熟虑的。
我做实验的时候弄伤了，而且还伤得十分严重。

defsEn: a person with special knowledge or training
zh: n. 专家, 行家
a. 老练的, 内行的, 专门的
examples: Only an expert can tell them apart.
He is an expert in the area of city planning.
exampleZh: 只有专家能区分出它们的不同。
他是个城市规划的专家。

defsEn: to give reasons for
to make clear
to tell about
to tell the meaning
zh: v. 解释, 说明
examples: Calm down and explain it from the beginning.
Would you like me to explain it?
exampleZh: 你冷静下来，从头开始跟我说。
你要我解释一下吗？

defsEn: to break apart violently with a loud noise, like a bomb
zh: vi. 爆炸, 爆发, 激增
vt. 使爆炸
examples: I thought my head would explode.
The aim of this game is to explode all the bombs on the screen.
exampleZh: 我觉得我的头要炸了。
这个游戏的目的是引爆荧幕上所有的炸弹。

defsEn: to travel in a place that is not well known to learn more about it
to make a careful search
to examine closely
zh: v. 探险, 探测, 探究
examples: Would you like to explore the castle with me?
They explore the impact of music on society.

defsEn: to send to another country
n. something sent to another country, usually for sale
zh: n. 输出品, 输出
vt. 输出, 出口
vi. 输出物资
examples: The Taiwanese dollar appreciated, causing Taiwanese exports to slump.
Can they export more goods this year?
exampleZh: 台币上涨，造成台湾的出口贸易不振。

defsEn: to say clearly
zh: n. 快车, 快递, 专使
a. 明确的, 丝毫不差的, 专门的, 快的
vt. 表达, 表示, 表露
examples: You can express the sentence this way.
We expressed the hope that they could go abroad again to study geography.
exampleZh: 你可以用这种方式表达这句话。
我们表示希望他们能再次出国学习地理。

defsEn: to stretch out in area or length
to continue for a longer time
zh: v. 扩充, 延伸, 伸展, 扩大
examples: I want to extend my stay here for a few more days.
Our branches extend all over the country.
exampleZh: 我想延长这里的住宿多几天。
我们的分店布满全国。

defsEn: more than normal, expected or necessary
zh: n. 额外的事物, 另外的收费
a. 额外的, 特别的
adv. 额外地, 特别地, 非常地
examples: Do you have an extra key?
I always need an extra blanket in the wintertime.
exampleZh: 你有多余的钥匙吗？
冬天我总是需要多加条被子。

defsEn: far greater or better than the usual or normal
zh: a. 非常的, 特别的, 非凡的
examples: The iPhone is an extraordinary cell phone.
Rosa Montero is an extraordinary woman.
exampleZh: 苹果是非凡的手机。
Rosa Montero是个不同寻常的女人。

defsEn: more than the usual or accepted
zh: n. 极端, 末端
a. 极端的, 尽头的, 极度的, 偏激的
examples: He holds an extreme opinion on education.
Your proposal is a bit extreme.
exampleZh: 关于教育，他持极端意见。
你的建议有点极端。

defsEn: a person with strong religious or political beliefs who acts in an extreme or violent way
zh: 偏激份子
examples: They're part of a Christian extremist group.
Zionist extremists reject the name "West Bank."

defsEn: the front of the head: eyes, nose, mouth
v. to look toward
to turn toward
to have before you, such as a problem or danger
zh: n. 脸, 面容, 正面, 外观
vt. 面对, 朝, 正视, 面临
vi. 朝, 向
examples: He told me to wash my face.
She at least, she can face them!
exampleZh: 他叫我洗脸。
至少她能面对他们！

defsEn: something known or proved to be true
zh: n. 事实, 真实性, 真相, 细节, 论据
examples: As a matter of fact, I do speak Spanish.
In point of fact, she had nothing to do with the scandal.
exampleZh: 事实上，我说西班牙语。
事实上，她和这个丑闻没有任何关系。

defsEn: a building or group of buildings where goods are made
zh: n. 工厂, 产生地, 代理店
examples: Possibly the factory will be closed down next week.
Hundreds of people work in this factory.
exampleZh: 下周工厂可能会关。
数百个人在这家工厂上班。

defsEn: to not succeed
to not reach a goal
zh: vi. 失败, 缺乏, 中断, 衰退, 失灵
vt. 忘记, 使...失望, 缺乏, 不及格
n. 不及格
examples: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
We failed due to a lack of preparation.
exampleZh: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。
我们因缺乏准备而失败了。

defsEn: just
honest
what is right
zh: n. 展览会, 市集, 美好的事物
a. 公平的, 按规则进行的, 不好不坏的, 晴朗的, 美丽的
adv. 公平地, 正面地, 有教养地, 清楚地
vi. 转晴
examples: It's not fair! I have to do the hard work!
Did you go to the book fair?
exampleZh: 这不公平！凭什么我必须做艰苦的工作。
你去书展了吗？

defsEn: to go down quickly
to come down
to drop to the ground or a lower position
zh: n. 落下, 瀑布, 采伐量, 下降, 落差, 降低, 堕落, 秋天
vi. 倒下, 落下, 来临, 失守, 阵亡, 下跌, 减弱, 倾斜, 垮台, 轮到, 变成, 降低
a. 秋天的
examples: I have nothing to fall back on.
Did you fall in love with her at first sight?
exampleZh: 我没什么可依靠的了。
你对她是不是一见钟情？

defsEn: not true
not correct
zh: a. 错误的, 虚伪的, 假的, 不老实的
adv. 不准确地, 欺诈地
examples: The rumor turned out to be false.
We considered the report as false.
exampleZh: 谣言最后被证明是假的。
我们认为这份报告是假的。

defsEn: the group that includes children and their parents
zh: n. 家庭, 家人, 族
a. 家庭的
examples: All of his family work on a farm.
I care about you and your family.
exampleZh: 他全家都在农场工作。
我很关心你和你的家人。

defsEn: known very well to many people
zh: a. 出名的, 极好的
examples: London, where I live, used to be famous for its fog.
His little brother is a famous soccer player.
exampleZh: 我住的地方－伦敦，从前以雾闻名。
他弟弟是个有名的足球选手。

defsEn: a person who actively supports a sport, activity or performer (“The baseball fan attended every game his team played.”)
zh: n. 风扇, 迷, 狂热者, 爱好者
vt. 煽动, 刺激, 吹拂
vi. 飘动, 成扇形散开
examples: Could you turn that fan off?
The fans all hope the club will change the manager.
exampleZh: 你能把风扇关掉吗？
球迷们都希望球队能换个教练。

defsEn: at, to or from a great distance
zh: a. 远的, 久远的, 遥远的
adv. 甚远地, 很, 到很深的程度, 到很远的距离
examples: I will help you as far as I can.
How far do you want to go?
exampleZh: 我会尽可能帮你的。
你要走多远？

defsEn: land used to grow crops and animals for food
zh: n. 农场, 农田
vt. 耕种
vi. 种田
examples: I live on a farm not too far from Boston.
The land on his farm is very fertile.
exampleZh: 我住在离波士顿不远的一个农场。
他农场的土地十分肥沃。

defsEn: moving or working at great speed
quick
zh: a. 快速的, 紧的
adv. 很快地, 紧紧地, 彻底地
n. 绝食, 斋戒
vi. 绝食, 斋戒
examples: She can swim as fast as her brother.
Can you swim as fast as he can?
exampleZh: 她能和她哥哥游得一样快。
你能游得比他快吗？

defsEn: tissue in the bodies of humans and animals used to store energy and to keep warm
ad. thick
heavy
zh: n. 脂肪, 脂油, 肥肉
a. 肥的, 胖的, 油腻的
n. 文件分配表
examples: I am not too rich, too fat or too happy.
He is tall, fat and always busy.
exampleZh: 我不太有钱、不太胖，也不太快乐。
他又高又胖，还总是很忙。

defsEn: the male parent
a man who has a child or children
zh: n. 父亲, 祖先, 长辈, 神父, 创始者
vt. 当...的父亲, 保护, 创作, 发明, 培养
examples: My father asked me to go to the concert.
My father will not let me marry him.
exampleZh: 父亲让我去演唱会。
我父亲不允许我嫁给他。

defsEn: liked more than others (“Ice cream was her favorite food.”)
zh: n. 喜欢的事物, 幸运儿
a. 特别受喜爱的, 喜爱的, 宠爱的, 中意的
examples: Do you have a favorite color?
My favorite word in German is the word for "glove".
exampleZh: 你有喜欢的颜色吗？
我最喜欢的德文字是「手套」。

defsEn: to be afraid
to worry that something bad is near or may happen (“He feared falling down.”)
n. a strong emotion when there is danger or trouble (“He had a fear that he would fall down.”)
zh: n. 恐怖, 害怕, 担心
v. 害怕, 恐惧, 为...担心, 敬畏
examples: I fear this work will take up most of my time.
There's a fear that the snow will strengthen amid the strong winter pressure pattern.
exampleZh: 我怕这项工作会占用我大部份的时间。
人们担心在强劲的冬季气压模式下，降雪量会增加。

defsEn: of or having to do with a national or central government
zh: a. 联邦的, 联合的, 同盟的
examples: Federal, state, and community officials immediately pledged to rebuild it.
I live in a federal republic.
exampleZh: 联邦、州及地方官员立即承诺将其重建。

defsEn: to give food to
zh: n. 饲料, 一餐, 饲养
vt. 喂, 饲养, 放牧, 靠...为生
vi. 吃东西, 用餐, 流入
examples: Just as food feeds the body, so reading feeds the mind.
She is the one who feeds our dog.
exampleZh: 就像食物喂养身体，所以阅读喂养心灵。
她是喂我们的狗的人。

defsEn: to have or experience an emotion
to know by touching
zh: vt. 感觉, 觉得, 触摸, 以为
vi. 有知觉, 摸索, 同情
n. 感觉, 觉得, 触摸
examples: How would you feel if your wife left you?
How do you feel about the new job?
exampleZh: 如果你的妻子离开了你，你会怎么想？
你对新工作感觉怎么样？

defsEn: a woman or girl
the sex that gives birth
ad. of or about women
zh: n. 女性, 女人, 雌性动物
a. 女性的, 女子的
examples: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.
Mrs. Bruce was the first female pilot to fly between England and Japan.
exampleZh: 我的一个女性朋友喜欢跟我一起去同志酒吧。
布鲁斯夫人是英国和日本之间航线的第一位女性飞行员。

defsEn: something around an area of land to keep animals or people in or out
zh: n. 围墙, 栅栏, 买卖赃物的人, 剑术
vt. 用篱笆围住, 练习剑术, 防护
vi. 击剑, 搪塞
examples: My father put a fence around the garden.
Walking along the fence he noticed a mouse.
exampleZh: 我父亲在花园边上装了篱笆。
沿着栅栏走时, 他看到了一只老鼠。

defsEn: rich in production of plants or animals
producing much
zh: a. 可繁殖的, 肥沃的, 生产多的
examples: It's fertile land inhabited by diverse nations.
Fertile soil is indispensable for a good harvest.
exampleZh: 这是一片肥沃的土地，居住着不同的民族。

defsEn: unborn young
zh: 胎儿；胚胎
examples: A fetus is not a baby.
A fetus is not a person.

defsEn: not many
a small number of
zh: a. 很少的, 不多的, 少数的
n. 少数
examples: Few people know how to do it.
Few, if any, will criticize him.
exampleZh: 很少有人知道怎么做。
很少有人会批评他，即使有也不多。

defsEn: an area of open land, usually used to grow crops or to raise animals
zh: n. 领域, 田地, 场地, 战场, 场, 域
vt. 使...晒在场上, 使上场
a. 田间的, 野生的, 野外的, 田赛的
examples: I found the field trip very educational.
She has a lot of experience in this field of work.
exampleZh: 我发现实地考察很有教育意义。
她对这项工作有着多年的工作经验。

defsEn: extremely strong
violent
angry
zh: a. 凶猛的, 猛烈的, 热烈的, 暴躁的
examples: How can you stand that fierce heat all day?
The author is a fierce critic of American foreign policy.

defsEn: to use violence or force
to attempt to defeat or destroy an enemy
n. the use of force
a battle
zh: n. 打架, 争吵, 斗志
v. 对抗, 打架
examples: I will fight to the last breath.
I will fight to the death.
exampleZh: 我会战斗到最后一口气。
我会战斗至死。

defsEn: to put or pour something into a container until there is space for no more
zh: vt. 装满, 填充, 弥漫, 供给, 满足, 供应
vi. 充满, 变得沉重
n. 满足, 装满, 充分, 填方
vt. 填充
vi. 填充
examples: Can you fill in for me at the meeting?
Can you tell me how to fill in this form?
exampleZh: 你能代替我出席会议吗?
你能教我怎么填这份表格吗？

defsEn: to record something so it can be seen again
to make a motion picture or movie
n. a thin piece of material for making pictures with a camera
a movie
zh: n. 软片, 薄膜, 胶卷, 电影
vt. 覆以薄膜, 拍摄
vi. 生薄膜, 拍电影
examples: I want to watch this film.
Which film do you like most?
exampleZh: 我想看这部电影。
你最喜欢的电影是哪部？

defsEn: at the end
last
zh: n. 期末考试, 结局, 决赛
a. 最后的, 终极的, 决定性的
examples: We left the final decision to him.
The final exams will probably carry over into next month.
exampleZh: 我们让他做最后的决定。
期末考试也许要持续到下个月吧。

defsEn: of or about the system that includes the use of money, credit, investments and banks
zh: a. 财政的, 金融的
examples: We must consider the financial aspects of this project.
Tokyo, as you know, is one of the financial centers of the world.
exampleZh: 我们必须从财政方面考虑一下这个计划。
如你所知，东京是全球金融中心之一。

defsEn: to discover or learn something by searching or by accident
to decide a court case (“The jury finds the man guilty of murder.”)
zh: vt. 发现, 感到, 找到, 认为, 得到
vi. 裁决
n. 发现
寻找指定的字符串, 将符合条件的行或行数输出到标准输出设备上
examples: How do you find food in outer space?
I have to find a part-time job.
exampleZh: 你怎么在太空里找到食物？
我得找一份兼职工作。

defsEn: a payment ordered by a court to punish someone for a crime
ad. very good
very small or thin
zh: n. 罚款, 罚金, 晴天, 精细
a. 好的, 晴朗的, 健康的, 细小的, 精细的
vt. 罚款, 精炼, 澄清
vi. 变清, 变细
adv. 很好
examples: Tomorrow will be a fine day.
I think it will be fine.
exampleZh: 明天是晴天。
我觉得没什么问题。

defsEn: to complete
to end
zh: n. 完成, 结束, 末道漆, 磨光, 完美
vt. 完成, 结束, 用完, 毁掉
vi. 结束
examples: I want to finish the work on my own.
I must finish this work by the day after tomorrow.
exampleZh: 我想要独立完成工作。
我后天以前必须要完成这个工作。

defsEn: to shoot a gun
n. the heat and light produced by something burning fire
zh: n. 火, 炉火, 电炉, 火灾, 闪光体, 炮火, 热情
vt. 点燃, 烧制, 使发光, 激动, 放枪, 解雇
vi. 着火, 烧火, 开枪, 射击, 激动
examples: Be sure to put out the fire before you leave.
He set fire to the school building.
exampleZh: 一定要熄了火，然后再离开。
他放火烧了校舍。

defsEn: rockets producing bright fire in the sky, used in holiday celebrations
zh: n. 烟火, 激烈争论
examples: They set off fireworks to celebrate the holiday.
They set off fireworks with a great bang.

defsEn: not easily moved or changed (“She is firm in her opinion.”)
zh: n. 公司, 商号
a. 坚定的, 坚强的, 牢固的, 结实的, 坚硬的, 坚挺的, 严格的, 确定的
vt. 使牢固, 使坚定
vi. 变稳固, 变坚实
adv. 稳固地
examples: With a firm goal in mind, you will do well.
I feel happy in her firm.
exampleZh: 有了坚定的目标，你会做得很好。
在她的公司里，我感觉很好。

defsEn: coming before all others
zh: adv. 首先, 第一, 优先
a. 第一的
num. 第一
n. 开始, 第一
examples: I fell in love with her at first sight.
She will be the first Japanese woman astronaut.
exampleZh: 我对她一见钟情。
她将会成为日本第一个女性太空人。

defsEn: a creature that lives and can breathe in water fish
zh: n. 鱼, 鱼肉, 鱼类, 接合板
vt. 钓, 钓鱼, 查出, 用接合板连接
vi. 捕鱼, 钓鱼, 用钩捞取, 摸索寻找
examples: I asked you to buy fish, not chicken!
I like to go fishing with my father.
exampleZh: 我让你买鱼，不是鸡！
我喜欢和父亲一起去钓鱼。

defsEn: a splitting
in atomic fission, the nucleus of an atom is split to produce nuclear energy
zh: n. 裂开, 分裂, 分体
examples: What's the difference between fission and fusion?

defsEn: to be of the correct size or shape (“These shoes fit my feet.”)
zh: n. 适宜, 合身, 发作, 痉挛
a. 适宜的, 对的, 准备好的
vt. 适合, 安装, 使合身, 使适应, 使合格
vi. 适合, 符合, 合身
examples: The price should fit my budget.
This fish is not fit to eat.
exampleZh: 价格应该符合预算。
这条鱼不能吃了。

defsEn: to make good or right again
zh: vt. 使固定, 修理, 准备, 安装, 凝视, 牢记, 确定, 整理
vi. 固定, 注视, 确定
n. 困境, 方位, 维修, 贿赂
examples: Will you be able to fix my car?
Can I fix you a hot drink?
exampleZh: 您能修好我的车吗？
我可以为你调杯热饮料吗？

defsEn: a piece of colored cloth used to represent a nation, government or organization
zh: n. 标志, 旗标, 旗子, 信号旗, 菖蒲
vt. 悬旗, 打旗号, 铺石板
vi. 无力地下垂
examples: The red flag indicated the presence of danger.
The colors of the American flag are red, white, and blue.
exampleZh: 红旗代表存在危险。
美国国旗的颜色是红白蓝。

defsEn: smooth
having no high places
zh: a. 平坦的, 单调的, 无力的, 浅的, 萧条的, 干脆的, 无聊的
adv. 平直地, 断然地
n. 扁平物, 平面, 平地, 平原, 平板车
v. (使)变平
examples: I live in a flat in the city.
She rented a flat close the to the city centre.
exampleZh: 我住在城市中的一间公寓里。
她在离市中心不远处租了间公寓。

defsEn: to run away from
zh: vt. 逃避, 逃跑, 逃走
vi. 逃, 消失
examples: Where will we flee, which country will take us in?
If you flee this battle, you will lose some gold.

defsEn: to be on water without sinking
to move or be moved gently on water or through air
zh: n. 漂流物, 浮舟, 漂浮, 浮萍, 彩车
vi. 浮动, 飘动, 散播, 摇摆, 动摇, 浮动
vt. 使漂浮, 容纳, 淹没, 发行, 实行
examples: He was the first man to float in space.
A white cloud floats in the blue sky.
exampleZh: 他是世上第一个在太空中飘浮的人。
一朵白云在蓝天上飘。

defsEn: to cover with water
n. the movement of water out of a river, lake or ocean onto land
zh: n. 洪水, 大量之水, 涨潮
vt. 淹没, 使泛滥, 注满
vi. 被淹, 溢出, 涌进
examples: The flood caused a lot of damage.
The town was destroyed by the flood after the storm.
exampleZh: 洪水造成了很大的损害。
小镇被暴风雨后的洪水摧毁了。

defsEn: the bottom part of a room for walking on (“The book fell to the floor.”)
the level of a building (“The fire was on the first floor.”)
zh: n. 地板, 楼层, 底部, 底价
vt. 铺地板, 打倒
n. 地面, 地板, 基底
examples: What floor do you live on?
Which floor do you live on?
exampleZh: 你住在哪层楼？
你住在哪层楼？

defsEn: to move like a liquid
zh: n. 流程, 流动, 流量, 洋溢, 泛滥, 涨潮
vi. 流动, 流泄, 畅流, 川流不息, 飘扬, 涌出
vt. 使流动, 淹没, 流出
examples: The flow of the water was strong enough to wash away the bridge.
The river flows under the bridge.
exampleZh: 水流的强力把桥给冲垮了。
河从桥下流过。

defsEn: the colored part of plants that carry seeds
zh: n. 花, 开花植物, 精华, 盛时
vi. 开花, 发育, 旺盛, 成熟
vt. 用花装饰, 使开花
examples: I see a flower on the desk.
What do you call this flower?
exampleZh: 我看见书桌上有朵花。
这个花叫什么名字？

defsEn: any substance that can flow, such as a liquid flower
zh: n. 液体, 分泌液, 流体
a. 流动的, 可改变的
examples: This fluid can be substituted for glue.
At a point, the pressure of a fluid is the same in all directions.

defsEn: to move through the air with wings, like a bird or airplane
to travel in an airplane or flying vehicle
zh: n. 苍蝇, 两翼昆虫, 飞行
vi. 飞, 飞翔, 飘扬, 逃走
vt. 飞, 飞越, 使飘扬, 逃出
a. 敏捷的
examples: A fly can walk on the ceiling.
Can you teach me how to fly?
exampleZh: 苍蝇能在天花板上走。
你能教我飞吗?

defsEn: a mass of wet air that is difficult to see through
a cloud close to the ground
zh: n. 雾, 迷惑, (割后的)最生草, 苔藓
vi. 被雾笼罩, 变模糊
vt. 使困惑, 以雾笼罩
examples: I could see nothing but fog.
The thick fog made it hard to see the road.
exampleZh: 除了雾我什么都看不见。
浓雾使道路很难看清。

defsEn: to come or go after
to accept the rule or power of
to obey
zh: vt. 跟随, 沿行, 遵循, 追求
vi. 跟随, 接着
n. 跟随, 追随
examples: Please follow this road and turn right at the bank.
I will follow you wherever you go.
exampleZh: 请沿着这条路走，在银行那里向右转。
你去哪我都跟。

defsEn: that which is taken in by all living things for energy, strength and growth
zh: n. 食物, 养料
examples: Hurry up! The food will get cold.
What kind of food do you have?
exampleZh: 快点，菜要凉了！
你们有什么菜？

defsEn: to make someone believe something that is not true
to trick
n. a person who is tricked easily
zh: n. 愚人, 受骗者, 奶油拌水果
vt. 愚弄, 欺骗, 浪费
vi. 干傻事, 开玩笑, 游荡
a. 傻的
examples: He is not such a fool as to believe that story.
What kind of fool do you think I am?
exampleZh: 他还没有傻到相信这个故事的地步。
你觉得我是傻子吗？

defsEn: the bottom part of the leg
the part of the body that touches the ground when a person or animal walks
zh: n. 脚, 步调, 英尺, 底部, 末尾, 步兵
vt. 走在...上, 给...换底, 支付
vi. 跳舞, 步行, 总计
examples: He hurt his left foot when he fell.
Will you go on foot or by bus?
exampleZh: 当他跌倒时，他伤了他的左脚。
你要用走的还是搭公车？

defsEn: because of (“He is famous for his work.”)
in exchange (“Give me one dollar for the book.”)
through space or time (“They traveled for one hour.”)
representative of (“I speak for all people.”)
to be employed by (“She works for a computer company.”)
zh: prep. 为, 因为, 至于
conj. 因为
examples: For some reason I feel more alive at night.
You can ask for whoever you want to.
exampleZh: 不知道为什么我夜里觉得比较有活力。
你想请谁就请谁。

defsEn: to make someone do something or make something happen by using power
n. power, strength
strength used against a person or object
military power of a nation
a military group
zh: n. 力量, 武力, 势力, 影响力, 军队, 力, 效力
vt. 强迫, 强夺, 推动, 提高
examples: I will never force you to marry him.
May the force be with you.
exampleZh: 我永远不会逼你跟他结婚。
愿力量与你同在。

defsEn: of, about or from another nation
not from one’s own place or country
zh: a. 外国的, 外交的, 外省的, 外来的, 不相关的
examples: The police found foreign DNA at the scene of the crime.
To learn a foreign language requires a lot of time.
exampleZh: 警方在犯罪现场发现了陌生人的 DNA。
学外语很费时间。

defsEn: a place of many trees
zh: n. 森林, 林区
vt. 植树于
examples: I walk in the forest every day.
We went for a walk in the forest.
exampleZh: 我每天都去森林散步。
我们去了林中散步。

defsEn: to not remember
zh: vt. 忘记, 忽略, 忘
vi. 忘记
examples: Forget it, let us talk about happy stuff!
You should try to forget your unhappy past.
exampleZh: 算了，我们聊点开心的事吧！
你应该要尝试着忘掉不快乐的过去。

defsEn: to pardon
to excuse
to remove guilt
zh: vt. 原谅, 宽恕, 免除
examples: I can on no condition forgive her.
Please forgive me for being late.
exampleZh: 我绝不能原谅她。
请原谅我迟到。

defsEn: to make
to start
to shape (“They formed a swim team.”)
n. a kind (“Swimming is a form of exercise.”)
zh: n. 形状, 形体, 类型, 方式, 表格, 形式
v. 形成, 排列, (使)组成
n. 表单
examples: Please mail this form to your insurance company.
Please fill out this form first.
exampleZh: 请把这份表格寄给您的保险公司。
请先填写这张表格。

defsEn: earlier in time
not now forest
zh: a. 从前的, 前者的
n. 起形成作用的人(或物), 模型, 样板
examples: When I met my former teacher, he inquired after my parents.
Lincoln greeted his former political rival.
exampleZh: 我遇见了以前的班主任时，他问候了我的父母。
林肯向前政敌行礼。

defsEn: the direction in front of
toward the front
zh: a. 向前的, 早的, 迅速的, 在前的, 进步的
vt. 促进...的生长, 转寄, 运送
adv. 向前地
examples: I look forward to your next visit.
I look forward to hearing from you.
exampleZh: 我期待着您的再次光临。
我期待收到你的来信。

defsEn: to release
ad. not controlled by another or by outside forces
not in prison
independent
not limited by rules
without cost
zh: a. 自由的, 享受政治权力的, 允许的, 免费的, 丰富的
vt. 释放, 解放, 使自由
adv. 自由地, 免费
examples: When you have free time, please come and play.
What do you like to do in your free time?
exampleZh: 有空的时候，请过来玩儿。
您空闲时间喜欢做什么？

defsEn: the condition of being free
zh: n. 自由, 坦率, 特权
examples: Freedom is the center of American democracy.
All I want is my freedom.
exampleZh: 美国民主的中心思想是自由。
我只要自由。

defsEn: to cause or to become very cold
to make or to become hard by cold
zh: vi. 冻结, 冷冻, 僵硬, 楞住
vt. 使结冰, 使冻住, 使呆住
n. 结冰, 凝固
examples: Water will freeze at zero Celsius, right?
When water freezes it becomes ice.
exampleZh: 摄氏零度时水会结冰，对吧？
水结冻后，变成冰。

defsEn: newly made or gathered
recent
zh: a. 新鲜的, 新奇的, 另外的, 淡的, 精神饱满的, 冒失的
adv. 最新地, 刚刚
n. 开始, 泛滥
examples: A little fresh air will do me good.
I want to eat fresh fish.
exampleZh: 呼吸点新鲜空气会让我好些。
我想吃点新鲜的鱼。

defsEn: a person one likes and trusts
zh: n. 朋友, 支持者, 赞助者
examples: A true friend would not say such a thing.
I do want to be your friend.
exampleZh: 如果真的是朋友的话，是不会说这样的话的吧。
我想跟你交朋友。

defsEn: to cause great fear
zh: vt. 使惊吓
vi. 惊恐
examples: I didn't mean to frighten you.
This movie is frightening to the children.
exampleZh: 我没想要吓你。
这部电影对小孩来说很可怕。

defsEn: having a person, place or thing as a beginning or cause (“It is a message from the president.”)
at a place distant, not near (“The school is five kilometers from my home.”)
because of (“He is suffering from cancer.”)
zh: prep. 从, 来自, 根据
examples: I hear from my mother once in a while.
I read the book from cover to cover.
exampleZh: 我时不时得到母亲的消息。
那本书我从头到尾看完了。

defsEn: the forward part
the opposite of back
the beginning
the first part
zh: n. 前面, 开头, 前线, 阵线, 态度
vt. 面对, 朝向, 对抗
vi. 朝向
examples: Please let me off in front of that building.
Move up to the front, please.
exampleZh: 请让我在那栋房子前下车。
请到前面来。

defsEn: food from trees and plants
zh: n. 水果, 果类, 结果
examples: What kind of fruit do you like?
What fruit do you like the most?
exampleZh: 你爱吃什么水果？
你最喜欢什么水果？

defsEn: any substance burned to create heat or power
zh: n. 燃料, 木炭
vt. 加燃料, 供燃料
vi. 得到燃料
examples: There was a shortage of fuel.
What kind of fuel do you use in this machine?
exampleZh: 燃料短缺。

defsEn: containing as much as a person or thing can hold
complete
zh: n. 全部, 完整
a. 充满的, 完全的, 丰富的, 完美的, 丰满的, 详尽的
adv. 完全地, 整整, 十分
vt. 把(衣服等)缝得宽松, 漂洗
examples: We could see the full extent of the park from the hotel.
We have full reason to believe that it is true.
exampleZh: 我们从酒店里可以把整个公园看得清清楚楚。
我们有充分的理由相信这是真的。

defsEn: anything that is pleasing and causes happiness
zh: n. 乐趣, 玩笑, 娱乐
vi. 开玩笑
a. 供娱乐用的
examples: You ought not to make fun of them.
This should be a lot of fun.
exampleZh: 你别嘲弄他们。
这应该很有意思。

defsEn: a ceremony held in connection with the burial or burning of the dead
zh: n. 葬礼, 出殡
examples: Tom's funeral will be this weekend.
I went to three funerals last month.
exampleZh: 汤姆的葬礼订在这周末。
上个月我参加了三场葬礼。

defsEn: a joining together
in atomic fusion, atomic particles are joined together to produce nuclear energy
zh: n. 熔合物, 结合, 熔合
examples: Nuclear fusion could wean the global economy off fossil fuels.
Everyone coming together is an example of fusion.

defsEn: time after now (“We can talk about it in the future.”)
ad. in the time to come (“All future meetings will be held in this room.”)
zh: n. 未来, 将来
a. 将来的, 未来的
examples: What would you like to do in the future?
What would you like to be in the future?
exampleZh: 以后打算干什么？
你以后想当什么呢？

defsEn: to get possession of
to get more
to increase
zh: n. 增益, 获得, 利润, 收获, 增加
vt. 得到, 增进, 赚到
vi. 获利, 增加
examples: You gain more than you spend when you go to college.
His first work gained great popularity among people.
exampleZh: 上大学的时候，你得到的比付出的还多。
他的处女作受到了大家的极大欢迎。

defsEn: an activity with rules in which people or teams play or compete, usually sports
zh: n. 比赛, 玩耍, 比分, 得胜, 比赛规则, 策略, 游戏, 野味
vi. 赌博
a. 勇敢的, 有胆量的, 关于野味的, 跛的
examples: Whatever game I play with you, you never win.
Tell me how to play the game.
exampleZh: 无论我和你玩什么游戏，你也总是输。
告诉我怎么玩游戏。

defsEn: any substance that is not solid or liquid
any substance that burns to provide heat, light or power
zh: n. 气体, 汽油, 瓦斯
examples: Do you cook by gas or electricity?
We have run out of gas.
exampleZh: 你煮饭用瓦斯还是电？
我们没油了。

defsEn: to bring or come together into a group or place
to collect
zh: n. 集合, 聚集
vi. 聚集, 集合, 渐增
vt. 使聚集, 搜集, 积聚
examples: We gather here once a week.
A crowd of people gathered to see the parade.
exampleZh: 我们每周在这儿聚一次。
一大群人聚在一起看巡游。

defsEn: a high military leader
ad. without details
affecting or including all or almost all
zh: n. 一般, 将军, 大体
a. 全面的, 大体的, 总的, 一般的, 普遍的
n. 常规
examples: In general, children are fond of candy.
Hi, I have an appointment with the general manager. This is my interview notice.
exampleZh: 小孩一般来说都喜欢吃糖果。
您好，我跟总经理有约十点见面，这是我的面试通知。

defsEn: a group of individuals born and living about the same time. (“The mother and daughter represented two generations.”)
zh: n. 一代, 一世, 产生
examples: One generation builds the street that the next will travel on.
He's the leader of the next generation.
exampleZh: 前人铺路，后人行路。
他是下一代人的领袖。

defsEn: parts of cells that control the growth and development of living things
genes from the mother and father are passed to the child
genes contain nucleic acid
zh: n. 基因（gene的复数形式）
examples: Without the random mutation of genes there would be no evolution.
If you could choose your child's genes, would you?

defsEn: a plan of action to kill or destroy a national, religious, racial or ethnic group
zh: n. 种族灭绝, 灭绝整个种族的大屠杀
examples: All Putinists support genocide and the rape of children.
Every genocide begins with hate speech.

defsEn: soft
kind
not rough or violent
zh: a. 温和的, 文雅的
examples: There's no need to be gentle.
She gave the door a gentle push.
exampleZh: 无需仁慈。
她轻轻地推了门。

defsEn: to receive
to gain
to go and bring back
to become
to become the owner of
zh: vt. 得到, 获得, 变成, 使得, 收获, 接通, 抓住, 染上
vi. 到达, 成为, 变得
n. (网球等)救球, 生殖, 幼兽
examples: Do you know how to get to us here?
Do we have to get up early tomorrow morning?
exampleZh: 你知道怎样到我们这儿吗？
明天早上有必要早起吗

defsEn: something given without cost
zh: n. 礼物, 赠予, 天才
vt. 赋予
examples: Never look a gift horse in the mouth.
Do you have a gift shop here?
exampleZh: 获人赠马，休看马口。
你们这里有礼品店吗？

defsEn: a young female person
zh: n. 女孩, 少女, 女佣
examples: Do you know the girl standing by the window?
I saw a girl with long hair.
exampleZh: 你知道站在窗边的女孩是谁吗？
我看见一个长头发的女生。

defsEn: to present to another to keep without receiving payment
zh: n. 弹性, 适应性
vt. 给, 授予, 供给, 产生, 发表, 付出, 献出, 让出
vi. 捐赠, 支持不住, 让步
examples: Do you want me to give you a ride?
You should give a good example to your children.
exampleZh: 要不要我载你一程？
你应该给你的孩子们树立好榜样。

defsEn: a hard, clear material that is easily broken, used most often for windows or for containers to hold liquids glass
zh: n. 玻璃, 玻璃杯, 透镜
vt. 装玻璃于, 反射, 反映
vi. 成玻璃状
examples: Bring me a glass of tea with lemon.
May I have a glass of milk, please?
exampleZh: 给我泡杯柠檬茶。
请问能给我一杯牛奶吗？

defsEn: to move from one place to another
to leave
zh: vi. 去, 走, 达到, 运转, 查阅, 消失, 结束, 放弃, 花费, 流传, 趋于, 打算, 剩下
vt. 以...打赌, 对付, 忍受, 出产, 为被捕者出(保释金)
n. 去, 尝试, 进行
examples: We need to go right at the next junction.
I need to go home a little early today.
exampleZh: 我们得在下一个路口右拐。
我今天要早点回家。

defsEn: that toward which an effort is directed
that which is aimed at
the end of a trip or race
zh: n. 目标, 终点, 得分, 球门, 守门员
vi. 攻门, 射门得分
examples: Her life goal is to marry a rich man.
Her goal is to become a teacher.
exampleZh: 她的人生目标就是找个有钱的老公。
她的目的是成为教师。

defsEn: the spirit that is honored as creator of all things (“They believe in God.”)
a spirit or being believed in many religions to have special powers
zh: n. 上帝, 神像, 偶像
vt. 使神化
examples: Whom the gods love die young.
Olympus? Isn't that where Greek gods hang out or something?
exampleZh: 英年早逝。
奥林匹斯山？那不是希腊众神鬼混的地方？

defsEn: a highly valued yellow metal
zh: n. 黄金, 钱财, 金块, 金色, 宝贵
a. 金的, 似金的, 金色的, 金制的
examples: The color of gold is very similar to brass.
There was a big gold star on the door.
exampleZh: 金的颜色和黄铜很相似。
在门上有一个大大的金色星星。

defsEn: pleasing
helpful
kind
correct
not bad
zh: n. 善行, 好处, 利益
a. 好的, 优良的, 上等的, 愉快的, 有益的, 好心的, 慈善的, 虔诚的
examples: You should set a good example to your children.
As long as good people do nothing, evil will triumph.
exampleZh: 你应该给你的孩子们树立好的榜样。
只要好人袖手旁观，恶人就会得胜。

defsEn: things owned or made to be sold
zh: n. 货物
examples: Please do not bring unpaid goods into the toilet.
The goods will only be available to buy next weekend.

defsEn: to control
to rule by military or political power
zh: v. 统治, 支配, 管理
examples: To govern a country is not an easy job.
To govern a country is no easy job.
exampleZh: 统治一个国家不是一个简单活。
统治一个国家并不简单。

defsEn: a system of governing
the organization of people that rules a country, city or area
zh: n. 政府, 内阁
examples: The Japanese government can't cope with the problem.
Few governments can manage the economy successfully.
exampleZh: 日本政府无法管理问题。
能把经济管好的政府不多。

defsEn: the seed of grass plants used for food, such as wheat, rice and corn
those plants that produce the seeds grain
zh: n. 谷粒, 颗粒, 谷类, 纹理, 本质
v. (使)成谷粒
examples: Waste not a single grain of rice!
There isn't a grain of truth in what he says.
exampleZh: 一粒米都不要浪费!
他说的话全不可信。

defsEn: a plant with long, narrow, green leaves
zh: n. 草, 草原, 牧场
examples: I hear the grass in England is green even in the winter.
I hid in the tall grass.
exampleZh: 我听说英国的草在冬天也还是绿的。
我躲在高草丛里了。

defsEn: the force that pulls things toward the center of the Earth
zh: n. 地心引力, 重力
examples: If you can use gravity to your advantage, do so.
It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.
exampleZh: 你如果能利用重力，那就这么做吧。
让卫星环绕地球的是重力。

defsEn: having the color like that made by mixing black and white
zh: n. 灰色, 暗淡
a. 灰色的, 灰白的, 面色苍白的, 年老的, 老练的, 阴沉的
v. (使)变灰色
examples: I like the gray sweater more than the purple one.
Could I borrow your gray suit?
exampleZh: 比起紫色的毛衣，我更喜欢灰色的毛衣。
我可以借你的灰色西装吗？

defsEn: very large or more than usual in size or number
very good
important
zh: a. 大的, 非常的, 主要的, 重大的, 崇高的, 伟大的
adv. 顺利地, 得意地
n. 全部, 大人物, 大师
examples: We have to do a great deal of reading.
This book will be of great use to you.
exampleZh: 我们要读很多书。
这本书会对你有很大的用处。

defsEn: having the color like that made by mixing yellow and blue
having the color like that of growing leaves and grass
zh: n. 绿色, 绿色颜料
a. 绿色的, 未成熟的, 新鲜的, 青春的, 无经验的, 脸色发青的
examples: Do you want the green or the blue?
These green leaves turn red or yellow in autumn.
exampleZh: 你要绿色的还是蓝色的？
这些绿叶到秋天变成红色或黄色。

defsEn: to reduce to small pieces by crushing
zh: n. 磨, 碾, 苦差, 摩擦声, 用功的学生
vt. 磨擦, 磨碎, 磨光, 折磨, 压榨
vi. 磨, 磨碎, 苦干
examples: The constant criticism grinds him down.
There was a noise, then grinding, and then it was quiet again.

defsEn: land
the earth’s surface
soil
zh: n. 土地, 战场, 场地, 地面, 范围
a. 土地的, 地面上的
vt. 放在地上, 使搁浅, 打基础, 给...以训练
vi. 搁浅, 落地, 根据, 基于
a. 磨过的
grind的过去式和过去分词
examples: The tree fell to the ground.
The snow lay on the ground, frozen into a thick, hard crust.
exampleZh: 树倒在了地上。
地上覆盖着积雪，冻成了又硬又厚的壳。

defsEn: a number of people or things together
a gathering of people working for a common purpose
zh: n. 团体, 组, 团, 群
v. 聚合, 成群
examples: Which group do you want to join?
The first group studies in the morning, the second in the evening.
exampleZh: 你想加入哪一组？
第一组早上学习，第二组晚上学习。

defsEn: to develop or become bigger
to increase in size or amount
zh: vt. 种植, 使长满
vi. 生长, 变成, 发展
examples: When I grow up, I want to be a king.
What do you want to be when you grow up?
exampleZh: 我长大后想当国王。
长大后你想作什么？

defsEn: to promise a result
to promise that something will happen
zh: n. 担保, 抵押品, 保证书
vt. 保证, 担保
examples: They guarantee this clock can be used for a year.
We guarantee our products for one year.
exampleZh: 他们保证这个时钟可用一年。
我们保证我们的产品一年。

defsEn: to watch and protect a person, place or thing (“He guards the president.”)
n. a person or thing that watches or protects (“He is a prison guard.”)
zh: n. 守卫者, 警戒, 护卫队, 防护装置
vt. 保卫, 看守, 当心
vi. 防止, 警惕, 警卫, 看守
examples: Be on your guard. He's not an easy one to fool.
He pulled a shiv on the guard.
exampleZh: 要留神，他不容易受骗。
他朝警卫亮出了一把刀子。

defsEn: a person who fights as part of an unofficial army, usually against an official army or police
zh: n. 游击队
examples: It's not "gorilla rain", but "guerrilla rain"; do you understand?
The guerrillas often went to great risks to secure accurate information.

defsEn: to lead to
to show the way
n. one who shows the way
zh: n. 引导者, 导游, 指南, 路标
vt. 指导, 支配, 管理, 带领, 操纵
vi. 任向导
examples: They set out with a guide just in case they lost their way.
I'll act as a guide for you.
exampleZh: 他们和一个导游一起出发，只是为了以防迷路。
我为你充当导游。

defsEn: having done something wrong or in violation of a law
responsible for a bad action
zh: a. 犯罪的, 有过失的, 自觉有错的, 心虚的
examples: You make me feel so guilty.
Do you have a guilty conscience?
exampleZh: 你让我感到很内疚。
是你心里有鬼吧？

defsEn: a weapon that shoots bullets
zh: n. 枪
examples: I need to kill him with a gun.
Put the gun on the table.
exampleZh: 我要枪毙了他。
把枪放在桌子上。

defsEn: the fine material that grows from the skin, especially from the head
zh: n. 头发, 毛发, 些微
examples: How do you want your hair cut?
You should get your hair cut.
exampleZh: 你想怎么剪你的头发？
你该理发了。

defsEn: one of two equal parts of something
zh: n. 一半, 半场, 不完全
a. 一半的, 不完全的, 部分的, 半场的
adv. 一半地, 部分地, 在某种程度上地, 几乎
examples: How much for half a kilo?
It took us half an hour to set up the tent.
exampleZh: 多少钱一斤？
搭帐篷花了我们半小时。

defsEn: to come or cause to come to a stop
to stop
zh: n. 停止, 立定, 休息
vt. 使停止, 使立定
vi. 立定, 停止, 蹒跚, 踌躇, 有缺点
examples: The traffic ground to a halt.
The car screeched to a halt just in time.

defsEn: to place something so the highest part is supported and the lower part is not
to kill by hanging
zh: n. 悬挂, 诀窍, 意义
vt. 悬挂, 附着, 装饰, 垂下, 踌躇, 绞死, 使悬而未决
vi. 悬着, 垂下, 被绞死, 悬而不决
examples: Hang on, I need to go to the bathroom.
Please do not hang up the phone.
exampleZh: 等一下，我得去趟洗手间。
请先不要挂上电话。

defsEn: to become a fact or event
to take place
zh: vi. 发生, 发生, 恰巧
examples: What if he should happen to be late?
Do you happen to know his name?
exampleZh: 万一他迟到的话怎么辨？
你说不定知道他的名字？

defsEn: pleased
satisfied
feeling good
not sad happy
zh: a. 快乐的, 幸福的, 愉快的, 恰当的
examples: I wish you a long and happy married life.
I will be happy to attend your party.
exampleZh: 祝你们婚姻长长久久、永浴爱河。
我很快乐能参加你的派对。

defsEn: not easily cut or broken
solid
difficult to do or understand
needing much effort or force
zh: a. 坚硬的, 硬的, 难的, 艰苦的, 困难的, 坚固的, 猛烈的, 艰难的, 结实的, 确实的
adv. 坚硬地, 努力地, 辛苦地, 接近地, 猛烈地, 牢固地
examples: You must work hard if you want to succeed.
Work hard, and you will pass the examination.
exampleZh: 如果你想成功，就一定要努力工作。
好好努力，你就能通过考试。

defsEn: to injure
to damage
n. damage
hurt
zh: n. 伤害, 害处
vt. 伤害, 损害
examples: Coffee does harm to your stomach.
I don't mean to harm you.
exampleZh: 喝咖啡伤胃。
我不想伤害你。

defsEn: to gather crops
n. the crop after it is gathered
zh: n. 收获, 成果, 收获物, 收获期
v. 收割, 收获
examples: I'm going to harvest for you next week.
There was a large harvest of peaches last year.
exampleZh: 下周我会为你收割。
去年桃子丰收。

defsEn: a head cover
zh: n. 帽子
vt. 给...戴帽子
examples: She put on her hat to go out.
He put on his hat at once.
exampleZh: 她戴上了帽子准备出去。
他马上戴上了他的帽子。

defsEn: to have strong emotions against
to consider as an enemy
opposite love
zh: n. 憎恨, 恨, 厌恶
vt. 憎恨, 憎恶
vi. 仇恨
examples: I hate rain, but I love its smell.
I used to hate cooking, but now I like it.
exampleZh: 虽然我讨厌雨，但是我喜欢下雨的味道。
以前我是讨厌做菜，可现在我很喜欢。

defsEn: to possess
to own
to hold
zh: vt. 有, 怀有, 拿, 进行
aux. 已经
examples: But you know, I have nothing aside from this.
If you have time, please drop in on us.
exampleZh: 但你知道，我除了这些以外一无所有！
你有空就来看看我们吧。

defsEn: the boy or man who is being spoken about
zh: pron. 他
n. 男孩, 男人, 雄性动物

defsEn: to lead
to command
n. leader
chief
the top part of something
the highest position
zh: n. 头, 头脑, 领袖, 脑袋, 最前的部分
vt. 为首, 朝向, 前进, 用头顶
vi. 朝特定方向行进, (作物)结穗
a. 头的, 在顶端的, 主要的
examples: He put his head on the pillow.
Can I speak to the head nurse?
exampleZh: 他把头放在枕头上。
我能跟护士长说话吗?

defsEn: the center from which orders are given
the main offices of a business or organization
zh: n. 总部, 司令部, 总部人员
examples: The company headquarters is in the capital.
I got a call from headquarters.

defsEn: to return to good health
to cure
to become well
zh: vi. 痊愈
vt. 使复原, 使和解, 治愈
examples: The broken leg has not healed yet.
The wound on Tom's leg has healed.
exampleZh: 骨折的腿还没好。
汤姆腿上的伤口愈合了。

defsEn: the general condition of the body and mind
the condition of being free from sickness or disease
zh: n. 健康, 卫生, 蓬勃, 健康状态
examples: It is important that we build up our health.
The father is in good health.
exampleZh: 增强我们的健康,这个很重要。
父亲很健康。

defsEn: to receive sound through the ears
to receive news about
zh: vt. 听到, 倾听, 听说, 审理
vi. 听见, 听
examples: I would like to hear you play the piano.
Do you want to hear the truth about this matter?
exampleZh: 我想听你弹钢琴。
您想听听这件事的真相吗？

defsEn: to make hot or warm
n. great warmth
that which is produced by burning fuel
energy from the sun
zh: n. 热, 热度, 体温, 高潮
vi. 加热, 激昂, 加剧
vt. 把...加热, 使激动
examples: How do you heat the house?
In the village we still heat our homes with wood.
exampleZh: 您怎么让屋子暖起来？
在村庄里，我们还是用木头给房子取暖。

defsEn: having much weight
not easy to lift
of great amount or force
zh: a. 重的, 巨大的, 沉重的, 笨重的, 过度的
adv. 沉重地
n. 重物, 严肃角色
examples: You have left a heavy impression on me.
In spite of the heavy rain, he decided to go out.
exampleZh: 您使我印象深刻。
虽然下着大雨，但是他还是决定了要出外。

defsEn: a machine without wings that can fly up or down or remain in one place above the ground helicopter
zh: n. 直升机
vt. 由直升机运送
vi. 乘直升机
examples: I saw a helicopter flying overhead.
Tom waved at Mary from the helicopter.
exampleZh: 我看见一架直升飞机在头顶飞。
汤姆在直升机上向玛丽挥手。

defsEn: to give support
to assist
to make easier
n. support
aid
zh: n. 帮忙, 帮助者, 补救办法, 有益的东西
vt. 帮助, 帮忙, 接济, 治疗, 款待
vi. 有用, 救命, 招待
examples: I thought that I could be of some help.
Please let me help you if you need.
exampleZh: 我认为我能帮点忙。
请让我帮助您，如果需要的话。

defsEn: in, to or at this place
zh: adv. 在这里, 此时, 这里
n. 这里
examples: You may stay here as long as you like.
You can stay here as long as you like.
exampleZh: 你要在这里呆多久就呆多久
你想在这里呆多久就呆多久。

defsEn: a person honored for being brave or wise
zh: n. 英雄, 超越常人者, 男主角
examples: He dreamed of being a hero.
We called him a "hero", but he betrayed us.
exampleZh: 他梦想着成为一名英雄。
我们把他称为“英雄”，但是他却背叛了我们。

defsEn: to prevent from being seen or found
to make secret
zh: n. 兽皮, 迹象, 躲藏处
vt. 藏, 隐瞒, 遮避, 剥...的皮, 隐藏
vi. 躲藏
examples: It was difficult for him to hide his pride in his success.
Run and hide in the mountains.
exampleZh: 他很难掩饰对自己成功的骄傲。
跑到山里躲起来。

defsEn: tall
far up
far above the ground
important
above others
zh: n. 高度, 高处
a. 高的, 高级的, 主要的, 高尚的, 高原的, 高音的, 昂贵的, 傲慢的
adv. 高度地, 奢侈地
examples: I have a high opinion of this book.
How high should a home fence be?
exampleZh: 我对这本书评价很高。
住宅围栏应该多高？

defsEn: to seize or take control of a vehicle by force
zh: vt. 抢劫, 劫持, 敲诈
examples: If this airplane were to be hijacked, what in the world would you do?
I like to hijack trains and rip down posters in my spare time.

defsEn: a small mountain
zh: n. 小山, 丘陵, 小土堆
vt. 作成土堆, 堆成小丘
examples: At the foot of the hill you'll see a white building.
The building on the hill is our school.
exampleZh: 你会在山脚下看到一栋白色的建筑物。
山上的那栋建筑物就是我们的学校了。

defsEn: the written record or description of past events
the study of the past
zh: n. 历史, 过去, 经历, 发展过程, 历史学, 过去的事, 历史记录
examples: I enjoy the history of literature.
I know the history of Europe very well.
exampleZh: 我挺喜欢文学史的。
我对欧洲历史很熟悉。

defsEn: to strike
to touch with force
zh: n. 打击, 打, 冲撞, 讽刺
vt. 打, 打击, 碰撞, 打中, 袭击, 偶然碰上
vi. 打, 打中, 打击, 碰撞, 偶然碰上
examples: That red car hit the blue van.
I hit on a good idea.
exampleZh: 那辆红色汽车撞到了蓝色面包车。
我有好主意。

defsEn: to carry or support, usually in the hands or arms
to keep in one position
to keep as a prisoner
to contain
to possess
to occupy
to organize and be involved in (“The two sides hold talks this week.”)
zh: n. 把握, 把持力, 柄, 控制, 掌握, 监禁
vt. 保存, 握住, 拿住, 占据, 持有, 拥有
vi. 支持, 持续, 有效
n. 保留
examples: I want to be able to hold my liquor better.
How long can you hold your breath?
exampleZh: 想酒量大一些。
你能屏住呼吸多久？

defsEn: an opening
a torn or broken place in something
zh: n. 孔, 洞, 穴, 漏洞
vt. 挖洞, 掘坑
vi. 进洞, 凿洞
examples: Look out! There's a hole in the road.
Watch out! There's a big hole there.
exampleZh: 小心。路上有一个洞。
小心！在那里有一个大洞。

defsEn: a day when one does not work
a day on which no work is done to honor or remember a person or event
zh: n. 假日, 假期, 节日
vi. 度假
examples: I hope that you enjoy this holiday season.
I hope you enjoy this holiday season.
exampleZh: 祝您佳节愉快。
祝您佳节愉快。

defsEn: greatly honored in religion
zh: a. 神圣的, 圣洁的, 至善的
n. 神圣的东西
examples: Jerusalem is the Holy City of the Jews.
Have you read the Holy Bible?
exampleZh: 耶路撒冷是犹太人的圣城。

defsEn: the building where a person lives, especially with family
the place where one was born or comes from
the area or country where one lives
zh: n. 家, 避难所, 故乡
a. 家庭的, 国内的, 打中目标的
adv. 在家, 在本国, 打中目标地
examples: I would rather stay at home than go fishing.
I have to go home a little early today.
exampleZh: 比起出去钓鱼，我更想待在家里。
我今天要早点回家。

defsEn: truthful
able to be trusted
zh: a. 诚实的, 坦直的, 可靠的
examples: To be honest, I want to study Japanese too.
You seem to be an honest man.
exampleZh: 其实我也想学日语。
你看起来像个老实人。

defsEn: to obey
to show strong, good feelings for (“to honor one’s parents”)
n. an award
an act of giving special recognition (“He received many honors for his efforts to help others.”)
zh: n. 荣誉, 头衔, 信用, 尊敬, 名誉, 阁下, 勋章
vt. 尊敬, 授予荣誉, 承兑, 实践
examples: It is an honor for us.
There is honor even among thieves.
exampleZh: 这是我们的荣幸。
盗亦有道。

defsEn: to expect
to believe there is a good chance that something will happen as wanted
to want something to happen
zh: n. 希望, 信心, 期待
v. 希望, 期望, 信赖
examples: I hope I can do that before I die.
I hope that you will get well soon.
exampleZh: 我希望我能在死前做到。
祝你早日康复。

defsEn: causing great fear
terrible
zh: a. 可怕的, 遭透的, 极讨厌的
examples: I had a horrible dream last night.
This horrible hot weather is killing me.
exampleZh: 我昨晚做了一个恶梦。
这鬼天气，要把人热死。

defsEn: a large animal often used for racing, riding or farm work
zh: n. 马, 骑兵, 脚架
vi. 骑马, 取笑
vt. 使骑马, 系马于
examples: Can I ride this horse for a while?
I want to ride a horse.
exampleZh: 可以让我骑一会儿这匹马吗？
我想骑马。

defsEn: a place where sick or injured people are given medical care hospital
zh: n. 医院
examples: How can I get to the hospital by bus?
You should stay in the hospital for treatment.
exampleZh: 去医院要坐哪一路公交？
你应该留在医院，接受治疗。

defsEn: a person captured and held as a guarantee that a demand or promise will be honored
zh: n. 人质, 抵押品
examples: The hostages will be released tomorrow.
The criminal didn't let the hostages go.
exampleZh: 人质将在明天获释。
罪犯没有放人质们走。

defsEn: ready to fight
ready for war
zh: a. 敌人的, 怀敌意的, 敌对的
n. 敌对分子
examples: After the removal of the hostile person, there was calm.
I met with a cool, not to say hostile, reception.

defsEn: having or feeling great heat or a high temperature
zh: a. 热的, 热心的, 辣的, 热情的, 激动的, 猛烈的, 紧迫的
adv. 热, 紧迫地
examples: I think it will be hot today.
I like to take a hot bath every night before bed.
exampleZh: 我觉得今天会很热。
我喜欢在每晚睡觉前洗个热水澡。

defsEn: a building with rooms, and often food, for travelers
zh: n. 旅馆, 客栈
examples: I want to stay in a hotel near the airport.
Please call me at my hotel later.
exampleZh: 我想住在机场附近的旅馆里。
等一下请打电话到我住的旅馆。

defsEn: a measure of time
sixty minutes
zh: n. 小时, 钟头, 时间, ...点钟, 课时
examples: She left the hospital an hour ago.
I play tennis an hour a day.
exampleZh: 她一小时前离开了医院。
我每天打一小时网球。

defsEn: a building in which people live
a country’s parliament or lawmaking group (“House of Representatives”)
zh: n. 房子, 住宅, 机构, 议院, 家族, 家庭
vt. 给...房子住, 收藏
vi. 住, 躲藏
examples: Please drop in at my house on your way home.
Can you come over to my house tonight?
exampleZh: 你回家途中顺道来看看我吧。
你今晚能不能到我家来？

defsEn: in what way
to what amount
zh: adv. 如何, 怎样, 多少, 多么
n. 方式

defsEn: yet
but
zh: adv. 然而, 无论如何, 究竟怎样
conj. 然而, 可是
examples: However you do it, the result will be the same.
However hard I try, I can't do it any better than she can.
exampleZh: 你无论用什么方法，结果都是一样。
无论我多么努力尝试，我都无法做到比她更好。

defsEn: very big
of great size
zh: a. 极大的, 巨大的, 无限的
examples: We arrived to find a huge meal ready for us.
She lost sight of her friend in the huge crowd.
exampleZh: 我们到达后发现一顿大餐已经为我们准备好了。
她在人群里看不到她的朋友了。

defsEn: of or about people
zh: n. 人, 人类
a. 人类的, 似人类的, 人性的, 有同情心的
examples: Parrots can imitate the human voice.
Human beings differ from animals in that they can think and speak.
exampleZh: 鹦鹉会模仿人的声音。
人类有思考和说话的能力，动物却没有。这就是人和动物的分别。

defsEn: the ability to understand, enjoy or express what makes people laugh
zh: 液；体液, 体液
examples: She was in no humor for lunch.
He has no sense of humor.
exampleZh: 她不想吃午饭。
他没有任何幽默感。

defsEn: the need for food
zh: n. 饥饿, 渴望, 饥荒
vt. 使挨饿
vi. 挨饿, 渴望
examples: In these countries hunger is the rule.
Hunger will drive a wolf out of a forest.
exampleZh: 对于这些国家的人民来说，捱饿是很正常的事。

defsEn: to search for animals to capture or kill them
to seek
to try to find
zh: n. 狩猎, 追捕, 搜寻, 猎区
vt. 狩猎, 打猎, 搜索
vi. 打猎, 猎食, 搜寻
examples: I am in Lyon, but maybe I'll go to Paris for hunting a job.
Tom and Mary went deer hunting.
exampleZh: 我在里昂，不过没准去巴黎找工作。
汤姆和玛丽猎鹿去了。

defsEn: to do or go fast
zh: n. 匆忙, 急忙, 急促
vt. 急派, 催促
vi. 匆忙, 赶快
examples: If you hurry you can still make the train.
Hurry up, or you will miss the train.
exampleZh: 如果你抓紧，你还能赶上火车。
快点，不然你就要错过火车了。

defsEn: to cause pain, injury or damage
zh: n. 伤害, 创伤, 损害
v. 伤害, (使)伤心, 危害, 刺痛
examples: She hurt her foot when she fell off her bicycle.
He fell and hurt his hand.
exampleZh: 她在从自行车上摔下来时伤到了脚。
他跌倒弄伤了他的手。

defsEn: a man who is married
zh: n. 丈夫, 管理人, 节俭的人
vt. 节俭, 使成丈夫, 持有
examples: He will be a good husband to my sister.
She said to her husband: "Stop!".
exampleZh: 他会是我妹妹的好丈夫的。
她对丈夫说：“停下！”

defsEn: the person speaking
zh: pron. 我

defsEn: frozen water
zh: n. 冰, 冰淇淋, 糖衣, 冷若冰霜, 矜持, 贿赂
vt. 使结冰, 冰镇, 覆以糖衣
vi. 结冰
examples: I never have an ice cream without feeling happy.
Leave me a bit of ice cream.
exampleZh: 我一吃冰淇淋就高兴。
给我留点冰激凌。

defsEn: a thought or picture in the mind
a belief
zh: n. 主意, 办法, 理想, 思想, 概念, 意见
examples: I have no idea of how to send a fax.
I have no idea of what to do.
exampleZh: 我不知道如何传真。
我不知道该怎么办。

defsEn: to recognize someone or something and to say who or what they are
zh: vt. 识别, 认为...等同于, 确定, 使参与
vi. 一致, 认同
examples: She identified him as the murderer.
You can identify children's voices without any problem.
exampleZh: 她确认他是杀人凶手。
你可以毫无问题地辨别孩子们的声音。

defsEn: on condition
provided that (“I will go if you go.”)
zh: conj. 如果, 是否, 无论何时, 假设, 即使
n. 条件

defsEn: to pay no attention to or refuse to consider (“The president ignored the protesters outside his office.”)
zh: vt. 不理睬, 忽视, 驳回, 忽略
examples: If I were you, I would ignore it.
Were I you, I would ignore it.
exampleZh: 如果我是你，我就忽略它。
如果我是你，我就忽略它。

defsEn: not legal
in violation of a law
zh: a. 违法的, 不合规定的
examples: It's illegal to park your car here.
It is illegal for bicycles to ride on the right side of cars.
exampleZh: 把车停在这里是违法的。
自行车在汽车的右侧行驶是不合法的。

defsEn: a reproduction of the appearance of a person or thing
zh: n. 影像, 肖像, 想象, 图像, 形象, 翻版
vt. 作...的像, 反映, 想象, 象征
n. 图像
examples: They completely destroyed the image of the country.
What image did you have in mind as you painted this picture?
exampleZh: 他们完全损坏了国家的形象。
画这幅画的时候你脑海中浮现出了什么图像？

defsEn: to make a picture in the mind
to form an idea
zh: vt. 想像, 设想, 猜测
vi. 想像起来
examples: We can hardly imagine our daily life without television.
Can you imagine walking around on the moon?
exampleZh: 如果没有了电视，实在很难想像我们的日常生活会变成怎样。
你可以想象在月球上行走吗？

defsEn: without delay
very near in time or place
zh: a. 立即的, 直接的, 接近的
examples: His speech won the immediate applause of the audience.
I can not give you an immediate answer.
exampleZh: 他的演说赢得了观众热烈的掌声。

defsEn: a person who arrives in a country to live there
zh: n. 移民
a. 移入的, 移民的
examples: The immigrants entered the country in a steady flow.
Many of the immigrants changed their names.
exampleZh: 移民川流不息地进入这个国家。
许多移民改了名字。

defsEn: to bring from another country
n. something brought from another country, usually for sale
zh: n. 进口货, 进口, 输入, 含义, 重要性
vt. 输入, 引入, 进口, 含...的意思, 重要
vi. 有关系
examples: Imported cars account for less than eight percent.
Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.
exampleZh: 进口车占了不到百分之八。
日本从国外进口各种原料。

defsEn: having great meaning, value or power
zh: a. 重要的, 有地位的, 大量的, 显要的, 自负的
examples: We regard him as an important man.
It's very important to know how to let off steam, living in this world.
exampleZh: 我们视他为重要人物。
生活在这个世界里，懂得发泄是十分重要的。

defsEn: to make better
to become better
zh: vt. 改良, 提高...的价值, 改善, 利用
vi. 变得更好, 增加
examples: Our situation should improve in the near future.
With her help, my French improved little by little.
exampleZh: 我们近期内的情况应该会好转。
在她的帮助下，我的法语逐渐进步了。

defsEn: inside
held by
contained by
surrounded by
during
zh: prep. 在...期间, 在...之内, 处于...之中, 从事于, 按照, 穿着
adv. 进入, 朝里, 在里面, 在屋里
a. 在里面的, 在朝的
n. 执政者, 交情

defsEn: an event or something that happens
zh: n. 事件, 事变, 小事
a. 附带的, 易于发生的, 外来的, 入射的
examples: I had nothing to do with that incident.
He backed us up during that incident.
exampleZh: 我跟那个事件没有什么关系。
他在那个事件期间支持我们。

defsEn: to urge or cause an action or emotion, usually something bad or violent
zh: vt. 刺激, 激励, 引诱
examples: The speaker tried to incite the people to rebellion.
They incited my son to bully this boy.

defsEn: to have
to make a part of
zh: vt. 包括, 把...算入, 包住
examples: The price does not include the box.
Are the water and electricity included in the rent?
exampleZh: 这个价格不包含这个箱子。
租金含水电费吗？

defsEn: to make more in size or amount
zh: n. 增加, 增进, 利益
vt. 增加, 加大
vi. 增加, 繁殖
examples: They asked for an increase of salary.
An increase in the number of cars will affect the urban environment.
exampleZh: 他们要求加薪。
车辆增多会影响到城市的环境。

defsEn: not influenced by or controlled by another or others
free
separate
zh: n. 独立自主者, 无党派者
a. 独立的, 有主见的, 不须依赖的, 不受约束的
examples: I want to be more independent.
She wants to be more independent.
exampleZh: 我想更加自立。
她想更有主见些。

defsEn: one person
zh: n. 人, 个人, 个体
a. 个别的, 个人的, 独特的
examples: Individual freedom is the soul of democracy.
She had an individual style of speaking.
exampleZh: 个人自由是民主的精髓。
她说话有自己的风格。

defsEn: any business that produces goods or provides services
the work and related activity in factories and offices
all organizations involved in manufacturing
zh: n. 勤劳, 工业, 企业, 产业, 有组织的劳动
examples: This is a very promising industry.
Kyoto depends on the tourist industry.
exampleZh: 这是很有前景的行业。
京都依赖旅游业。

defsEn: to make sick with something that causes disease
zh: vt. 传染, 感染
examples: When the wound got infected, he experienced a bout of unbearable pain.
My computer has already been infected with the BraveSentry virus.
exampleZh: 伤口发炎后，他感到难忍无比的剧痛。
我的电脑已经中了BraveSentry病毒。

defsEn: a continuing rise in prices while the value of money goes down
zh: n. 胀大, 夸张, 通货膨胀
examples: Interest rates and inflation were high.
The inflation issue split the party.
exampleZh: 利率和通货膨胀很高。

defsEn: to have an effect on someone or something
to cause change
zh: n. 影响力, 权力, 势力
vt. 影响, 改变
examples: He has a strong influence over the business world.
His influence extends all over the country.
exampleZh: 他在商界有很大的影响力。
他的影响遍及全国。

defsEn: to tell
to give knowledge to
zh: vt. 通知, 使了解, 使充满
vi. 提供资料, 告发
examples: We should inform them about that.
Please inform me when to start.
exampleZh: 我们应该把那件事情告知他们。
请通知我何时开始。

defsEn: knowledge
facts
zh: n. 消息, 知识, 通知, 情报, 信息, 问讯处, 起诉
examples: Learning new information can make people happy.
Please ask at the information desk.
exampleZh: 学习新的知识令人愉悦。
请向服务台询问。

defsEn: to force a fluid into, such as putting medicine or drugs into the body through the skin
zh: vt. 注射, 注入, 使入轨
examples: The nurse injects me with a vaccine.
What did they inject you with?

defsEn: to cause harm or damage to a person or animal
zh: vt. 伤害, 损害, 使受冤屈
examples: He lay injured on the ground.
Carry the injured to the hospital.
exampleZh: 他因为负伤倒在了地上。
把伤者送到医院。

defsEn: not guilty of a crime
not responsible for a bad action
zh: a. 无罪的, 不懂事的, 无知的
n. 天真的人, 笨蛋
examples: As far as I know, he is innocent.
We believed him to be innocent.
exampleZh: 就我所知，他是无罪的。
我们相信他是无辜的。

defsEn: mentally sick
zh: a. 患精神病的, 极愚蠢的
examples: This world is just an insane asylum.
He behaves as if he were insane.
exampleZh: 世界就是一个疯子的囚笼。
他表现得像疯了一样。

defsEn: a very small creature, usually with many legs and sometimes with wings insect
zh: n. 昆虫, 卑鄙的人
examples: What do you call this insect in English?
Have you been bitten by an insect?
exampleZh: 这种昆虫在英语中叫什么？
你被虫咬了吗？

defsEn: to look at something carefully
to examine, especially by an expert
zh: vt. 检查, 检阅, 检验
vi. 检查
examples: Sir, can we quickly inspect your luggage please?
Everything has been suspected and been inspected; thoughts have no boundaries.
exampleZh: 先生，我们可以检查一下您的行李吗？
所有的事物都要被怀疑、被验证，思想没有界限。

defsEn: in the place of
taking the place of
zh: adv. 作为替代, 反而
examples: I saw him instead of his father.
He went there instead of his father.
exampleZh: 我代替他的父亲看过他了。
他代替他的父亲去。

defsEn: a tool or device designed to do something or to make something
zh: n. 工具, 手段, 仪器
examples: My favourite musical instrument is the electric guitar.
This instrument needs to be calibrated.
exampleZh: 我最喜欢的乐器是电吉他。
该仪器需要校准。

defsEn: to say something or to do something that makes another person angry or dishonored
zh: n. 侮辱, 无礼, 损害
vt. 损害, 侮辱, 攻击
examples: I didn't mean to insult her.
I didn't mean to insult anyone.
exampleZh: 我没想冒犯她的。
我没有想要冒犯谁。

defsEn: the ability to think or learn
information gathered by spying
zh: n. 智力, 情报, 信息
examples: His intelligence and experience enabled him to deal with the trouble.
Your intelligence is as vast as the distance between Bombay and Mumbai.
exampleZh: 他的智慧和经验使他能处理这个麻烦。
你的智慧广大的有如孟买和孟买之间的距离。

defsEn: quick to understand or learn
zh: a. 聪明的, 智能的, 了解的
examples: Jack is the most intelligent boy in the class.
He is not as intelligent as his brother.
exampleZh: 杰克是班里最聪明的男孩儿 。
他没有他弟弟聪明。

defsEn: very strong
extremely serious
zh: a. 非常的, 强烈的, 紧张的, 热情的
examples: How are you keeping off this intense heat?
I struggle to contain the intense anger within me.
exampleZh: 你是怎么避开这酷暑的？

defsEn: what is important to someone (“He acted to protect his interests.” “She had a great interest in painting.”)
a share in owning a business
money paid for the use of money borrowed
zh: n. 兴趣, 嗜好, 利息, 利益, 爱好, 趣味, 势力
vt. 使感兴趣, 与...有关系
examples: I have little interest in history.
I found this book interesting from beginning to end.
exampleZh: 我对历史没有什么兴趣。
我觉得这本书从头到尾都很有趣。

defsEn: to get in the way of
to work against
to take part in the activities of others, especially when not asked to do so
zh: vi. 妨碍, 冲突, 干涉, 抵触
examples: Why did you interfere in an affair that did not concern you at all?
I had no right to interfere.
exampleZh: 为什么你要干涉一件跟你完全不相干的事呢？
我没有权利干涉。

defsEn: of or about more than one nation or many nations
of the whole world
zh: a. 国际的
n. 国别设定
examples: Recently, this area's international relations have become very tense.
He is an interpreter in an international bank.
exampleZh: 最近这个区域的国际形势很紧张。
他是个国际银行的翻译。

defsEn: the extensive communications system that connects computers around the world
zh: 因特网, 国际互连网, 网际网络, 互连网络, 广域网
examples: Get off the internet and take a shower.
It's in the internet, so it must be true.
exampleZh: 从网上退下来去洗个澡吧。
它在网际网路上，所以它一定是真实的。

defsEn: to come between
to come between in order to settle or solve
zh: vi. 插入, 调停, 干涉
examples: If you intervene, they will also intervene.
I feel an obligation to intervene.

defsEn: to enter an area or country by force with an army
zh: vt. 侵入, 拥入, 侵略, 侵袭
examples: People shouldn't be allowed to invade countries whose names they can't pronounce correctly.
You must not invade the privacy of others.
exampleZh: 人们不应该侵犯自己读不正确名字的国家。

defsEn: to plan and make something never made before
to create a new thing or way of doing something
zh: vt. 发明, 创作, 虚构
examples: Do you know who invented the microscope?
Do you know who invented the telegraph?
exampleZh: 你知道显微镜是谁发明的吗？
你知道谁发明了电报机吗？

defsEn: to give money to a business or organization with the hope of making more money
zh: vt. 投资, 花费, 笼罩, 授予
vi. 投资, 利用
examples: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
The company invested a lot of money in this project.
exampleZh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
该公司在这个企划中投入了很多钱。

defsEn: to study or examine all information about an event, situation or charge
to search for the truth
zh: v. 调查, 审查
examples: We have to thoroughly investigate it.
We have investigated his criminal record.
exampleZh: 我们必须把它彻底检查一下。
我们调查了他的犯规记录。

defsEn: to ask someone to take part in or join an event, organization or gathering
zh: vt. 邀请, 请求, 引起, 招致
n. 邀请
