examples: Invite us to dinner at a restaurant.
My friend invited me to go out to dinner.
exampleZh: 请我们去饭店吃晚饭。
我的朋友邀请我去吃晚餐。

defsEn: to take part in
to become a part of
to include
zh: vt. 包括, 使陷于, 潜心于, 包围
examples: Not only you but also I was involved.
We got involved in a traffic accident.
exampleZh: 不止你， 连我也被牵连了。
我们被卷入了一场交通事故。

defsEn: a strong, hard metal used to make machines and tools
zh: n. 铁, 熨斗, 铁器, 坚强, 烙铁, 镣铐
vt. 烫平, 熨, 用铁包
vi. 烫平
examples: I cannot iron my clothes. I have no iron.
They tried to use an iron bar to pry open the lock.
exampleZh: 我没法烫我的衣服，我没有熨斗。
他们试图用一根铁棒撬开锁。

defsEn: a land area with water all around it
zh: n. 岛, 岛屿, 孤立地区, 安全岛
vt. 使成岛状, 孤立
examples: No one lived on the island at that time.
How long did you live on the island?
exampleZh: 那个时候，没有人在这个岛上生活。
你在岛上住了多久？

defsEn: an important problem or subject that people are discussing or arguing about
zh: n. 发行, 问题, 后果, 流出, 出口, 争端
vi. 发行, 流出, 造成...结果, 传下
vt. 使流出, 放出, 发行, 发布, 发给
examples: I agree with you on this issue.
This issue has nothing to do with you.
exampleZh: 我同意你对这问题的看法。
这件事与你无关。

defsEn: a thing, place, event or idea that is being spoken about (“The sky is blue, but it also has a few white clouds.”)
zh: pron. 它

defsEn: a prison for those waiting to be tried for a crime or for those serving sentences for crimes that are not serious
zh: n. 监牢, 监狱, 拘留所
vt. 监禁, 下狱
examples: How long were you in jail?
Have you ever been in jail?
exampleZh: 你在监狱里呆了多久？
你去过监狱吗？

defsEn: a valuable stone, such as a diamond or emerald
zh: n. 珠宝, 贵重物, 镶珠宝的饰物
vt. 饰以珠宝, 镶以宝石
examples: Compare this genuine jewel with that imitation.
She put all her jewels into a little red box.

defsEn: the work that one does to earn money
zh: n. 工作, 零活, 职业, 事情
vi. 做零工, 打杂, 做股票经纪, 假公济私
vt. 代客买卖, 批发, 承包, 欺骗
examples: Do you want this job or not?
I start a new job tomorrow.
exampleZh: 你想不想要这工作？
明天我要去做一份新工作。

defsEn: to put together or come together
to become part of or a member of
zh: vi. 参加, 结合, 加入
vt. 连接, 结合, 参加, 加入
n. 连接, 结合, 接合点
examples: I will be back to join you in one month.
Excuse me, can I join you?
exampleZh: 我会在一个月后回来和你们见面。
请问，我可以加入你们吗？

defsEn: shared by two or more
zh: n. 连接处, 接合, 关节
a. 共同的, 联合的, 连接的, 合办的
vt. 连接, 接合, 使有接头
vi. 贴合, 长节
examples: My joints ache when it gets cold.
My husband and I have a joint bank account.
exampleZh: 当天气变冷的时候，我的关节疼痛。

defsEn: something done or said to cause others to laugh
zh: n. 笑话, 玩笑, 笑柄
v. 开玩笑, 取笑, 作弄
examples: That was a joke, of course.
Why did you tell this joke?
exampleZh: 当然，这只是个玩笑。
你为什么要讲这个笑话呢？

defsEn: to form an opinion about
to decide a question, especially a legal one
n. a public official who decides problems of law in a court
zh: n. 法官, 裁判员, 审判官, 鉴定人
vt. 审理, 鉴定, 判断, 判决, 裁定
vi. 下判断, 作评价
examples: In your view, can we judge other people's religion or not?
Do not judge so that you will not be judged.
exampleZh: 对你来说，我们可不可以评判别人的宗教？
不要做评判，这样您自己才不会被人评判。

defsEn: to push down on the feet and move up quickly into the air
zh: n. 跳跃, 跳动, 暴涨, 惊跳
vt. 跳跃, 跃过, 突升, 使跳跃
vi. 跳跃, 跳, 跳动, 暴涨
examples: I need to jump start my car.
Jump as high as you can.
exampleZh: 我需要助推起动我的车。
你会跳多高，就跳多高。

defsEn: a group of people chosen to decide what is true in a trial
zh: n. 陪审团, 评判委员会
a. 应急的
examples: The jury's guilty verdict gave rise to widespread debate.
The judge asked the jury to reach a verdict.
exampleZh: 陪审团作出的犯罪判决激起了很大的争论。

defsEn: only (“Help me for just a minute.”)
very shortly before or after the present (“He just left.”)
at the same time (“He left just as I came in.”)
what is right or fair (“The law is just, in my opinion.”)
zh: a. 正直的, 合理的, 正确的, 应得的
adv. 刚刚, 正好, 仅仅
examples: I just wish we could leave this horrible place.
I just need you to come with me.
exampleZh: 我只是希望我们能离开这个可怕的地方。
我只要你跟我来。

defsEn: the quality of being right, fair or lawful
zh: n. 正义, 公平, 公正, 正确, 司法, 审判
examples: I fight in the cause of justice.
The objective of law is justice.
exampleZh: 我为正义而战。
法律的目标是正义。

defsEn: to possess
to have for oneself
zh: n. 生计, 维持, 保持
vt. 保持, 保存, 遵守, 看守, 整理, 维持, 履行, 经营, 拘留, 记帐
vi. 保持, 继续不断
examples: If you like it, you can keep it!
By the way, how many of you keep a diary?
exampleZh: 这个东西，要是你喜欢，就拿去吧！
对了，你们当中写日记的有几位？

defsEn: to hit with the foot
zh: n. 踢, 反冲, 后座力, 凹底
vi. 踢, 反抗, 反冲
vt. 踢, 反冲
examples: I get a kick out of life.
He kicked the ball into the goal.
exampleZh: 我为人生感到很开心。
他把球踢进了球门。

defsEn: to seize and take away by force
zh: vt. 绑架, 诱拐, 拐骗
examples: What if someone kidnapped Tom? What would you do?
The princess asked us to kidnap her.
exampleZh: 要是有人绑架了Tom呢？你会怎么做？

defsEn: to make dead
to cause to die
zh: n. 杀, 杀戮, 小河
vt. 杀, 破坏, 消灭, 使终止, 抵消, 否决
vi. 杀死
examples: Why do you want to kill me?
Who would want to kill me?
exampleZh: 你为什么想杀我？
有谁想杀我？

defsEn: sort (“What kind of dog is that?”)
ad. gentle
caring
helpful
zh: n. 种类, 性质, 方式
a. 亲切的, 仁慈的, 和蔼的
examples: I use all kinds of software to study Chinese.
There are all kinds of people in the world.
exampleZh: 我用各种各样的软件学习中文。
林子大了什么鸟都有。

defsEn: to touch with the mouth to show love or honor knife
zh: n. 吻
vt. 吻
vi. 接吻
examples: The grand prize is a kiss from the princess.
I'd never let you kiss me.
exampleZh: 一等奖是公主的香吻。
我永远也不会让您亲我。

defsEn: a tool or weapon used to cut
zh: n. 小刀, 匕首
vt. 切割, 伤害, 切, 戳
vi. 劈开, 穿过
examples: I used a knife to cut the cake.
I have no knife to cut with.
exampleZh: 我是用刀切蛋糕的。
我没有刀子可用来切。

defsEn: to understand something as correct
to have the facts about
to recognize someone because you have met and talked together before
zh: v. 知道, 了解, 认识, 确信
examples: I do not know if it will rain tomorrow.
I want to know how I can lose weight.
exampleZh: 我不知道明天会不会下雨。
我想知道我能怎样减肥。

defsEn: that which is known
learning or understanding
zh: n. 知识, 学问, 认识, 知道
examples: To the best of my knowledge, she's hard to please.
A baby has no knowledge of good and evil.
exampleZh: 据我所知，她很难被取悦。
婴儿不懂得分是非黑白。

defsEn: work
workers as a group
zh: 动
examples: Capital, land and labor are the three key factors of production.
Jim was afraid of physical labor.
exampleZh: 资本、土地和劳动是生产的三大要素。
吉姆怕了体力劳动了。

defsEn: a room or place where experiments in science are done
zh: n. 实验室, 研究室, 化工厂
examples: This is a chemistry laboratory in an ordinary secondary school.
This laboratory is where we work every day.
exampleZh: 这里是普通中学的化学实验室。
这个实验室是我们每天工作的地方。

defsEn: to be without
n. the condition of needing, wanting or not having
zh: n. 缺乏, 无, 不足
vt. 缺乏, 短少, 不足, 需要
vi. 缺乏
examples: By lack of attention, she hit the post with her car.
You lack the most important thing at your age, which is love.
exampleZh: 她心不在焉的把车子撞在了柱子上。
你缺乏你这个年龄最重要的东西，爱。

defsEn: a large area of fresh water surrounded by land
zh: n. 湖, 池, 色淀
v. (使)血球溶解
examples: The ice on the lake is too thin to bear your weight.
There are a lot of fish in that lake.
exampleZh: 湖上的冰太薄了，承受不了你的重量。
那片湖里有很多鱼。

defsEn: to come to the earth from the air (“Airplanes land at airports.”)
n. the part of the earth not covered by water
the ground
zh: n. 陆地, 地面, 地界, 地产, 国土, 土地
vi. 登陆, 登岸, 到达
vt. 使上岸, 使登陆, 使到达
examples: Tomorrow, he will land on the moon.
He bought land for the purpose of building a house.
exampleZh: 明天，他将登上月球。
他买土地目的是要造房子。

defsEn: words and their use
what people speak in a country, nation or group
zh: n. 语言, 文字, 措辞
examples: What language do you want to talk in with me?
How do you say that in your language?
exampleZh: 你想用什么语言和我交谈？
您用您的语言怎么说？

defsEn: big
being of more than usual size, amount or number
opposite small
zh: a. 大的, 大量的, 宽大的, 广博的
adv. 大大地, 夸大地
examples: I prefer a phone with a large screen.
Look at the large building over there.
exampleZh: 我更喜欢荧幕大的手机。
看那边那幢高楼。

defsEn: an instrument that makes a thin, powerful light
zh: n. 激光
examples: The laser cow in WHAT THE CAR? is both hilarious and terrifying!
This clinic is doing laser surgery.
exampleZh: 《WHAT THE CAR?》中的雷射奶牛又好笑又吓人！
这个诊所正在做激光手术。

defsEn: to continue (“The talks will last three days.”)
ad. after all others
the only one remaining (“She is the last person in line.”)
zh: a. 最后的, 末尾的, 最近的
vi. 持续, 支持, 维持
vt. 使维持, 够...用
adv. 最后, 后来
n. 最后, 末尾, 鞋楦头
examples: Do it again, the same as last time.
Last night, I fell into a panic.
exampleZh: 再做一次，和之前一样。
昨天晚上，我惊慌失措。

defsEn: after the correct time
near the end
opposite early
zh: a. 迟的, 晚的, 已故的
adv. 很晚, 很迟, 晚
examples: I can stay up as late as I want.
If she should come late, give her this message.
exampleZh: 我熬夜熬多久都行。
万一她回来得太晚，把这个口信带给她。

defsEn: to make sounds to express pleasure or happy feelings
zh: n. 笑, 笑声
vi. 笑, 大笑
vt. 以笑表示
examples: We must not laugh at the poor.
How dare you laugh at me!
exampleZh: 我们不能嘲笑穷人。
你怎么敢笑我？

defsEn: to put into operation
to begin
to send into the air or space
zh: n. 下水, 汽艇, 发射
vt. 使下水, 发射, 发动
vi. 起飞, 下水, 投入, 开始
examples: Recently, this brand launched a series of limited edition underwear.
The enemy launched an attack on us.
exampleZh: 最近这个品牌推出了一系列限量版内衣。
敌人对我们发起了攻击。

defsEn: all or any rules made by a government
zh: n. 法律, 法则, 定律, 法律的制约, 法学, 司法界, 诉讼
v. 起诉
examples: You have to obey the law.
Respect for law is fundamental to our society.
exampleZh: 你必须遵守法律。
尊重法律是我们社会的基础。

defsEn: to show the way
to command
to control
to go first
zh: n. 铅, 铅条, 领导, 超前量, 领引, 榜样, 主角, 导线
vt. 引导, 带领, 领导, 指挥, 致使, 加铅于, 用铅包
vi. 领导, 带头, 导致, 用测深锤测深, 被铅覆盖
a. 带头的, 最重要的
examples: This road will lead you to the airport.
I lead a fast way of living.
exampleZh: 这条路是去机场的。
我过着放荡的生活。

defsEn: to come out of or to escape through a small opening or hole (usually a gas or liquid)
zh: n. 漏洞, 漏处, 漏出, 泄漏
vi. 漏, 泄漏
vt. 使渗漏
examples: Don't let this information leak out.
His secretary denied leaking the information.
exampleZh: 不要把这些资料泄露出去。
他的秘书不承认是她泄露了信息。

defsEn: to get knowledge about
to come to know a fact or facts
zh: vt. 学习；认识到；得知
examples: We must learn to live in harmony with nature.
I want to learn how to play the guitar.
exampleZh: 我们必须学会与自然和谐共处。
我想要学如何弹吉他。

defsEn: to go away from
to let something stay where it is
zh: n. 许可, 告别, 请假, 休假
vt. 离开, 剩下, 遗忘, 委托, 丢弃
vi. 出发, 离开, 生叶
examples: I want to leave my name on the encyclopedia.
I think you should leave as soon as you can.
exampleZh: 我要在百科全书上留名。
我觉得你应该赶紧走。

defsEn: on the side that is toward the west when one is facing north
opposite right left
zh: a. 左边的, 左倾的, 左侧的, 左派的
adv. 在左面
n. 左, 左面, 左派
leave的过去式和过去分词
examples: I left the window open all through the night.
She left her son a lot of money.
exampleZh: 我整晚都开着窗户。
她留了很多钱给她儿子。

defsEn: of or in agreement with the law
zh: a. 法律的, 法定的, 合法的
examples: Legal frameworks exist to hold war criminals accountable.
The legal system in America is the world's finest.
exampleZh: 法律架构的存在，使战争罪犯的责任可以追究。
美国的司法制度是世界上最好的。

defsEn: a government lawmaking group
zh: n. 立法机关, 议会, 立法院
examples: In a bicameral legislature, both chambers must approve a bill before it becomes law.
The country adopted a unicameral legislature to simplify the lawmaking process.

defsEn: to permit someone to use a thing temporarily
to make a loan of money
zh: vt. 借, 贷款给, 增添, 提供, 出租
vi. 贷款
examples: Lend money only to such as will repay it.
Lend me some money if you have any.
exampleZh: 只借钱给会还钱的人。
你有钱的话，借我一些。

defsEn: smaller in amount
not as much
zh: n. 较少, 较小
a. 少的, 小的
adv. 较少, 较小, 较差
examples: The more you know, the less you understand.
We have less snow than usual.
exampleZh: 人知道的越多，懂的就越少。
今年下的雪比以往少。

defsEn: to permit to do or to be
to make possible
zh: vt. 让, 假设, 出租, 排放, 妨碍
vi. 出租, 被承包
n. 出租屋, 障碍
examples: Let us think about the worst that could happen.
Let me know if I need to change.
exampleZh: 考虑一下最坏的情况下会发生什么。
让我知道我是否需要改变。

defsEn: a message written on paper
a communication in writing sent to another person letter
zh: n. 信, 字母, 证书, 字面意义, 铅字, 学问, 出租人
vt. 写字母于, 在...上刻字母, 用字母标明
vi. 写印刷体字
examples: Please send me a letter as soon as you arrive.
I want you to read this letter.
exampleZh: 你到了之后请马上给我写一封信。
我想你读一下这封信。

defsEn: the amount or height that something reaches or rises to
the position of something or someone
zh: n. 水平, 水准, 平地
a. 同高的, 平坦的, 齐平的, 水平的
vt. 弄平, 夷平, 使同等, 瞄准, 对准
vi. 变平, 拉平
examples: His level of Spanish should still be improved.
I wonder if the sea levels will rise when the North Pole melts.
exampleZh: 他的西语水平还应该提高。
我在想是否北极的冰融化的时候, 海平面就会上升。

defsEn: one who usually supports social progress or change
zh: n. 自由主义者
a. 慷慨的, 不拘泥的, 宽大的, 自由主义的
examples: Take a liberal view of young people.
I can afford to be liberal.

defsEn: to have one’s body on the ground or other surface
to say something that one knows is not true
zh: n. 谎言, 假象, 位置
vi. 躺着, 说谎, 位于, 展现, 存在, 停泊
vt. 谎骗
examples: People who will lie for you, will lie to you.
Would you rather lie than make him angry?
exampleZh: 会为你说谎的人，就会对你说谎。
你宁愿说谎也不愿让他生气吗？

defsEn: the time between being born and dying
opposite death
all living things
zh: n. 生活, 生命, 人生, 世事, 生物, 寿命, 一生, 生命力, 灵魂, 无期徒刑
examples: What do you want to do with your life?
I want to spend my life with you.
exampleZh: 你想如何过完一生？
我想和你共渡余生。

defsEn: to take or bring up to a higher place or level
zh: n. 举起, 帮助, 昂扬, 电梯
vt. 升高, 提高, 鼓舞, 清偿, 空运, 举起, 剽窃
vi. 升起, 消散, 耸立
examples: Let me give you a lift as far as the station.
She tried to lift the box, but found it impossible to do.
exampleZh: 让我送你到车站吧。
她试了试举起箱子，但举不起来。

defsEn: a form of energy that affects the eyes so that one is able to see
anything that produces light
ad. bright
clear
not heavy
zh: n. 光, 光亮, 灯, 日光, 发光体, 光源, 杰出人物, 火花, 眼光
a. 轻的, 少量的, 轻微的, 轻快的, 轻浮的, 明亮的, 淡色的, 容易的
vt. 点燃, 照亮
vi. 点着, 变亮, 突降, 偶然碰到
adv. 轻地
examples: Please turn off the light before you go to sleep.
Please turn off the light before you go to bed.
exampleZh: 上床睡觉之前请关灯。
上床睡觉之前请关灯。

defsEn: light produced by electricity in the air, usually during a storm lightning
zh: n. 闪电
vi. 闪电
a. 闪电的
examples: The lightning lit up the sky.
The big tree was struck by lightning.
exampleZh: 闪电照亮了天空。
这棵大树遭到雷击。

defsEn: to be pleased with
to have good feelings for someone or something
ad. in the same way as
similar to
zh: a. 相似的, 同样的
vt. 喜欢, 愿意, 想
vi. 喜欢, 希望
n. 爱好, 同样的人(或物)
prep. 象, 如同
adv. 可能
examples: Which one of you would like some hot chocolate?
Do you like to go to the movie theater?
exampleZh: 哪位要热巧克力？
你喜欢去电影院吗？

defsEn: to restrict to a number or amount
n. the greatest amount or number permitted
zh: n. 界限, 边界, 限度, 极限, 限制
vt. 限制, 限定
examples: How can a router be used to limit network speed?
Our company is a limited company.
exampleZh: 怎么用路由器限制网速？
我们公司是有限公司。

defsEn: a long, thin mark on a surface
a number of people or things organized
one after another
the edge of an area protected by military forces
zh: n. 列, 线, 绳, 电线, 线路, 路线, 航线, 作业线, 界线, 战线, 外形, 排, 家系
vt. 排成一行, 顺...排列, 划线于, 加衬里, 使有线条, 使起皱纹
vi. 排队
examples: Drop me a line as soon as you get there.
You have to wait in line.
exampleZh: 到了那儿之后跟我说一声儿。
您必须排队。

defsEn: to connect
to unite one thing or event with another
n. a relation between two or more things, situations or events
zh: n. 环, 连结物, 链接, 火把
vt. 连结, 联合, 挽住
vi. 连接起来
examples: Did you mean to link me that?
I have a link for you regarding that research.
exampleZh: 你是想将我与其联系起来吗？

defsEn: a substance that is not a solid or gas, and can move freely, like water
zh: n. 液体, 流体, 流音
a. 液体的, 透明的, 明亮的, 流动的, 易变的
examples: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
I don't like to use liquid laundry detergent.
exampleZh: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。
我不喜欢用洗衣液。

defsEn: to put in writing a number of names of people or things
n. a written series of names or things
zh: n. 目录, 名单, 明细表, 布条, 条纹, 列表, 序列, 数据清单
vt. 列出, 列于表上, 记入名单内, 装布条
vi. 列于表上
examples: His name is not on the list.
Do you have a list of hotels?
exampleZh: 他的名字不在名单里。
你有旅馆名录吗？

defsEn: to try to hear
zh: vi. 听, 倾听, 听从
n. 听, 倾听
examples: I like to listen to music, especially jazz.
I want to listen to Japanese music.
exampleZh: 我喜欢听音乐，特别是爵士音乐。
我想听日本的音乐。

defsEn: all the poems, stories and writings of a period of time or of a country
zh: n. 文学, 文艺, 著作
examples: I, too, like literature very much.
I majored in American literature at college.
exampleZh: 我也很喜欢文学。
我在大学主修美国文学。

defsEn: not tall or big
a small amount
zh: n. 一点点, 少许, 一会儿, 短时间
a. 小的, 很少的, 幼小的, 琐碎的, 短暂的, 矮小的
adv. 很少, 稍微, 完全不
examples: You seem to be a little under the weather.
I just need a little more time.
exampleZh: 你看上去不太好。
我只是需要多花点时间。

defsEn: to have life
to exist
ad. having life
alive
zh: a. 活的, 生动的, 精力充沛的, 实况转播的
vi. 活, 生存, 居住
vt. 过着, 度过, 经历
adv. 实况地
examples: I used to live not too far from here.
People do not live to eat but eat to live.
exampleZh: 我以前住的地方离这里不远。
人为生而食，非为食而活。

defsEn: to put objects on or into a vehicle or container
n. that which is carried
zh: n. 负荷, 担子, 重担, 装载量, 负载, 工作量, 加载
vt. 装载, 装填, 使担负
vi. 装货, 上客, 装料
examples: We loaded a lot of luggage into the car.
The old man loaded his mule with bags full of sand.
exampleZh: 我们往车里装了很多行李。
老人在骡子的背上放上了一个个装满了沙的袋子。

defsEn: money borrowed that usually must be returned with interest payments
something borrowed
zh: n. 贷款, 借出
v. 借, 供应货款, 借给
examples: You can get a loan from a bank.
He wants to pay off his loan.
exampleZh: 你可以从银行贷款。
他想还清贷款。

defsEn: about or having to do with one place
zh: a. 地方性的, 当地的, 局部的, 乡土的, 本地的
n. 当地居民, 本地新闻, 局部
examples: Local people can give appropriate advice.
The locals call this river the man-eating river and fear it.
exampleZh: 当地人可以给予适切的建议。
当地人叫这条河"食人川"并且惧怕着它。

defsEn: feeling alone
zh: a. 孤单的, 孤寂的, 荒凉的
examples: I feel lonely in this town.
I wonder why I feel so lonely when it gets cold.
exampleZh: 我在这座小镇感到很孤独。
我很疑惑为什么天气变冷的时候我会觉得很孤单。

defsEn: not short
measuring from beginning to end
measuring much
for much time
zh: a. 长的, 长久的, 冗长的, 做多头的
vi. 渴望, 热望, 极想
adv. 长久, 始终
n. 长时间, 长信号, 长整型
examples: You should have told me a long time ago.
You can stay as long as you like.
exampleZh: 很久以前你就应该告诉我的。
你想要待多久就待多久。

defsEn: to turn the eyes toward so as to see
to search or hunt for
to seem to be
zh: n. 一看, 神色, 样子, 面容
vi. 看, 注意, 朝着, 显得
vt. 打量, 看上去与...一样, 以眼色(或脸色)显示, 期待
examples: I want to have a look at this one.
I want to take a look at this room.
exampleZh: 我要看一下这个。
我想看看这个房间。

defsEn: to have no longer
to not find
to fail to keep
to be defeated
zh: vt. 遗失, 损失, 丢失, 使失去, 错过, 浪费, 迷失, 使迷路, 输去, 使沉溺于
vi. 受损失, 失败
examples: A student should not lose sight of his own identity.
He would rather lose his life than betray his organization.
exampleZh: 学生不该忽略自己的身份。
他宁可牺牲生命，也不出卖组织。

defsEn: having a strong sound
full of sound or noise
zh: a. 大声的, 不断的, 喧吵的
adv. 高声地, 大声地
examples: I felt an impulse to cry out loud.
There's no need to speak so loud.
exampleZh: 我突然好想大叫。
没有必要说话这么大声。

defsEn: to like very much
to feel a strong, kind emotion (sometimes involving sex)
n. a strong, kind emotion for someone or something
opposite hate
zh: n. 爱, 恋爱, 爱情, 爱好, 性爱
vt. 爱, 爱好, 爱慕
vi. 爱
examples: How do you say "I love you" in French?
Could you tell me why you love her?
exampleZh: “我爱你”用法语怎么讲？
你能告诉我你为什么喜欢她吗？

defsEn: not high or tall
below the normal height
close to the ground
zh: n. 低点, 低价, 低, 牛叫声
a. 低的, 消沉的, 低等的, 浅的, 卑贱的
adv. 低下地, 谦卑地, 低
vi. 牛叫
examples: Choose food low in fat, sugar and salt, and high in fibre.
This desk is a little low for me.
exampleZh: 挑选少油、少糖、少盐和高纤的食物。
我觉得这张桌子低了点。

defsEn: showing strong friendship and support for someone or something
zh: a. 忠诚的, 忠实的, 忠贞的
examples: To whom are you loyal: me or the king?
As loyal as a dog. Why not as a man?
exampleZh: 你忠于我还是国王？

defsEn: something that happens by chance
zh: n. 运气, 幸运, 好运, 侥幸
vi. 靠好运成功
examples: I wish you the best of luck.
We wish you the best of luck in your endeavors.
exampleZh: 祝你好运。
祝您一切顺利。

defsEn: a device with moving parts used to do work
zh: n. 机器, 机械装置, 机构, 自动售货机, 机械般工作的人
vt. 以机器制造
examples: She asked him how to turn on the machine.
If you had a time machine, where would you go?
exampleZh: 她问他机器怎么起动。
要是你有架时光机，你想去哪儿？

defsEn: a publication of news, stories, pictures or other information
zh: n. 杂志, 仓库, 弹盒, 胶卷盒
examples: This kind of magazine can do harm to young people.
I have a magazine in my room.
exampleZh: 这种杂志对年轻人有害。
我的房间里有一本杂志。

defsEn: a piece of iron or other material that has a pulling force
this pulling force is called magnetism magnet
zh: n. 磁铁, 有吸引力之人, 有吸引力之物
examples: Keeton put magnets on the heads of his pigeons.
Stick the magnet on the fridge.
exampleZh: 基顿把磁铁放在他的鸽子的头上。

defsEn: letters, papers and other things sent through an official system, such as a post office
zh: n. 邮件, 邮政, 邮递, 盔甲
vt. 邮寄, 给...穿盔甲
examples: Please remind me to mail the report tomorrow.
She asked him to mail that letter.
exampleZh: 请提醒我明天把报告寄了。
她请他寄那封信。

defsEn: the most important or largest
zh: n. 主要部分, 干线, 体力, 力量, 主群组
a. 主要的, 重要的, 全力的
examples: The water mains burst due to the earthquake.
Marriage is the main cause of divorce.
exampleZh: 一条主要水管被地震震裂了。
婚姻是造成离婚的主因。

defsEn: great in size, importance or amount
zh: n. 主修课, 成年人, 陆军少校
a. 主要的, 较多的, 大部分的, 成年的, 严重的
vi. 主修
examples: What do you plan to major in at college?
He majored in literature at the university.
exampleZh: 你计划去大学后主修什么？
他在大学主修文学。

defsEn: the greater number
more than half
zh: n. 多数, 大半
examples: The majority of people marry sooner or later.
In this country, the majority of the population espouses Sunni Islam.
exampleZh: 大部分人迟早要结婚。
在这个国家，大多数人口信奉逊尼派伊斯兰教。

defsEn: to produce
to create
to build
to do something or to carry out an action
to cause to be or to become
zh: vt. 制造, 安排, 创造, 构成, 使得, 产生, 造成, 整理, 布置, 引起, 到达, 进行
vi. 开始, 前进, 增大, 被制造, 被处理
n. 制造, 构造, 性情
examples: You should make better use of your free time.
I need to make a phone call to my friend.
exampleZh: 你要更好地利用闲暇时间。
我需要打电话给我的朋友。

defsEn: a man or boy
the sex that is the father of children
ad. of or about men
zh: n. 男人, 雄性动物
a. 男性的, 雄性的, 有力的
examples: Every male Algerian citizen must do military service.
Why are there differences between males and females?
exampleZh: 每个阿尔及利亚的男性国民都需要服兵役。
为何男女有别呢？

defsEn: an adult male human
zh: n. 男人, 人类, 人
vt. 为...配备人手, 操纵, 使振奋
examples: The old man set off at a quick trot.
Do you know this man in the picture?
exampleZh: 老人快步走开了。
你认识照片里的男人吗？

defsEn: to make goods in large amounts
zh: n. 产品, 制造
vt. 制造, 假造
vi. 制造
examples: You'll have to manufacture some kind of excuse.
These cameras are manufactured in Japan.
exampleZh: 你不得不制造一些借口。
这些相机是在日本生产。

defsEn: a large number or amount of
zh: n. 多数, 多数人
a. 许多的
pron. 许多
examples: How could so many people go along with this?
Many people swim here in the summer.
exampleZh: 怎么会有这么多的人同意呢？
许多人夏天在这里游泳。

defsEn: a picture of the earth’s surface or a part of it map
zh: n. 地图, 天体图, 映像
vt. 映射, 绘制...地图, 计划
examples: Can you give me a map of the street?
Can you show me on the map?
exampleZh: 请给我一张街道地图好吗？
可以在地图上展示给我看吗？

defsEn: to walk in a group like soldiers
to walk together in a large group to protest about something
zh: n. 三月, 进行, 行军, 步伐, 长途跋涉, 进行曲, 边界
vi. 进军, 前进, 交界
vt. 使行军, 使行进
examples: In March next year, I will fly to the US.
In March next year, I will take a plane to the USA.
exampleZh: 明年三月我坐飞机去美国。
明年三月我坐飞机去美国。

defsEn: to make a sign or cut on something
zh: n. 标志, 分数, 马克, 痕迹, 斑点, 靶子, 刻度, 记号, 符号, 戳记, 标准, 起跑线
vt. 做标记于, 留意, 打分数, 表明, 标志, 记录
vi. 作记号, 记得分
examples: Mark performed in front of people.
He shows no mark of progress.
exampleZh: 马克在众人面前表演。
他没有进步的迹象。

defsEn: a place or area where goods are sold, bought or traded
an economic system in which the prices of things are decided by how many there are and how much money people are willing to pay for them
zh: n. 市场, 交易, 集市, 推销地区, 行情, 市面, 销路
vt. 在市场上交易, 使上市, 销售
vi. 在市场上买卖
examples: This new market may improve the entire industry.
I will go to the market.
exampleZh: 这个新的市场可能改良全部的工业。
我要去市场。

defsEn: to join a man and woman together as husband and wife
to become husband and wife (usually in a religious or civil ceremony)
zh: vt. 与...结婚, 娶, 嫁
vi. 结婚
examples: I want to marry a girl like her.
I love you. Will you marry me?
exampleZh: 我想和一个像她那样的女孩结婚。
我爱你。嫁给我好吗？

defsEn: an amount of matter having no special form and usually of a large size
zh: n. 块, 大多数, 质量, 大量, 群众, 弥撒
a. 群众的, 大规模的, 整个的
vt. 使集合, 集中
vi. 聚集
examples: There is a mass of dark clouds in the sky.
A cloud is a mass of vapor in the sky.
exampleZh: 空中有一大片乌云。
云是天空中的水汽团。

defsEn: to bring together a male and a female to create another creature
zh: n. 配偶, 对手, 助手, (象棋)将死
vt. 使配对, 使一致, 结伴, (象棋)将死
vi. 成配偶, 紧密配合
examples: After my work mate quit his job he moved to Shanghai to teach English.
My beer was finished off by my room-mate.
exampleZh: 我的同事辞职了，后来去上海教英语。
我的啤酒被我的同屋喝完了。

defsEn: the substance, substances or matter of which something is made or from which something can be made, such as wood, cloth or stone
anything that can be made into something else
zh: n. 材料, 物资, 素材, 布料, 资料
a. 物质的, 肉体的, 重要的
examples: The prices of raw materials such as oil or coal continue to rise.
She is collecting material for a book.
exampleZh: 原材料的价格如石油或者煤的不停地上升。
她为一本书收集材料。

defsEn: the science dealing with amounts, sizes and shapes, as explained by numbers and signs
zh: n. 数学
examples: I do not like mathematics very much.
He asked if I like mathematics.
exampleZh: 我不太喜欢数学。
他问我喜不喜欢数学。

defsEn: anything that can be seen or felt
what things are made of
zh: n. 事件, 物质, 原因, 素材, 实体, 重要
vi. 有关系
examples: No matter how old one may be, one can learn.
No matter how much I consider it I do not understand.
exampleZh: 不管一个人有多老，他都能学习。
无论怎么去想我都搞不清楚。

defsEn: a word used with an action word to mean permit or possible (“May I go?” “They may leave tomorrow.”)
zh: n. 五月
aux. 愿能, 可以, 愿意
examples: I may give up soon and just nap instead.
You may still do that if you want to.
exampleZh: 也许我会马上放弃然后去打盹。
你想做也还是可以做。

defsEn: the chief official of a city or town government
zh: n. 市长
examples: He used to be the mayor.
They demanded that the mayor should resign.
exampleZh: 他曾经是市长。
他们要求市长辞职。

defsEn: food eaten to satisfy hunger, such as dinner
zh: n. 一餐, 膳食, 粗粉
vi. 进餐
examples: Can I have a meal with you?
Did you already have a meal or not?
exampleZh: 我能请你吃饭吗？
你吃饭了没有？

defsEn: to want to
to give the idea of
to have the idea of
zh: a. 低劣的, 卑贱的, 简陋的, 吝啬的, 惭愧的, 平均的, 中间的, 普通的
vt. 意谓, 想要, 意欲, 预定
vi. 用意, 有意义
n. 平均数, 中间, 中庸
examples: What do you mean to say to me?
I think that I know what this means.
exampleZh: 你想对我说什么？
我认为我知道那意味着什么。

defsEn: to learn the amount, size or distance of something
n. an action taken
a legislative proposal
zh: n. 尺寸, 量度器, 量度标准, 测量, 量具, 程度, 范围, 限度, 分寸, 措施, 方法
vt. 测量, 测度, 估量, 权衡, 调节, 拿(自己或自己的力量等)作较量
vi. 度量
examples: This measure is in accord with our policy.
These measures can prevent the disease from spreading.
exampleZh: 这个议案合符我们的政策内容。
这些措施可以预防疾病蔓延。

defsEn: the part of a dead animal used for food
zh: n. 肉, 餐, 食物
examples: If you want to keep meat for long, freeze it.
Could you cook this meat a little more?
exampleZh: 如果你想把肉类保存久一点，就要把它们放进冰箱里冷藏。
你能多烧一点这个肉吗?

defsEn: all public information organizations, including newspapers, television and radio
zh: n. 媒体
examples: The media stuck a shiv into his reputation.
I had otitis media last year.
exampleZh: 媒体抹黑了他的名誉。
我去年得了中耳炎。

defsEn: a substance or drug used to treat disease or pain
the science or study of treating and curing disease or improving health
zh: n. 药, 医学, 内科
vt. 给...用药
examples: Take this medicine in case you get sick.
I think this medicine will do you good.
exampleZh: 万一你生病了，吃这个药。
我想这药会对您有好处的。

defsEn: to come together with someone or something at the same time and place
zh: n. 会, 集会
a. 适宜的, 合适的
vt. 遇见, 引见, 认识, 满足, 对付
vi. 相遇, 接触
examples: I have to go to a meeting now.
You have to go to the meeting.
exampleZh: 我现在必须去开会。
你必须去会议。

defsEn: to make a solid into a liquid by heating it
zh: n. 熔化, 熔化物, 溶解
v. (使)熔化, (使)溶解, (使)消散, (使)变软
examples: The snow will melt when the sun comes out.
Who could melt that stone heart of yours?
exampleZh: 太阳一出来，雪就会融化。
谁能融化你的铁石心肠？

defsEn: one of a group
zh: n. 成员, 会员
examples: He is a member of the tennis club in our school.
Are you a member of the baseball team?
exampleZh: 他是学校网球具乐部的成员。
你是棒球队的一员吗？

defsEn: something done or made to honor the memory of a person or event
zh: n. 纪念物, 请愿书
a. 记念的, 记忆的
examples: The office held a memorial for him.
The teacher brought us to the museum and memorial tombs of World War II.

defsEn: a picture in the mind of past events
the ability to remember
a thing remembered
zh: n. 记忆, 记忆力, 回忆, 纪念, 存储
n. 内存
examples: My memory failed me. I just could not remember his name.
I have the memory of a goldfish.
exampleZh: 我的记性不好。我简直不记得他的名字了。
我有个黄鱼脑袋。

defsEn: about or having to do with the mind
zh: a. 心智的, 精神病的, 心理的, 颏的
n. 精神病患者
examples: Mental health is as important as physical health.
I know a good mental health facility.
exampleZh: 精神的健康和身体的健康一样重要。

defsEn: written or spoken news or information
a note from one person to another person or group
zh: n. 消息, 通讯, 讯息, 教训, 预言, 广告词
vt. 通知
vi. 通报, 报告, 报信
examples: Would you like to leave a message for him?
Would you like to leave him a message?
exampleZh: 你想留个讯息给他吗？
你想留个讯息给他吗？

defsEn: a hard substance such as iron, steel or gold
zh: n. 金属, 金属制品, 合金, 本质, 质料
a. 金属制的
vt. 以金属覆盖
examples: The acid ate into the metal.
On the mahogany desk, there is a metal cup and a blue coaster.
exampleZh: 酸性腐蚀了金属。
红木书桌上有一个金属杯子和一个蓝色杯垫。

defsEn: the way something is done
zh: n. 方法, 办法, 条理, 秩序
examples: Actually, the present method has plenty of room for improvement.
I apologize for the methods used to get you here.
exampleZh: 其实现时的方法还有很大的改善空间。
我很抱歉用这种方式把你请来。

defsEn: a device used to make very small things look larger so they can be studied microscope
zh: n. 显微镜
examples: Set the focus of the microscope.
Adjust the focus of the microscope.

defsEn: the center
a place or time of equal distance from both sides or ends
ad. in the center middle
zh: n. 中央, 中间, 腰部
a. 中央的, 中庸的, 中间的
examples: She and I were in the same class in middle school.
There is a park in the middle of the city.
exampleZh: 我和她在中学是一个班的。
城市中央有一座公园。

defsEn: someone active in trying to cause political change, often by the use of force or violence
zh: a. 好战的
examples: The man was said to be part of a rogue militant group.
He was the head of the League of Militant Atheists.

defsEn: the armed forces of a nation or group
ad. of or about the armed forces
zh: n. 军队
a. 军事的, 军人的, 适于战争的
examples: The military power of this country is very advanced.
There is a military base near here.
exampleZh: 这个国家的军事力量很先进。
这附近有一个军事基地。

defsEn: an army of citizens instead of professional soldiers
an armed force or private army
zh: n. 义勇军, 民兵组织, 国民军
examples: A group of militia saw him and began shooting.
The militia was formed to defend citizens in an emergency.

defsEn: the white liquid produced by female animals to feed their young
zh: n. 奶, 乳状物
vt. 挤乳, 榨取
vi. 产乳
examples: Do we have milk in the fridge?
Buy some milk on your way home.
exampleZh: 我们冰箱里有牛奶吗？
回来的路上买点牛奶。

defsEn: the thinking, feeling part of a person
zh: n. 思想, 愿望, 智力, 记忆, 心理, 情绪, 理智, 主意, 心意
vi. 介意, 注意, 留心
vt. 注意, 留意, 专心于, 照看, 介意
examples: Do you mind if I turn off the light?
Do you mind if I open the window?
exampleZh: 您介不介意我把灯关了？
你介意我开窗吗？

defsEn: to dig useful or valuable substances out of the earth
n. a place in the earth where such substances are found
a bomb placed under the ground or under water so it cannot be seen
zh: n. 矿, 矿藏, 地雷
vt. 挖掘, 开采, 在...布雷, 破坏
vi. 开矿, 埋设地雷
pron. 我的
examples: A friend of mine asked me to send her a postcard.
A friend of mine came to see me during the day.
exampleZh: 我的一位朋友要求我寄给她一张明信片。
我的一个朋友在白天的时候来看我。

defsEn: a substance found in nature that is not an animal or a plant, such as coal or salt
zh: n. 矿物, 无机物, 苏打水
a. 矿物的, 似矿物的
examples: That country is rich in mineral resources.
Water, forests, and minerals are important natural resources.
exampleZh: 那个国家拥有丰富的矿物资源。
水、森林和矿物都是重要的天然资源。

defsEn: a member of a cabinet
a high government official (“prime minister,” “foreign minister”)
zh: n. 部长, 牧师, 公使
vi. 服侍, 救助, 主持宗教仪式
examples: The Foreign Minister said that war was inevitable.
He made his way to the minister.
exampleZh: 外交部长称战争在所难免。
他设法当上了部长。

defsEn: small in size
of little importance
zh: n. 未成年人, 副修科目
a. 较小的, 二流的, 未成年的
vi. 副修
examples: He played a minor part in the play.
Even a minor injury can kill you.
exampleZh: 他在剧中演了一个小角色。

defsEn: the smaller number
opposite majority
zh: n. 少数, 未成年, 少数民族
a. 少数的, 属于少数派的
examples: April is the national minority health month.
I think that you have a minority viewpoint.
exampleZh: 四月是全国弱势团体医疗月。

defsEn: a measure of time
one of the sixty equal parts of an hour
sixty seconds
zh: n. 分, 分钟, 片刻, 备忘录, 笔记
vt. 记录, 摘录, 测定时间
a. 微小的, 详细的
examples: May I speak to you a minute?
I asked her to wait a minute.
exampleZh: 我可以和你讲一下话吗?
我让她等了一分钟。

defsEn: to fail to hit, see, reach or meet
zh: n. 失误, 避免, 失败, 小姐
vt. 未得到, 未达到, 未听到, 未觉察, 逃脱, 遗漏, 错过, 思念
vi. 失败, 击不中
examples: Hurry up, or you will miss the last train.
I know that you still miss me.
exampleZh: 再不快点你就要赶不上末班车了。
我知道你还是想我的。

defsEn: any weapon that can be thrown or fired through the air and explodes when it reaches its target
zh: n. 发射物, 导弹, 飞弹, 火箭
a. 可发射的
examples: Once a target is acquired, the missile will lock-on to it for the kill.
How many missiles can this aircraft carry?

defsEn: lost
not found
zh: a. 不见的, 缺少的
examples: Let me apologize once again for missing our meeting.
You have no idea how many people go missing here.

defsEn: a wrong action or decision
an action done without the knowledge that it was wrong
zh: n. 错误, 误会
vi. 犯错, 误认
vt. 误解, 弄错
examples: If you see a mistake, then please correct it.
A lot of our mistakes come from a lack of patience.
exampleZh: 如果你发现有错的话请帮忙改正。
许多错误源自于我们缺乏耐心。

defsEn: to put different things together to make one thing
zh: n. 混合物, 混乱, 糊涂
vt. 使混合, 弄混, 使结合, 混淆
vi. 相混合, 交往, 参与
examples: Mix the rice, egg and soy sauce.
If you mix blue and red, you'll get purple.
exampleZh: 混合米、蛋跟酱油。
如果将蓝色和红色混合，就会得到紫色。

defsEn: a large group of wild or angry people
zh: n. 暴民, 民众, 暴徒
vt. 大举包围, 蜂拥进入, 围攻
vi. 聚众生事
examples: The mob put a price on Tom's head.
The police could not control the mob.
exampleZh: 黑帮悬赏捉拿汤姆。

defsEn: an example
something, usually small, made to show how something will look or work
zh: n. 模型, 模范, 模特儿
a. 模范的, 作模型用的
vi. 做模型, 做模特儿
vt. 使模仿, 塑造
examples: I'm an actress, not a model.
She is said to have been a model.
exampleZh: 我是演员，不是模特。
据说她曾经是一个模特儿。

defsEn: not extreme
zh: a. 适度的, 稳健的, 中等的, 节制的
vt. 节制, 减轻, 使缓和
vi. 变缓和, 主持会议
examples: Moderate exercise will refresh both mind and body.
Moderate exercise is necessary for good health.
exampleZh: 适度的运动让身心焕然一新。
适度运动对身体健康是必要的。

defsEn: of the present or very recent time
the most improved
zh: n. 现代人, 有思想的人
a. 现代的, 时髦的
examples: A computer is a type of modern tool.
Modern ships only need a small crew.
exampleZh: 电脑是一种现代工具。
现代船只只需要一小组的船员。

defsEn: the smallest amount of a chemical substance that can exist
zh: n. 分子, 些微
examples: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
Each molecule in our body has a unique shape.
exampleZh: 一个水分子是由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成的。

defsEn: pieces of metal or paper used to pay for things money
zh: n. 金钱, 一笔款, 财富, 货币, 金额
examples: I have a lot of money on me now.
If you have any money, please lend me some.
exampleZh: 现在我有很多现金。
如果你有钱的话，借点给我吧。

defsEn: one of the twelve periods of time into which a year is divided
zh: n. 月
examples: We hold a meeting once a month.
How many times a month do you do that?
exampleZh: 我们一个月开会一次。
你一个月做几次这种事？

defsEn: the bright object often seen in the night sky that orbits the earth about every twenty-nine days
zh: n. 月亮, 月球, 月光
vi. 闲荡
vt. 虚度
examples: The moon is not a good place to live on.
There may be life on the moons of Jupiter.
exampleZh: 月球不是一个适合居住的地方。
木星的卫星上可能有生命存在。

defsEn: concerning what is right or wrong in someone’s actions
zh: n. 道德, 品行, 寓意
a. 道德的, 品性端正的, 精神上的
examples: Moral evil is the result of ignorance.
A person has morals like water is clear.
exampleZh: 道德上的恶乃是无知的后果。
人有德行，如水之清。

defsEn: greater in size or amount
zh: n. 更多
a. 多的, 程度较大的, 更大的
adv. 多, 更多, 进一步
examples: The truth can be more painful than a lie.
You should pay more attention to what you say.
exampleZh: 真相可能比谎言更令人痛苦。
你应该更注意你说的话。

defsEn: the early part of the day, from sunrise until noon
zh: n. 早晨, 早上, 初期
examples: Good morning, right now I have ice cream.
In the morning I always drink a cup of coffee.
exampleZh: 早上好、现在我有冰淇淋。
在早晨，我总是喝一杯咖啡。

defsEn: greatest in size or amount
zh: n. 最多, 最大
a. 大多数的, 几乎全部的, 最多的
adv. 最, 最多, 极其
examples: Most people only want to hear their own truth.
Try to make the most of your time.
exampleZh: 大部分人只想听到他们自己的真理。
尽量试着用好你的时间。

defsEn: the female parent
a woman who has a child or children
zh: n. 母亲, 修女院长
vt. 产生, 照看, 收养
examples: I remember my mother teaching me the alphabet.
My mother can play golf very well.
exampleZh: 我记得我母亲教我认字。
我妈妈高尔夫打得很好。

defsEn: a movement
a continuing change of position or place
zh: n. 移动, 手势, 动作, 意向, 请求, 提议
v. 打手势
examples: My father motioned for me to leave the meeting room.
I motioned for her to sit down.
exampleZh: 我父亲示意我离开会议室。
我对她做了一个手势，叫她坐下。

defsEn: a part of the earth’s surface that rises high above the area around it mountain
zh: n. 山, 山脉, 大堆
examples: I want to climb this mountain.
Her house is at the foot of a mountain.
exampleZh: 我想登上这座山。
她家在一座山的山脚下。

defsEn: to express or feel sadness
zh: v. 哀悼, 忧伤, 服丧
examples: The widow mourned for her husband for a long time.
I call the living, I mourn the dead, I repel lightning.
exampleZh: 寡妇为她的丈夫哀悼了很久。

defsEn: to change position
to put or keep in motion
to go
zh: n. 移动, 迁居, 步骤
vt. 移动, 开动, 感动, 搬(家)
vi. 移动, 离开, 运行, 迁移, 摇动, 搬家, 交往, 进展, 脱手
examples: Could you move the chair a bit?
Please move the desk to the left.
exampleZh: 你可以移一移那张椅子吗？
请把桌子向左移。

defsEn: the act of moving or a way of moving
a series of acts or efforts to reach a goal
zh: n. 运动, 动作, 运转, 移动, 倾向, 变化, 活动, 乐章
examples: Avoid sudden movements around the rabbit, they can startle them.
You were not able to check their movements.
exampleZh: 避免在兔子旁边突然做出动作，以免吓到牠们。
你无法阻止他们的行动。

defsEn: a motion picture
a film
zh: n. 电影
examples: What kind of movie do you want to watch?
What do you think of this movie?
exampleZh: 你想看什么类型的电影？
你觉得这个电影怎么样？

defsEn: great in amount
zh: n. 大量, 许多, 重要的事
a. 很多的, 重要的
adv. 多, 甚, 几乎
examples: How come you know so much about Japanese history?
How much do you want in terms of salary?
exampleZh: 你为什么知道这么多的日本历史?
您想要多少工资？

defsEn: to kill another person illegally
n. the crime of killing another person
zh: n. 谋杀
vt. 谋杀, 损毁, 破坏
vi. 犯杀人罪
examples: The court acquitted him of the charge of murder.
He avenged the murder of his father.
exampleZh: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。
他对杀父凶手进行了报复。

defsEn: the making of sounds by singing or using a musical instrument
zh: n. 音乐, 乐曲
examples: Without music, life would be an error.
Without music, life would be a mistake.
exampleZh: 没有音乐的话，生命是错误的。
没有音乐的话，生命是错误的。

defsEn: a word used with an action word to mean necessary (“You must go to school.”)
zh: n. 必须, 未发酵葡萄汁, 绝对必要的事物
aux. 必须
examples: You must think of this as a great improvement.
We must buy a new carpet for this room.
exampleZh: 你应该认为这是个很可观的改进。
我们要为这个房间买新地毯。

defsEn: something that is not or cannot be explained or understood
a secret
zh: n. 秘密, 神秘, 奥秘
examples: Solve the mystery lurking behind the murder!
What happened to them is still a mystery.
exampleZh: 要解开谋杀背后潜藏之谜！
在他们身上发生了什么仍然是个谜。

defsEn: to appoint
to nominate
to give a name to
n. a word by which a person, animal or thing is known or called
zh: n. 名字, 名称, 姓名, 名义, 名誉, 文件名
vt. 命名, 称呼, 任命, 提名, 列举
a. 姓名的, 据以取名的
examples: We have to pick a name for the child.
I wonder why they left my name off the list.
exampleZh: 我们要给孩子起个名字。
我奇怪他们为什么在表里把我的名字落下了。

defsEn: limited in size or amount
not wide
having a short distance from one side to the other
zh: n. 狭窄部分, 隘路
a. 狭窄的, 仔细的, 有限的, 勉强的, 狭隘的, 手紧的
vi. 变窄
vt. 使变狭窄
examples: There's narrow road to the village.
This road is too narrow for cars to pass.
exampleZh: 到村庄有条窄路。
这条路太窄，过不了车。

defsEn: a country, together with its social and political systems
zh: n. 国家, 民族
examples: Every nation should help each other.
If you are to know a nation, you must learn its history.
exampleZh: 每个国家都应该彼此帮助。
如果想了解一个国家，就必须学习这个国家的历史。

defsEn: someone who was born in a place, not one who moved there
zh: n. 本地人, 土产, 当地人
a. 本国的, 与生俱来的, 自然的
examples: My native language is the most beautiful gift from my mother.
I am looking for a native speaker who can correct this paper for me.
exampleZh: 我的母语是我从我母亲那里得到的最美好的礼物。
我正在寻找可以帮我修改这篇论文的母语人士。

defsEn: of or about nature
normal
common to its kind
zh: n. 白痴
a. 自然的, 自然界的, 本能的, 天然的, 物质的, 正常的, 原始的, 自然数的
examples: I like to drink natural mineral water.
It comes natural to him to speak French.
exampleZh: 我喜欢喝天然的矿泉水。
说法语对他来说很自然。

defsEn: all the plants, animals and other things on earth not created by humans
events or processes not caused by humans
zh: n. 自然, 大自然, 本性, 性格, 性质
examples: Nature plays an important role in our life.
Nature never deceives us; it is always we who deceive ourselves.
exampleZh: 大自然在我们的生活中扮演着重要的角色。
自然从不会欺骗我们，骗我们的永远是我们自己。

defsEn: the part of a country’s military force trained to fight at sea
zh: n. 海军, 海军人员, 海军军力, 烟蒂
examples: Mary was wearing a navy blue skirt.
I learned that in the Navy.
exampleZh: 玛丽穿着深蓝色的裙子。

defsEn: not far
close to
zh: a. 近的, 近亲的, 近似的
adv. 接近, 亲近
prep. 靠近, 近似于
v. 接近, 走近
examples: I wish I could live near your house.
She used to live near the river.
exampleZh: 我希望住在你家附近。
她过去住在河边。

defsEn: needed to get a result or effect
required
zh: a. 必要的；必然的；必需的
examples: I will go with you if necessary.
Will it be necessary for us to buy a book for this class?
exampleZh: 如果必要的话, 我会和你一起去。
我们有必要为上这门课买本教材吗？

defsEn: to require
to want
to be necessary to have or to do
zh: n. 需要, 必须, 缺乏
vt. 需要, 必需
vi. 贫困, 有必要
aux. 需要
examples: We need to turn right at the next junction.
You need to put more water in the vase.
exampleZh: 我们得在下一个路口右拐。
你需要往花瓶里加更多的水。

defsEn: to talk about a problem or situation to find a common solution
zh: vi. 商议, 谈判, 交涉
vt. 谈妥, 转让, 处理
examples: I would like to negotiate with that party.
They negotiate with their employer about their wages.

defsEn: a person or country that is next to or near another
zh: 邻近的
examples: They set fire to their neighbor's house in revenge.
A close neighbor is better than a distant relative.
exampleZh: 为了报仇，他们放火烧了邻居的家。
远亲不如近邻。

defsEn: not one or the other of two
zh: adv. 皆不, 两个都不
a. (两者)都不的
pron. 两者都不
conj. 既非, 既不
examples: I can neither confirm nor deny that.
Neither team played well in the game.
exampleZh: 我既不能确认也不能否定。
两组在比赛中的表现都不太好。

defsEn: a thin piece of tissue that sends information through the body to and from the brain
zh: n. 精神, 勇气, 叶脉, 神经
vt. 鼓起勇气
examples: She had the nerve to speak out.
That music gets on his nerves.
exampleZh: 她竟敢说出来。
那音乐烦死他了。

defsEn: not supporting one side or the other in a dispute
zh: n. 中立者, 中立国, 非彩色, 空档
a. 中立的, 中性的, 无色的
examples: You can never be neutral. Even silence is an opinion.
A neutral country was asked to help settle the dispute.

defsEn: at no time
not ever
zh: adv. 从不, 决不, 不曾
examples: I have never come across such a stubborn person.
I will never tell a lie from now on.
exampleZh: 我从来没碰到过这么倔的人。
我从今以后不会再说谎了。

defsEn: not existing before
not known before
recently made, built, bought or grown
another
different
zh: a. 新的, 陌生的, 最近的, 不熟悉的
examples: He should buy a new bicycle for his son.
I will buy a new car next month.
exampleZh: 他应该为他儿子买一台新的脚踏车。
我下个月买辆新车。

defsEn: information about any r ecent events, especially as reported by the media
zh: n. 新闻, 消息, 报导
examples: We could not but weep at the sad news.
I have some good news and some bad news.

defsEn: coming immediately after
nearest
zh: n. 下一个
a. 下一个的, 其次的, 贴近的
adv. 然后, 下次, 次于
examples: Next time it will be my turn to drive.
I have to get off at the next stop.
exampleZh: 下次该轮到我开车了。
我下一站下车。

defsEn: pleasing
good
kind
zh: a. 美好的, 和蔼的, 正派的, 做得好的, 精密的, 细微的, 挑剔的, 谨慎的
examples: It would be nice to have a party.
He used to be a nice boy.
exampleZh: 开个聚会很好。
他以前是个好男孩。

defsEn: the time between when the sun goes down and when it rises, when there is little or no light night
zh: n. 夜, 夜晚, 晚上, 黑暗, 夜晚的工作
examples: If you work day and night, you will lose your health.
We lock the door at night.
exampleZh: 你这样不分昼夜地工作，将会伤害自己的健康。
我们晚上锁门。

defsEn: used to reject or to refuse
not any
not at all
zh: n. 不, 拒绝, 否决票
a. 没有, 不是, 绝非
adv. 不

defsEn: sound, especially when loud
zh: n. 噪音, 杂音, 响声, 喧闹
vt. 谣传
vi. 喧闹
examples: She told us not to make a noise.
Can you hear the noise of the waves on the beach?
exampleZh: 她叫我们不要制造噪音。
你能听到沙滩上海浪的声音吗？

defsEn: to name someone as a candidate for an election
to propose a person for an office or position
zh: vt. 提名, 任命, 命名
examples: They nominated Calvin Coolidge for vice president.
Who would you nominate for this award?
exampleZh: 他们提名卡尔文•柯立芝为副总统。

defsEn: the middle of the day
twelve o’clock in the daytime
zh: n. 正午, 中午, 全盛期
examples: She should arrive there at noon.
Tell her to come at noon.
exampleZh: 她应该中午到那里。
让她中午过来。

defsEn: the usual condition, amount or form
ad. usual
what is expected
zh: n. 常态, 标准, 正常, 普通
a. 正常的, 正规的, 标准的, 师范的, 正态的
examples: Tomorrow there will be no normal lessons, in view of the athletic meet rehearsal.
It's normal to be a little afraid.
exampleZh: 明天是运动会的排练，没有往常的课程。
有点怕很正常。

defsEn: the direction to the left of a person facing the rising sun
zh: n. 北方, 北
a. 北的, 北方的
adv. 向北方, 在北方
examples: To reach the North Pole is not easy.
The north differs greatly from the south.
exampleZh: 到北极可不容易。
南方和北方的差异很大。

defsEn: a word showing that something is denied or untrue (“She is not going.”)
zh: adv. 不, 非, 未

defsEn: to talk about something already known
n. a word or words written to help a person remember
a short letter
zh: n. 笔记, 记录, 注解, 票据, 符号, 显要, 注重, 便笺, 照会
vt. 记录, 注解, 注意
examples: The students noted down every word the teacher said.
A bird is known by its note, and a man by his talk.
exampleZh: 学生们把老师说的话一字不漏地记了下来。
听其声而知其鸟，闻其声而知其人。

defsEn: not anything
no thing
zh: n. 无, 不关紧要之事, 零
adv. 毫不, 决不
interj. 什么也没有, 无
examples: As for me, I have nothing to say.
I have nothing to do with that crime.
exampleZh: 以我之见，我无话可说。
这个犯罪和我一点关系都没有。

defsEn: at this time
immediately
zh: adv. 现在, 刚才, 目前
n. 现在
a. 现在的
conj. 由于
examples: And now you want her to come back?
For now, I will wait at the hotel.
exampleZh: 然后你现在还想让她回来？
目前我待在酒店。

defsEn: not in, to or at any place
zh: adv. 无处, 到处都无
examples: I live in the middle of nowhere.
I have nowhere to go now.
exampleZh: 我住在一个鸟不拉屎的地方。
我现在无处可去。

defsEn: of or about the energy produced by splitting atoms or bringing them together
of or about weapons that explode by using energy from atoms
zh: a. 核子的, 原子能的, 核的, 中心的
examples: A nuclear war will bring about the destruction of mankind.
This time, the nuclear test was a success.
exampleZh: 核战争将会为人类带来灭亡。
这次核试验成功了。

defsEn: the center part of an atom or cell
zh: n. 核心, 核子, 原子核, 起点
examples: You two are the nucleus of the team.
The family is the nucleus of society.
exampleZh: 你们俩是团队的核心。

defsEn: a food or substance that makes plants, humans or animals grow
zh: a. 营养的, 滋养的
n. 营养物, 滋养物
examples: The body absorbs the nutrients into the blood stream.
Ziri wrote his thesis about nutrient absorption.

defsEn: a word or sign used to show the order or amount of things number
zh: n. 数, 数字, 数目, 号码
vt. 数, 计算, 共计
vi. 计算, 报数
examples: Could you tell me your name and your number?
Could you give me your phone number?
exampleZh: 你能告诉我你的姓名和手机号码吗？
能给我你的电话号码吗?

defsEn: to act as one is ordered to act
zh: vt. 服从, 遵从, 顺从
vi. 服从
examples: We ought to obey the law.
It is our duty to obey the law.
exampleZh: 我们必须遵纪守法。
遵守法律是我们的义务。

defsEn: to show that one does not like or approve
to protest
n. something not alive that can be seen or touched
zh: n. 物体, 目标, 目的, 对象, 宾语, 客体
vi. 反对, 抱反感
vt. 提出...来反对
examples: His main object in life was to become rich.
I object to her going there alone.
exampleZh: 他主要的人生目标就是成为一个有钱人。
我不同意她一个人去那儿。

defsEn: to watch
to look at carefully
to celebrate or honor something (“They will observe the anniversary of the day she was born.”)
zh: vt. 觉察到, 遵守, 注意到, 庆祝
vi. 注意, 评论
examples: His failure to observe traffic regulations resulted in a serious accident.
He pointed out how important it is to observe the law.
exampleZh: 他未能遵守交通规则，结果发生了严重的事故。
他指出了遵守法律的重要性。

defsEn: to take and hold or to control by force
zh: vt. 占领, 占(时间、空间等), 住进, 担任, 使从事, 使全神贯注
examples: Books occupy most of his room.
The meeting room is occupied at the moment.
exampleZh: 书堆满了他的房间。
会议室正在使用中。

defsEn: the area of salt water that covers almost seventy-five percent of the earth’s surface
any of the five main divisions of this water ocean
zh: n. 海洋, 广阔, 许多, 一大片
examples: We can hear the ocean from here.
I would swim through the ocean just to see your smile again.
exampleZh: 我们从这里可以听到海的声音。
我愿穿洋过海只为再看到你的笑容。

defsEn: made from
belonging to
about
connected to
included among
zh: prep. 的, 属于

defsEn: away
at a distance
condition when something is no longer operating or continuing
not on
not connected
zh: a. 关着的, 不再生效的, 处于...境况的, 休假的, 空闲的
adv. 走开, ...掉, ...下, 休息, 出发, 隔断
prep. 离开, 脱落, 不在从事......, 在...之外
vi. 离开, 滚开
vt. 杀死
n. 关闭状态

defsEn: a military campaign of attack
ad. having to do with attacking
zh: a. 令人不快的, 侮辱的, 攻击性的
examples: As an American, I find that offensive.
They went on the offensive in the first half.

defsEn: to present or propose
n. the act of presenting or proposing
that which is presented or proposed
zh: n. 给予(物), 出价, 提议, 意图, 报价
vt. 提供, 出价, 奉献, 试图, 使出现, 演出
vi. 出现, 献祭, 提议, 求婚
examples: This year we offer the same language course as last year.
It was foolish of you to accept his offer.
exampleZh: 今年我们提供与去年相同的语言课程。
你真笨去接受他的提议。

defsEn: a room or building where business or work is done
a public position to which one is elected or appointed
zh: n. 办公室, 部, 公职, 职责
examples: He left the office in great haste.
He left his office in a hurry.
exampleZh: 他急急忙忙地离开了办公室。
他急忙地离开办公室。

defsEn: a person in the military who commands others
any person who is a member of a police force
zh: n. 军官, 主管, 官员, 公务员
vt. 指挥
examples: There's a police officer at the door.
How did you become a police officer?
exampleZh: 门口有位警察。
你是怎么成为一名警察的？

defsEn: a person with power in an organization
a representative of an organization or government
ad. of or about an office
approved by the government or someone in power
zh: n. 官员, 公务员, 职员
a. 公务的, 官方的, 正式的
examples: He made an official visit to the French president the day before yesterday.
The number of officials doubled last year.
exampleZh: 他前天拜会了法国总统。
去年官员的数量成倍增加了。

defsEn: many times
zh: adv. 时常, 常常
examples: How often do you have to see the dentist?
He often says that we need to help one another.
exampleZh: 你多久看一次牙医？
他常说我们要互帮互助。

defsEn: a thick liquid that does not mix with water and that burns easily
a black liquid taken from the ground and used as fuel
zh: n. 油, 石油, 油画颜料
vt. 涂油于, 使融化成油状, 加油于
vi. 加燃油, 融化
examples: I work for an oil company.
Keep oil away from the fire.
exampleZh: 我为一家石油公司工作。
让油远离火。

defsEn: not young or new
having lived or existed for many years
zh: n. 以前, 往昔
a. 老的, 旧的, 古老的, 年长的, 老练的
examples: The old woman fell and could not get up.
I saw an old woman cross the street.
exampleZh: 那个老太太摔倒了爬不起来。
我看见一个老太太穿过了马路。

defsEn: above and held up by
touching the upper surface of (“The book is on the table.”)
supported by (“He is on his feet.”)
about (“The report on the meeting is ready.”)
at the time of (“He left on Wednesday.”)
zh: prep. 在...之上
adv. ...上去
a. 正起作用的

defsEn: one time only
zh: adv. 一次, 曾经, 一旦
conj. 一旦, 一经
n. 一次
a. 从前的

defsEn: being the single one or ones
no more than (“We have only two dollars.”)
zh: a. 唯一的, 仅有的, 最佳的
adv. 只有, 仅仅, 只能
conj. 但是, 不过
examples: If only I can go to the concert!
You can only let the matter take its own course.
exampleZh: 要是我能去音乐会就好了。
你只能听天由命。

defsEn: to start (“They opened talks.”)
ad. not closed
not secret
zh: n. 公开, 户外, 空旷
a. 开着的, 开放的, 开阔的, 营业着的, 公开的, 悬而未决的
vt. 打开, 公开, 开放
vi. 展开, 开始, 展现
examples: You need a key to open the box.
I think you should open an account here.
exampleZh: 你需要用一把钥匙打开那个盒子。
我认为你应该在这里开个账户。

defsEn: to do work or a job
to cut into the body for medical reasons
zh: v. 操作, 运转, 动手术, 活动
examples: Do you know how to operate a computer?
The doctor decided to operate at once.
exampleZh: 你知道怎么操作电脑吗？
医生决定立刻动手术。

defsEn: a belief based on one’s own ideas and thinking
zh: n. 意见, 评价, 主张
examples: In my opinion, it would be difficult to solve this problem.
I am of the opinion that he will never come back.
exampleZh: 在我看来，这个问题很难解决。
我看他永远也不会回来了。

defsEn: to be against
to fight against
zh: vt. 反对, 以...对抗, 抗争
vi. 反对
examples: Do you support or oppose abortion?
Red, as opposed to green, is a sign of danger.
exampleZh: 你支持还是反对堕胎？
红色是危险的标志，与绿色相对。

defsEn: different as possible
completely different from
exactly the other way (“North is the opposite direction from south.”)
zh: a. 相对的, 相反的, 对面的
prep. 对面
n. 对立面
examples: What they told you is the opposite of what they told me yesterday.
The result is opposite to what we expected.
exampleZh: 她们跟你说的可和她们昨天跟我说的完全相反。
结果与我们预期的相反。

defsEn: to make others suffer
to control by the use of unjust and cruel force or power
zh: vt. 压迫, 压抑, 使烦恼
examples: The government of this country oppresses its people.
The government of that country oppresses its people.
exampleZh: 这个国家的政府压迫人民。

defsEn: giving another of two choices
giving the last of several choices
zh: conj. 或, 或者

defsEn: to travel in space around a planet or other object
n. the path or way an object travels in space around another object or planet orbit
zh: n. 轨道, 常轨, 眼眶
vt. 绕...轨道而行
vi. 进入轨道, 盘旋
examples: The earth orbits the sun once a year.
Who can calculate the orbit of his own soul?
exampleZh: 地球公转时间是一年。

defsEn: to give a command
to tell someone what to do
n. a command
the correct or normal way things are organized
a peaceful situation in which people obey laws
zh: n. 次序, 规则, 命令
vi. 命令, 定货
vt. 整理, 命令, 定购
n. 顺序, 阶数
examples: We will help you order the stock.
Bill got up early in order that he might catch the first train.
exampleZh: 我们帮你叫货。
为了能够赶上第一班火车, 比尔很早就起床了。

defsEn: a part of the body that has a special purpose, such as the heart or brain
zh: n. 风琴, 器官, 元件, 机构, 机关
examples: Are you able to play organ?
The tongue and the palate are the taste organs.
exampleZh: 你会弹管风琴吗?
舌头和上颚都是味觉器官。

defsEn: a living thing, often so small it can be seen only through a microscope
zh: n. 生物, 有机体, 社会组织
examples: This organism can survive in outer space.
The alien organism can still enter the station through the thrusters.

defsEn: to put in order
to put together into a system
zh: vt. 组织, 有机化, 给予生机
vi. 组织起来
examples: I organized a marriage ceremony last month.
I keep meaning to organize my desk.
exampleZh: 我上个月举行了婚礼。
我一直想整理书桌。

defsEn: different
of another kind
the remaining one or ones of two or more (“That man is short
the other is tall.”)
zh: a. 其他的, 另外的, 从前的
pron. 其他的, 他人, 另外一个
examples: How do I get to the other side?
I call on him every other day.
exampleZh: 我怎么去另一边呢？
我每隔一天拜访他。

defsEn: of or belonging to us
zh: pron. 我们的

defsEn: to force to leave
to remove by force
zh: vt. 逐出, 罢黜, 剥夺, 驱逐
examples: The regime was eventually ousted from power.
They wanted to oust the communist government of Fidel Castro.

defsEn: away from the inside
opposite of in
zh: a. 外面的, 熄灭的, 结束的
adv. 在外, 熄灭, 出现
prep. 出自, 离去, 向

defsEn: above
covering
across, in or on every part of (“all over the world”)
zh: adv. 结束, 越过, 从头到尾
prep. 在...之上, 遍于...之上, 越过
a. 上面的
vt. 越过

defsEn: to remove from power
to defeat or end by force
zh: n. 推翻, 瓦解, 倾覆
vt. 打倒, 推翻, 倾覆
examples: The people want to overthrow the regime.
They conspire to overthrow the oppressive government.

defsEn: to pay or have to repay (usually money) in return for something received
zh: vt. 亏欠, 负...债, 归功于, 怀有, 应给予, 感恩
vi. 欠钱
examples: I owe my success to his help.
I know I owe you money.
exampleZh: 我的成功要归功于他。
我知道我欠你钱。

defsEn: to have or possess for oneself
zh: n. 自己的
a. 自己的, 嫡亲的, 同胞的
vt. 拥有, 支配, 自认, 承认, 顺从于
vi. 承认, 供认
examples: I want to have my own room.
Tell him to mind his own business.
exampleZh: 我想要有我自己的房间。
告诉他别多管闲事。

defsEn: a hurt or suffering somewhere in the body
zh: n. 痛苦, 疼痛, 辛苦
vt. 使痛苦, 痛苦
vi. 作痛, 疼
examples: I have a pain in my foot.
If the pain continues you have to go to the doctor.
exampleZh: 我的脚痛。
如果持续疼痛, 你必须去看医生。

defsEn: to cover with a liquid color
to make a picture with liquid colors
n. a colored liquid used to cover or protect a surface
zh: n. 油漆, 颜料, 绘画作品, 涂漆
vt. 油漆, 绘, 画, 描绘, 装饰, 点缀
vi. 绘画, 涂漆
examples: He had his sister help him paint the wall of his room.
This is the picture of his own painting.
exampleZh: 他让妹妹帮他涂他房间的墙。
这是一幅他自己画的画。

defsEn: a thin, flat material made from plants or cloth often used for writing
zh: n. 纸, 文件, 文章, 报纸, 证券, 证件
vt. 用纸糊, 贴壁纸于, 用纸包装
vi. 贴壁纸
a. 纸做的, 纸上的
examples: Will you put down that paper and listen to me?
Give me some paper to write on.
exampleZh: 你能放下报纸听我说吗？
给我一些纸来写字。

defsEn: a device that permits a person or thing to fall slowly from an airplane or helicopter to the ground parachute
zh: n. 降落伞
vi. 跳伞
examples: Where can I buy a parachute?
And now my parachutes fall from dream to dream through the spaces of death.

defsEn: a group of people and vehicles moving together to celebrate a special event or anniversary
zh: n. 游行, 炫耀, 阅兵
v. 游行, 炫耀, (使)列队行进
examples: I caught sight of a parade on my way home.
We like to march on the parade ground.
exampleZh: 在回家的路上，我看到一场阅兵式。

defsEn: to forgive for a crime and release from punishment
zh: n. 原谅, 赦免
vt. 宽恕, 原谅
examples: Pardon me, but that is my racket.
Pardon me, but that's my racket.
exampleZh: 抱歉，这是我的球拍。
抱歉，这是我的球拍。

defsEn: a father or mother
zh: n. 父母, 父母亲, 根源
examples: A parent or teacher should bring home to children the pleasure of reading.
Most parents see their own children as the best in the world.
exampleZh: 家长或老师应该让孩子们享受阅读的乐趣。
大部分的父母视自己的孩子为世界上最好的。

defsEn: a government lawmaking group
zh: n. 国会, 议会
examples: The President cannot disband the Parliament.
He will address Parliament for the first time tomorrow.
exampleZh: 总统不得解散国会。

defsEn: something less than the whole
not all of something
zh: n. 部分, 局部, 零件, 要素, 等分, 职责, 角色, 部位
vt. 分开, 分离, 断绝, 区别, 分配
vi. 分开, 断裂, 分手
a. 部分的, 局部的
adv. 部分地, 有些
examples: He would like to take part in the competition.
We will take part in the marathon.
exampleZh: 他想参加比赛。
我们将参加马拉松。

defsEn: a very small piece of matter
zh: n. 颗粒, 粒子, 质点, 极小量
examples: Tiny particles in the air can cause cancer.
He does not have a particle of honesty in him.
exampleZh: 空气中的微粒可以引发癌症。

defsEn: a person who takes part in some activity in common with another or others. (“The two men were business partners.”)
zh: n. 合伙人, 股东, 伙伴, 伴侣
vt. 与...合伙, 组成一对
vi. 做伙伴, 当助手
examples: The teacher and her partner took the people attending the wedding to a park.
The two men were business partners.
exampleZh: 老师和她爱人带着参加婚礼的人来到一个公园。
这两个男人是生意上的合作伙伴。

defsEn: a group of people working together for a political purpose
a group of people or friends gathered together for enjoyment
zh: n. 宴会, 党, 政党, 团体, 当事人, 聚会
v. 举办聚会
examples: Will you go to the party instead of me?
I wish I could go to the party with you.
exampleZh: 你会代替我去派对吗？
我希望我能和你一起参加派对。

defsEn: to go by or move around something
to move along
to cause or permit to go
zh: n. 经过, 要隘, 途径, 通行, 护照, 及格
vt. 经过, 越过, 通过, 批准, 度过, 传递, 忽略
vi. 经过, 变化, 流通, 及格, 宣判, 终止, 消逝, 被忽略, 不叫牌, 传递
examples: Can you pass me the salt, please?
Could you pass me the salt, please?
exampleZh: 请你把盐递给我好吗？
请你把盐递过来好吗？

defsEn: a person traveling by airplane, train, boat or car who is not the pilot or driver passport
zh: n. 乘客, 旅客
examples: There were not more than one hundred passengers on board the ferry.
Not all of the passengers escaped injury.
exampleZh: 渡轮上的乘客不多于一百人。
并非所有的乘客都免于受伤。

defsEn: an official government document that shows a person’s identity and citizenship and permits a citizen to travel to another country
zh: n. 护照, 手段, 通行证
examples: Give your passport number and your date of birth.
You should bring your passport to the bank.
exampleZh: 给你的护照号和你的出生日期。
你应该带护照去银行。

defsEn: the time gone by
the time before
ad. recent
immediately before
former
zh: n. 过去, 昔时, 往事, 早年经历, 过去时
a. 过去的, 结束的, 卸任的, 过去时的
prep. 越过, 晚于, 超越, 超出...的可能性(能力、范围等)
pass的过去分词
examples: Never live in the past but always learn from it.
I prefer to forget the past.
exampleZh: 不要沉迷于过去，而是要从中吸取教训。
我宁愿忘记过去。

defsEn: a narrow way for walking
a way along which something moves
zh: n. 路径, 小路, 道路, 途径, 路线, 轨道
examples: Follow your own path and let people talk.
There's a secret path on the left.
exampleZh: 走自己的路，让别人去说吧。
在左边有一条秘密通道。

defsEn: a person being treated by a doctor for a health problem
zh: n. 病人, 承受者
a. 忍耐的, 容忍的, 有耐性的, 坚忍的
examples: You have to be patient about your recovery.
That patient may die at any time.
exampleZh: 你必须对你的康复有耐心。
病人随时会死。

defsEn: to give money for work done or for something bought
zh: n. 薪资, 付款, 补偿
vt. 支付, 付清, 补偿, 偿还, 对...有利, 为...涂防水物
vi. 付款, 付出代价, 偿还, 得到报应, 获得好处
examples: You should pay more attention to what he says.
I want to pay by credit card.
exampleZh: 你应该多注意他说的话。
我想用信用卡付款。

defsEn: the condition of freedom from war, fighting or noise
rest
quiet
zh: n. 和平, 和约, 治安, 和睦, 安宁, 静寂
vi. 安静下来, 不作声
examples: Only peace can save the world.
We want peace in the world.
exampleZh: 只有和平能够拯救世界。
我们希望世界和平。

defsEn: any group of persons
all the persons of a group, race, religion or nation (“the American people”)
zh: n. 人, 人民, 民族, 平民
vt. 使住满人, 居住于
examples: A lot of people swim here in the summer.
People thought him to be a great scholar.
exampleZh: 许多人夏天在这里游泳。
人们认为他是一名伟大的学者。

defsEn: a part of every hundred (“Ten is ten percent of one hundred.”)
zh: n. 百分比, 百分数, 部分
examples: We have a five percent chance of success.
I'm not one hundred percent convinced of that.
exampleZh: 我们有百分之五的成功几率。
我不是百分之百确定。

defsEn: complete or correct in every way
completely right or good
without mistakes
zh: n. 完成时
a. 完美的, 完好的, 理想的, 熟练的, 精确的, 完成式的
vt. 使完美, 修改, 使精通, 改善, 使熟练
examples: A perfect map would have to be as big as the territory it represents.
To be perfect she lacked just one defect.
exampleZh: 一个完美的地图必须要像它所代表的领土一样大。
要变得完美，她就是少了一个缺点。

defsEn: to speak, dance or sing in front of others
zh: vt. 进行, 履行, 完成, 执行, 表演
vi. 行动, 工作, 执行, 演出
examples: Most teams perform better when they have a home game.
Doctors refused to perform a second operation.
exampleZh: 很多球队在主场都会踢得更好。
医生们拒绝做第二次手术。

defsEn: an amount of time within events, restrictions or conditions
zh: n. 时期, 节段, 节, 句点, 学时, 周期
a. 当时特有的, 过去某段时期的
interj. 就是这话, 就是这么回事
examples: We live in a wonderful period.
The students' lunch period is from twelve to one.
exampleZh: 我们生活在一个精彩的时代。
学生的午饭时间是十二点到一点。

defsEn: never changing
lasting for a very long time or for all time
zh: a. 永久的, 不变的, 固定的, 持久的
n. 烫发
examples: Please give me your permanent address.
A permanent job is better than a temporary one.
exampleZh: 请给我你的永久地址。
正式工比临时工要好。

defsEn: to let
to make possible
zh: n. 许可证, 许可, 执照, 通行证
vt. 允许, 容许, 可能, 使放手做
vi. 容许, 给以机会, 提供可能
examples: Will you permit me to go there?
Permit me to do that for you.
exampleZh: 您允许我去吗？
请允许我为你做。

defsEn: a man, woman or child
zh: n. 人, 人身, 人称
examples: That kind of person will fail for sure.
I want a person who can speak French.
exampleZh: 这种人注定惨败。
我要个会说法语的人。

defsEn: to cause someone to do something by explaining or urging (“The police persuaded the criminal to surrender his weapon.”)
zh: vt. 劝, 使相信, 恳求, 敦促, 说服
vi. 劝服, 被说服
examples: She tried to persuade him to attend the meeting.
I persuaded him to give up the idea.
exampleZh: 她试图说服他来参加会议。
我说服他放弃了这个主意。

defsEn: of the body
zh: a. 身体的, 物质的, 自然的, 物理学的, 好色的
n. 体格检查
examples: I'm not fit for physical labor.
On Saturday you do physical education.
exampleZh: 我不能做体力劳动。
星期六你们上体育课。

defsEn: the study of motion, matter and energy
zh: n. 物理学, 物理过程, 物理现象
examples: Learning physics can change your way of thinking.
Physics is the basic physical science.
exampleZh: 学习物理能够改变思维。
物理是基础自然科学。

defsEn: something that shows what another thing looks like
an idea or representation of something as seen by the eye
a painting
what is made with a camera
zh: n. 图画, 照片, 景色, 美丽如画的人(或物), 化身, 生动的描述, 想像, 形象思维
vt. 画, 拍摄, 用图说明, 描写, 想像
examples: I never see this picture without thinking of my father.
Would you be able to take a picture of us?
exampleZh: 我看到这张照片时总是想起我父亲。
您能好好给我们照一张相吗？

defsEn: a part of something larger
zh: n. 块, 片, 篇, 碎片, 部分, 部件, 标准量
vt. 修补, 修理, 拼合, 接线头
vi. 吃零食
examples: Would you like another piece of cake?
Please give me a piece of bread.
exampleZh: 你要再来一块蛋糕吗?
请你给我一块面包。

defsEn: a farm animal used for its meat
zh: n. 猪, 猪肉, 贪婪的人, 猪一样的人
v. 生小猪, 象猪般地生活
examples: It's not a pig; it's a monkey.
I'll go with you when pigs fly.
exampleZh: 那不是猪，而是猴子。
山无棱，天地合，我就跟你走。

defsEn: one who guides or flies an airplane or helicopter
zh: n. 飞行员, 领航员, 航船者, 导向器, 驾驶仪, 向导, 领导人
vt. 领航, 驾驶, 引导, 试用
a. 引导的, 控制的, 试点的
examples: I want to be a pilot in the future.
My dream is to become a pilot.
exampleZh: 将来我想做飞行员。
我的梦想是成为一名飞行员。

defsEn: a long, round piece of material used to move liquid or gas
zh: n. 管, 导管, 输送管, 管状器官, 声带, 尖细的声音, 烟斗, 笛, 管乐器
vt. 以管输送, 吹哨子, 吹奏, 尖声唱
vi. 吹笛, 尖叫, 吹长哨发令
examples: Grandfather talked to me with a pipe in his mouth.
He was sitting there with a pipe in his mouth.
exampleZh: 爷爷叼着烟管跟我说话。
他口里含着烟斗,坐在那儿.

defsEn: to put something somewhere
n. an area or a part of an area
space where a person or thing is
any room, building, town or country
zh: n. 地方, 地点, 位置, 住所, 座位, 地位, 处境, 特权, 空间, 余地, 职务, 位
vt. 放置, 寄予, 认出, 评定, 任命
vi. 名次列前
examples: I need a place where I can study.
What do you think of this place?
exampleZh: 我需要个可以读书的地方。
你觉得这套房子怎么样？

defsEn: to organize or develop an idea or method of acting or doing something (“They plan to have a party.”)
n. an organized or developed idea or method (“The plan will not work.”)
zh: n. 计划, 方案, 策略, 方法, 进度表, 程序表, 平面图, 设计图, 轮廓, 示意图
vt. 计划, 设计, 意欲
vi. 订计划
examples: I plan to stay at home all day tomorrow.
How long do you plan to stay in this country?
exampleZh: 我打算明天在家里待一天。
你打算在这个国家待多久？

defsEn: a large object in space that orbits the sun (“Earth is a planet.”)
zh: n. 行星, 命运星辰, 杰出的人, 重大影响的事
examples: The Moon is not a planet, but a satellite of the Earth.
The earth is not a star, but a planet.
exampleZh: 月球不是一颗行星，而是地球的一颗卫星。
地球不是恒星，而是行星。

defsEn: to put into the ground to grow
n. a living growth from the ground which gets its food from air, water and earth plant
zh: n. 植物, 作物, 工厂, 树枝, 生长, 设施, 成套设备
vt. 种植, 栽培, 播种, 培养, 安置, 殖民于, 使位于
vi. 种植
examples: I want to give Mom a plant.
I want to give Mum a plant.
exampleZh: 我要给我妈妈一个卉。
我要给我妈妈一个卉。

defsEn: a material made from chemicals that can be formed and made into things
zh: n. 塑料, 可塑体, 可塑性物质
a. 塑料的, 塑造的, 有可塑性的, 造型的, 易受影响的, 有创造力的
examples: A plastic dish will melt on the stove.
I refuse to use plastic bags.
exampleZh: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。
我拒绝使用塑料袋。

defsEn: to have fun
to not work
to take part in a sport
to make music on an instrument
n. a story acted in a theater
zh: n. 游戏, 游玩, 玩笑, 运动, 比赛, 赌博, 跳动, 表演, 剧本
v. 玩, 游戏, 假装, 开玩笑, 比赛, 扮演, 演奏, 演戏, 传摇曳, (使)跳动
examples: Do you play any instrument other than the piano?
Will you tell me how to play the guitar?
exampleZh: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？
你会教我弹吉他吗？

defsEn: to make one happy
to give enjoyment
zh: adv. 请
vt. 使高兴, 合...的心意, 取悦
vi. 使人满意, 讨好, 愿意, 敬请
examples: Please tell me how to get to the airport.
Can you please tell me your name once more?
exampleZh: 请你告诉我机场怎么去。
请问你能再告诉我一遍你的名字吗？

defsEn: all that is needed
a large enough amount
zh: n. 充分, 很多, 丰富
a. 很多的, 足够的, 丰富的
examples: I have plenty of money with me.
We still have plenty of time left.
exampleZh: 我身上带着很多钱。
我们还剩下很多时间。

defsEn: to make secret plans
n. a secret plan to do something wrong or illegal
zh: n. 小块土地, 地区图, 图, 阴谋, 情节
vt. 划分, 绘图, 密谋
vi. 密谋, 策划
examples: They accused him of being part of the plot.
They are plotting to kill the king.
exampleZh: 人们指控他参与了这场阴谋。
他们正密谋要杀害国王。

defsEn: words and their sounds organized in a special way to express emotions
zh: n. 诗, 诗般美的事物
examples: I want to write a poem for you.
She had no difficulty in learning the poem by heart.
exampleZh: 我想写一首诗送给你。
她轻而易举的就把诗背熟了。

defsEn: to aim one’s finger toward
to aim
n. the sharp end of something
zh: n. 点, 小数点, 标点, 地点, 要点, 特点, 尖端, 分数, 得分, 穴位
vt. 弄尖, 强调, 指出, 加标点于, 瞄准
vi. 指, 指向, 表明
examples: I have a ball-point pen, but I want another.
I agree with you on this point.
exampleZh: 我有一支圆珠笔，可是我还想再要一支。
我同意你这一点。

defsEn: a substance that can destroy life or damage health
zh: n. 毒药, 毒, 毒物, 有毒害的事物
vt. 毒害, 毒杀, 使中毒
vi. 放毒, 下毒
examples: There's no poison in this fish.
We suspect it's about a poisoning by snake bite.
exampleZh: 这条鱼没有毒。
我们猜这是一种被蛇咬伤的毒。

defsEn: a government agency responsible for guarding the public, keeping order, and making sure people obey the law
members of that agency
zh: n. 警察, 警察当局, 治安
vt. 维持治安, 管辖
examples: The police will soon arrive on the scene.
How can I get to the police station?
exampleZh: 警方将很快到达现场。
我怎么去警察局？

defsEn: an established set of plans or goals used to develop and make decisions in politics, economics or business
zh: n. 政策, 方针, 策略, 保险单
examples: The employment policy is a failure.
The aim of this policy is to improve the environment in the poorest cities.
exampleZh: 工作政策是个失败。
这个政策的目的是改善最贫困城市的环境。

defsEn: the activities of government and of those who are in public office
zh: n. 政治, 政治学, 政见, 政治活动
examples: Mrs. Brown wrote a book on politics.
He has no interest in politics.
exampleZh: 布朗夫人写了一本关于政治的书。
他对政治没有兴趣。

defsEn: to release dangerous or unpleasant substances into the air, soil or water
zh: vt. 污染, 弄脏, 玷污
examples: The air was polluted by exhaust gas.
This water was polluted by oil.
exampleZh: 空气被废气污染了。
这水被石油污染了。

defsEn: people with little or no money
ad. lacking money or goods
of bad quality
zh: a. 贫穷的, 贫乏的, 不幸的, 可怜的, 拙劣的, 卑鄙的
examples: I prefer being poor to being rich.
I used to be poor like you.
exampleZh: 我更愿意贫穷而不是富裕。
我从前和你一样穷。

defsEn: liked by many people
generally approved by the public
zh: a. 通俗的, 流行的, 受欢迎的, 大众的, 人民的, 普及的
examples: I want to listen to popular music.
This movie is very popular among young people.
exampleZh: 我想听听流行音乐。
这部电影在年轻人之间很流行。

defsEn: all the people in a place, city or country
zh: n. 人口, 人口数
examples: The population of the world will double before long.
They have a growing population; therefore they need more and more food.
exampleZh: 世界人口将在不久的将来增加两倍。
那国家的人口正在增长，所以他们需要的食物量也愈来愈大。

defsEn: a city where ships load or unload goods
a place on a coast where ships can be safe from a storm
zh: 燃烧器)喷口
examples: Kobe is famous as a port city.
The ship was piloted into port.
exampleZh: 神户是一个著名的港口城市。
船驶入了港口。

defsEn: a place
the way of holding the body
the way a thing is set or placed
a job (or level of a job) in an organization
zh: n. 位置, 地位, 身分, 形势, 姿势, 立场, 职位, 状态, 阵地
vt. 安置, 决定...的位置
examples: I can understand your position perfectly.
I resigned from my position as club treasurer.
exampleZh: 我完全理解你得处境。
我辞去了具乐部司库的职位。

defsEn: to have
to own
to control or be controlled by
zh: vt. 持有, 占有, 拥有, 克制, 支配, 迷住
examples: I believe you already possess all the qualities needed to go undercover.
He's unaware of who possesses them.
exampleZh: 我认为，你已经完全具备了潜伏的资质。
他不知道这些东西的归属。

defsEn: able to be done
can happen or is expected to happen
zh: a. 可能的, 潜在的, 合适的
n. 可能性, 可能的事物
examples: If possible, I would like to go home now.
I need that as soon as possible.
exampleZh: 如果可以的话, 我现在就想回家。
我尽可能快地需要那个。

defsEn: to delay action until a later time
zh: vt. 延迟, 使延期, 缓办, 搁延
vi. 延缓, 延缓发作
examples: We postponed our departure because of the storm.
Their trip was postponed because of the rain.
exampleZh: 我们因为风暴推迟了起程。
他们的旅行因为下雨延期了。

defsEn: to flow
to cause to flow
zh: n. 流出, 倾泻, 骤雨
vt. 倒, 灌, 注, 倾泻, 诉说, 倾吐
vi. 倾泻, 蜂涌而来, 下大雨
examples: He poured the milk into the glass.
I poured water into the bucket.
exampleZh: 他把牛奶倒到杯子里了。
我将水倒入了桶中。

defsEn: the condition of being poor
zh: n. 贫穷, 贫困, 缺乏
examples: When poverty comes in at the door, love flies out the window.
I've had enough of your anti-science poverty.
exampleZh: 当贫穷降临在门口，爱从窗外飞走。
我受够了你的反科学贫穷。

defsEn: the ability to control or direct others
control
strength
ruling force
force or energy used to do work (“Water power turns the wheel.”)
zh: n. 力, 体力, 力量, 势力, 动力, 权力, 强国, 乘方, 强度, 幂, 功率
vt. 使...有力量, 供以动力, 激励
examples: First of all, power off your cellphones and remain silent.
The battery has run out of power.
exampleZh: 首先，关闭手机，保持安静。
电池没电了。

defsEn: to say good things about
to approve
zh: n. 赞美, 称赞, 崇拜
vt. 称赞, 赞美
vi. 赞扬, 表扬
examples: I cannot praise them too highly.
Mark is so honest that everyone praises him for it.
exampleZh: 我都不知道该怎么夸他们了。
马克是如此的诚实所以每个人都称赞他。

defsEn: to make a request to a god or spirit
to praise a god or spirit
zh: v. 祈祷, 恳求, 请
examples: We prayed that our children would forgive us.
We all knelt down to pray.
exampleZh: 我们祈祷孩子们会原谅我们。
我们都跪了下来祈祷。

defsEn: to say what one believes will happen in the future. (“The weather scientist predicted a cold winter.”)
zh: v. 预知, 预言, 预报
examples: No one can predict the future.
It's hard to predict what the weather will be like tomorrow.
exampleZh: 没人能预测未来。
很难说明天的天气将会怎样。

defsEn: carrying a child within the body before it is born
expecting to give birth to a baby
zh: a. 怀孕的, 充满的, 思想丰富的, 成果丰硕的
examples: No, thank you, I am pregnant!
I got pregnant from the Finnish harpist that I told you about last night.
exampleZh: 不，谢谢，我已经怀孕了！
我跟那个芬兰竖琴手怀孕了，他就是我昨晚告诉你的那个人。

defsEn: to offer for consideration (“We will present our idea to the committee.”)
n. a gift (“I gave them a present for their anniversary.”)
ad now (“The present time is a good time.”)
ad. to be at a place (“I was present at school yesterday.”)
zh: n. 现在, 礼品, 瞄准
a. 现在的, 出席的
vt. 介绍, 引见, 赠送, 提出, 呈现, 上演
vi. 举枪瞄准
examples: You must live in the present, not in the past.
A present? For me? Thank you!
exampleZh: 你一定要活在当下，不能总是留恋过去。
礼物？给我的？多谢多谢！

defsEn: the chief official of a country that is a republic
the leader of an organization
zh: n. 总统, 总裁, 董事长, (学院)院长, (大学)校长, 主管人, 主持人
examples: The President is to speak on television this evening.
Mr Johnson, president of the club, will soon come.
exampleZh: 总统今晚将会在电视上发表演说。
具乐部会长Johnson先生很快就要来了。

defsEn: to urge strongly
n. newspapers, magazines and other publications
zh: n. 压, 揿, 按, 人群, 印刷机, 压力, 出版社, 记者, 报刊, 新闻舆论, 紧迫
vt. 压, 压榨, 紧抱, 逼迫, 推进, 强迫征募, 催逼
vi. 压, 重压, 催促, 拥挤, 奋力前进, 受压
examples: Press this red button in case of an accident.
When you begin downloading, please press the "Save" button.
exampleZh: 发生意外的话按这个红按钮。
开始下载时，请点击“保存”按钮。

defsEn: the force produced when something is pushed down or against something else
zh: n. 压, 榨, 按, 强制, 压力, 压迫, 压强
vt. 迫使, 使增压, 密封
examples: Could you check the tire pressure?
I'm under so much pressure, I just want to cry.
exampleZh: 你能检查一下这个轮胎的气压吗？
我压力好大，我真想哭。

defsEn: to keep or stop from going or happening
zh: v. 预防, 防止, 阻止, 妨碍
examples: The surest way to prevent war is not to fear it.
Would you like to know how to prevent getting wrinkles?
exampleZh: 预防战争的最佳方法，就是勇敢地去面对它。
你想要知道如何避免皱纹吗？

defsEn: the amount of money for which anything is bought, sold or offered for sale
zh: n. 价格, 代价, 价值
vt. 定...的价格
examples: I want to discuss the price with you.
I can't sell at this price.
exampleZh: 我想和你谈谈价钱。
这价儿我不卖。

defsEn: a place where a person is kept as punishment for a crime
zh: n. 监狱, 监禁, 拘留所
vt. 监禁
examples: There used to be a prison here.
Life in prison is worse than the life of an animal.
exampleZh: 这里以前有一座监狱。
监狱生活比做畜牲还不如。

defsEn: of or about a person or group that is secret
opposite public
zh: a. 私人的, 秘密的, 私立的, 隐蔽的
n. 士兵, 隐士, 阴部
examples: I would prefer to speak to you in private.
Do you study at a private school?
exampleZh: 我想和你单独谈谈。
你在私立学校读书吗？

defsEn: something offered or won in a competition
something of value that one must work hard for prize
zh: n. 奖赏, 奖金, 奖品, 战利品, 捕获
a. 得奖的
vt. 珍视, 估价, 捕获, 撬, 撬动
examples: He carried off the first prize at the chess tournament.
She won first prize in the speech contest.
exampleZh: 他在国际象棋比赛中取得了冠军。
她在演讲比赛中取得了第一名。

defsEn: a good chance of taking place
a little more than possible
zh: adv. 大概, 或许
examples: The train will probably arrive at the station before noon.
I know that you probably need some help.
exampleZh: 火车大概会在中午前到站。
我知道你可能需要一些帮助

defsEn: a difficult question or situation with an unknown or unclear answer
zh: n. 问题, 难题
a. 成问题的, 难处理的
examples: He cast off the problem from his mind.
I understand how to solve the problem.
exampleZh: 他把问题从脑子里排除了。
我明白怎么解决问题。

defsEn: an operation or series of changes leading to a desired result
zh: （技术）处理
examples: Once this process is started, we can get the result within one hour.
This process must be stopped immediately, otherwise the server will break down.
exampleZh: 这个进程一旦开始，我们能在一小时内得到结果。
这个进程必须立即停止，否则服务器会故障。

defsEn: to make
to create
to cause something to be
to manufacture
zh: n. 生产品, 物产, 后代
vt. 产生, 生产, 提出, 出示
vi. 生产, 制造
examples: Can you produce any evidence that he was not at home that night?
These fields produce a rich harvest.
exampleZh: 你能不能提供他那天晚上没在家的证明？
这些田有很多收获。

defsEn: a job that requires special training
zh: n. 职业, 表白, 声明
examples: The "family manager" is a profession, occupation, vocation.
He is a doctor by profession.
exampleZh: “一家之主”是一份专业工作、事业和使命。
他的职业是医生。

defsEn: a teacher at a college or university
zh: n. 教授
examples: He used to be a professor, but now he is the dean.
By chance, I met my professor at a restaurant last night.
exampleZh: 他以前是教授，后来当了系主任。
很巧， 昨天在饭馆里碰到了我的教授。

defsEn: money gained from a business activity after paying all costs of that activity
zh: n. 利润, 赢利, 利益
vi. 有益, 获利, 赚钱
vt. 有益于
examples: A wise man profits from his mistakes.
Someone else profits from the situation.
exampleZh: 聪明人会从自己的错误中受益。
渔人得利。

defsEn: a plan of action
the different events or parts of a meeting or show
zh: n. 节目, 节目单, 程序, 纲要, 大纲, 计划
vt. 规划, 拟...计划
vi. 安排节目, 编程序
examples: Tell me about your program for the future.
I like this program a lot!
exampleZh: 给我谈谈你未来的计划。
我很喜欢这个节目！

defsEn: movement forward or toward improvement or a goal
zh: n. 进步, 发展, 前进
vi. 进步, 进行
examples: The ship made slow progress against the strong wind.
He made no progress in his speaking ability.
exampleZh: 这艘船逆风而行缓慢前进。
他说话的能力没有任何的进步。

defsEn: a planned effort to do something
zh: n. 计划, 设计, 事业
vt. 计划, 设计, 投掷, 发射, 使凸出, 放映
vi. 凸出
examples: I know about this project for the most part.
I intend to see the project through.
exampleZh: 这个项目我大致了解。
我打算完成这个项目。

defsEn: to say one will do something
n. a spoken or written agreement to do something
zh: n. 诺言, 约定的事情, 有指望
vt. 允诺, 约定, 预示
vi. 允诺, 有前途, 有指望
examples: I promise that I will send you to prison.
I promise you, we as a people will get there.
exampleZh: 我保证我会把你送进牢里。
我向你们承诺——我们作为一个整体将会达成目标。

defsEn: ideas or information used to influence opinions
zh: n. 宣传, 宣传活动
examples: I'm in charge of the propaganda.
The "anti-woke" propaganda being imported into your country's media comes straight from actual fascists.
exampleZh: 宣传由我来负责。
你们国家媒体中输入的「反觉醒」宣传，是直接来自真正的法西斯的。

defsEn: anything owned by someone such as land, buildings or goods
zh: n. 财产, 所有权, 性质, 属性
examples: He left all his property to his wife in his will.
He passed his property on to his son.
exampleZh: 他在遗嘱里说要把他的财产全部留给他的妻子。
他把他的财产传给了他儿子。

defsEn: to present or offer for consideration
zh: vt. 计划, 打算, 建议, 提议, 求(婚)
vi. 打算, 求婚
examples: I'm going to propose to her.
She had been proposed to five times by the time she was twenty.
exampleZh: 我打算向她求婚。
她二十岁的时候，就已经有五个人向她求过婚了。

defsEn: to guard
to defend
to prevent from being harmed or damaged
zh: vt. 防卫, 保护, 警戒
examples: I believe it my duty to protect these children.
You have to protect your family.
exampleZh: 我认为我有义务保护这些孩子。
你必须保护你的家庭。

defsEn: substances responsible for the growth of tissue and for fixing damaged tissue
zh: n. 蛋白质( protein的复数形式 )
examples: Proteins have many functions in the human body.
Cream is a white and light yellow liquid composed of concentrated proteins and fat.

defsEn: to speak against
to object
zh: n. 抗议, 反对, 抗议书, 断言
v. 反对, 抗议, 断言
examples: The residents protested outside the sex shop that opened in their neighborhood recently.
People are protesting in Hong Kong.
exampleZh: 居民们在一家开在邻近的性用品商店前抗议。
人们在香港抗议。

defsEn: to show to be true
zh: vt. 证明, 查验, 检验, 勘探, 显示
vi. 证明是
examples: The report proved true as a result of their investigation.
He believes that he can prove it.
exampleZh: 他们的调查结果显示这篇报导是真实的。
他相信他能证明它。

defsEn: to give something needed or wanted
zh: vt. 提供, 供应, 规定, 预备
vi. 作准备, 抚养, 规定
examples: I can provide my family with food and clothing.
I will provide you all the necessary information.
exampleZh: 我可以给我的家庭提供衣食。
我会把所有有用的信息给你的。

defsEn: of or about all the people in a community or country
opposite private
zh: n. 公众, 民众
a. 公众的, 公共的, 公立的, 公用的
examples: The more public the work, the more criticism you receive.
Where can I take the public bus?
