exampleZh: 工作越公开，批评就越多。
哪里坐公共汽车？

defsEn: something that is published such as a book, newspaper or magazine publication
zh: n. 出版物, 出版, 公布
examples: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
Take my favorite publication in the gift shop.
exampleZh: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。

defsEn: to make public something that is written
to include something in a book, newspaper or magazine
zh: vt. 出版, 发行, 公开, 发表, 宣传, 公布
vi. 出版, 发行
examples: When will your book be published?
He had a book on physics published.
exampleZh: 你们的书什么时候会出版呢？
他有一本关于物理学的书被出版了。

defsEn: to use force to move something toward the person or thing using the force
opposite push
zh: vt. 拉, 拖, 拔, 牵, 撕开, 吸引
vi. 拉, 拖, 拔, 有吸引力
n. 拉, 拖, 拔, 拉力, 牵引力, 划船, 吸引
examples: This car pulled up in front of the bank.
The car pulled up in front of the bank.
exampleZh: 这辆车在银行前面停下来了。
这辆车停在银行前。

defsEn: to force a gas or liquid up, into or through
zh: n. 抽水机, 打气筒, 泵, 抽吸
vt. 用唧筒抽水, 打气, 盘问, 倾注, 使疲惫
vi. 抽水, 上下(或往复)运动
examples: Do you know how to pump up the tyre?
They used a pump to take out the water.

defsEn: to cause pain, suffering or loss for doing something bad or illegal
zh: vt. 处罚, 惩罚, 严厉对待
vi. 惩罚
examples: In Singapore, one way to punish a criminal is to whip him or her.
He ought to be punished if he commits a crime.
exampleZh: 在新加坡，鞭刑是处置犯人的方法之一。
如果他犯了罪，他应该受到惩罚。

defsEn: to buy with money or with something of equal value
n. that which is bought
zh: n. 购买, 购买品, 紧握, 绞辘
vt. 购买, 赢得, 努力取得, 用滑轮起(锚等)
examples: Your plan to purchase another PC will not be a problem at all.
If I had the money, I would immediately purchase this computer.
exampleZh: 您购买另一台电脑的计划完全不会有问题。
我要是有钱，立马就买这台电脑。

defsEn: free from anything that is different or that reduces value
clean
zh: a. 纯的, 纯净的, 纯洁的, 清白的, 完美的, 无瑕的, 抽象的
examples: The sample is not pure enough.
When the mind is pure, joy follows like a shadow that never leaves.
exampleZh: 样本不够纯净。
心灵纯净时，喜悦便如影随形。

defsEn: the reason or desired effect for doing something
goal
zh: n. 目的, 意向, 决心, 用途, 效果, 论题
vt. 意欲, 企图, 计划
examples: He bought the land for the purpose of building a house on it.
He missed on purpose so as not to kill me.
exampleZh: 他买土地目的是要造房子。
他故意射偏, 因为不想射死我。

defsEn: to use force to move something away from the person or thing using the force
opposite pull push
zh: n. 推, 推动, 奋斗, 攻击, 进取心
vt. 推, 推动, 使伸出, 推行, 逼迫, 增加
vi. 推, 推进, 增加, 努力争取
examples: In case of fire, push the button.
You have only to push the button.
exampleZh: 万一发生火灾，按下按钮。
您只要按下按钮就行了。

defsEn: to place
to set in position
zh: vt. 放, 摆, 安置, 移动, 发射, 投掷, 写上, 表达, 使从事, 使受到, 驱使, 赋予
vi. 出发, 航行, 发芽
n. 掷, 股票出售权, 笨蛋
a. 固定不动的
examples: I want to put an end to the quarrel.
Do I need to put a coin in first?
exampleZh: 我想结束这场争执。
我需要先放一枚硬币吗？

defsEn: that which something is known to have or be (“An important quality of steel is its strength.”)
amount of value or excellence (“Their goods are of the highest quality.”)
zh: n. 品质, 特性, 才能, 质量
a. 优质的
examples: Camera quality is a top priority for me.
I bought a computer of the best quality.
exampleZh: 相机品质是我的优先考量。
我买了一台最高貭素的电脑。

defsEn: to ask
to express wonder or disbelief
n. a sentence or word used in asking for information
a problem
an issue to be discussed
zh: n. 问题, 询问
v. 询问, 审问, 怀疑
examples: I have a question I need to ask you.
If you have a question, please raise your right hand.
exampleZh: 我有一个问题得问你。
如果有问题，请举起你的右手。

defsEn: fast
zh: a. 快的, 迅速的, 敏捷的, 灵敏的, 急速的
adv. 快
n. 新长出的肉, 要害, 核心, 感觉敏锐部位
examples: Be quick, or you will miss the train.
I need to have a quick look at the files.
exampleZh: 快点，不然要赶不上火车了。
我需要去查一下档案。

defsEn: with little or no noise
having little or no movement
calm
zh: n. 安静, 闲适, 平静
a. 安静的, 静止的, 寂静的, 朴素的, 从容的, 暗中的
vi. 平静下来
vt. 使平静, 使平息, 使安心, 安慰
examples: As long as you keep quiet, you can stay here.
The teacher told us to be quiet.
exampleZh: 只要你保持安静, 你可以留在这里。
老师告诉我们要安静。

defsEn: to run
to take part in a competition to decide who or what can move fastest
to take part in a campaign for political office
n. one of the major groups that humans can be divided into because of a common physical similarity, such as skin color
zh: n. 种族, 人种, 赛跑, 比赛, 急流, 人类, 同道, 姜根
vi. 赛跑, 竞赛, 疾走
vt. 与...赛跑, 使疾走, 使猛转
examples: Our friend finished the race in second place.
I ran a race with him.
exampleZh: 我们的朋友完成了比赛，得了第二名。
我和他比赛跑步。

defsEn: a device that uses radio signals to learn the position or speed of objects that may be too far away to be seen
zh: n. 雷达, 无线电探测器
examples: The ship is not equipped with radar.
You have a natural radar as a parent.
exampleZh: 这艘船没有雷达装备。

defsEn: waves of energy from something that produces heat or light
energy from a nuclear substance, which can be dangerous
zh: (电磁)放射
examples: Can we survive radiation exposure on Mars?
We absorb radiation all the time.

defsEn: the system of sending and receiving signals or sounds through the air without wires
zh: n. 无线电, 收音机, 无线电报, 无线电广播, 无线电台
v. 用无线电发送
examples: Do you listen to the radio at home every day?
I like to listen to the radio.
exampleZh: 你每天都在家听收音机吗？
我喜欢听广播。

defsEn: to make a sudden attack
n. a sudden attack carried out as an act of war, or for the purpose of seizing or stealing something
zh: n. 袭击, 突袭, 搜捕
v. 奇袭, 搜捕
examples: She gave birth in an air-raid shelter during an air raid.
She was born in an air-raid shelter during an air raid.

defsEn: a road for trains
a company that operates such a road and its stations and equipment railroad
zh: n. 铁路, 铁路公司
vt. 铺设铁路, 用铁路运输
vi. 在铁路工作
examples: The railroad is parallel to the road.
A railroad has connected the two cities.
exampleZh: 铁路与公路平行。
铁路连通了两个城市。

defsEn: water falling from the sky
zh: n. 雨, 下雨, 雨天
vi. 下雨
vt. 使大量落下
examples: We like to sing in the rain.
Do you have rain gear with you?
exampleZh: 我们喜欢在雨中高歌。
你有没有带雨具？

defsEn: to lift up
to move to a higher position
to cause to grow
to increase
zh: n. 上升, 高地, 增高
vt. 升起, 举起, 唤起, 提高, 使出现, 使复活, 提出, 筹集, 饲养
examples: Raise your hand when I call your name.
I'll see to it that you have a raise after the first year.
exampleZh: 我叫你的名字的时候，请你把手举起来。
我将确保你们在第一年后有一个增长。

defsEn: to carry out a sexual attack by force against a person
zh: n. 抢夺, 掠夺, 强奸, 葡萄渣, 芸苔
vt. 掠夺, 抢夺, 强奸
examples: Rape blossoms... Moon in the East. Sun in the West.
Rape is a shame for her and her family.

defsEn: not common
not usual
not often
zh: a. 稀罕的, 罕有的, 珍奇的, 稀薄的, 半熟的, 非常好的
adv. 非常
examples: An eclipse of the sun is a rare appearance.
It's rare to meet nice people like you.
exampleZh: 日蚀只会偶尔发生。
很少能见到像你那么好的人。

defsEn: speed
a measure of how quickly or how often something happens
the price of any thing or service that is bought or sold
zh: n. 比率, 率, 速度, 价格, 费用, 等级
vt. 估价, 认为, 鉴定等级, 责骂
vi. 被评价, 责骂
examples: At any rate, we have no means of helping him.
What is the exchange rate today?
exampleZh: 无论如何，我们也帮不了他。
今天的汇率是多少？

defsEn: to put a hand toward
to arrive at
to come to
zh: n. 伸出, 延伸, 区域, 范围, 流域, 岬
vt. 到达, 达到, 伸出, 延伸, 影响
vi. 达到, 延伸, 伸出手, 传到
examples: You can reach the park by either road.
He never gave up hope that he would reach that goal.
exampleZh: 哪条路都可以去公园哦。
他从没放弃达成那个目标的希望。

defsEn: to act as a result of or in answer to
zh: vi. 起反应, 起作用, 反攻
examples: Tom was the first to react.
Tom was too surprised to react.
exampleZh: 汤姆是最先作出反应的。
汤姆惊讶得没有反应。

defsEn: to look at and understand the meaning of written words or numbers
zh: v. 读, 阅读, 理解
a. 有学问的
n. 读取, 阅读
examples: Why do you need to read such a book?
I asked him if I could read his book.
exampleZh: 为什么你要读这样一本书？
我问他我可不可以看他的书。

defsEn: prepared
completed
organized
willing
zh: n. 预备好的状态, 现款
a. 准备好的, 备用的, 可以使用的
adv. 预先, 迅速
vt. 使准备好
examples: We will soon be ready for the party.
Can you be ready to leave tomorrow?
exampleZh: 很快地我们的派对就要准备完成了。
明天你能准备好离开吗？

defsEn: true
truly existing
not false
zh: a. 真的, 真实的, 实际的, 实在的, 不动(产)的, 实数的
n. 实数, 现实
adv. 真正地
examples: This might be real, or it might not.
You have to acquire real skills, not just superficial knowledge.
exampleZh: 这可能是真的，可能不是。
你要学的是实实在在的技能，而不单是表面的知识。

defsEn: in agreement with the way things are
zh: a. 现实的, 逼真的, 现实主义的, 实在论的
examples: We need to be more realistic than that.
You have to be realistic now.

defsEn: the cause for a belief or act
purpose
something that explains
zh: n. 理由, 原因, 理智, 道理, 前提, 理性
vt. 说服, 推论, 辩论
vi. 推论, 劝说, 思考
examples: Do you know the reason why he cut class today?
You have good reason to be angry.
exampleZh: 你知道为什么他今天逃课了吗？
你有充分的理由生气。

defsEn: ready to listen to reasons or ideas
not extreme
ready or willing to compromise
zh: a. 合理的, 明理的, 适当的
examples: It's reasonable that you should do that.
Tom bought this camera for a reasonable price.
exampleZh: 你那样做是合理的。
Tom用合理的价格买了相机。

defsEn: to act against a government or power, often with force
to refuse to obey
n. one who opposes or fights against the government of his or her country
zh: n. 叛徒, 反叛者
vi. 造反, 反抗, 抵抗, 反感
a. 造反的, 反抗的
examples: The rebel concealed his ambition to destroy the regime.
These rebels only want to destroy our country.

defsEn: to get or accept something given, offered or sent
zh: vt. 收到, 接到, 得到, 接待, 迎接, 承受
vi. 收到, 会客
examples: I still want to receive more.
I have received your letter and read it with delight.
exampleZh: 我还要收到更多。
我收到了你的来信并很高兴地读了。

defsEn: a short time ago
zh: a. 最近的, 近代的, 最新的
examples: News of the recent blast is all over the radio.
The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
exampleZh: 收音机广播充斥著有关最近爆炸的新闻。
近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。

defsEn: a temporary reduction in economic activity, when industries produce less and many workers lose their jobs
zh: n. 后退, 凹处, 衰退, 归还
examples: Because of that, the global recession could not affect the economy of Bangladesh.
A recession is bound to come next year.

defsEn: to know or remember something or someone that was known, known about or seen before
to accept another nation as independent and establish diplomatic ties with its government
zh: vt. 认出, 认可, 承认, 公认, 识别, 赏识
vi. 承认, 具结
examples: I recognize that what he says is the truth.
I recognized your voice right away.
exampleZh: 我承认他说的是事实。
我立刻认出了你的声音。

defsEn: to write something in order to have it for future use
to put sound or pictures in a form that can be kept and heard or seen again
n a writing that shows proof or facts about something
zh: n. 记录, 履历, 档案, 审判记录, 最高纪录, 唱片
vt. 记录, 记载, 标明, 将...录音
vi. 记录, 录音, 可被录音
a. 创纪录的
examples: He has a good school record.
She told me that she has bought a record.
exampleZh: 他的学习成绩很好。
她跟我说她买了唱片。

defsEn: to get again something that was lost, stolen or taken away (“The police recovered the stolen money.”)
to return to normal health or normal conditions (“She is expected to recover from the operation.”)
zh: vt. 重新获得, 恢复, 复原, 拯救
vi. 痊愈, 复原, 胜诉
examples: Anyone who can recover the money he lost will receive a reward.
Do you know how to recover a deleted file?
exampleZh: 凡能将他遗失的钱寻回者可得到酬金。
你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？

defsEn: having the color like that of blood
zh: a. 红的, 红色的, 红肿的, 流血的
n. 红色, 红颜料, 赤字
examples: Look at the house with the red roof.
Do you prefer red or white wine?
exampleZh: 看看那间红色屋顶的房子。
你比较喜欢红酒还是白酒？

defsEn: to make less or smaller in number, size or amount
to cut
zh: vt. 减少, 分解, 降低, 使衰退, 把...分解, 把...归纳
vi. 减少, 减肥, 缩小
examples: Can you reduce the price a bit?
I think we should reduce the price.
exampleZh: 可以便宜一点吗？
我觉得我们得调低价格。

defsEn: to make better by changing
to improve
n. a change to a better condition
zh: n. 改革, 改正, 改造
vt. 改革, 改过, 革新, 重整
vi. 革新, 改过
examples: I support the spelling reform of the German language.
Do we need to reform Islam?

defsEn: a person who has been forced to flee because of unjust treatment, danger or war
zh: n. 难民, 流亡者
examples: The refugee crisis could shake up the political landscape in Germany.
I was born in a refugee camp.

defsEn: to reject
to not accept, give or do something
zh: vt. 拒绝, 谢绝
vi. 拒绝
n. 废物
a. 扔掉的, 无用的
examples: I refuse to answer your question.
You refuse a toast, only to be forced to drink a forfeit.
exampleZh: 我拒绝回答你的问题。
敬酒不吃吃罚酒。

defsEn: to have one’s name officially placed on a list of people permitted to vote in an election or take part in an educational program
zh: n. 寄存器, 记录, 登记簿, 注册
vt. 记录, 注册, 提示, 表达, 把...挂号
vi. 登记, 注册, 挂号
examples: Could you please sign the register?
Should I register for that class?
exampleZh: 请您在登记册上签名好吗？
我应该登记这堂课吗？

defsEn: a feeling of sadness or sorrow about something that is done or that happens
zh: n. 遗憾, 后悔, 悔恨, 抱歉, 歉意
vt. 为...感到遗憾, 后悔, 惋惜, 懊悔, 抱歉
vi. 感到抱歉
examples: I regret missing the chance to meet her.
I will make you regret it.
exampleZh: 我很后悔当时没有把握机会认识她。
我会让你后悔。

defsEn: to refuse to accept, use or believe
zh: n. 被拒之人, 被弃之物, 不合格品, 次品
vt. 拒绝, 抵制, 否决, 驳回, 丢弃, 呕出
examples: Many people rejected the invitation to the welcome party.
You should've rejected such an unfair proposal.
exampleZh: 许多人拒绝了欢迎会的邀请。
你本该拒绝一个那么不公平的提议。

defsEn: understandings or ties between nations
members of the same family
people connected by marriage or family ties
zh: n. 交往, 关系, 事务
examples: Try to construct good relations whenever possible at work.
Relations between us seem to be on the ebb.

defsEn: to free
to permit to go
to permit to be known or made public
zh: n. 释放, 发泄, 豁免, 发行, 释放证书
vt. 释放, 解除, 放松, 豁免, 免除, 发布, 放弃, 让与
n. 发布
examples: An octopus can release ink when it gets into danger.
The girl released the birds from the cage.
exampleZh: 章鱼遇到危险时会喷出墨汁。
女孩把鸟儿从笼中放了出来。

defsEn: a belief in, or the honoring of, a god or gods
zh: n. 宗教, 信仰
examples: Latin was the language of religion and culture.
You should think of their religions.
exampleZh: 拉丁文是宗教与文化的语言。
你应该考虑他们的宗教。

defsEn: to stay in a place after others leave
to stay the same
zh: vi. 保持, 逗留, 剩余
examples: I thought it best to remain silent.
When only death remains, the last resort is to beg for food.
exampleZh: 我想最好还是保持沉默。
除死无大事，讨饭到了家。

defsEn: a dead body
zh: n. 剩余物, 废墟, 残余
examples: If the box remains open, the food will perish.
The fundamental issue remains the scarcity of available housing.

defsEn: to think about the past
opposite forget
zh: vt. 记得, 回忆起, 记住, 铭记, 纪念
vi. 记得
examples: You may not remember me, but I remember you.
I must remember to buy that book tomorrow.
exampleZh: 你可能不记得我了，但我记得你。
明天我一定要记得去买那一本书。

defsEn: to take away or take off
to put an end to
to take out of a position or office
zh: vt. 移动, 调动, 除去, 迁移, 开除, 移交
vi. 迁移, 移动, 搬家
n. 班级, 升级, 移动, 搬家, 间距
examples: Please remove that chair because it is in the way.
Do you have anything to remove stains?
exampleZh: 请把椅子拿走，它挡着道儿了。
你有除锈的东西吗？

defsEn: work done to fix something
zh: n. 修理, 补救, 修复
vt. 修理, 修补, 补救, 恢复, 补偿
vi. 修理, 修补, 补救, 恢复, 去, 常去, 集合
examples: I will have repaired your watch by tomorrow.
I had my brother repair my bicycle.
exampleZh: 我会在明天之前把你的手表修理好。
我让我哥修理我的自行车。

defsEn: to say or do again
zh: n. 重复, 反复
vt. 重做, 重复, 复述, 使再现, 复制
vi. 重复
examples: Would you be so kind as to repeat that?
Could you please repeat what you just said?
exampleZh: 能不能请你重复一下？
您可以再重复一遍刚才说的话吗？

defsEn: to tell about
to give the results of a study or investigation
n. the story about an event
the results of a study or investigation
a statement in which the facts may not be confirmed report
zh: n. 报告, 报道, 传说, 案情报告, 爆炸声, 成绩单
vt. 报告, 汇报, 转述, 报道, 揭发, 使报到
vi. 报告, 写报道, 报到
examples: I must hand in the report today.
Would you please look over my report?
exampleZh: 我今天必须交报告。
你可以仔细检查一下我的报告吗?

defsEn: to act in the place of someone else
to substitute for
to serve as an example
zh: vt. 表现, 表示, 描绘, 讲述, 代表, 象征, 回忆, 再赠送, 再上演
vi. 提出异议
examples: He represented our company at the conference.
He was accredited to the United States to represent Japan.
exampleZh: 他代表我们公司出席了会议。
他被任命为驻美日本大使。

defsEn: to control or to restrict freedoms by force
zh: vt. 镇压, 抑制, 压制
vi. 压制
examples: He tried to to repress his anger during the meeting.
Repressing what I feel for you is now impossible for me.

defsEn: to ask for
n. the act of asking for
zh: n. 请求, 需要, 申请书
vt. 请求, 要求, 邀请
examples: He requested me to keep it secret.
They requested the mayor to resign.
exampleZh: 他要求我保存秘密。
他们要求市长辞职。

defsEn: to need or demand as necessary
zh: vt. 需要, 命令, 要求
examples: I would like to but I have a required course tonight.
An aging population will require more spending on health care.
exampleZh: 我不是不想听，但是今晚我有必修课。
老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。

defsEn: to free from danger or evil
zh: n. 援救, 解救, 营救
vt. 援救, 救出, 营救
examples: He rescued the dog at the risk of his own life.
He rescued the child from the fire.
exampleZh: 他冒着生命危险救了那条狗。
他从火场中救了这个孩子。

defsEn: a careful study to discover correct information
zh: n. 研究, 调查, 考察
vi. 研究, 调查
examples: He researched British tea culture in great detail.
Research on the causes of cancer is very expensive.
exampleZh: 他对英国茶文化很有研究。
有关癌症成因的研究耗费颇巨。

defsEn: to leave a position, job or office
zh: vt. 辞职, 放弃, 使顺从
vi. 辞职, 屈从
examples: He resigned from the job to take the responsibility for the loss.
He has no choice but to resign.
exampleZh: 为了这次的损失，他扛起责任，辞职了。
他没有选择，只能辞职。

defsEn: to oppose
to fight to prevent
zh: v. 抵抗, 耐得住, 抵制, 反抗
n. 防染材料
examples: No man can resist the lure of a woman.
It's hard to resist the wish to make the sentence rhyme.
exampleZh: 没有男人能够抵挡女人的诱惑。
难以抵抗给句子押韵的愿望。

defsEn: an official statement of agreement by a group of people, usually reached by voting
zh: n. 解析, 决心, 坚定, 决定, 决议, 消除, 解答, 分解
n. 图形分辨率
examples: I have made a resolution to keep a diary this year.
My New Year's resolution is to learn how to play the ocarina.
exampleZh: 这一年我下了决心写日记。
我新年的愿望是学会吹奥卡利纳埙。

defsEn: anything of value that can be used or sold
zh: n. 资源, 财力, 办法, 策略, 急智, 消遣
examples: The one resource more precious than any other was land.
The internet is an immeasurable resource of information.
exampleZh: 唯一比无论什么资源都珍贵的是土地。
互联网是一种无法估量的信息资源。

defsEn: to feel or show honor to a person or thing (“All citizens should respect the law.”)
zh: n. 尊敬, 尊重, 问候
vt. 尊敬, 注意, 遵守
examples: I respect him as a writer and as a man.
We must learn to respect each other.
exampleZh: 我尊重他这位作家，也尊重他这个人。
我们必须学会互相尊重。

defsEn: having a duty or job to do (“He is responsible for preparing the report.”)
being the cause of (“They were responsible for the accident.”)
zh: a. 有责任的, 负责的, 责任重大的
examples: A drunk driver was responsible for the car accident.
One must be responsible for one's conduct.
exampleZh: 喝醉的驾驶员对车祸有责任。
人要为自己的行为负责。

defsEn: to sit, lie down or sleep to regain strength
n. that which remains
the others
zh: n. 休息, 睡眠, 安息, 稍息, 静止, 支架, 休息处, 其余者, 剩余部分
vi. 休息, 睡, 长眠, 安心, 静止, 停止, 安置, 依赖
vt. 使休息, 使支撑, 把...寄托于
examples: I always rest for an hour after dinner.
I have no time to have a rest.
exampleZh: 晚饭后，我总要休息一个小时。
我没有休息的时间。

defsEn: a place where people can buy and eat meals
zh: n. 餐馆, 饭店
examples: I want to work in a restaurant.
The small restaurant of today may be a big hotel tomorrow.
exampleZh: 我想在餐厅工作。
今天的小饭馆明天就可以变成大饭店了。

defsEn: to keep controlled
to limit action by a person or group
zh: vt. 抑制, 阻止, 束缚
examples: You should learn to restrain yourself.
He could not restrain his excitement.
exampleZh: 你应该学习控制自己的情绪。

defsEn: to limit
to prevent from increasing or becoming larger
zh: vt. 限制, 限定, 约束
examples: You have no right to restrict Tom.
Facebook can restrict you without proper explanation.

defsEn: to happen from a cause
n that which follows or is produced by a cause
effect
zh: n. 结果, 成绩, 答案
vi. 产生, 结果, 致使
examples: Let me know the result as soon as you can.
Whether he comes or not, the result will be the same.
exampleZh: 尽早让我知道结果。
他来还是不来，结果是一样的。

defsEn: to leave a job or position because one is old or in poor health
zh: n. 隐居
vi. 引退, 退役, 退休, 退去, 撤退, 退却
vt. 使...撤退, 辞退
examples: My father will retire at the age of sixty.
His decision to retire surprised all of us.
exampleZh: 我父亲六十岁就要退休了。
他要退休的决定让我们都感到吃惊。

defsEn: to go or come back
to bring, give, take or send back
zh: n. 回来, 返回, 来回票, 归还, 报答, 利润率, 报告书
a. 返回的, 回程的, 报答的, 反向的, 重现的, 复原的
vi. 返回, 归还, 回来
vt. 归还, 还, 回报, 产生, 反射, 报告, 申报, 退回
examples: As soon as they return, I will telephone you.
I have to return this book to the library today.
exampleZh: 他们一回来,我就给您打电话。
我今天得把这本书还给图书馆。

defsEn: to protest violently
to fight for a change, especially of government
zh: n. 叛乱, 反抗, 反感
vi. 叛乱, 反抗, 起义, 厌恶, 反感
vt. 使反感, 使恶心
examples: The revolt happened day by day.
People rose in revolt against the king.
exampleZh: 叛乱一天天发生。

defsEn: a food grain
zh: n. 米, 米饭, 稻
vt. 将...压成米粒状
examples: The Japanese live on rice and fish.
Do you eat rice in your country?
exampleZh: 日本人以米饭和鱼为生存之食。
在你们国家吃米饭吗？

defsEn: having much money or goods
having plenty of something
zh: a. 富裕的, 富饶的, 浓厚的, 贵重的
examples: If I get rich, I will buy it.
Rich people can do what they want.
exampleZh: 等我有钱了，我就买它。
有钱人可以做他们想做的事。

defsEn: to sit on or in and be carried along
to travel by animal, wheeled vehicle, airplane or boat
zh: n. 骑马, 乘坐, 乘车, 搭便车
vt. 骑, 乘坐, 压迫, 控制
vi. 骑马, 乘车, 漂游
examples: Do you know how to ride a horse?
Do you know how to ride a bicycle?
exampleZh: 你会骑马吗？
你会骑车吗？

defsEn: what a person legally and morally should be able to do or have (“It is their right to vote.”)
ad. agreeing with the facts
good
correct
opposite wrong
on the side that is toward the east when one is facing north
opposite left
zh: n. 权利, 右边, 正义, 右派, 公正
a. 正确的, 对的, 恰当的, 正常的, 正直的, 正面的, 右方的
adv. 正确地, 以有利结果, 一直, 直接, 向右
vt. 扶直, 整理, 纠正, 伸冤, 使昭雪
vi. 恢复平衡
examples: We need to go right at the next turn.
Do I have to do it right away?
exampleZh: 我们得在下一个路口右拐。
我必须立刻做吗？

defsEn: to act with many others in a violent way in a public place
n. a violent action by a large group of people
zh: n. 暴动, 喧闹, 放纵
vi. 发动, 暴动, 纵情, 放荡
vt. 浪费, 挥霍
examples: The riot spread across the city.
The riot was soon put down by the police.

defsEn: to go up
to go higher
to increase
to go from a position of sitting or lying to a position of standing
zh: n. 上升, 增加, 上涨, 高地, 升高, 出现
vi. 升起, 起身, 起立, 上升, 上涨, 增长, 高耸, 起义, 浮现
vt. 使飞起
examples: The factory waste gave rise to serious environmental pollution.
The sun always rises in the east.
exampleZh: 工厂的废料导致了严重的环境污染。
太阳总是从东方升起。

defsEn: the chance of loss, damage or injury
zh: n. 冒险, 危险, 保险额
vt. 冒...的危险, 冒险干
examples: I found this at the risk of my life.
We have no choice but to risk it.
exampleZh: 我冒着生命危险找到了这个。
我们别无选择只能冒着危险。

defsEn: a large amount of water that flows across land into another river, a lake or an ocean
zh: n. 河, 江
examples: The teacher told them not to swim in the river.
I used to swim in this river.
exampleZh: 老师跟他们说，叫他们别在河里游泳。
我以前在这条河里游泳。

defsEn: a long piece of hard ground built between two places so people can walk, drive or ride easily from one place to the other road
zh: n. 路, 道路, 公路, 途径, 方法
examples: This road will take you to the museum.
May I have a road map, please?
exampleZh: 这条路会引你去博物馆。
请给我一张路线图。

defsEn: to take money or property secretly or by force
to steal
zh: v. 抢夺, 抢掠, 剥夺
examples: He robbed me of all my money.
A mugger robbed him of all of his money.
exampleZh: 他把我所有的钱都抢走了。
他身上的钱全被强盗抢走了。

defsEn: a machine that moves and performs work
zh: n. 机械人, 自动机械, 机械般工作的人
examples: The robot went out of control.
In the future, will robots be as common as personal computers?
exampleZh: 这个机器人失控了。
未来，机器人会像个人电脑一样普及吗？

defsEn: a hard piece of mineral matter
zh: n. 岩石, 岩礁, 石头, 基石, 暗礁, 摇动, 摇滚乐
vt. 摇摆, 摇动, 使摇晃, 使动摇
vi. 摇, 摇动
examples: At first I did not like rock music, but now I do.
I play guitar in a psychedelic rock band.
exampleZh: 我起初不怎么喜欢摇滚音乐，不过现在喜欢上了。
我在一支迷幻摇滚乐团里弹吉他。

defsEn: a device shaped like a tube that moves through air or space by burning gases and letting them escape from the back or bottom, sometimes used as a weapon
zh: n. 火箭, 烟火
vi. 急升, 猛涨, 飞驰
vt. 用火箭运载
examples: Connecting a PC to the internet is not rocket science.
The rocket was launched into space.
exampleZh: 将电脑连线到网际网路并不是什么难事。
火箭发射进入太空。

defsEn: to turn over and over
to move like a ball
zh: n. 卷, 滚动, 名单, 案卷, 压路机
vi. 滚, 滚动, 飘流, 起伏, 卷, 绕
vt. 使滚动, 卷, 绕
examples: Would you like to eat a roll for lunch?
One roll of color film, please.
exampleZh: 你午饭想吃面包吗？
请给我一卷彩色胶片。

defsEn: a separate area within a building with its own walls
zh: n. 房间, 空位, 场所
vi. 住宿, 居住
vt. 留宿
examples: Could you please not smoke in this room?
I want you out of my room.
exampleZh: 请问你能不在房间里吸烟吗？
我想让你离开我的房间。

defsEn: the part of a plant that is under the ground and takes nutrients from the soil root
zh: n. 根, 根本, 根源, 基础, 底部
vt. 使扎根, 使固定, 根除, 肃清, 搜出, 用鼻拱
vi. 生根, 固定, 源于, 用鼻拱土, 寻找, 捧场, 支持
examples: We must get to the root of the problem.
The lack of money is the root of all evil.
exampleZh: 我们必须找出问题的根源。
所有的罪恶源于金钱的不足

defsEn: a long, thick piece of material made from thinner pieces of material, used for tying
zh: n. 绳, 索, 粗绳, 绞索, 决窍
vt. 捆, 缚, 绑, 圈起, 以绳将...系住
vi. 拧成绳状
examples: She cut the rope with her knife.
I let go of the rope.
exampleZh: 她用她的小刀割断了绳子。
我放开了绳子。

defsEn: not flat or smooth
having an uneven surface
violent
not made well
zh: n. 粗糙的东西, 毛坯, 未加工品, 梗概, 草图, 暴徒, 艰难
a. 粗糙的, 粗暴的, 蓬乱的, 草率的, 大致的, 简陋的, 暴风雨的, 艰难的
vt. 使粗糙, 使不平, 使蓬乱, 粗制, 草拟, 粗暴对待, 对...动粗
vi. 变粗糙
adv. 粗糙地, 粗暴地
examples: Boxing is not always a rough sport.
They were made of rough brown leather.
exampleZh: 拳击并不总是一种粗暴的运动。
它们是用粗糙的褐色皮革制成的。

defsEn: having the shape of a ball or circle
zh: n. 圆, 圆形物, 巡回, 循环, 一轮, 一回合, 一局, 范围, 轮唱
a. 圆的, 球形的, 丰满的, 肥胖的, 完全的, 大概的, 完美的, 圆润的
prep. 围着, 附近, 绕过, 在...周围
adv. 围绕着, 在周围, 迂回地, 挨个, 朝反方向
vt. 弄圆, 使成圆形, 绕行, 完成, 围捕, 把...四舍五入
vi. 变圆, 发胖, 环行, 拐弯, 进展
examples: Please give me a round-trip ticket to Chicago.
The teacher said that the earth is round.
exampleZh: 请给我一张芝加哥的往返票。
老师说地球是圆的。

defsEn: to move something over the surface of another thing
zh: n. 摩擦, 困难, 障碍, 磨损处
vt. 擦, 搓, 摩擦, 惹怒
vi. 摩擦, 擦破
examples: Rub out these words with your eraser.
Never rub your eyes with dirty hands.
exampleZh: 用你的橡皮把这些字擦掉。
手脏的时候千万不要揉眼睛。

defsEn: a substance made from the liquid of trees with the same name, or a similar substance made from chemicals
zh: n. 橡皮, 橡胶, 做摩擦动作的人, 按摩师, 决胜盘
vt. 用橡胶制造, 涂橡胶于
examples: Rubber is not hard: it gives way to pressure.
Sorry, I won't do it without a rubber.
exampleZh: 橡皮不硬：它在压力下会变形。
对不起，但是如果不用避孕套的话我不做。

defsEn: to damage severely
to destroy
zh: n. 毁灭, 推翻, 废墟
vi. 毁灭, 衰败, 破坏, 破产, 堕落
vt. 使毁灭, 毁坏, 使破产
examples: The two of you have ruined my life.
There is an important ruin hidden under this gym.
exampleZh: 你们两个误了我一生。
这座体育馆下藏着一个重要的遗址。

defsEn: to govern or control
to decide
n. a statement or an order that says how something must be done
zh: n. 规则, 统治, 控制, 支配, 规律, 标准, 章程, 破折号, 铅线
vt. 规定, 统治, 管理, 控制, 支配, 裁决
vi. 统治, 管辖, 裁定
examples: Will you explain the rule to me?
He makes it a rule to take a walk every morning.
exampleZh: 你能帮我说明一下规则吗？
他给自己定下每天早上散步的规矩。

defsEn: to move quickly by steps faster than those used for walking run
zh: n. 跑, 赛跑, 奔跑, 奔跑的路程, 趋向, 流出, 运转时间, 连续
vi. 跑, 奔跑, 跑步, 赛跑, 竞赛, 行驶, 运转, 进行, 蔓延
vt. 使跑, 参赛, 追究, 驾驶, 开动, 管理, 经营, 使流出, 运行
a. 熔化的, 融化的, 浇铸的
run的过去式和过去分词
examples: He can run as fast as I can.
Why do you try to run away?
exampleZh: 他能跑得和我一样快。
为什么你企图逃走？

defsEn: describing areas away from cities which may include farms, small towns and unpopulated areas.
zh: a. 乡下的, 田园的, 乡村风味的
examples: It seems the rural area will be developed on a large scale.
I want to live in a rural area.
exampleZh: 农村好像要大规模发展了。

defsEn: to damage or destroy as an act against an organization or nation
zh: n. 怠工, 破坏活动, 破坏
vi. 从事破坏活动
vt. 妨害, 破坏
examples: Why do you think this could be sabotage?
This will absolutely sabotage your career.

defsEn: to do without something or to suffer a loss for a belief, idea, goal or another person
zh: n. 牺牲, 供奉, 祭品
vt. 牺牲, 祭祀, 贱卖
vi. 献祭
examples: Parents often sacrifice themselves to ensure that their children receive a good education.
He did not sacrifice his life, nor did he sell out his organization.
exampleZh: 父母为了确保孩子受到良好的教育常常牺牲自己。
他没有牺牲生命，也没有出卖组织。

defsEn: not happy
zh: a. 忧愁的, 悲哀的
examples: I feel sad every now and then.
Why should you be so sad?
exampleZh: 我不时地觉得难过。
为什么你要这么难过?

defsEn: away from harm or danger
zh: n. 保险箱, 冷藏室
a. 安全的, 可靠的, 平安的, 稳健的, 有把握的
examples: I will take you to a safe place.
Keep the money in a safe place.
exampleZh: 我会带你去安全的地方。
把钱保存在安全的地方。

defsEn: to travel by boat or ship sail
zh: n. 帆, 篷, 帆船, 航程, 帆状物
vi. 航行, 启航, 张帆而行
vt. 航行于, 驾船
examples: They sailed along the west coast of Africa.
I belong to the sailing club.
exampleZh: 他们沿着非洲西岸航行了。
我参加帆船社。

defsEn: a person involved in sailing a boat or ship
zh: n. 水手, 船员, 海员
examples: A sailor saw his fellow sailor sink from exhaustion.
A sailor saw his friend drown from exhaustion.

defsEn: a white substance found in sea water and in the ground, used to affect the taste of food
zh: n. 盐, 风趣, 刺激
a. 含盐的, 咸的, 风趣的, 辛辣的
vt. 加盐于, 用盐腌
examples: He asked me to pass him the salt.
Would you pass me the salt, please?
exampleZh: 他让我把盐递给他。
请你把盐递给我好吗?

defsEn: not different
not changed
like another or others
zh: a. 相同的, 同样的
pron. 相同的人(或事物)
adv. 同样地
examples: I eat and read at the same time.
I have the same trouble as you have.
exampleZh: 我边吃饭边看书。
我有跟你同样的麻烦。

defsEn: extremely small pieces of crushed rock found in large amounts in deserts and on coasts
zh: n. 沙, 沙子, 沙滩, 光阴, 生涯
vt. 撒沙, 以沙掩盖
examples: There is sand at the bottom of the ocean.
We found the footprints in the sand.
exampleZh: 海洋底部有沙子。
我们发现了沙滩上的脚印。

defsEn: a small object in space that moves around a larger object
an object placed in orbit around the earth
zh: n. 人造卫星
examples: Choose a suitable satellite image as the base map.
The Moon isn't a planet, but a satellite of the Earth.
exampleZh: 选择合适的卫星图做为底图。
月球不是一颗行星，而是地球的一颗卫星。

defsEn: to give or provide what is desired, needed or demanded
zh: vt. 使满意, 满足, 符合, 使确信, 赔偿
vi. 令人满意, 替人赎罪
examples: I am not satisfied with the result at all.
On the whole I am satisfied with the result.
exampleZh: 我对这个结果一点儿也不满意。
总的来说，我对这个结果很满意。

defsEn: to make safe
to remove from harm
to keep for future use
zh: n. 救球
vt. 解救, 挽救, 储蓄, 保存, 节省, 保留
vi. 挽救, 节省, 救球
prep. 除...之外
examples: I try to save room for dessert.
Can you save this seat for me?
exampleZh: 我尽量留着胃吃甜点。
你可以帮我保留这个座位吗?

defsEn: to speak
to express in words
zh: vt. 说, 讲, 念, 说明, 指明
vi. 说, 讲
n. 意见, 发言权
examples: Since you all say that, I must think again.
Who can say what will happen in the future?
exampleZh: 既然你们这么说，那让我再想想。
谁能说将来会发生什么呢。

defsEn: a place for education
a place where people go to learn
zh: n. 学校, 鱼群, 门派, 学派
vt. 教育, 训练, 培养
vi. 成群地游
examples: I want to go to school and study hard.
Do you go to school on foot every day?
exampleZh: 我想上学并努力学习。
你每天走路去学校吗？

defsEn: the study of nature and the actions of natural things, and the knowledge gained about them
zh: n. 科学, 学科, 学问, 自然科学
examples: Science begins when you ask why and how.
Space science is still in its infancy.
exampleZh: 为何如何？你疑问的当下就是科学的开端。
空间科学还在起步阶段。

defsEn: a large area of salt water, usually part of an ocean
zh: n. 海, 海洋, 海浪, 大量
examples: I live near the sea, so I often go to the beach.
You could go to rest on the sea while I'm on a business trip.
exampleZh: 我住在海边所以经常去海滩。
在我出差时你可以去享受沙滩。

defsEn: to look for carefully
zh: n. 搜寻, 查究
v. 搜寻, 搜查, 探求, 调查, 搜索
examples: I need to search for my pen.
The police said the search for Tom will continue.
exampleZh: 我得查找一下我的笔。
警方表示，对汤姆的搜寻工作将持续进行。

defsEn: one of the four periods of the year that is based on the earth’s position toward the sun (spring, summer, autumn, winter)
a period of time based on different weather conditions (“dry season”, “rainy season”)
a period during the year when something usually happens (“baseball season”) seasons
zh: n. 季节, 时节, 当令期, 时期
vt. 给...调味, 使成熟, 使老练, 缓和
vi. 变干燥
examples: Which season do you like best, spring or autumn?
What season do you like the best?
exampleZh: 春天和秋天，你更喜欢哪个？
你最喜欢哪个季节？

defsEn: a thing to sit on
a place to sit or the right to sit there (“a seat in parliament”)
zh: n. 座, 座位, 位子, 席位, 所在地
vt. 使坐下, 使就座, 为...设座于, 使就职
vi. 安装在底座上
examples: Will you hold this seat for me?
He found me a good seat.
exampleZh: 您能给我留这个座吗？
他帮我找到了一个好位子。

defsEn: the one that comes after the first
zh: n. 秒, 瞬间, 第二名, 支持者, 助手
a. 第二的, 其次的, 次要的, 附加的, 辅助的
num. 第二
vt. 当...助手, 支持
examples: He will be back in a second.
You never get a second chance to make a first impression.
exampleZh: 他很快就会回来。
你永远没有第二次机会去打造第一印象。

defsEn: something known only to a few and kept from general knowledge
ad. hidden from others
known only to a few
zh: n. 秘密, 机密, 秘诀, 秘方
a. 秘密的, 极机密的, 隐蔽的, 暗中的, 神秘的, 偏僻的
examples: He let out the secret regarding this matter.
He told me a little secret about her.
exampleZh: 在这点上他泄露了秘密。
他告诉我她的小秘密。

defsEn: freedom from danger or harm
protection
measures necessary to protect a person or place (“Security was increased in the city.”)
zh: n. 安全, 安全性, 防护物, 保安, 可靠性, 担保人, 抵押品, 保证金
examples: If you want security in your old age, begin saving now.
Social security? Who do they think they're kidding.
exampleZh: 如果你想安享晚年，现在就要开始储蓄了。
社会保障吗？他们在说什么笑话？

defsEn: to know or sense through the eyes
to understand or know see
zh: vt. 看见, 查看, 参观, 游览, 理解, 知道, 同意
vi. 看, 观看, 注意, 知道, 考虑
n. 主教的职位
examples: You can see it from as far as over there.
I want to go and see a film.
exampleZh: 你从那里就看得到了。
我要去看电影。

defsEn: the part of a plant from which new plants grow
zh: n. 种子, 籽, 萌芽, 子孙, 精液
vt. 在...播种, 催...发育, 脱...籽
vi. 结实, 播种
examples: The incident sowed the seeds of the war.
Farmers sow seeds in the spring.
exampleZh: 该事件播下了战争的种子。
农民在春天播种。

defsEn: to search for (“They are seeking a cure for cancer.”)
to try to get (“She is seeking election to public office.”)
to plan to do (“Electric power companies are seeking to reduce their use of coal.”)
zh: vt. 寻求, 寻找, 探索, 追求, 搜索, 请求
vi. 寻找, 搜索
examples: Perhaps you will seek his aid.
They went out to Australia seeking gold.
exampleZh: 你也许要寻求他的帮助。
他们为了找到黄金而前往澳大利亚。

defsEn: to appear to be (“She seems to be in good health.”)
zh: vi. 象是, 似乎
examples: Some of them seem to be too difficult.
You seem like a very smart person.
exampleZh: 其中一些似乎太难了。
你看起来像一个聪明人。

defsEn: to take quickly by force
to take control of quickly
to arrest
zh: vt. 抓住, 逮捕, 俘获, 没收, 扣押, 掌握
vi. 突然抓住, 利用
examples: He seized me by the neck.
The boy seized the ladder, and began to climb.
exampleZh: 他抓住了我的脖子。
男孩登上了梯子，向上爬了起来。

defsEn: all that which makes one person different from others
zh: n. 自己, 自我, 本性, 本质, 私心, 本人
vt. 使近亲繁殖, 使自花授精
vi. 自花授精
a. 同一的
examples: Could you give a simple self-introduction?
I have self-studied half a semester's worth of German.
exampleZh: 你可以简单地做一下自我介绍吗？
我自学了半个学期的德文。

defsEn: to give something in exchange for money
zh: vt. 卖, 背叛, 销售, 出卖
vi. 卖, 销售
n. 卖, 推销术, 失望
examples: Will you sell your car to me?
I have to sell my house.
exampleZh: 你可以把你的车卖给我吗？
我得卖我的房子。

defsEn: the smaller of the two groups in the governments of some countries, such as in the United States Congress
zh: n. 参议院, 立法机构, 评议会
examples: Grant asked the Senate to approve the treaty.
This week, we welcome the president of the senate.

defsEn: to cause to go
to permit to go
to cause to be carried, taken or directed to or away from a place
zh: vt. 发送, 使进入, 寄, 派遣, 发射, 使陷于
vi. 寄信, 派人, 播送
n. (船的)上升运动
examples: I told them to send me another ticket.
I asked her to send us the book.
exampleZh: 我请他们再寄给我一张票。
我让她把书寄给我们。

defsEn: to come to know about by feeling, believing or understanding
n. any of the abilities to see, hear, taste, smell or feel
zh: n. 感应, 感觉, 感官, 意识, 观念, 情理, 知觉, 理智
vt. 感觉, 觉察, 检测
examples: You have no sense of reading the room.
Can you make sense of what he says?
exampleZh: 真没眼力见儿。
你听得懂他说什么吗？

defsEn: to declare the punishment for a crime
n. the punishment for a crime
zh: n. 句子, 命题, 宣判
vt. 宣判, 判决
examples: I think the sentence would sound more natural like that.
Can I enter a sentence in French?
exampleZh: 我觉得像这样句子听起来更自然。
我能用法语加一句句子吗？

defsEn: to set or keep people, things or ideas away from or independent from others
ad. not together or connected
different
zh: n. 独立件, 抽印本
a. 分开的, 各别的, 单独的, 分隔的
vi. 分开, 隔开, 分居
vt. 使分离, 使分开, 区分, 使分居
examples: You cannot separate the milk from the coffee once you put it in.
In our city, we carefully separate and collect garbage.
exampleZh: 你一把它放进去，就不能把牛奶和咖啡分开了。
在我们的城市那，我们非常谨慎地分类收集垃圾。

defsEn: a number of similar things or events that follow one after another in time, position or order
zh: n. 串联, 序列, 连续, 系列, 丛书, 套, 级数, 组
examples: Why are series about time travel so popular at the moment?
They watched a TV series tonight.
exampleZh: 现在穿越剧为什么这么火？
他们今晚看了电视连续剧。

defsEn: important
needing careful consideration
dangerous
zh: a. 严肃的, 认真的, 重要的, 严重的
examples: He could not come because of his serious illness.
You may get a serious disease.
exampleZh: 他因为生重病不能来。
你也许会染上疾病。

defsEn: to work as an official
to be employed by the government
to assist or help
zh: vt. 可作...用, 服务, 经历, 招待, 供应, 送交, 对待
vi. 服务, 服役, 侍应, 适合, 有用, 开球
n. 发球, 轮到发球
examples: Please serve him his meal first.
Have you ever served as a witness in a court case?
exampleZh: 请先为他上菜。
你曾是一宗司法案件的证人？

defsEn: an organization or system that provides something for the public (“Schools and roads are services paid for by taxes.”)
a job that an organization or business can do for money
military organizations such as an army, navy or air force
a religious ceremony
zh: n. 服务, 贡献, 雇佣, 公职, 服役, 功劳, 仪式, 送达, 行政部门
vt. 保养, 维修
a. 武装部队的, 服务性的, 仆人的, 耐用的
examples: Can I be of any service to you?
They give good service at that restaurant.
exampleZh: 你需要我帮忙吗？
那家餐馆提供良好的服务。

defsEn: to put in place or position
to establish a time, price or limit
zh: n. 日落, 同伙, 组合, 集合, 装置
vt. 放, 安置, 放置, 设定, 使凝结, 点燃, 确定, 点缀, 使就位, 树立, 分配, 调整
vi. 日落, 凝固, 定型, 搁住, 结果, 适合
a. 决心的, 规定的, 故意的, 持久的, 固定的, 老套的, 准备好的
examples: You should set a good example for your children.
I will never set my foot there again.
exampleZh: 你应该给你的孩子们树立好榜样。
我再也不会踏进这个地方。

defsEn: to end (a dispute)
to agree about (a problem)
to make a home in a new place
zh: n. 有背长椅
vt. 决定, 整理, 安放, 使定居, 使平静, 支付, 安排, 解决, 结算
vi. 停留, 下陷, 沉淀, 澄清, 安下心来, 结清, 定居, 安家
examples: I need to settle in here first.
They made a great effort to settle the problem.
exampleZh: 我需要先在这里安顿下来。
为了解决问题，他们尽了很大努力。

defsEn: three or more, but not many
zh: a. 几个的, 一些的, 各自的
pron. 几个
examples: There seem to be several reasons for his failure.
After several delays, the plane finally left.
exampleZh: 他的失败看来有几个原因。
经过数次延迟之后，飞机终于离开了。

defsEn: not gentle
causing much pain, sadness or damage
zh: a. 严格的, 尖锐的, 严肃的, 严重的, 严厉的, 朴素的
examples: In severe weather, it's best to stay indoors.
He was severe with his children.
exampleZh: 天气恶劣的时候尽量不要外出。
他对自己的孩子很严格。

defsEn: either the male or the female group into which all people and animals are divided because of their actions in producing young
the physical activity by which humans and animals can produce young.
zh: n. 性别, 性欲
vt. 区别...的性别, 引起...的性欲
examples: I want to have sex with him.
I want to have sex with her.
exampleZh: 我要和他发生性关系。
我要和她发生性关系。

defsEn: to move or cause to move in short, quick movements
zh: n. 摇动, 震动
vt. 摇动, 动摇, 使震动, 挥舞
vi. 震动, 发抖, 动摇
examples: We felt the house shake a little.
She stepped forward to shake his hand.
exampleZh: 我们感觉到房子摇动了一下。
为了握住他的手，她往前跨了一步。

defsEn: to give form to
n. the form of something, especially how it looks
zh: n. 形状, 形态, 外形, 形式, 身材
vt. 定形, 使成形, 塑造, 计划, 使符合
vi. 成形, 形成, 成长
examples: That cloud is in the shape of a fish.
She patted her hair into shape.
exampleZh: 那片云是鱼的形状。
她把头发拍整齐了。

defsEn: to give part of something to another or others
n. a part belonging to, given to or owned by a single person or a group
any one of the equal parts of ownership of a business or company
zh: n. 部分, 参与, 一份, 参股, 份额
vt. 均分, 分担, 分享, 分配, 共有
vi. 分享
文件锁定及检测磁盘更动和对超过32MB硬盘分区的支持
examples: I want to share it with you.
I want to share this with you.
exampleZh: 我想跟你分享。
我想跟你分享。

defsEn: having a thin edge or small point that can cut or hurt
causing hurt or pain
zh: n. 半升音调, 利刃, 骗子
a. 锋利的, 明显的, 敏锐的, 急剧的, 尖刻的, 严厉的, 刺耳的, 精明的
adv. 锐利地, 急速地
examples: All of a sudden, I felt a sharp pain in my stomach.
The boy was very sharp at physics.
exampleZh: 我突然肚痛得要命。
这个男孩儿精通物理学。

defsEn: the girl or woman who is being spoken about
zh: pron. 她

defsEn: a farm animal used for its meat and hair
zh: 绵羊
examples: I have a lot of sheep.
It's time to feed the sheep.
exampleZh: 我有很多绵羊。
是时候喂羊了。

defsEn: to fire artillery
n. a metal container that is fired from a large gun and explodes when it reaches its target
a hard outside cover
zh: n. 贝壳, 壳, 外形, 炮弹
vt. 去壳, 脱落, 炮轰
vi. 剥落, 脱壳
examples: I found a beautiful shell on the shore.
I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.
exampleZh: 我在海滩上发现了一个漂亮的贝壳。
我在海边捡了个漂亮贝壳。

defsEn: to protect or give protection to
n. something that gives protection
a place of safety
zh: n. 庇护所, 避难所, 庇护, 隐蔽处, 掩蔽
vt. 庇护, 保护, 隐匿
vi. 躲避
examples: To escape the storm, we took shelter in a nearby barn.
Food, clothing and shelter are the basis of life.
exampleZh: 为躲避风暴，我们躲到了附近的一个谷仓内。
衣食住是生存的基础。

defsEn: to aim a light
to give bright light
to be bright
to clean to make bright
zh: n. 光泽, 阳光
vt. 使发光
vi. 照耀, 发光, 发亮
examples: I shine light in the world.
Whether rain or shine, I go to the park every day to run.
exampleZh: 我在这个世界散发着自己的光芒。
不管下不下雨，我都每天去公园跑步。

defsEn: to transport
n. a large boat ship
zh: n. 船, 舰
vt. 以船运送, 装船, 运送
vi. 上船, 乘船
examples: A camel is, so to speak, a ship on the desert.
This ship is too big to pass through the canal.
exampleZh: 骆驼，这么说吧，也就是沙漠中的船。
这艘船太大，没法通过运河。

defsEn: to cause to feel sudden surprise or fear
n. something that greatly affects the mind or emotions
a powerful shake, as from an earthquake
zh: n. 震动, 冲突, 震惊, 冲击, 突击, 禾束堆, 休克, 长毛狗
vt. 使震动, 使休克, 使受电击, 震惊得
vi. 震动, 吓人
a. 蓬乱浓密的
examples: His death was great shock to his wife.
It was a great shock to me.
exampleZh: 他的去世让他的太太大受打击。
这对我是很大的震撼。

defsEn: a covering for the foot
zh: n. 鞋, 靴, 外胎
vt. 给...穿鞋, 为马钉蹄铁
examples: The color of her dress and that of her shoes go well together.
Only a shoe knows about a hole in a sock.
exampleZh: 她裙子和鞋子的颜色很配。
只有鞋子知道袜子的洞。

defsEn: to cause a gun or other weapon to send out an object designed to kill
to use a gun
zh: n. 射击, 狩猎, 芽, 射伤, 发射, 发芽, 急流, 推力, 摄影, 急送, 滑运道, 浪费
vt. 射击, 射中, 损毁, 拍摄, 喷出, 投射, 挥出, 飞速行进, 挥霍, 给...注射
vi. 射出, 射击, 发出, 拍电影, 射门, 发芽
examples: My camera can shoot high-definition video.
I just saw a shooting star.
exampleZh: 我的录像机可以拍高清视频。
我刚看到一颗流星。

defsEn: lasting only for a small period of time
not long
opposite tall
zh: a. 短的, 近的, 矮的, 短期的, 简短的, 少量的
adv. 简短地, 突然
n. 扼要, 短片, 缺乏
vt. 故意少给, 使短路
examples: Life being very short, we ought not to waste time.
We are not short of oil in this country.
exampleZh: 人生十分短暂，我们不应该浪费时间。
我们国家不缺石油。

defsEn: used with another verb (action word) to show responsibility. (“We should study.”), probability (“The talks should begin soon.”), or that something is believed to be a good idea (“Criminals should be punished.”)
zh: aux. 应该, 将要
examples: Could you tell me what I should do next?
Do you think we should send for the doctor?
exampleZh: 你可以告诉我我下一步该做什么吗？
你认为我们应该派人去请医生来吗?

defsEn: to speak very loudly
zh: n. 呼喊, 喊声
vi. 呼喊, 喊叫, 嚷
vt. 高喊
examples: Shouting at your computer will not help.
The manager shouted out to his players to mark the opposition.
exampleZh: 对你的电脑吼一点帮助也没有。
教练对自己的球员大喊，让他盯守对方球员。

defsEn: to make something be seen
to make known
n. a play or story presented in a theater, or broadcast on radio or television, for enjoyment or education
something organized to be seen by the public show
zh: n. 显示, 表现, 展览, 卖弄, 炫耀, 外观, 演出, 洋相
vt. 表示, 显示, 展现, 陈列, 演出, 表明, 指出, 带领
vi. 露面, 显现, 演出
examples: Could you show me the way to the bus stop?
Which TV show do you like the most?
exampleZh: 请问公车站该怎么去？
你最喜欢哪一个电视节目？

defsEn: to make or become less in size, weight or value
zh: n. 收缩, 萎缩, 回避
vi. 收缩, 退缩, 萎缩, 缩小, 回避
vt. 使收缩, 使缩小
examples: Why do sheep not shrink in the rain?
My shrink says I should relax more.

defsEn: suffering physically or mentally with a disease or other problem
not in good health
zh: n. 病人
a. 不舒服, 有病的, 恶心的, 厌恶的, 渴望的, 病态的
vt. 呕吐, 追击, 使(狗)去攻击
examples: If you get sick, go to the doctor.
Excuse me, but I feel sick.
exampleZh: 如果你生病了，就去看医生。
不好意思，但我有点恶心。

defsEn: the condition of being in bad health
zh: n. 疾病, 不健康, 呕吐
examples: She is absent because of sickness.
Sickness and health start with the mind.
exampleZh: 她不在是因为病了。

defsEn: the outer surfaces of an object that are not the top or bottom
parts away from the middle
either the right or left half of the body
zh: n. 旁边, 侧, 方面, 胁, 侧边, 血统
a. 旁的, 侧的, 次要的
vt. 同意, 支持
vi. 支持, 赞助
examples: They live on the other side of the road.
The river's on the other side of the hill.
exampleZh: 他们住在路对面。
河在山丘的另一端。

defsEn: to write one’s name
n. a mark or shape used to mean something
evidence that something exists or will happen
a flat piece of material with writing that gives information
zh: n. 符号, 招牌, 征兆, 正负号, 手势
vt. 签名, 打手势表达
vi. 签名
examples: The park sign says "Please keep off the grass."
I would take it as a sign.
exampleZh: 公园的告示牌上写着「请勿践踏草地」。
我会把它看作一个征兆。

defsEn: to send a message by signs
n. an action or movement that sends a message
zh: n. 信号, 暗号, 近因, 导火线
vt. 向...作信号, 标志, 用信号通知
vi. 发信号
a. 作为信号的, 显著的
examples: He gave us the signal to begin.
What are you saying? I cannot hear, the signal here is too bad.
exampleZh: 他给了我们开始的信号。
你说什么？我听不见，这里信号太差了。

defsEn: to make quiet
to stop from speaking or making noise
n. a lack of noise or sound
zh: n. 沉默, 无声, 静寂, 湮没, 无声息
vt. 使缄默
interj. 安静
examples: The eternal silence of these infinite spaces terrifies me.
Speech is silver, but silence is golden.
exampleZh: 这些无限空间的永恒沉默使我恐惧。
雄辩如银，沉默如金。

defsEn: a valued white metal
zh: n. 银, 银币, 银器
a. 银的, 银制的, 银器的
vt. 镀银
vi. 变银白色
examples: Can you tell silver and tin apart?
Can you distinguish silver from tin?
exampleZh: 你能分辨银和锡吗?
你能分辨银和锡吗?

defsEn: like something else but not exactly the same
zh: a. 相似的, 类似的
n. 相似的东西
examples: Gold is similar in color to brass.
Your chair is similar to mine.
exampleZh: 金的颜色和黄铜很相似。
你的椅子和我的很像。

defsEn: easy to understand or do
not difficult or complex
zh: a. 简单的, 普通的, 朴素的, 单纯的, 绝对的, 初级的, 原始的, 迟钝的
n. 出身低微者, 傻子
examples: We want to make a simple change.
The accident arose from a simple mistake.
exampleZh: 我们想做出一个简单的改变。
事故由一个简单的错误产生。

defsEn: from a time in the past until now (“I have known her since we went to school together.”)
zh: prep. 自...以后, 自...以来
adv. 自那时以后
conj. 既然, 自...以后, 自...以来
examples: Since when do you learn Japanese?
Since I have today off, shall we play a game?
exampleZh: 你从什么时候开始学日文？
今天我休假，要不要一起玩游戏？

defsEn: to make music sounds with the voice
zh: vi. 唱, 唱歌, 演唱, 鸣, 啼
vt. 唱, 歌颂
n. 嗖嗖声
examples: I would love to sing with your band.
It would be great if you could sing.
exampleZh: 我非常乐意和你们乐团一起唱歌。
如果你唱歌的话一定很棒。

defsEn: one only
zh: a. 单身的, 单程的, 单一的, 个别的, 孤独的, 专一的
n. 一个, 单打, 单程票
vt. 选出
vi. 击出一垒打
examples: A single step, and you will fall over the cliff.
A single room with bath, please.
exampleZh: 只迈一步，你就会落下悬崖。
我要一个带浴室的单人房。

defsEn: to go down into water or other liquid
zh: n. 藏垢的场所, 沟渠, 污水槽
vi. 下沉, 沉没, 下陷, 减弱, 衰退, 消沉, 堕落, 渗透
vt. 使低落, 使下沉, 陷于, 投入(资金等), 挖掘
examples: The evening sun is sinking in the west.
She put the dirty dishes in the sink.
exampleZh: 夕阳西下。
她把脏盘子放进水池里。

defsEn: a female with the same father or mother as another person
zh: n. 姐妹, 姐, 妹, 护士, 修女
vt. 姐妹般对待
examples: I let my sister use my new computer.
My sister can play the piano better than I can.
exampleZh: 我让我妹妹用我的新电脑。
我妹妹钢琴可以弹得比我好。

defsEn: to rest on the lower part of the body without the support of the legs
to become seated
zh: vi. 坐, 就座, 坐落
vt. 使就座, 骑
n. 坐, 衣服合身
examples: Sit in the well and look at the sky.
Sit down and rest for a while.
exampleZh: 坐井观天。
您坐下休息休息。

defsEn: the way things are during a period of time
zh: n. 情形, 境遇, 位置
examples: What should they do in this situation?
I am sure the situation will take a turn for the better.
exampleZh: 在这种情况下，他们该做什么？
我肯定事情会往好的方向发展。

defsEn: the space occupied by something
how long, wide or high something is
zh: n. 大小, 尺寸, 规模, 尺码, 能力, 浆料
vt. 上浆, 依大小排列
vi. 可比拟
a. 一定大小的, 一定尺寸的
examples: We have your size, but not in that color.
What size cake do you need?
exampleZh: 我们有你的尺寸，但是没有那个颜色。
你需要多大的蛋糕？

defsEn: all the bones of a human or other animal together in their normal positions skeleton
zh: n. 骨骼, 骨瘦如柴的人, 梗概, 骨干, 残骸
a. 骨骼的, 概略的, 基层的, 骨干的
examples: Tom found a skeleton in the cave.
The explorers discovered a skeleton in the cave.
exampleZh: 汤姆在洞穴里找到了一具骨架。
探险家们在洞穴里发现了骸骨。

defsEn: the ability gained from training or experience
zh: n. 技术, 技巧, 技能, 熟练, 熟练工人
examples: Skilled soldiers know how to use their environment as a weapon.
He is already skilled in both math and literature.
exampleZh: 熟练的士兵知道怎么以他们的环境为武器。
他既精于数学又精于文学。

defsEn: the outer covering of humans and most animals
zh: n. 皮肤, 皮
vt. 剥皮, 在...植皮
vi. 长皮, 愈合, 蜕皮
examples: Her skin is as white as snow.
Her skin is more white than snow.
exampleZh: 她的皮肤白得像雪。
她的皮肤比雪还白。

defsEn: the space above the earth
zh: n. 天空, 天色, 天堂
vt. 击向空中, 挂在高处
vi. 高涨
examples: No matter where you go, the sky will always be the same color.
From the look of the sky, it may rain in the afternoon.
exampleZh: 不管你去哪里，天空都是同样的颜色。
从天色看起来，下午可能会下雨。

defsEn: a person owned or controlled by another
zh: n. 奴隶, 从动装置, 卑鄙的人
vi. 拼命工作
examples: He treats me like his slave.
She is a slave of fashion.
exampleZh: 他对待我就像他的奴隶。
她是潮流的奴隶。

defsEn: to rest the body and mind with the eyes closed
zh: n. 睡眠, 静止, 昏迷, 麻木, 长眠, 冬眠
vi. 睡觉, 睡眠, 静止
vt. 睡
examples: I still have to sleep for a while.
I would like to go to sleep now.
exampleZh: 我还要再睡一会儿。
我想要现在睡觉。

defsEn: to move smoothly over a surface
zh: n. 滑, 滑道, 山崩, 雪崩, 幻灯片
vt. 使滑动, 偷偷放入
vi. 滑动, 滑落, 不知不觉陷入, 偷偷地走
examples: The slow blue puma slides under the diligent cat.
Hasn't Huiru sent the slides yet? The client's pushing.
exampleZh: 行动迟缓的蓝色美洲狮从勤奋的猫身下滑过。
慧如那个简报档还没传喔？客户在催。

defsEn: to reduce the speed of
ad. not fast in moving, talking or other activities
zh: a. 慢的, 缓慢的, 迟缓的, 迟钝的, 冷漠的, 落后的
adv. 慢地, 迟缓地
v. (使)慢下来
examples: It's a bit slow, can you wait for a bit?
They showed the scene in slow motion.
exampleZh: 现在有点慢，能不能等一下？
他们用慢动作把那一幕播了出来。

defsEn: little in size or amount
few in number
not important
opposite large
zh: a. 小的, 少的, 小型的, 低微的, 小气的, 细微的
adv. 些微地
n. 狭小部分
examples: Do you have small change with you?
Can you see that small house?
exampleZh: 你身上有零钱吗？
您能看到那栋小房子吗？

defsEn: to break or be broken into small pieces by force
to hit or move with force
zh: n. 打碎, 粉碎, 打碎时哗啦声, 猛击, 扣球, 杀球, 经营失败, 破产, 硬币, 假硬币
a. 非常轰动的, 了不起的
vt. 打碎, 粉碎, 击溃, 使破产, 使裂变, 使用假硬币
vi. 碎裂, 猛撞, 破产, 扣球, 杀球
adv. 轰隆一声, 哗啦一声
examples: Someone smashed the windshield of my new car.
The front windshield of a car was smashed to pieces.
exampleZh: 有人把我新车的挡风玻璃砸碎了。
车头的挡风玻璃被砸至粉碎。

defsEn: to sense through the nose
n. something sensed by the nose (“the smell of food cooking”)
zh: n. 味道, 气味, 嗅觉, 嗅, 臭味, 气息
vt. 闻, 探出, 察觉, 发出...的气味
vi. 嗅, 散发气味, 发臭
examples: I hate it when my clothes smell of smoke.
This smell might come from the oven!
exampleZh: 我讨厌我的衣服有烟味。
这味道可能是微波炉传出来的!

defsEn: to use cigarettes or other tobacco products by burning them and breathing in the smoke
n. that which can be seen rising into the air like a cloud from something burning
zh: n. 烟, 雾气, 烟熏剂, 抽烟, 烟色
vi. 吸烟, 冒烟, 弥漫
vt. 以烟熏, 抽烟而导致...
examples: You smoke far too much. You should cut back.
Do you mind if I smoke a cigarette?
exampleZh: 你吸太多烟了。你应该少抽一点。
你介意我抽根烟吗？

defsEn: having a level surface
opposite rough
zh: a. 平滑的, 平稳的, 流畅的, 和蔼的, 安祥的, 圆滑的, 调匀的, 无毛的
vt. 使光滑, 烫平, 使平和, 消除
vi. 变平滑, 变平静
n. 一块平地, 平滑部分
examples: It's as smooth as a baby's bottom.
Its surface can be smooth or rough.
exampleZh: 它像婴儿的屁股一样光滑。

defsEn: soft, white pieces of frozen water that fall from the sky, usually in winter or when the air temperature is very cold
zh: n. 雪, 积雪, 下雪, 雪花形干扰
vi. 下雪, 似雪般落下
vt. 使雪白, 用雪覆盖, 使像雪般落下
examples: I wonder if it will snow in our town this winter.
There's a lot of snow in the winter.
exampleZh: 我想知道这个冬天在我们的城市会不会下雪。
冬天经常下雪。

defsEn: in such a way that (“He held the flag so all could see it.”)
also
too (“She left early, and so did we.”)
very (“I am so sick.”)
as a result (“They were sick, so they could not come.”)
conj. in order that
for the purpose of (“Come early so we can discuss the plans.”)
zh: adv. 如此, 如是, 如...那样
conj. 所以, 因此
pron. 这样

defsEn: of or about people or a group
zh: a. 社会的, 群居的, 社交的
n. 联欢会
examples: Social customs vary from country to country.
Social conditions are going backward rather than forward.
exampleZh: 国家不同，习俗各异。
社会不是在进步，而是在退步。

defsEn: not hard
easily shaped
pleasing to touch
not loud
zh: a. 软的, 温和的, 柔和的, 柔滑的, 温柔的, 软弱的, 坡度小的, 笨的, 纸币的
n. 柔软的东西, 笨人, 纸币
adv. 柔软地, 温和地
examples: This scarf feels soft and smooth.
This towel is so soft and fluffy. It feels good!
exampleZh: 这条围巾摸起来又软又滑。
这条毛巾蓬松又柔软，特别舒服。

defsEn: earth in which plants grow
zh: n. 土壤, 土地, 国家, 国土, 温床, 污物, 粪便, 水池
vt. 弄脏, 污辱
vi. 变脏
examples: She renewed the soil in the flower pot.
She put new soil in the flower pot.
exampleZh: 她更新了花盆里的土。

defsEn: a person in the army
zh: n. 军人, 士兵, 兵蚁
vi. 从军, 尽职, 偷懒, 磨洋工
examples: The soldier gave water to me.
They supplied the soldiers with enough food and water.
exampleZh: 士兵给了我水。
他们给士兵提供了充足的食物和水。

defsEn: having a hard shape with no empty spaces inside
strong
not in the form of a liquid or gas
zh: n. 固体
a. 坚硬的, 稳固的, 固体的, 实心的, 纯质的, 立体的, 立方的
examples: Can you do me a solid?
Water becomes solid when it freezes.
exampleZh: 可以帮我一个忙吗?
水结冰后成为固体。

defsEn: to find an answer
to settle
zh: vt. 解决, 付给, 溶解
vt. 求解
vi. 求解
examples: I know how to solve the problem.
Tell me how to solve the problem.
exampleZh: 我知道怎么解决这个问题。
告诉我如何解决这个问题。

defsEn: of an amount or number or part not stated
not all
zh: pron. 一些, 一部分, 若干
adv. 大约
a. 一些的, 少许的, 某一的
examples: Would you like some sugar in your tea?
I thought I could be of some help.
exampleZh: 红茶里要加糖吗？
我认为我能帮点忙。

defsEn: a person’s male child
zh: n. 儿子, 女婿, 子孙
examples: I have to take my son to the doctor.
He left his son a large fortune.
exampleZh: 我得带我儿子去看医生。
他留给了他的儿子一大笔财富。

defsEn: not long after the present time
quickly
zh: adv. 不久, 早, 快, 宁可
examples: You will soon get accustomed to your new school.
They will do it as soon as possible.
exampleZh: 你很快就会适应你的新学校。
他们会尽快。

defsEn: any group of people or things that are the same or are similar in some way
a kind of something
zh: n. 种类, 方式, 品质, 态度, 举止
vt. 分类, 排序, 挑选
vi. 交往, 协调
对它以行为单位进行排序, 然后在标准输出设备上输出
examples: What sort of work do you do?
She seldom goes to that sort of place.
exampleZh: 你做什么类型的工作？
她很少去像那样的地方。

defsEn: fast–moving waves of energy that affect the ear and result in hearing
that which is heard
zh: n. 声音, 语音, 吵闹, 声调, 听力范围, 探条, 海峡
a. 健全的, 可靠的, 合理的, 健康的, 彻底的, 资金充实的
adv. 彻底地, 充分地
vi. 发出声音, 回响, 测深, 试探, 听起来
vt. 使发声, 宣告, 听诊, 测...深, 试探
examples: I can hear the sound in your mind.
Do I sound like an idiot if I talk like this?
exampleZh: 我可以听见你心里的声音。
我这么说的话是不是像个傻瓜？

defsEn: the direction to the right of a person facing the rising sun
zh: n. 南方, 南
a. 南的, 向南的
adv. 在南方
vi. 转向南方
examples: They come from the south of France.
We go to the South of France for a change of air.
exampleZh: 他们是从法国南部来的。
我们去南法散心。

defsEn: the area outside the earth’s atmosphere where the sun, moon, planets and stars are
the area between or inside things space
zh: n. 位置, 空间, 距离, 太空, 空白, 间隔, (期刊等的)篇幅
vt. 隔开, 分隔
vi. 留间隔
examples: Space travel will be commonplace some time in the future.
Space travel will one day become commonplace.
exampleZh: 太空旅行终有一天会成为平常事。
太空旅行终有一天会成为平常事。

defsEn: to talk
to say words with the mouth
to express one’s thoughts to others and exchange ideas
to give a speech to a group speak
zh: vi. 说, 说话, 演说, 发言
vt. 说, 讲, 说出
examples: Could you please speak a little bit more slowly?
I do not speak to him about this thing.
exampleZh: 能否请你说慢一点?
我不跟他讲这件事。

defsEn: of a different or unusual kind
not for general use
better or more important than others of the same kind
zh: n. 专辑, 专车, 号外, 特别的东西, 负有特别任务的人员
a. 特别的, 专门的, 特殊的, 额外的, 附加的, 特别亲密的
examples: You have to pay special attention to what you eat and drink.
This year is definitely a special year in human history.
exampleZh: 尤其是要注意你吃的和喝的东西。
今年肯定是人类历史上特殊的一年。

defsEn: a talk given to a group of people
zh: n. 演讲, 说话, 谈话, 言语, 引语, 民族语言
examples: I never make a speech without being nervous.
I know from his speech that he is not an American.
exampleZh: 我没有一次演讲的时候是不紧张的。
听他的谈吐，就知道他不是美国人了。

defsEn: to make something go or move faster
n. the rate at which something moves or travels
the rate at which something happens or is done
zh: n. 速率, 速度, 迅速
vi. 加速, 超速, 快进
vt. 快速传送, 促进, 使加速
examples: The bus picked up the speed gradually.
He is driving at top speed.
exampleZh: 总线速度逐步回升。
他全速驾驶着。

defsEn: to give as payment
to use (“He spends much time studying.”)
zh: vt. 花费, 浪费, 度过, 消耗, 消磨
vi. 花费, 用尽
examples: I want to spend the whole day with you.
I wish we could spend more time together.
exampleZh: 我想跟你度过一整天。
我希望我们有更多时间呆在一起。

defsEn: to cause or permit liquid to flow out, usually by accident
zh: n. 溢出, 溅出, 摔下, 溢出量, 木片, 小塞子
vt. 使溢出, 使散落, 洒, 使流出, 倒出, 使摔下
vi. 溢出, 涌流, 摔下
examples: I spilled my coffee on the carpet.
I spilled jam on the electric outlet and there was a short circuit.
exampleZh: 我把咖啡倒翻在地毯上了。
我把果酱撒到电源插座上短路了。

defsEn: the part of a human that is not physical and is connected to thoughts and emotions
the part of a person that is believed to remain alive after death
zh: n. 精神, 心灵, 灵魂, 态度, 志气, 人格, 情绪, 心情, 烈酒
vt. 诱拐, 鼓励, 鼓舞
examples: The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.
Spirits of Heaven and Earth, heed my call; manifest swiftly by divine decree!
exampleZh: 心有余而力不足。
天灵灵，地灵灵；急急如律令！

defsEn: to separate into two or more parts
to divide or break into parts
zh: n. 劈开, 裂片, 裂缝, 分裂, 派系, 派别, 柳条
a. 劈开的
vi. 分离, 分开, 裂开, 被劈开
vt. 劈开, 切开, 使分裂, 使分离
examples: You come to eat and then split? How rude!
Do you want to split this sandwich in half?

defsEn: any game or activity of competition involving physical effort or skill
zh: n. 运动, 游戏, 娱乐, 消遣, 玩笑
a. 运动的, 户外穿戴的
vi. 游戏, 参加体育运动, 戏弄, 产生变种
vt. 炫耀, 使产生变种
examples: Sport is good for your health.
I know that you like sports.
exampleZh: 运动有益健康。
我知道你喜欢体育运动。

defsEn: to become longer or wider
to make or become widely known
zh: n. 传播, 散布, 伸展
a. 双唇展开的, 伸展的
vt. 展开, 铺开, 传播, 推广, 伸出, 涂, 敷, 延伸
vi. 展开, 扩大, 传开, 延伸
examples: The fire spread out in a fan-shape.
The news of his death spread.
exampleZh: 火势以扇形迅速蔓延。
他去世的消息传开来了。

defsEn: the time of the year between winter and summer
zh: n. 春天, 弹簧, 跳跃, 弹性, 活力, 泉, 源泉
a. 春天的
vi. 跳, 弹跳, 涌出, 生长, 裂开, 高耸
vt. 使跳起, 使爆炸, 突然提出
examples: Which do you prefer, spring or autumn?
I like spring better than fall.
exampleZh: 春天和秋天，你更喜欢哪个？
我喜欢春天胜过秋天。

defsEn: to steal or get information secretly
n. one who watches others secretly
a person employed by a government to get secret information about another country
zh: n. 间谍, 侦探, 侦察
vt. 侦察, 找出, 发现
vi. 做密探, 侦查
examples: He was under suspicion of being a spy.
One of them is a spy.
exampleZh: 人们怀疑他是间谍。
他们其中一人是间谍。

defsEn: a flat shape having four equal sides
zh: n. 正方形, 街区, 广场, 平方, 直角尺
a. 正方形的, 正直的, 公正的, 平方的, 方正的, 结清的
adv. 成直角地, 对准地
vi. 一致, 符合, 结清
vt. 使成方形, 使平方自乘, 调正, 结清, 使一致
examples: We learned at school that the square root of nine is three.
I'll square things with you later.
exampleZh: 我们上课时学了九的根是三。
待会我再和你谈谈。

defsEn: to cut or push into or through with a pointed weapon
zh: n. 刺, 戳, 剧痛, 尝试, 努力
vt. 刺, 戳, 刺入, 刺痛, 直入, 使伤心
vi. 刺, 刺伤
examples: I'll take a stab at it.
She stabbed him in the back.
exampleZh: 我试试。
她在他的背上戳了一下。

defsEn: to move into or be in a position in which only the feet are on a surface
to be in one position or place
zh: n. 站立, 站住, 停顿, 讲台, 看台, 立场, 法院证人席
vi. 站, 立, 坐落, 停滞, 位于, 坚持, 维持原状
vt. 忍受, 使站立, 抵挡
examples: I know the boy standing over there.
The teacher told me to stand up.
exampleZh: 我知道站在那里的那个男孩。
老师叫我站起来。

defsEn: a mass of gas that usually appears as a small light in the sky at night, but is not a planet
a famous person, usually an actor or singer
zh: n. 星, 恒星, 星形物, 运气, 明星
vt. 以星状物装饰, 用星号标, 使成为明星
vi. 变成明星
examples: I intend to stay at a five-star hotel.
He stared at me from head to foot.
exampleZh: 我打算去五星级酒店住。
他把我从头到脚打量了一番。

defsEn: to begin
to make something begin
zh: n. 惊起, 出发, 开端, 起点, 吃惊, 有利条件
vi. 开始, 出发, 启动, 跳起, 吃惊, 出现, 松动, 脱落, 起价, 参赛
vt. 使惊起, 开动, 发动, 启动, 开始, 创办, 提议, 使松动, 使脱落, 起用
examples: Start at once, or you will miss the bus.
I do not know where to start.
exampleZh: 马上出发，不然你就要错过公车了。
我不太知道从哪里开始。

defsEn: to suffer or die from a lack of food
zh: v. (使)饿死, (使)挨饿
examples: I would rather starve than steal.
The old man starved to death.
exampleZh: 我宁愿饿死，也不会去偷东西。
这位老人饿死了。

defsEn: to say
to declare
n. a political part of a nation
zh: n. 州, 状态, 情形, 国家, 政府, 领土, 国务, 社会地位
a. 国家的, 正式的, 礼仪用的, 州的
vt. 说明, 陈述, 规定
examples: The two states now live in peace with one another.
A devastating earthquake hit the state capital.
exampleZh: 两国目前和平共处。
一场毁灭性的地震袭击了这个州的首府。

defsEn: a place of special work or purpose (“a police station”)
a place where passengers get on or off trains or buses
a place for radio or television broadcasts
zh: n. 车站, 站, 局, 驻地, 位置, 身分, 地位
vt. 安置, 配置, 驻扎
examples: Could you tell me the way to the station?
Could you please take me to the station?
exampleZh: 能否告诉我去车站的路怎么走？
可以带我去车站吗？

defsEn: a form of a human, animal or other creature usually made of stone, wood or metal
zh: vt. 以雕像装饰
n. 雕像
examples: This statue is as large as life.
Their wish is engraved on the base of the statue.
exampleZh: 这座雕像和真人的尺寸一样。
他们的愿望被刻在雕像的底座上。

defsEn: to continue to be where one is
to remain
to not leave
to live for a time (“They stayed in New York for two years.”)
zh: n. 停留, 逗留, 制止, 延缓, 停止, 支柱, 支撑物, 支索
vt. 制止, 延缓, 坚持, 支持, 支撑, 用支索固定
vi. 停留, 逗留, 暂停, 坚持, 中止
examples: You can stay here as long as you want.
You can go or stay, as you wish.
exampleZh: 你要在这里呆多久就呆多久
你走或留，随你高兴。

defsEn: to take without permission or paying
zh: vt. 剽窃；偷偷地做；偷窃；vi. 窃取；偷偷地行动；偷垒；n. 偷窃；便宜货；偷垒；断球
examples: Can you teach me how to steal?
It's hard to steal from a thief.
exampleZh: 你能教我偷东西吗?
想从贼身上捞点儿什么是很难的

defsEn: the gas that comes from hot water steam
zh: n. 蒸汽, 精力
a. 蒸汽的
vi. 蒸发, 行驶, 发怒
vt. 蒸, 煮, 散发
examples: Do you know if there's a steam room anywhere around here?
Should we order the steamed perch or the beef with oyster sauce?
exampleZh: 你知道这附近哪里有汗蒸房吗？
叫个清蒸鲈鱼好呢，还是蚝油牛肉好？

defsEn: iron made harder and stronger by mixing it with other substances
zh: n. 钢, 钢制品, 钢铁, 坚硬, 坚固
a. 钢的, 钢制的, 钢铁业的, 坚强的
vt. 使坚强, 钢化, 使冷酷
examples: There are daisies next to the steel building.
There are daisies around the steel building.
exampleZh: 在钢铁大厦的旁边有许多的雏菊。
那里有许多雏菊围绕着钢铁大厦。

defsEn: to move by lifting one foot and placing it in a new position
n. the act of stepping
one of a series of actions designed to reach a goal
zh: n. 步骤, 步, 步幅, 脚步声, 踏级, 步伐, 短距离, 步态, 手段, 等级
vt. 踏, 以步测量, 跨步, 使成阶梯状
vi. 跨步, 轻快地走, 跳舞, 踩, 踏上, 行走
examples: Step out of the car and place your hands behind your back.
Maybe we should take a step back before we fall?
exampleZh: 下车，把手放在背后。
我们是不是该退一步，免得倒下？

defsEn: to attach something to another thing using a substance that will hold them together
to become fixed in one position so that movement is difficult (“Something is making the door stick.”)
n. a thin piece of wood
zh: n. 棍, 棒, 刺, 枯枝, 茎, 条状物
vt. 插进, 刺入, 钉住, 伸出, 粘贴, 停止
vi. 粘住, 停留, 坚持, 陷住, 伸出
examples: Stick a notice on the board.
I think you had better stick to your present job.
exampleZh: 把告示贴在在布告板上。
我觉得你应该继续做这份工作。

defsEn: not moving (“The man was standing still.”)
until the present or a stated time (“Was he still there?”)
even so
although (“The job was difficult, but she still wanted to do it.”)
zh: n. 蒸馏室, 寂静, 剧照
v. 蒸馏, (使)平静, (使)静止
a. 静止的, 不动的, 静寂的, 不起泡的, 静物摄影的
adv. 仍然, 更, 静止地
conj. 然而, 但是
examples: Do you still want to give me a hug?
We still have a lot more work to do.
exampleZh: 你还想拥抱我一下吗？
我们还有很多工作要做。

defsEn: a small piece of rock
zh: n. 石头, 宝石, 果核, 纪念碑, 结石
vt. 投扔石子, 铺石头
a. 石的, 石制的, 完全的
examples: From a distance, this stone looks like a human face.
He threw a stone at the big dog.
exampleZh: 从远看得话，这个石头看起来像人的脸。
他朝着大狗扔了块石头。

defsEn: to prevent any more movement or action
to come or bring to an end
zh: n. 停止, 车站, 逗留, 填塞, 障碍, (风琴的)音栓
vi. 停止, 被塞住
vt. 塞住, 堵塞, 阻止, 击落, 停止, 终止, 断绝
examples: I wish the rain would stop.
If only the rain would stop.
exampleZh: 希望雨快点停吧。
要是雨停了该多好！

defsEn: to keep or put away for future use
n. a place where people buy things
zh: n. 商店, 贮藏, 仓库, 备用品, 存储器
vt. 储存, 贮藏, 供给
vi. 贮藏
a. 贮藏的, 现成的
examples: There used to be a store right here.
I want to go to the store.
exampleZh: 这里以前有个商店。
我想去商店。

defsEn: violent weather, including strong winds and rain or snow
zh: n. 暴风雨, 骚动, 风波, 风暴, 猛攻
vi. 起风, 猛冲, 怒吼
vt. 猛攻
examples: How long will the storm last?
Because of the storm, we had no choice but to stay at home.
exampleZh: 暴风雨会持续多久？
因为暴风雨的关系，所以我们必须待在家里。

defsEn: the telling or writing of an event, either real or imagined
zh: n. 故事, 小说, 传奇, 描述, 阅历, 经历, 层
examples: He told me the story of his life.
Tell us the story from beginning to end.
exampleZh: 他给我讲述了他的一生。
请你把故事从头到尾给我们说一遍。

defsEn: a heating device used for cooking
zh: n. 火炉, 窑
vt. 用火炉烤
stave的过去式和过去分词
examples: Clean the stove and oven after cooking.
Wood for the stove must burn only in the stove.
exampleZh: 烹饪结束后请清洁炉灶和烤箱。

defsEn: continuing in one direction without turns
zh: n. 直线, 直
a. 直的, 笔直的, 正直的, 直接的, 连续的, 整齐的
adv. 直接地, 立即, 不断地
examples: Go straight on to the end of the road.
Go straight on down this street.
exampleZh: 直走直到这条街道的尽头。
沿着这条街直走。

defsEn: unusual
not normal
not known
zh: a. 奇怪的, 陌生的, 生疏的, 不熟悉的, 不可思议的, 外行的, 外地的, 异乡的
examples: I want to tell you a strange thing.
You have a strange sense of humor.
exampleZh: 我想告诉你一件怪事。
你有种奇怪的幽默感。

defsEn: a road in a city, town or village
zh: n. 街道, 马路, 街区
a. 街道的
examples: Take the first street to the right.
Can you give me a street map?
exampleZh: 第一条街右转。
请给我一张街道地图好吗？

defsEn: to extend for a distance
to pull on to make longer or wider
zh: n. 伸展, 张开, 连绵, 一段路, 一段时间
a. 可伸缩的, 弹性的
vt. 伸展, 张开, 曲解, 使过度伸展
vi. 伸展, 延伸
examples: On the border, there is a stretch of agricultural land.
He stretched out his arm to take the book.
exampleZh: 边境上有一片农业区。
他伸长了手臂为了能拿到书。

defsEn: to hit with force
to stop work as a way to seek better conditions, more pay or to make other demands
zh: n. 罢工, 打击, 殴打
vt. 打, 撞击, 冲击, 侵袭, 取消, 结算, 打掉, 罢工, 刺透, 使生根, 遇见
vi. 打, 打击, 抓, 罢工, 搏动, 触礁, 敲, 响, 穿透, 打动
examples: They already called off the strike.
Strike while the iron is hot.
exampleZh: 他们已经取消了罢工。
打铁趁热。

defsEn: having much power
not easily broken, damaged or destroyed
zh: a. 强壮的, 坚固的, 坚强的, 强烈的, 有力的, 优良的
adv. 强劲地, 有力地, 猛烈地
examples: Thank you for your strong support.
I'm not as strong as I used to be.
exampleZh: 感谢你的鼎力支持。
我不跟以前一样壮了。

defsEn: the way something is built, made or organized
a system that is formed or organized in a special way
a building
zh: n. 结构, 构造, 建筑物
vt. 构成, 组织
examples: The structure of the brain is complicated.
This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.
exampleZh: 头脑的结构很复杂。
这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。

defsEn: to try with much effort
to fight with
n. a great effort
a fight
zh: n. 斗争, 努力, 奋斗
vi. 努力, 奋斗, 挣扎
examples: I struggled to get out of the subway.
The injured bird struggled with all its might on the grass.
exampleZh: 我挣扎着挤出地铁。
那只受伤的小鸟在草地上尽力挣扎。

defsEn: to make an effort to gain knowledge by using the mind
to examine carefully
zh: n. 学习, 研究, 学科, 论文, 求学, 书房, 试作
vt. 学习, 读书, 研究, 考虑, 计划
vi. 学习, 思索
examples: I want to go study at a Canadian university.
You see? You must study a foreign language.
exampleZh: 我想去加拿大读大学。
看到了吧？你应该学一门外语。

defsEn: not able to learn much
not intelligent
zh: a. 愚蠢的, 麻木的
examples: How stupid of me to do so!
Let me ask a stupid question.
exampleZh: 我干了件什么傻事啊！
我来问个有点傻的问题。

defsEn: the person or thing being discussed, studied or written about
zh: n. 科目, 主题, 臣民, 主语, 题目, (事物的)经受者, 学科, 受治疗者, 原因, 理由
a. 服从的, 易患...的, 隶属的, 受支配的
adv. 在...条件下
vt. 使隶属, 使受到
examples: What subject do you like best?
A sentence normally has a subject and a verb.
exampleZh: 你最喜欢哪一个科目?
句子通常有主词和动词。

defsEn: an underwater ship submarine
zh: n. 潜水艇, 海底生物
a. 海中的, 生长在海中的
vt. 用潜水艇攻击
vi. 在下疾行, 在下滑动
examples: A submarine can travel over and under the water.
This submarine can dive more than a mile deep.

defsEn: the material of which something is made (a solid, liquid or gas)
zh: n. 物质, 实质, 主旨, 资产, 本质, 牢固
examples: The substance is light enough to float on the water.
There is no substance in his speech.
exampleZh: 这种物质很轻，可以浮在水面上。
他言之无物。

defsEn: to put or use in place of another
n. a person or thing put or used in place of another
zh: n. 代理, 代理人, 代用品, 代替者, 代替物
vt. 代替
vi. 替代, 取代, 代用
a. 代替的, 代用的, 代用品的
examples: Then I'll work on the principle that deference is no substitute for obedience.
We should substitute alcohol for oil.
exampleZh: 那我就恭敬不如从命啦。

defsEn: an attempt to weaken or destroy a political system or government, usually secretly
zh: n. 颠覆, 打倒, 破坏
examples: May we never confuse honest dissent with disloyal subversion.

defsEn: to reach a goal or thing desired
to produce a planned result
zh: vi. 成功, 继承, 继续
vt. 继承, 接替
examples: He wanted to succeed, even at the cost of his health.
If it were not for your help, I could not succeed.
exampleZh: 他想要成功，即使是以他的健康作为代价。
没有你的帮忙，我无法达成。

defsEn: of this or that kind
of the same kind as
similar to
zh: a. 如此的, 这样的
examples: Such a teacher may as well retire from his work.
Such being the case, I can not go with you.
exampleZh: 像那样的老师还是别干了比较好。
这样的话我不能和你一起去。

defsEn: not expected
without warning
done or carried out quickly or without preparation
zh: n. 突然, 忽然
a. 突然的, 意外的, 快速的
examples: There was a sudden drop in the temperature last night.
All of a sudden the sky became dark.
exampleZh: 昨天晚上气温突然下降
天空突然变暗了。

defsEn: to feel pain in the body or mind
to receive or experience hurt or sadness
zh: vt. 遭受, 经历, 忍受
vi. 受痛苦, 受损害
examples: He suffered from a bad accident.
The company suffered a loss of one billion yen last year.
exampleZh: 他遭遇了一场严重的意外。
那家公司去年亏损了10亿日元。

defsEn: a sweet substance made from liquids taken from plants
zh: n. 糖, 糖块, 甜言蜜语
vt. 加糖于, 使甜蜜, 粉饰, 美化
vi. 制成糖
examples: How much sugar should I put in your coffee?
Do you take sugar in your tea?
exampleZh: 我应该往你的咖啡里放多少糖呢？
你喝茶搁糖吗？

defsEn: to offer or propose something to think about or consider
zh: vt. 提议, 建议, 促成, 暗示, 启发, 使人想起
examples: I suggest you turn around and go back home.
How do you suggest we go about it?
exampleZh: 我建议你转身回家。
你觉得我们应该怎么处理？

defsEn: the act of killing oneself
zh: n. 自杀, 自杀者
v. 自杀
a. 自杀的
examples: He committed suicide by taking poison.
I heard that Tom attempted suicide.
exampleZh: 他服毒自杀了。
我听说汤姆自杀没成。

defsEn: the warmest time of the year, between spring and autumn
zh: n. 夏季, 全盛时期
vi. 避暑, 过夏天
examples: I like summer better than winter.
In summer, I go to the swimming pool every day.
exampleZh: 我喜欢夏天胜于冬天。
夏天的时候，我每天都去游泳池。

defsEn: the huge star in the sky that provides heat and light to earth
zh: n. 太阳, 日, 日光, 阳光
vt. 晒
vi. 晒太阳
examples: Without the light of the sun, we could see nothing.
Without the sun, there would be no life.
exampleZh: 如果没有了阳光，我们就什么也看不见了。
没有太阳就没有生命。

defsEn: to direct and observe the work of others
zh: v. 监督, 管理, 指导
examples: How will we supervise this project?
He wanted to supervise the situation.

defsEn: to give
to provide
n. the amount of something that can be given or sold to others
zh: n. 补给, 供给, 供应品
vt. 补给, 供给, 提供, 补充
vi. 替代
examples: Prices depend on supply and demand.
Where's the box the power supply came in?
exampleZh: 价格取决于供给和需求。
电源转接器的包装盒在哪里？

defsEn: to carry the weight of
to hold up or in position
to agree with others and help them reach a goal
to approve
zh: n. 支持, 支撑, 援助, 供养, 支撑物
vt. 支援, 支撑, 帮助, 支持, 忍受, 供养, 证实
examples: I have two children to support.
He has to support his mother and his sister.
exampleZh: 我需要养两个孩子。
他要供养他的妈妈和妹妹。

defsEn: to believe, think or imagine (“I suppose you are right.”)
to expect (“It is supposed to rain tonight.”)
zh: vt. 推想, 假设, 以为, 想像, 假定
vi. 料想
examples: I suppose he will be back soon.
What do you suppose this could be?
exampleZh: 我想他会很快回来的。
你认为这是什么？

defsEn: to put down or to keep down by force
to prevent information from being known publicly
zh: vt. 镇压, 使止住, 禁止, 抑制, 查禁
examples: Heathers help to suppress weeds in your garden.
Is France trying to suppress Algeria's development?
exampleZh: 石楠花有助于抑制花园里的杂草。
法国是在试图压制阿尔及利亚的发展吗？

defsEn: very probable
with good reason to believe
true without question
zh: a. 确信, 必然的, 必定的
adv. 当然, 确实地, 无疑地
examples: I sure could go for a cup of coffee.
Make sure you get plenty of rest.
exampleZh: 我想要杯咖啡。
你务必要好好地休息。

defsEn: the outer side or top of something (“The rocket landed on the surface of the moon.”)
zh: n. 面, 表面, 水面, 外表, 平面
a. 表面的, 外观的, 肤浅的, 水面上的
vt. 使成平面, 使浮出水面
vi. 浮出水面, 呈现, 在地面上工作
examples: The surface of the object is fairly rough.
A fallen leaf floated on the surface of the water.
exampleZh: 这件物件的表面颇为粗糙。
水面浮着一片落叶。

defsEn: an amount that is more than is needed
extra
(“That country has a trade surplus. It exports more than it imports.”)
zh: n. 剩余, 过剩, 盈余
a. 过剩的, 剩余的
examples: Our surplus has swelled by nearly ten percent in this quarter.
We will refund you the surplus amount.
exampleZh: 我们公司今季的赤字上涨了差不多一成。

defsEn: to cause a feeling of wonder because something is not expected
n. something not expected
the feeling caused by something not expected
zh: n. 惊奇, 奇袭, 诧异
vt. 使惊奇, 撞见, 奇袭
examples: I have a surprise for you.
Her surprise was so great that she could not speak.
exampleZh: 我带了一个惊喜给你。
她惊讶得说不出话来。

defsEn: to form a circle around
to be in positions all around someone or something
zh: vt. 包围, 环绕, 围绕
n. 围绕物
examples: The garden was surrounded by a wooden fence.
The surrounding area was very quiet.
exampleZh: 花园被木栅栏围了起来。
周围的地区非常安静。

defsEn: to remain alive during or after a dangerous situation
zh: vt. 比...活得长, 生存, 生还, 幸免于
vi. 活下来, 幸存
examples: I had to do that to survive.
I once hoped that my mother would survive until I got married.
exampleZh: 我不得不这么做以维生。
我曾经希望我妈妈能活到我结婚的时候。

defsEn: to imagine or believe that a person is guilty of something bad or illegal
n. a person believed to be guilty
zh: n. 被怀疑者, 嫌疑犯
a. 令人怀疑的, 不可信的, 可疑的
v. 怀疑, 猜想
examples: I suspect that Tom will never agree to do that.
We suspect him of telling a lie.
exampleZh: 我怀疑汤姆永远不会同意那样做。
我们怀疑他在说谎。

defsEn: to cause to stop for a period of time
zh: vt. 悬, 吊, 使悬浮, 暂停, 中止, 推迟
vi. 暂停, 中止, 悬浮, 停止偿付债务
examples: The lamp was suspended from the branch of a tree.
We reserve the right to suspend any account that violates our terms of use.
exampleZh: 灯笼在树枝上吊着。

defsEn: to take into the stomach through the mouth
zh: n. 燕子, 吞咽, 喉
vt. 咽, 淹没, 吞没, 耗尽, 轻信, 忍受, 抑制
vi. 吞下, 咽下
examples: Many swallows will come soon from the south.
In the autumn, swallows will fly south.
exampleZh: 许多燕子不久就要从南方飞来了。
秋天的时候，燕子会往南飞。

defsEn: tasting pleasant, like sugar
zh: n. 甜蜜, 糖果, 情人
a. 甜的, 芳香的, 悦耳的, 漂亮的, 和蔼的, 不咸的, 灵活的, 轻快的
examples: I will eat sweet and sour spareribs tonight.
Share out the sweets between you.
exampleZh: 今天晚上吃糖醋排骨。
你们分了这些糖果吧。

defsEn: to move through water by making motions with the arms and legs
zh: n. 游泳, 漂浮, 潮流, 眩晕
vi. 游泳, 游, 漂浮, 浸, 覆盖, 充溢, 大量拥有, 旋转, 眩晕
vt. 游过, 使浮起
examples: As a boy, I used to swim in the pond.
How long would it take to swim across the river?
exampleZh: 我还是个小男孩时常去池塘游泳。
游过这条河要多久？

defsEn: a sharing of feelings or emotions with another person, usually feelings of sadness
zh: n. 同情, 赞同, 怜悯, 慰问, 吊唁
examples: I feel no sympathy for Tom.
Everybody showed sympathy toward the prisoner.
exampleZh: 我不同情汤姆。
每个人都对囚犯表示同情。

defsEn: a method of organizing or doing something by following rules or a plan
a group of connected things or parts working together for a common purpose or goal
zh: n. 系统, 体系, 制度, 方式, 秩序, 分类原则
examples: The repair for the system malfunction lasted for an entire night.
Not all of us were satisfied with the system.
exampleZh: 系统故障的修复工作持续了一整个晚上。
我们没有人满意此系统。

defsEn: to put a hand or hands around something and hold it, often to move it to another place
to carry something
to seize
to capture
to begin to be in control (“The president takes office tomorrow.”)
zh: vt. 拿, 取, 抓, 带领, 获得, 就座, 接受, 吃, 吸引, 采取, 乘, 需要, 花费
vi. 吃掉对方棋子, 抓住, 起作用, 依法获得财产
n. 拿, 取, 收成, 奏效
examples: I think I will take a vacation this week.
Why should I take the time to do that?
exampleZh: 我觉得我这个星期要度假了。
我凭什么花时间做这事？

defsEn: to express thoughts in spoken words
n. a meeting for discussion
zh: n. 谈话, 交谈, 会谈, 讲话, 演讲, 空谈, 谣言, 方言, 语言
vi. 讲话, 演讲, 说话, 谈话, 交流, 闲聊, 说闲话
vt. 讲, 说, 讨论, 谈论
examples: Look at me when I talk to you!
I think we should talk about this now.
exampleZh: 我跟你说话的时候看着我！
我看我们现在就该谈谈这事。

defsEn: higher than others
opposite short
zh: a. 高的, 长的, 夸大的
adv. 夸大地
examples: The tall man left in a hurry.
She saw a tall man yesterday.
exampleZh: 高的男人匆匆地走了。
她昨天看见一个高大的男人。

defsEn: a large container for holding liquids
a heavy military vehicle with guns
zh: n. 槽, 箱, 柜, 罐, 池塘, 储水池, 坦克
vt. 储于箱中
examples: The fuel tank in the car is full.
Keep the fish tank away from direct sunlight.
exampleZh: 汽车油箱是满的。

defsEn: any person or object aimed at or fired at
zh: n. 目标, 靶子, 指标
vt. 对准, 订指标
examples: No matter how low the target, always aim higher.
I aimed my gun at the target.
exampleZh: 无事掘小，小事掘大。
我把我的手枪指向了目标。

defsEn: to sense through the mouth (“The fruit tastes sweet.”)
zh: n. 味道, 品味, 味觉, 感受, 体验, 爱好, 审美, 少量
vt. 尝, 察觉...的味道, 体会
vi. 品尝, 察觉味道, 有某种味道
examples: Do you know the taste of thought?
The orange left a strange taste in my mouth.
exampleZh: 你知不知道思念的滋味？
橙子在我嘴里留下了一种奇怪的味道。

defsEn: the money a person or business must pay to the government so the government can provide services
zh: n. 税, 税款, 重负, 会费
vt. 课以税, 使负重荷, 斥责
examples: Tax cuts are often used as a major fiscal tool to stimulate the economy.
He wanted to reduce the tax on imports.
exampleZh: 减税常被用作刺激经济的主要财政手段。
他想要减少进口品的税。

defsEn: a drink made from the plant of the same name
zh: n. 茶, 茶叶
examples: Which would you rather have, tea or coffee?
Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?
exampleZh: 你喜欢喝茶；还是咖啡？
你比较喜欢哪一个，茶还是咖啡?

defsEn: to show how to do something
to provide knowledge
to cause to understand
zh: vt. 教, 讲授, 教导, 教育
vi. 教书, 教学, 可以教
examples: If you like, I will teach you to play chess.
I can teach you how to swim.
exampleZh: 你要是想学的话我可以教你下象棋。
我能教你怎样游泳。

defsEn: a group organized for some purpose, often for sports
zh: n. 队, 组
vt. 把马(牛)套在同一辆车上, 把...编成一组
vi. 驾驶卡车, 协作
examples: Which team do you think will win?
I like being on the team.
exampleZh: 你觉得哪支球队会赢？
我喜欢在队伍里。

defsEn: to pull apart, often by force
zh: n. 泪滴, 眼泪, 撕, 扯, 裂缝, 激怒, 飞奔
vi. 流泪, 撕破, 赶快, 飞奔, 被撕破
vt. 撕裂, 戳破, 拉掉, 撕掉, 使分裂, 使精神不安, 折磨
examples: To those who would tear the world down: we will defeat you.
They will tear down the old building in two days.
exampleZh: 那些想要颠覆这个世界的人们，我们将击败你们。
他们将在两天内拆除这栋旧的建筑物。

defsEn: involving machines, processes and materials in industry, transportation and communications
of or about a very special kind of subject or thing (“You need technical knowledge to understand how this system works.”)
zh: a. 技术上的, 专门的, 工业的, 严格根据法律的
examples: Do you have a technical diagram for this portion?
You should go on to a technical college.

defsEn: the use of scientific knowledge and methods to produce goods and services
zh: n. 技术, 工业技术, 术语
examples: Technology will make a lot of progress in the nineties.
What is the advantage of this technology?
exampleZh: 科技在 1990 年代会有很大进步吧。
这种科技的优势是什么？

defsEn: a device or system for sending sounds, especially the voice, over distances
zh: n. 电话, 电话机
v. 打电话
examples: Where can I get a telephone card?
I will telephone you later on.
exampleZh: 我在哪儿可以弄到电话卡？
我晚点打给你。

defsEn: a device for making objects that are far away appear closer and larger telescope
zh: n. 望远镜
vi. 叠缩, 嵌进, 缩短
vt. 使叠缩, 使缩短
examples: You can use a telescope to look at the stars.
My telescope can see Jupiter and its six moons.
exampleZh: 你可以用望远镜看星星。
我的望远镜可以看到木星和它的六个卫星。

defsEn: a device that receives electronic signals and makes them into pictures and sounds
the system of sending pictures and sounds by electronic signals over a distance so others can see and hear them on a receiver
zh: n. 电视
examples: Could you turn the television down a bit?
I watch television in the evening.
exampleZh: 把电视声音关小点好吗？
我在晚上看电视。

defsEn: to give information
to make known by speaking
to order
to command
zh: vt. 告诉, 说, 吩咐, 断定, 知道
vi. 讲述, 泄密, 告发, 表明
examples: You may as well tell me all about it.
Could you tell me what I have to do?
exampleZh: 你不妨告诉我一切。
你能告诉我该怎么做吗？

defsEn: the measurement of heat and cold
zh: n. 温度, 发烧, 热度
examples: I seem to have a temperature.
The temperature in different places can vary greatly at the same time of year.
exampleZh: 我好像发烧了。
不同的地方可以在同一时节有十分不同的温度。

defsEn: lasting only a short time
zh: a. 暂时的, 临时的
n. 临时工, 临时雇员
examples: They said the situation was only temporary.
Form is temporary, class is permanent.
exampleZh: 他们说情况只是暂时的。
形式是暂时的，等级才是永恒的。

defsEn: having fear or concern
dangerous
opposite calm
zh: a. 紧张的, 拉紧的
v. (使)紧张, (使)拉紧
n. 时态
examples: He was tense with his new business.
We use the present tense for this kind of case.
