exampleZh: 他对他的新业务感到紧张。

defsEn: a limited period of time during which someone does a job or carries out a responsibility (“He served two terms in Congress.”)
the conditions of an agreement that have been accepted by those involved in it
zh: n. 术语, 专有名词, 期限, 学期, 任期, 条件, 价钱, 关系, 地位, 项, 界石
vt. 称, 呼
examples: After all they came to terms with each other.
Would you explain it in simpler terms?
exampleZh: 最后他们互相达成了协议。
你能用更简单的话做解释吗？

defsEn: very bad
causing terror or fear
zh: a. 可怕的, 令人恐惧的, 极坏的
examples: I had a terrible dream last night.
Yesterday evening I had a terrible nightmare.
exampleZh: 昨晚我作了一个可怕的梦。
昨天晚上我做了恶梦

defsEn: a large area of land
zh: n. 领土, 领地, 版图, 地区, 活动范围
examples: They increased the territory of the empire.
China's territory is vast, thus the types of tea vary.
exampleZh: 他们扩阔了帝国的领土。
中国幅员辽阔,因而茶的品种繁多。

defsEn: extreme fear
that which causes great fear
zh: n. 恐怖, 可怕的人
examples: He could never forget the terror of war.
The real terror began about a week after that.

defsEn: a person who carries out acts of extreme violence as a protest or a way to influence a government
zh: n. 恐怖分子
examples: The USA is acting like a terrorist force in the Middle East.
One man's terrorist is another man's freedom fighter.
exampleZh: 美国在中东的行为如同恐怖主义势力。
一个人的恐怖分子为另人的自由战士。

defsEn: to attempt to learn or prove what something is like or how it will act by studying or doing (“The scientists will test the new engine soon.”)
n. an attempt to learn or prove what something is like or how it will act by studying or doing (“The test of the new engine takes place today.”)
a group of questions or problems used to find out a person’s knowledge (“The students did well on the language test.”)
zh: n. 测试, 试验, 化验, 检验, 考验, 甲壳
vt. 测试, 试验, 化验
vi. 接受测验, 进行测试
examples: I have to take the test again.
I have to take a test tomorrow.
exampleZh: 我必须再考一次试。
明天我必须参加考试。

defsEn: connecting word used to link things that may be similar, but are not equal (“My sister is taller than I am.”)
zh: conj. 比, 除...外
prep. 比

defsEn: to say that one has a good feeling toward another because that person did something kind (“I want to thank you for helping me.”)
zh: n. 谢意, 感谢
vt. 谢谢, 感谢
examples: Thank you very much for the wonderful dinner last night.
I thank you very much for your kindness.
exampleZh: 非常感谢您昨晚美妙的晚餐。
我十分感谢你的好意。

defsEn: showing the person, place or thing being spoken about (“That man is a soldier.”)
pro. the person, place or thing being spoken about (“The building that I saw was very large.”)
zh: a. 那, 那个
conj. 以致, 因为
pron. 那
adv. 那么, 那样

defsEn: used in front of a name word to show that it is a person or thing that is known about or is being spoken about
zh: art. 那

defsEn: a place where movies are shown or plays are performed
zh: n. 戏院, 电影院, 剧场, 全体观众, 戏剧, 戏剧效果, 阶梯式讲堂, 场所
examples: On my way to the theater I saw a traffic accident.
All of us went to the theater to see a play.
exampleZh: 在去剧院的路上，我看到了一起车祸。
我们所有的人都去剧院看戏。

defsEn: other people being spoken about
zh: pron. 他们, 她们, 它们

defsEn: at that time
existing
and so
zh: adv. 然后, 当时
conj. 然后, 当时
n. 那时

defsEn: a possible explanation of why something exists or how something happens using experiments or ideas, but which is not yet proven (“Other scientists are debating his theory about the disappearance of dinosaurs.”)
zh: n. 理论, 学说, 原理, 意见, 推测
examples: Theory and practice should go hand in hand.
This theory is too difficult for me to comprehend.
exampleZh: 理论得联系实际。
这个理论对我来说太难了，理解不了。

defsEn: in that place or position
to or toward that place
zh: adv. 在那里

defsEn: of or about the people, places or things nearby that have been spoken about already
zh: pron. 这些
examples: Some of these people look a lot like each other.
Some of these people look really similar to each other.
exampleZh: 这些人当中有些长得很像。
这些人里面有些长得很像。

defsEn: those ones being spoken about
zh: pron. 他们, 它们

defsEn: having a large distance between two opposite surfaces (“The wall is two meters thick.”)
having many parts close together (“The forest is very thick.”)
almost solid, such as a liquid that does not flow easily
opposite thin
zh: a. 厚的, 粗壮的, 浓的, 迟钝的, 浑浊的, 多雾的, 过分的, 口齿不清的
adv. 厚地, 密地, 浓浓地
n. 最浓处, 最厚处, 最密集处
examples: Due to the thick fog, the road was difficult to see.
Because of the thick fog, the road was hard to see.
exampleZh: 因为大雾所以看不清道路。
因为大雾所以看不清道路。

defsEn: having a small distance between two opposite surfaces
not fat
not wide
opposite thick
zh: a. 薄的, 细的, 瘦的, 稀疏的, 稀薄的, 淡的, 弱的, 空洞的
vt. 使变薄, 使变细, 使稀少, 使淡
vi. 变薄, 变细, 变少, 变淡
adv. 薄地, 稀疏地, 微弱地
n. 细小部分
examples: If you want to become thin, you should cut back on the between-meal snacks.
She wore such thin clothes that she might well catch a cold.
exampleZh: 如果你想变瘦，就应该少点在正餐以外吃零食。
她衣衫单薄，恐会着凉。

defsEn: any object
zh: n. 事物, 东西, 物, 用品, 事, 事件, 情况, 行为, 特征
examples: You say one thing and then act just the opposite.
Things change from time to time, and one should change with them.
exampleZh: 你说一套做一套。
世事变幻无常，人不能因循守旧、一成不变。

defsEn: to produce thoughts
to form ideas in the mind
to consider
to believe
zh: vt. 想, 考虑, 想起, 想像, 打算, 认为
vi. 思考, 料想
n. 想法
a. 思想的
examples: I do not think there will be rain tomorrow.
Who do you think will win the gold medal?
exampleZh: 我不认为明天会下雨。
你们觉得谁会赢金牌？

defsEn: coming after two others
zh: num. 第三, 三分之一
examples: I wonder if a third world war will break out.
We live on the third floor.
exampleZh: 不知道第三次世界大战会不会爆发。
我们住在三楼。

defsEn: of or about the person, place or thing nearby that has been spoken about already
zh: pron. 这, 本
a. 这, 本
adv. 这么

defsEn: to warn that one will do harm or cause damage
zh: vt. 恐吓, 威胁, 预示...的凶兆
vi. 威胁, 恫吓, 可能来临
examples: He threatened to make it public.
No point in threatening me. I'll still tell you nothing.
exampleZh: 他威胁要公开。
威胁我也没用，我什么都不会说的。

defsEn: in at one end and out at the other
from front to back
from top to bottom
with the help of
by
zh: adv. 穿越, 从头至尾, 到底, 因为
prep. 经过, 穿过
a. 对穿的, 直达的, 完结的
examples: I must go through the task by tomorrow.
You must go through with your plan.
exampleZh: 我必须在明天之前完成任务。
你必须按照你的计划行事。

defsEn: to cause to go through the air by a movement of the arm
zh: vt. 投, 掷, 抛, 发射, 摔下, 匆匆穿上(或脱下), 抛弃, 摆脱
vi. 丢, 掷, 抛
n. 投掷, 掷骰子, 冒险
examples: I asked the boy to throw the ball back.
Throw the ball back to me.
exampleZh: 我请这个男孩把球扔回来。
把球丢还给我。

defsEn: to join or hold together with some material
n. anything that joins or unites
links or connections (“The two nations have strong trade ties.”)
zh: n. 带子, 线, 鞋带, 领带, 领结, 关系, 束缚, 平局, 不分胜负
vt. 系, 打结, 扎, 约束, 与...成平局
vi. 结合, 打结, 不分胜负
examples: Can you show me how to tie a tie?
They tied the thief to the tree.
exampleZh: 能教教我怎么打领带吗？
他们把小偷绑到了树上。

defsEn: that which is measured in minutes, hours, days and years
a period that can be identified in hours and minutes and is shown on a clock
a period when an event should or will take place
zh: n. 时间, 时侯, 时机, 时期, 期限, 次数, 节拍, 暂停, 规定时间
vt. 测定...的时间, 记录...的时间, 计时, 定时
a. 时间的, 记时的, 定时的, 定期的, 分期的
examples: I have no more time to talk with you.
Do we have time for another cup of coffee?
exampleZh: 我没时间再跟你说话了。
我们有时间再喝一杯咖啡吗？

defsEn: having less strength because of work or exercise
needing sleep or rest
zh: a. 疲累的, 疲乏的, 厌倦的
examples: The long walk through the city tired me out.
He must be very tired after a long walk.

defsEn: living material
a group of cells that are similar in appearance and do the same thing
zh: n. 薄的织物, 薄纱, 棉纸, 组织, 一套
examples: Human tissue is made up of cells.
Do you have a tissue for me?
exampleZh: 人体的组织是由细胞构成的。

defsEn: showing the direction of an action
showing the person or place toward which an action is directed
showing a goal or purpose
zh: prep. 到, 向, 趋于
adv. 向前

defsEn: this day
zh: n. 今天, 当今, 现在
adv. 今天, 当今
examples: Today no one can imagine a life without television.
Today we have a lot of food.
exampleZh: 今天没有人能想像一个没有电视的生活。
我们今天吃了很多饭。

defsEn: in one group
at the same time or place
in cooperation
zh: adv. 一起, 共同, 彼此
examples: I want us to do it together.
We get together once a year.
exampleZh: 我想让我们一起做。
我们一年聚一次。

defsEn: the day after today
zh: n. 明天, 未来
adv. 明天, 未来地
examples: Tomorrow, tomorrow, just not today - say all lazy people.
What do you want to do tomorrow?
exampleZh: 明天，明天，只是不是今天-所有的懒惰的人都这么说。
明天您想作什么？

defsEn: this night
zh: n. 今晚, 今夜
adv. 今晚, 今夜
examples: The weather forecast said tonight it will rain.
Could you call me tonight, please?
exampleZh: 听天气预报说今晚有雨。
今晚你能打电话给我吗？

defsEn: also
as well as
more than is necessary
zh: adv. 也, 非常, 太
examples: You will never be too old to learn.
We should not make too much of money.
exampleZh: 你永远不会太老而不能学习。
我们不应该把金钱看得太重。

defsEn: any instrument or device designed to help one do work tool
zh: n. 工具, 机床, 傀儡
vt. 用工具加工
vi. 使用工具
examples: You'll need a special tool to do it.
Put the pliers in the tool box.
exampleZh: 你会需要一个特殊的工具来做这件事。
把钳子放在工具箱里。

defsEn: the upper edge or surface
the highest part
the cover of something
zh: n. 顶部, 顶端, 极点, 上面, 上部, 顶篷, 最高地位, 首位, 陀螺
a. 最高的, 顶上的, 头等的
vt. 盖, 加以顶, 高达, 超越
vi. 结束, 达到顶点, 高出
examples: Put the book on the top shelf.
Look at the picture at the top of the page.
exampleZh: 把书放在最上面的架子上。
请看看页顶的图片。

defsEn: to cause severe pain
n. the act of causing severe pain in order to harm, to punish or to get information from
zh: n. 拷问, 苦闷
vt. 拷问, 曲解, 折磨, 使弯曲
examples: The cruelty of the torture in the police station is beyond description.
It was torture for him to see his girlfriend with another man.

defsEn: the complete amount
zh: a. 全体的, 总的, 全然的
vt. 计算...的总和, 共计为
vi. 合计
n. 总数, 全体, 合计
adv. 统统
examples: What he says is total nonsense.
What is the total amount of money you spent?
exampleZh: 他说的话不合情理。
你一共花了多少钱？

defsEn: to put the hand or fingers on
zh: n. 触觉, 碰, 触, 机灵, 轻触, 格调, 少许, 缺点, 弹力
vt. 接触, 触摸, 触及, 使接触, 达到, 涉及, 影响到, 使轻度受害, 感动
vi. 触摸, 接近, 涉及, 提到
examples: How can I get in touch with you?
You can get in touch with him at his home tonight.
exampleZh: 我怎么联系你？
今晚你可以在他家联络到他。

defsEn: in the direction of
leading to
zh: prep. 向, 对于, 为了
a. 即将来临的, 进行中的
examples: They made their way toward the town.
Sunflowers always point towards the sun.
exampleZh: 他们往小镇方向去了。
向日葵总是面向太阳。

defsEn: a center where people live, larger than a village but not as large as a city
zh: n. 城镇, 市, 镇
examples: I would like to leave this town and never come back.
I go into town every weekend.
exampleZh: 我希望离开这个村子并且再也不要回来。
我每周末都会去市区。

defsEn: to buy and sell or exchange products or services
n. the activity of buying, selling or exchanging products or services
zh: n. 贸易, 商业, 交易, 生意, 职业, 顾客, 信风
vi. 进行交易, 做买卖, 经商, 对换, 购物
vt. 用...进行交换
examples: Do you want to trade our two sheep, one for another?
I traded in my old car for a new one.
exampleZh: 你想把我们的两只羊一换一吗？
我用我的旧车换了一辆新的。

defsEn: a ceremony, activity or belief that has existed for a long time
zh: n. 传说, 传统, 交付
examples: At nightfall I like following the tradition of taking a walk along the lakeside.
Many local traditions have fallen into decay in recent years.
exampleZh: 傍晚我喜欢沿着湖边散步。
近几年，很多当地的传统都衰败了。

defsEn: the movement of people, vehicles or ships along a street, road or waterway
zh: n. 交通, 通行, 运输, 交通量, 贸易, 交易, 交往, 通信量
vi. 交易, 做买卖
vt. 用...作交换
examples: You must be careful of the traffic when you cross the street.
After you get to the traffic lights, turn right.
exampleZh: 你横穿马路要小心。
到了红绿灯以后，往右拐。

defsEn: extremely sad
terrible
zh: a. 悲惨的, 悲剧的
examples: The family mourned the tragic death of their young child.
He lost his family in a tragic traffic accident.

defsEn: to teach or learn how to do something
to prepare for an activity
n. an engine and the cars connected to it that move along a railroad
zh: n. 火车, 列车, 行列, 长队, 一连串的后果, 顺序
vt. 训练, 教育, 对准
vi. 受训练, 锻炼
examples: How do I get to the train station?
How can I get to the train station?
exampleZh: 火车站怎么走？
请问火车站怎么走？

defsEn: to move goods or people from one place to another
zh: n. 运输, 运输工具, 激动, 狂喜, 流放犯
vt. 传送, 运输, 流放
examples: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.
This truck transports fresh food from Aomori to Tokyo.
exampleZh: 政府用直升机把物资送到了那个小岛。
这辆卡车从青森运输新鲜食品到东京。

defsEn: the act or business of moving goods or people
zh: n. 运输, 输送, 交通车辆
examples: The transportation in this city is very convenient.
What form of public transportation do you prefer?
exampleZh: 这个城市的交通方便得很。

defsEn: to catch or be caught by being tricked
to be unable to move or escape
n. a device used to catch animals
zh: n. 圈套, 陷阱, 诡计, 存水弯
vi. 设圈套, 设陷阱
vt. 诱捕, 诱骗, 抓住, 使受限制
examples: We set a trap to catch a fox.
I know how to set a trap.
exampleZh: 我们设了个陷阱来抓狐狸。
我知道怎么设陷阱。

defsEn: to go from one place to another, usually for a long distance
zh: n. 旅行, 游历, 行进
vi. 旅行, 行进, 移动, 被传播
vt. 旅行, 通过, 使移动
examples: Do you often travel abroad on business?
I want to travel around the world.
exampleZh: 你经常去国外出差吗？
我想环游世界。

defsEn: the act of fighting against one’s own country or of helping its enemies
zh: n. 叛逆, 不忠, 叛国罪
examples: If this be treason, make the most of it.
This could be construed as an act of treason.

defsEn: a large collection of money, jewels or other things of great value
zh: n. 宝物, 财富
vt. 珍爱, 重视, 秘藏
examples: This ball is the treasure of that boy.
It happened that he found the treasure.
exampleZh: 这个球是那个男孩的宝贝。
他碰巧发现了宝藏。

defsEn: to deal with
to act toward in a special way
to try to cure
zh: n. 宴请, 款待
vt. 视为, 对待, 论述, 治疗, 款待
vi. 讨论, 谈判, 作东
examples: I treat you to a cup of coffee.
They treat me like a child.
exampleZh: 我请你喝杯咖啡。
他们把我当小孩。

defsEn: the act of treating
the use of medicine to try to cure or make better
zh: n. 治疗, 待遇, 处理
examples: You must complete the treatment until the end.
He asked her to give him preferential treatment.
exampleZh: 你必须坚持完成治疗。
他请求她给予优待。

defsEn: a written agreement between two or more nations
zh: n. 条约, 谈判
examples: The treaty was not a success.
The treaty will come into force at midnight.
exampleZh: 谈判没有成功。

defsEn: a very tall plant that is mostly wood, except for its leaves
zh: n. 树, 木料, 树状物
vt. 把...赶上树
examples: A big tree fell during the storm.
If trees could talk, what would they tell us?
exampleZh: 一棵大树在风暴中倒下了。
如果树木会说话，他们会告诉我们什么？

defsEn: an examination in a court of a question or dispute to decide if a charge is true
zh: n. 审判, 试验, 艰苦, 麻烦事, 考验
a. 审讯的, 试验性的
examples: The truth finally came out at his trial.
Through trial and error, he found the right answer by chance.
exampleZh: 在他的裁判下，真相终于大白。

defsEn: a group of families ruled by a common chief or leader
zh: n. 宗族, 部落, 一群人
examples: The Zulu tribe in South Africa has its own language.
Members of that tribe settled along the river.
exampleZh: 南非的祖鲁族人有着自己独特的语言。
部落成员沿着河岸定居了。

defsEn: to cheat
to fool a person so as to get something or make him or her do something
zh: n. 诡计, 欺诈, 谋略, 恶作剧, 习惯, 决窍
vt. 愚弄, 欺骗, 装饰
vi. 哄骗, 戏弄
a. 有决窍的, 特技的, 欺诈的, 漂亮的, 靠不住的
examples: The phone call was a trick to get him out of the house.
She would often play tricks on me.
exampleZh: 那通电话是引他离开房子的一个小把戏。
她常常开我的玩笑。

defsEn: a movement from one place to another, usually a long distance
zh: n. 旅行, 绊倒, 摔倒, 失足, 差错, 旅程
vt. 使跌倒, 使犯错, 使失败
vi. 轻快地走, 绊倒, 失误, 犯错, 结巴, 旅行, 远足
examples: She set out on a trip last week.
The trip will take at least a week.
exampleZh: 她上周去旅行了。
这次旅行至少得花一星期时间。

defsEn: a number of soldiers in a large controlled group
zh: n. 军队, 装甲部队, 骑兵队, 部队
examples: The troops soon put down the rebellion.
The troops easily put down the rebellion.

defsEn: that which causes concern, fear, difficulty or problems
zh: n. 烦恼, 麻烦, 困难, 动乱, 故障
vt. 困扰, 麻烦, 使烦恼, 折磨
vi. 烦恼, 费心
examples: If you have any trouble, please speak up.
The lie got him in trouble when his boss found out the truth.
exampleZh: 有什么事就请直说吧。
当他的上司察觉他的谎言，麻烦来了。

defsEn: a temporary halt in fighting agreed to by all sides involved
zh: n. 停战, 休战
vi. 停战, 休止
vt. 以休战结束
examples: A truce if we stay; if we leave or advance, war.
Shall I report a truce or war?

defsEn: a heavy vehicle used to carry goods truck
zh: n. 卡车, 货车, 对...进行交易, 来往, 实物工资, (供应市场的)蔬菜, 废物, 废话
vt. 对...进行交易, 交往, 以卡车运输
vi. 驾驶卡车, 以物易物
examples: A truck was standing in the middle of the road.
A dog was run over by a truck.
exampleZh: 路中间有一辆卡车。
一条狗被卡车碾过。

defsEn: correct
not false
zh: a. 真实的, 正确的, 忠诚的, 可靠的, 纯粹的, 正式的
n. 真实, 准确
adv. 真实地, 准确地
examples: A true scientist would not think like that.
It may or may not be true.
exampleZh: 一个正确的科学家不会那样想。
这可能是真的，可能不是。

defsEn: to believe that someone is honest and will not cause harm
zh: n. 信任, 信赖, 相信, 受托, 职责, 信心, 托拉斯
a. 信托的, 托拉斯的
vt. 信赖, 信任, 相信, 盼望, 赊卖给
vi. 相信, 信赖, 依靠
examples: Never trust a woman with a pistol in hand.
You can trust him to keep his word.
exampleZh: 千万别相信一个手里拿手枪的女人。
你可以相信他会信守诺言。

defsEn: to make an effort
to take court action against a person to decide if he or she is guilty or innocent of a crime
zh: n. 尝试, 试验, 审理, 审判
vt. 试, 尝试, 试验, 考验, 审问, 提炼
vi. 尝试, 试图
examples: Try not to think about her all the time.
You should try to learn a little French.
exampleZh: 你最好别总去想她。
你应该试试学点法语。

defsEn: a long, round structure through which liquids or gases can flow
a long, thin container in which they can be kept
zh: n. 管, 软管, 隧道
vt. 把...装管, 使通过管子
examples: Does the tube train stop at the next station?
Londoners call the subway "The Tube."
exampleZh: 地铁会在下一站停吗？
伦敦人把捷运叫做「The Tube」

defsEn: to change direction
to move into a different position
to change color, form or shape
zh: n. 转弯, 转动, 旋转, 翻转, 一圈, 顺次, 改动, 变化, 性格, 特色, 形状, 转折
vt. 使旋转, 转弯, 转动, 使转向, 驱赶, 阻挡, 兑换, 改写, 使作对, 绕过, 使流通
vi. 转动, 转弯, 转向, 翻转, 回转, 改变, 转身, 变成, 变质, 晕眩, 易脱手
examples: Turn back if you want to see her.
Turn here to get on the subway.
exampleZh: 如果你想见她就回头。
你到这儿拐弯角上去坐地铁。

defsEn: below
below the surface of
less than
as called for by a law, agreement or system (“The river flows under the bridge.” “Such action is not permitted under the law.”)
zh: prep. 在...之下, 低于
a. 下面的, 从属的
adv. 在下面

defsEn: to know what is meant
to have knowledge of
zh: vt. 理解, 了解, 领会, 听说, 懂
vi. 懂得, 认为
examples: I would like to understand your home country.
You understand best how to use the machine.
exampleZh: 我希望了解您的国家。
你最会操作这台机器了。

defsEn: to join together
zh: vi. 联合, 接合, 混合
vt. 使联合, 统一, 使粘合, 使结合
examples: Workers of the world - unite!
When man and woman unite, work is no longer as tiring.
exampleZh: 全世界无产者，联合起来！
男女搭配，干活不累。

defsEn: all of space, including planets and stars
zh: n. 宇宙, 星系, (思想等)范围
examples: How many galaxies are there in the universe?
Can we understand the universe through the mind alone?
exampleZh: 宇宙里有多少个星系呀？

defsEn: a place of education that usually includes several colleges and research organizations
zh: n. 大学
examples: What do you want to do in university?
Today I went to university to study. Tomorrow I will go again.
exampleZh: 你想在大学里做什么?
我今天去大学读书，明天我会再去。

defsEn: except if it happens
on condition that (“I will not go, unless the rain stops.”)
zh: conj. 除非
prep. 除...之外
examples: I never drink unless there's a big event of some kind.
I will not believe it unless and until he tells me so.
exampleZh: 除非是大活动，否则我是从不喝酒的。
除非他亲口对我说，否则我决不相信。

defsEn: up to a time
before
zh: prep. 直到, 在...以前
conj. 直到...时, 在...以前
examples: Please wait until the end of this month.
Wait for me until I write you.
exampleZh: 本月结束之前请等待。
等我一到就写信给你。

defsEn: to, in or at a higher position or value
zh: a. 向上的, 起床的, 涨的
adv. 向上, 上涨
prep. 在...上面, 向...的较高处

defsEn: to advise strongly
to make a great effort to get someone to do something
zh: n. 冲动, 推动力, 迫切的要求
vt. 驱策, 力劝, 竭力主张, 推动
vi. 强烈要求
examples: I urge you to tell him the truth.
Lawyers will urge the parents to take further legal action.
exampleZh: 我劝你告诉他实话。
律师们会力劝家长们采取进一步的法律行动。

defsEn: needing an immediate decision or action
zh: a. 紧急的, 急迫的, 催逼的
examples: I have an urgent message from Tom.
There is an urgent message for you.
exampleZh: 我收到汤姆的一条紧急消息。
你有一个紧急的讯息。

defsEn: the form of the word “we” used after a preposition (“He said he would write to us.”) or used as an object of a verb (“They saw us yesterday.”)
zh: pron. 我们

defsEn: to employ for a purpose
to put into action
zh: n. 使用, 习惯, 使用价值, 用法, 使用权
vt. 使用, 利用, 运用, 耗费
vi. 惯常
examples: If you want to, you can use my car.
We use a lot of water every day.
exampleZh: 如果你愿意，你可以用我的车。
我们每天用很多的水。

defsEn: as is normal or common
as is most often done, seen or heard
zh: a. 平常的, 通常的
examples: You cannot solve this problem with the usual method.
As usual, he placed the key on the table.
exampleZh: 这个问题不能以常规方法解决。
他习惯性地将钥匙放在了桌子上。

defsEn: a holiday
a period of time for travel, pleasure or rest, especially one with pay given to an employee
zh: n. 假期, 休假
examples: I go on vacation next week.
When I go on vacation, I'll rent a car.
exampleZh: 下周我去度假。
去度假的时候我要租辆车。

defsEn: a substance containing killed or weakened organisms given to a person or animal to produce protection against a disease
zh: n. 牛痘苗, 疫苗
a. 疫苗的, 牛痘的
examples: I haven't had the vaccine for Coronavirus.
Can the flu vaccine cause the flu?
exampleZh: 我没有接种过冠状病毒疫苗。

defsEn: a long area of land between higher areas of land
zh: n. 山谷, 溪谷, 流域, 凹地
examples: A beautiful valley lies behind the hill.
We went down to the valley where the village is.
exampleZh: 小山后面有个美丽的山谷。
我们下到山谷里，那里有个村庄。

defsEn: the quality of being useful, important or desired
the amount of money that could be received if something is sold
zh: n. 价值, 价格, 购买力, 评价, 估价, 计算结果
vt. 评价, 估价, 重视
examples: Do you know the value of fear?
The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.
exampleZh: 你知道恐惧的价值吗?
钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。

defsEn: a plant grown for food
zh: n. 蔬菜, 植物, 无精打采之人
a. 蔬菜的, 植物的
examples: What vegetable do you like best?
What do you call this vegetable in English?
exampleZh: 你最喜欢什么蔬菜？
这种蔬菜英语叫什么名字？

defsEn: anything on or in which a person or thing can travel or be transported, especially anything on wheels
a car or truck
zh: n. 交通工具, 车辆, 传播媒介
examples: The number of vehicles driving in the city has increased.
Edmundo threw Rima off the vehicle.
exampleZh: 在城市里行驶的车辆数量增加了。
埃德蒙多把里玛从车上推下去了。

defsEn: the form of something with different details than earlier or later forms
zh: n. 一种描述, 版本, 译文
examples: They gave different versions of the accident.
The modernized version of the qipao is noted for accentuating the female figure.
exampleZh: 人们对于这场事故有很多种说法。
现代版旗袍因能突显女人的身材而闻名。

defsEn: extremely (“He was very late.”)
zh: a. 真正的, 恰好的, 十足的, 特有的
adv. 非常, 完全
examples: This plan will be very expensive to carry out.
This book will be very useful to us.
exampleZh: 这计划执行起来花销会很大。
这本书会对我们有很大用处。

defsEn: to reject or refuse to approve
zh: n. 否决权
vt. 否决, 禁止
examples: I have no authority to veto it.
The president made use of his veto.

defsEn: someone or something that is injured, killed or made to suffer
someone who is tricked
zh: n. 受害人, 牺牲者, 牺牲品
examples: Who would be its next victim?
She is the victim of this incident.
exampleZh: 谁会是下一个受害者?
她是这件事的受害者。

defsEn: a success in a fight or competition
zh: n. 胜利, 战胜, 克服
examples: Both victory and defeat are but an everyday occurrence to a soldier.
They congratulated us on our victory.
exampleZh: 胜败是兵家常事。
他们祝贺我们的胜利。

defsEn: a method of recording images and sound without a traditional film camera to be shown on a television, computer or other device
zh: n. 影像, 电视
a. 图像的, 电视的
examples: Would you like to play video games?
She was absorbed in the video.
exampleZh: 你想要电玩吗？
她迷上了视频。

defsEn: a very small town
zh: n. 村庄
a. 乡村的, 村庄的
examples: Our city used to be a village.
To my surprise, there were no people in the village.
exampleZh: 以前我们的城市还是一个村庄。
奇怪的是，村子里竟然一个人也没有。

defsEn: to fail to obey or honor
to break (an agreement)
zh: vt. 违犯, 亵渎, 违反, 侵犯, 妨碍
examples: I will never violate a law again.
I'll never violate a law again.
exampleZh: 我不会再违法了。
我不会再违法了。

defsEn: the use of force to cause injury, death or damage
zh: n. 猛烈, 暴力, 暴虐, 暴行
examples: Violence is the cancer of our society.
Victory attained by violence is tantamount to a defeat, for it is momentary.
exampleZh: 暴力是社会的癌症。
靠武力取胜，犹如落败，因为这样的胜利不会长久。

defsEn: a kind of organism that causes disease
zh: n. 病毒, 滤过性病毒, 毒害
examples: Tom got a computer virus while he was watching videos on dubious Internet sites.
Ebola is one of the most virulent viruses known to man.
exampleZh: 汤姆在可疑的网站上看视频的时候中了电脑病毒。
埃博拉是人类已知的最致命的病毒之一。

defsEn: the official permission given to a person to enter a country where he or she is not a citizen
zh: n. 签证
vt. 签发
examples: I beg you, give me a visa.
How long is this visa good for?
exampleZh: 拜托您，请给我一张签证。
这个签证的有效期限是多久?

defsEn: to go to or come to a place for a short time for friendly or business reasons
zh: n. 拜访, 访问, 游览, 视察
vt. 拜访, 访问, 参观, 视察, 降临
vi. 访问, 参观, 闲谈
examples: We will visit our teacher next week.
You can visit me whenever you want.
exampleZh: 下周我们要去看望我们的老师。
只要你喜欢，你随时可以来我家。

defsEn: the sound made by creatures, especially humans, for speaking
zh: n. 声音, 嗓音, 嗓子, 愿望, 发言权, 表达, 喉舌, 语态
vt. 表达, 吐露, 调音
examples: You sing with a voice as clear as the waters of the Pacific Ocean.
To my surprise, he had a beautiful voice.
exampleZh: 你的歌声清澈如太平洋的海水。
他的歌声出乎意料之外地好听。

defsEn: a hill or mountain around a hole in the earth’s surface that can explode, sending hot, melted rock and ash into the air
zh: n. 火山
examples: I want to see a volcano.
We sat, as it were, on a volcano.
exampleZh: 我想看火山！
我们如同坐在火山口上。

defsEn: a person who chooses to do something without being asked, usually without being paid
zh: n. 志愿者
a. 志愿的
v. 自愿
examples: Tom was the first person to volunteer.
The babies are taken care of by volunteers.
exampleZh: 汤姆是第一个志愿参与的人。
婴儿被志愿者们照顾着。

defsEn: to choose a candidate in an election
n. a choice or decision expressed by the voice, by hand or by writing
zh: n. 投票, 选举, 选票, 表决, 选举权, 得票数
vi. 投票, 选举
vt. 投票选举, 投票决定, 公认, 使投票
examples: Who will you vote for for president?
For whom will you vote for president?
exampleZh: 你选谁当总统？
你选谁当总统？

defsEn: money received for work done
zh: n. 工资, 报酬, 薪金, 工钱, 报应, 报答, 年产额
examples: She asked for an increase in her wages.
Wages vary in relation to the age of the worker.

defsEn: to delay acting
to postpone
zh: n. 等待, 等候
vt. 等候, 期待, 延缓, 伺候, 推迟
vi. 等, 等候, 耽搁, 伺候用餐
examples: I would like to wait another half an hour.
When you get there, wait for a while.
exampleZh: 我想我们还要再等半个小时。
你到了以后等一会儿。

defsEn: to move by putting one foot in front of the other
zh: n. 走, 散步, 步行, 行走的路程, 竞走, 散步场所
vi. 走路, 步行, 处世
vt. 走过, 遛, 使走, 护送...走
examples: I used to take a walk every morning.
You walk too fast for me to keep up with you.
exampleZh: 我以前每天早上也会去散步。
你走得太快我跟不上。

defsEn: the side of a room or building formed by wood, stone or other material
a structure sometimes used to separate areas of land
zh: n. 墙, 墙壁, 垣, 内壁, 分界物, 屏障
a. 墙的
vt. 给...建墙, 禁闭, 用墙围住
examples: He hit the wall with his fist.
Hang that picture on the wall.
exampleZh: 他打了墙壁一拳。
把那幅画挂到墙上。

defsEn: to desire
to wish for
to need
zh: n. 需要的东西, 缺乏, 贫困, 需要
vt. 要, 希望, 应该, 缺少
vi. 生活困苦, 需要, 缺少
examples: I want to ask him for his phone number.
By what age do you want to get married?
exampleZh: 我想问他要电话号码。
你想到几岁才结婚呢？

defsEn: fighting between nations, or groups in a nation, using weapons
zh: n. 战争, 战争状态, 战术, 军事, 冲突, 斗争, 竞争
vi. 进行战争, 作战, 打仗, 战斗
a. 战争的, 战时用的
examples: War may break out at any moment.
We hope the war will end.
exampleZh: 战争随时可能爆发。
我们希望战争结束。

defsEn: almost hot
having or feeling some heat
zh: a. 暖和的, 暖的, 温暖的, 热烈的, 兴奋的, 激烈的, 多情的, 色情的
vt. 使温暖, 弄热, 使兴奋, 使充满仇恨
vi. 变暖和, 变温暖, 取暖, 激动, 同情, 爱好
n. 暖, 保暖物
examples: I want to eat warm soup.
It's warm for this time of year.
exampleZh: 我想喝点儿热汤。
对一年的这个时候来说，天气很温暖。

defsEn: to tell of possible danger
to advise or inform about something bad that may happen
zh: vt. 警告, 提醒, 通知
vi. 发出警告
examples: The teacher warned me not to be late for school.
She warned him not to go out at night alone.
exampleZh: 老师警告我不要上学迟到。
她警告他晚上不要一个人出去。

defsEn: to make clean, usually with water
zh: n. 洗, 洗涤, 冲洗, 洗的衣服, 冲积物, 洼地
vt. 洗, 洗涤, 洗清, 用水冲洗, 流过, 弄湿, 粉刷, 镀金属薄层于
vi. 洗涤, 洗澡, 被冲蚀, 漂浮
examples: How often do you wash your car a month?
Go and help wash up at the sink!
exampleZh: 你每个月洗几次车？
到洗涤槽去帮忙洗碗盘吧！

defsEn: to spend or use without need or care
to make bad use of
n a spending of money, time or effort with no value gained or returned
something thrown away as having no value
the liquid and solid substances that result from body processes and are passed out of the body
zh: n. 浪费, 废物, 损耗, 消耗, 荒地, 垃圾, 地面风化物
a. 废弃的, 荒芜的, 多余的
vt. 浪费, 消耗, 使荒芜
vi. 浪费, 消耗, 变消瘦
examples: In this way, we waste a lot of time.
You should not waste your time.
exampleZh: 这样的话我们会浪费很多时间。
你不该浪费你的时间。

defsEn: to look at
to observe closely
to look and wait for
zh: n. 观察, 手表, 看守, 守护, 监视, 值班人
vt. 看, 注视, 照顾, 看守, 守护, 监视
vi. 观看, 注视, 守侯
examples: Do you want to watch this TV programme?
Where would you like to go watch?
exampleZh: 你想看这个电视节目吗？
你想去哪里看看？

defsEn: the liquid that falls from the sky as rain or is found in lakes, rivers and oceans
zh: n. 水, 雨水, 海水, 水位, 水面, 流水
vt. 给...浇水, 供以水, 注入水, 使湿
vi. 流泪, 流口水, 加水
a. 水的, 水上的, 水生的, 含水的
examples: Without water, no one can survive on Earth.
Give me a glass of water, please.
exampleZh: 如果没有了水，没有人能够在地球上生存。
请给我一杯水。

defsEn: to move or cause to move one way and the other, as a flag in the wind
to signal by moving the hand one way and the other
n. a large mass of water that forms and moves on the surface of a lake or ocean
zh: n. 波, 波浪, 波动, 起伏, 高潮, 潮涌, 挥手致意, (气压)突变
vi. 波动, 飘动, 挥手示意, 起伏
vt. 使波动, 使飘扬, 挥舞, 使成波浪形
examples: A cold wave of fear hit me like a brick.
She waved her hand until the train was out of sight.
exampleZh: 一阵寒意像砖头一样击中了我。
她挥着她的手，直到火车消失在视线之外。

defsEn: a path on land or sea or in the air
how something is done
method
zh: n. 路, 路线, 路途, 方法, 道路, 情形, 规模, 习惯, 行业, 方面
adv. 远远地, 非常
examples: Will you tell me the way to his house?
I remember the way you used to dance.
exampleZh: 请问他家在哪里。
我记得你以前跳舞的方式。

defsEn: two or more people, including the speaker or writer (“He and I will go together, and we will return together.”)
zh: pron. 我们

defsEn: having little power
easily broken, damaged or destroyed
opposite strong
zh: a. 不牢固的, 弱的, 虚弱的, 软弱的, 无力的, 无权力的, (论据等)不充分的
examples: The weak are food for the strong.
Aunt Yoko is too weak to work.
exampleZh: 弱肉强食。
洋子阿姨的身体太虚弱了而无法工作。

defsEn: a large amount of possessions, money or other things of value
zh: n. 财富, 资源, 财产, 丰富, 富裕, 大量
examples: Because of his wealth, he was able to become a member of that club.
Even with all his wealth and fame, he's unhappy.
exampleZh: 由于他的财富，他能够成为这个具乐部的成员。
尽管有金钱和名誉，他还是不幸福。

defsEn: anything used to cause injury or to kill during an attack, fight or war
zh: n. 武器, 兵器
vt. 武装
examples: He used his umbrella as a weapon.
Sami dropped the murder weapon in a lake.
exampleZh: 他用他的雨伞当作武器。
萨米把凶器丢进湖里了。

defsEn: to have on the body, as clothes
zh: n. 穿着, 戴, 使用, 耗损, 服装, 耐久性
vt. 穿着, 戴, 留(须、发等), 呈现, 磨损, 磨成, 耗损, 使疲乏, 消磨
vi. 磨损, 变旧, 耐久, 渐变, 渐渐消失
examples: I always have to wear a tie because of my job.
I have no idea what to wear.
exampleZh: 因为这份工作的关系，我总是要打领带。
我不知道要穿什么。

defsEn: the condition of the atmosphere resulting from sun, wind, rain, heat or cold
zh: n. 天气, 气象, 处境
a. 迎风的
vt. 使受风吹雨打, 侵蚀, 使风化, 经受住
vi. 风化, 受侵蚀, 经受风雨
examples: I wonder what the weather will be like tomorrow.
Do you think the weather will be fine tomorrow?
exampleZh: 不知道明天天气会怎么样呢？
你觉得明天天气会变好吗？

defsEn: a period of time equal to seven days
zh: n. 星期, 周
examples: Hope this week will be good for all of you.
They will arrive a week from today.
exampleZh: 祝你们这一周都过得很好。
他们将于下个星期的今天抵达。

defsEn: to measure how heavy someone or something is welcome – v. to express happiness or pleasure weigh when someone arrives or something develops
zh: vt. 称...重量, 衡量, 把...压弯, 考虑, 权衡, 起锚
vi. 称分量, 有意义, 重压, 起锚
n. 过秤, 称分量
examples: He weighs a lot more than before.
Do you weigh more than Tom?
exampleZh: 他比以前重得多。
你有比汤姆重吗?

defsEn: in a way that is good or pleasing
in good health
n. a hole in the ground where water, gas or oil can be found
zh: n. 井, 泉水, 源泉, 好
v. 涌出
a. 健康的, 良好的, 适宜的, 恰当的
adv. 很好地, 适当地, 好意地, 很, 完全
interj. 好啦
examples: I get on very well with your cousin.
This book may well be useful to you.
exampleZh: 我与你的表亲相处甚好。
这本书对你有用。

defsEn: the direction in which the sun goes down
zh: n. 西方, 西部
a. 西方的, 向西的
adv. 向西, 自西方, 在西方
examples: A Mr West called in your absence.
The sun sets in the west.
exampleZh: 有个West先生在你不在的时候打过电话来。
太阳在西边落下

defsEn: covered with water or other liquid
not dry
zh: n. 湿气, 潮湿, 水分, 雨天
a. 湿的, 潮的, 搞错的, 下雨的, 反对禁酒的
vi. 变湿
vt. 使...湿
examples: He dried his wet clothes by the fire.
The road was wet from the rain.
exampleZh: 他在火旁烘干他的湿衣服。
这条路因为下雨所以是湿的。

defsEn: used to ask about something or to ask for information about something (“What is this?”)
ad which or which kind (“He wants to know what you would like to drink.”)
zh: pron. 什么
interj. 怎么, 多么
a. 什么的
adv. 到什么程度

defsEn: a grain used to make bread
the plant that produces the grain
zh: n. 小麦
examples: Can you tell wheat from barley?
You can recognize wheat by its market.
exampleZh: 你能辨别小麦和大麦吗？

defsEn: a round structure that turns around a center wheel
zh: n. 轮子, 车轮, 轮, 方向盘, 旋转, 机构, 重要人物
vt. 使旋转, 转动, 使转向
vi. 旋转, 转弯, 盘旋
examples: Tom fell asleep at the wheel.
The wheel began to roll slowly.
exampleZh: 汤姆趴在方向盘上睡着了。
轮子开始慢慢转动。

defsEn: at what time
at any time (“When will she come home?”)
conj during or at the time (“I studied hard when I was in school.”)
zh: conj. 当...的时候
adv. 何时, 什么时候
pron. 什么时侯
n. 时间

defsEn: , conj. at, to or in what place (“Where is his house?” “The house where he lives is in the old part of the city.”)
zh: adv. 在哪里
pron. 哪里
n. 地点

defsEn: if it be the case or fact that (“He did not know whether he was right or wrong.”)
zh: conj. 是否, 不论
pron. 两个中的哪一个
examples: Do you know whether or not it will rain tomorrow?
I do not know whether to accept or to refuse.
exampleZh: 您是否知道，明天会不会下雨？
我不知道是否该同意或拒绝。

defsEn: used to ask about what one or what ones of a group of things or people (“Which program do you like best?” “Which students will take the test?”)
zh: pron. 哪一个, 那一个

defsEn: a space of time (“Please come to my house for a while.”)
conj. at or during the same time. (“It may not be a good idea to eat while you are running.”)
zh: n. 一会儿, (一段)时间
conj. 当...的时候, 虽然
vt. 消磨
examples: While walking, I used to feel somewhat in a hurry.
I will call you in a while.
exampleZh: 以前，我散步的时候感觉有点匆忙。
我稍后会打电话给你。

defsEn: having the color like that of milk or snow
zh: n. 白色, 洁白, 眼白, 白种人, 蛋白
a. 白色的, 纯洁的, 白种的, 苍白的, 空白的, 幸运的
examples: I have a black and a white dog.
You look great in that white outfit.
exampleZh: 我有一只黑狗和一只白狗。
你穿那件白色的衣服很好看。

defsEn: what or which person or persons that (“Who wants to go?”)
the person or persons (“They are the ones who want to go.”)
zh: pron. 谁

defsEn: the complete amount
all together
not divided
not cut into pieces
zh: n. 全部, 全体, 整体, 完全之体系
a. 所有的, 完整的, 完全的, 纯粹的
examples: On the whole, I agree with her.
I feel a whole lot better today.
exampleZh: 我大致上同意她。
我今天感觉好多了。

defsEn: for what cause or reason (“Why did she do it?”)
conj. the reason for which (“I do not know why she did it.”)
zh: adv. 为什么
n. 原因, 理由

defsEn: having a great distance from one side to the other
not limited
zh: a. 宽的, 广阔的, 普遍的, 宽阔的, 广泛的, 一般的
adv. 广阔地, 遍及各处地, 广泛地
n. 大千世界
examples: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
What you say is quite wide of the mark.
exampleZh: 婚前张开眼，婚后半闭眼。
您说的话完全跑题了。

defsEn: a woman who is married
zh: n. 妻子, 太太, 夫人
examples: My wife asked me to throw this old hat away.
My wife told me to do away with this old hat.
exampleZh: 老婆叫我把这顶旧帽子丢掉。
老婆叫我把这顶旧帽子丢掉。

defsEn: living and growing in natural conditions and not organized or supervised by humans
angry
uncontrolled
zh: n. 荒野, 荒地
a. 野性的, 野蛮的, 野生的, 失控的, 任性的, 杂乱的, 轻率的, 狂热的, 疯狂的
adv. 狂暴地, 失控地
examples: Look out for the wild dog!
Wild animals live in the forest.
exampleZh: 小心那野狗！
野生动物住在森林里。

defsEn: a word used with action words to show future action (“They will hold talks tomorrow.”)
zh: n. 意志, 决心, 意愿, 意向, 干劲, 遗嘱
vt. 用意志的力量驱使, 决意, 愿意, 立遗嘱
vi. 下决心, 愿意
aux. 将, 愿意, 必须
examples: Who can tell what will happen in the future?
Will you be able to do that for us?
exampleZh: 谁能说将来会发生什么呢。
你能为我们做吗？

defsEn: being ready or having a desire to (“They are willing to talk about the problem.”)
zh: a. 乐意的, 自愿的, 甘愿的
examples: Would you be willing to fix it for me?
Would you be willing to do me a favor?

defsEn: to gain a victory
to defeat another or others in a competition, election or battle
zh: vt. 赢得, 打胜, 成功
vi. 获胜, 达到, 影响
n. 胜利, 赢, 收益
examples: He who would the daughter win, with the mother must begin.
I may win if I have luck.
exampleZh: 想要得到女儿，就必须从她母亲那儿开始努力。
如果我运气够好的话，说不定会赢。

defsEn: a strong movement of air
zh: n. 风, 气息, 气味, 呼吸, 风声, 趋势, 空谈, 卷绕, 弯曲
vt. 使通风, 嗅出, 使喘气, 吹号角, 上发条, 缠绕, 包, 绞起, 吊起, 使弯曲, 使迂回
vi. 嗅出猎物, 吹响号角, 卷曲, 蜿蜒, 迂回, 缠绕
examples: Winds from the sea are moist.
Chongqing is a hilly city with winding streets.
exampleZh: 从海洋吹来的风感觉湿漉漉的。
重庆是一座丘陵的城市，道路弯弯曲曲的。

defsEn: an opening in a wall to let in light and air, usually filled with glass window
zh: n. 窗户, 窗子, 窗口
vt. 给...开窗
examples: I want you to open the window.
I asked him to open the window.
exampleZh: 我要你把窗户打开。
我请他把窗户打开。

defsEn: the coldest time of year, between autumn and spring
zh: n. 冬季, 萧条期, 衰退期
a. 冬天的
vt. 使度过冬天
vi. 过冬
examples: In winter, I always need to add an extra quilt.
In winter I like to eat chocolate.
exampleZh: 冬天我总是需要多加条被子。
冬天的时候我喜欢吃巧克力。

defsEn: a long, thin piece of metal used to hang objects or to carry electricity or electronic communications from one place to another
zh: n. 电线, 电报, 电信, 铁丝网, 金属丝
vt. 用金属丝捆扎, 拍电报
vi. 打电报
examples: Is the wire live? I can tell just by touching it.
The puppets are controlled by wires.
exampleZh: 电线有没有电？我一摸就知道。
木偶由电线控制。

defsEn: having much knowledge and understanding
able to use knowledge and understanding to make good or correct decisions
zh: a. 明智的, 慎虑的, 聪明的, 博学的, 狡猾的, 机灵的
vi. 知道
vt. 教导, 告诉, 劝导
n. 方法, 方式
examples: A wise man would not say such a thing.
A word is enough to a wise man.
exampleZh: 一个聪明人不会说这种话。
对聪明人说话，一语即足。

defsEn: to want
to express a desire for
zh: n. 希望, 愿望, 祝愿, 命令, 请求
vt. 愿, 想要, 希望, 祝愿
vi. 希望
examples: I wish that we could spend more time together.
I wish you could come with us.
exampleZh: 我希望我们有更多时间呆在一起。
但愿你可以跟我们一起来。

defsEn: along or by the side of
together
using (“He fixed it with a tool.”)
having (“the house with the red door”)
zh: prep. 和...在一起, 以, 由于

defsEn: to take or move out, away or back
to remove
zh: vt. 撤回, 取回, 撤消, 使撤退, 拉开, 移开
vi. 撤退, 离开
examples: You may as well withdraw from the club right away.
Excuse me, can I withdraw some money?
exampleZh: 你还不如立刻退出这个具乐部。
不好意思，我可以取一点钱吗？

defsEn: with no
not having or using
free from
not doing
zh: prep. 没有, 不, 在...之外
adv. 在外面, 户外
n. 外面, 外部
examples: Without water, nothing could live on this earth.
I can do it without her help.
exampleZh: 没有水，没有东西能生活在这个地球上。
没有她的帮忙我也能做。

defsEn: a person who saw and can tell about an action or event, sometimes in a court of law
zh: n. 证人, 目击者, 证据, 证词
vt. 目击, 作证, 证明, 表明
vi. 作证人, 作为证据
examples: Can you put them on the witness stand?
Ziri change the name of the witness to keep his identity safe.

defsEn: an adult female human
zh: n. 女人, 妇女, 女仆
a. 女用的, 女性的, 妇女的
vt. 贬称...为女人, 使成女人腔
examples: A woman fell from a ship into the sea.
Must the woman always play the secondary role?
exampleZh: 有个女人从船上掉进了海里。
女性永远只能扮演次要角色吗？

defsEn: to ask oneself
to question (“She wonders if it is true.”)
n. a feeling of surprise
zh: n. 奇迹, 惊奇, 惊愕
vt. 惊奇, 想知道
vi. 惊讶, 怀疑
examples: I wonder if I can do it again.
I wonder what the weather will be tomorrow.
exampleZh: 我不知道我能不能再做一次。
不知道明天天气会怎么样呢？

defsEn: causing wonder
especially good
zh: a. 令人惊奇的, 奇妙的, 极好的
examples: It would be wonderful if you could sing at our wedding.
I saw a wonderful fall there.
exampleZh: 你能在我们的婚礼上唱歌就太好了。
我看见那儿有个很美的瀑布。

defsEn: the solid material of which trees are made
zh: n. 木材, 木制品
vt. 植林于, 给...添加木柴
vi. 收集木材
examples: My father cut wood with a saw.
There is a path through the wood.
exampleZh: 我父亲用一把锯子切木头。
有一个穿过树林的小路。

defsEn: one or more connected sounds that form a single part of a language
zh: n. 话, 消息, 词, 诺言, 命令
vt. 用言辞表达
examples: You can take her at her word on that.
I would like to have a word with you.
exampleZh: 这件事上你大可相信她的话。
我想和你谈谈。

defsEn: to use physical or mental effort to make or do something
n. the effort used to make or to do something
that which needs effort
the job one does to earn money
zh: n. 工作, 劳动, 职业, 行为, 功, 作品, 成果, 产品, 工程
vi. 工作, 劳动, 做, 运转, 起作用, 被加工
vt. 使工作, 使转动, 开动, 使用, 经营, 使逐渐变得, 造成
examples: Work hard so that you may earn your living.
We must work as long as we live.
exampleZh: 努力工作才能养活自己。
我们要活到老，做到老。

defsEn: the earth
the people who live on the earth
zh: n. 世界, 地球, 宇宙, 万物, 世人, 人间, 领域, 世事, 世故, 社会生活, 大量
examples: We will turn the world into a paradise.
When will the world come to an end?
exampleZh: 我们会把人间变成天堂。
世界末日是什么时候？

defsEn: to be concerned
to continue thinking that something, possibly bad, can happen
zh: n. 担心, 烦恼, 忧虑, 苦恼, 撕咬
vt. 使烦恼, 使焦虑, 使苦恼, 困扰, 折磨, 撕咬
vi. 烦恼, 担心, 撕咬
examples: You worry too much about your weight.
I think you worry too much.
exampleZh: 你太担心你的体重了。
你想太多了。

defsEn: more bad than
zh: n. 更坏的事, 更恶劣的事, 败局
a. 更坏的, 更恶劣的
adv. 更坏地, 更恶劣地
examples: The situation must be worse than you thought.
I thought that it would be worse.
exampleZh: 情况比您想的要严重。
我觉得会更糟。

defsEn: value measured in money
zh: n. 价值, 财产
a. 值...的, 值得的
examples: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
This painting is worth a great deal of money.
exampleZh: 一鸟在手胜过二鸟在林。
这幅画值很多钱。

defsEn: to injure
to hurt
to cause physical damage to a person or animal
n. an injury to the body of a human or animal in which the skin is usually cut or broken
zh: n. 创伤, 伤口, 伤疤, 伤害, 痛苦
vt. 伤害, 损害, 使受伤
vi. 打伤, 伤害
wind的过去式和过去分词
examples: The bandage was wound around the wound.
The wound will not stop bleeding.
exampleZh: 绷带把伤口包扎住了。
伤口流血不止。

defsEn: to damage greatly
to destroy
n. anything that has been badly damaged or broken
zh: n. 失事, 残骸, 破坏
vt. 使失事, 拆毁, 破坏
vi. (船)失事, 营救失事船只
examples: You're going to wreck your eyesight if you play games all the time.
They love to wreck the place on a regular basis.
exampleZh: 要是你老打游戏的话，你的视力会下降的。

defsEn: what remains of something severely damaged or destroyed
zh: n. 残骸, 失事, 破坏
examples: The wreckage of the plane was found in the desert.
Investigators will collect wreckage samples to determine the cause.

defsEn: to use an instrument to make words appear on a surface, such as paper write
zh: vt. 书写, 著述, 写, 写满, 写信给
vi. 写, 写字, 写信, 写作, 作曲
examples: Write to me as soon as you get there.
Please write down and give to me your personal address.
exampleZh: 你一到就写信给我。
请把您的个人地址写给我。

defsEn: not correct
bad
not legal
opposite right
zh: a. 错误的, 不正当的, 失常的
adv. 错误地
examples: Be careful not to drive the wrong way on a one-way street.
There's nothing wrong with not being tall.
exampleZh: 小心不要在单行道逆向行驶。
长不高不是坏事。

defsEn: a kind of radiation that can pass through most solid material, often used in medicine
zh: a. X射线的
vt. 用X光检查, 照X光
vi. 使用X光

defsEn: a period of time equal to twelve months
zh: n. 年, 年度, 年龄
examples: May the new year bring you happiness!
Tomorrow a new year will begin.
exampleZh: 祝你新年快乐！
明天新的一年就要开始了。

defsEn: having the color like that of gold or the sun
zh: n. 黄色
a. 黄色的
examples: The girl wore a yellow ribbon in her hair.
The door of the office is yellow.
exampleZh: 那女孩的头发上绑了一根黄丝带。
办公室的门是黄色的。

defsEn: used to express agreement or to permit
zh: adv. 是
n. 是, 同意
v. 同意
examples: Yes. She used to be a very shy girl.
Yes. I have to read it by tomorrow.
exampleZh: 对啊，她以前是一个很害羞的女孩。
是的。我明天必须读完。

defsEn: the day before today
zh: n. 昨天
adv. 昨天
examples: You should have told me yesterday.
Yesterday he saw a big man.
exampleZh: 你昨天就该告诉我了。
昨天他遇到了高大的男人。

defsEn: at some time before now (“Have they arrived yet?”)
now
at this time (“I cannot tell you about it yet.”)
conj. however (“The sun was shining, yet it was cold.”)
zh: adv. 还, 尚, 仍然, 已经, 然而
conj. 然而
examples: And yet, the contrary is always true as well.
And with me, we are yet one more.
exampleZh: 然而，相反的理论往往也是真的。
有了我，我们已经多一个人了。

defsEn: the person or persons being spoken to
zh: pron. 你, 你们

defsEn: in the early years of life
not old
zh: a. 年轻的, 无经验的, 朝气蓬勃的
n. 青年们, 幼小动物, 崽
examples: She saw a young man at the entrance.
Do young French people talk about politics too?
exampleZh: 她在入口看到一个年轻男人。
法国年轻人也谈政治吗？

defsEn: the number meaning none or nothing
zh: n. 零, 零点, 零度, 无, 乌有, 最低点
a. 零的, 没有的
vt. 调零, 对(炮火等)作协调校正
examples: The thermometer went down below zero.
Because of his score of zero, he didn't dare to return.
exampleZh: 温度计上的温度跌到了零度以下。
因为考了零分，所有不敢回去。

defsEn: a place where animals are kept for the public to look at and study
zh: n. 动物园
examples: Would you like to go to the zoo this afternoon?
My father took us to the zoo yesterday.
exampleZh: 今天下午你想去动物园吗?
爸爸昨天带了我们去动物园。
